domains.name: vessel
domains.description: Manages vessel traffic, scheduling, berthing operations, and marine movements including VTS coordination, anchorage management, ETA/ETB/ATA/ATD tracking, and vessel documentation. Covers vessel profiles (LOA, DWT, GRT, NRT, IMO number), port calls, berth allocation planning, voyage planning, and stowage plans. SSOT for all vessel-related operational data.

products.name: vessel
products.description: Master registry of all vessels calling at the port, including ownership and management hierarchy. Captures the authoritative vessel profile: IMO number, vessel name, flag state (FK to masterdata), vessel type (FK to masterdata), LOA, beam, draft, DWT, GRT, NRT, TEU capacity, call sign, MMSI number, classification society, P&I club, year built, shipyard, and current operational status. Ownership attributes: registered owner, technical manager, commercial operator (disponent owner), ISM company, ship manager, IMO company numbers, country of domicile, and management role types — tracked as SCD Type 2 for ownership change history. Supports ISPS compliance (CSO identification), PSC inspection records, commercial billing relationships, sanctions screening, and vessel risk profiling. SSOT for all vessel identity, static characteristics, and corporate hierarchy referenced across terminal, cargo, marine, and billing domains.

products.name: call
products.description: Core transactional record representing a single vessel visit to the port, from pre-arrival notification through departure. Captures: voyage number, POL, POD, ETA/ETB/ETD, ATA/ATB/ATD, call purpose (loading, discharge, bunkering, transit, lay-up, crew change), cargo type, total TEU/FEU declared, call status, VTS clearance reference. Agent appointment attributes: appointed agent company, agency type (general, husbanding, cargo, protective), appointment scope (single call, voyage series, annual), appointment dates, primary contact, and appointment status. Milestone timestamps: pilot boarded, first line, all fast, gangway down, cargo ops start/end, last line, pilot off. The primary operational anchor entity linking vessel movements to berth allocation, cargo operations, pilotage, towage, and billing. Supports SLA measurement, port call performance reporting (UNCTAD indicators), and agent coordination for document submission authority and billing address routing.

attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module; UN/EDIFACT BAPLIE Standard

attributes.name: call_number
attributes.description: Sequential port-assigned identifier for this specific vessel visit. Used as the business reference number for all port operations and billing.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: call_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the port call. Tracks progression from pre-arrival notification through departure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pre_arrival|expected|arrived|berthed|working|completed|departed|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: cargo_ops_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when all cargo loading or discharge operations were completed. Used for calculating working time and productivity.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: cargo_ops_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when cargo loading or discharge operations commenced. Used for calculating working time and productivity.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this port call record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: customs_clearance_status
attributes.description: Current status of customs clearance for this port call. Affects cargo release and vessel departure authorization.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); World Customs Organization (WCO)

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is carrying IMDG-classified dangerous goods during this call. Triggers additional safety and documentation requirements.

attributes.name: eta
attributes.description: Estimated timestamp when the vessel is expected to arrive at the port anchorage or pilot boarding station. Updated as voyage progresses.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module; Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS)

attributes.name: etb
attributes.description: Estimated timestamp when the vessel is expected to be secured alongside the berth and ready for cargo operations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: etd
attributes.description: Estimated timestamp when the vessel is expected to depart from the berth and leave the port.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: first_line_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the first mooring line was secured to the berth during berthing operations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: gangway_down_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the gangway was lowered and secured, allowing personnel access to the vessel.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Security Level
attributes.description: ISPS security level in effect during this port call (1=normal, 2=heightened, 3=exceptional). Determines security procedures and access controls.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: last_line_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the last mooring line was released during unberthing operations. Marks start of departure sequence.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this port call record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: pilot_boarded_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the marine pilot boarded the vessel to guide it into port. First milestone in the arrival sequence.
attributes.references: Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS); NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System

attributes.name: pilot_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the marine pilot disembarked after guiding the vessel out of port. Final milestone in the departure sequence.
attributes.references: Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS); NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System

attributes.name: pod
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the next port where cargo will be discharged after this call. Five-character code following UN/LOCODE standard.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: pol
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port where cargo was loaded prior to this call. Five-character code following UN/LOCODE standard.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: port_state_control_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vessel was selected for Port State Control inspection during this call. True if inspection occurred.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Primary reason for the vessel visit. Determines operational requirements and resource allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: loading|discharge|loading_discharge|bunkering|transit|lay_up|crew_change|repair|provisions — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or exceptions related to this port call.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: total_feu_declared
attributes.description: Total number of FEU declared for loading and discharge operations during this call. Used for capacity planning and billing.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: total_teu_declared
attributes.description: Total number of TEU declared for loading and discharge operations during this call. Used for capacity planning and billing.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: vts_clearance_reference
attributes.description: Reference number issued by VTS granting clearance for vessel movement within port waters. Required for compliance with ISPS and port regulations.
attributes.references: Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS); International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

products.name: voyage
products.description: Master record of a vessel voyage representing the commercial and operational journey between ports. Captures voyage number, voyage type (inbound, outbound, coastal, international), service route, shipping line service code, origin port, destination port, intermediate ports of call sequence, voyage start and end dates, and voyage status. Links to port calls at each port of call and supports stowage planning (BAPLIE), cargo manifest reconciliation, and freight billing. Distinct from port_call which represents the single-port visit event.
products.reference: Voyage Number / Shipping Line Service Voyage

attributes.name: voyage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the voyage record. Primary key for the voyage entity.

attributes.name: applicable_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.rate_card. Business justification: Service-level commercial agreements link entire voyages to negotiated rate cards. Shipping line services (identified by service_code, shipping_line_id) operate under contracted pricing for the rotatio

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Voyage profitability reporting requires each voyage to be tracked against a finance internal order for cost/revenue attribution. Maritime finance teams run voyage P&L reports by internal order. No exi

attributes.name: pilotage_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.pilotage_tariff. Business justification: voyage has pilot_required_flag indicating pilotage is anticipated. Pre-arrival proforma DA preparation requires the applicable pilotage_tariff for cost estimation. Shipping lines and port agents refer

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.port_community_participant. Business justification: Voyage billing, SLA tracking, and commercial reporting require linking each voyage to the operating shipping line's port community participant record. voyage.shipping_line_id references masterdata but

attributes.name: service_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vessel.service_route. Business justification: A voyage operates on a specific shipping line service route (liner service). voyage.service_code and voyage.service_name are denormalized STRING copies of service_route.service_code and service_route.

attributes.name: shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipping line or carrier operating this voyage. Links to the participant account representing the commercial operator responsible for the voyage.

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to terminal.terminal. Business justification: Voyage rotation planning and terminal capacity forecasting require linking each voyage to its calling terminal. Terminal operations teams use voyage-level data for advance resource allocation and thro

attributes.name: towage_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.towage_tariff. Business justification: voyage has towage_required_flag indicating towage is anticipated. Pre-arrival proforma DA preparation requires the applicable towage_tariff to estimate costs. Port agents and shipping lines use voyage

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel performing this voyage. Links to the vessel master data containing vessel profile, IMO number, LOA, DWT, GRT, NRT, and other vessel characteristics.

attributes.name: ata
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the vessel arrived at the port limits or pilot boarding station. Recorded by Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) and used for performance measurement and billing calculations.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention - Actual Arrival Reporting

attributes.name: atb
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the vessel was secured alongside the berth with first line ashore. Marks the start of berth occupancy time for billing and the commencement of cargo operations window.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations - Berth Occupancy Standards

attributes.name: atd
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the vessel departed from the berth with last line off. Marks the end of berth occupancy time for billing and the conclusion of the port call.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention - Actual Departure Reporting

attributes.name: baplie_received_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether the BAPLIE (Bayplan and Stowage Plan) EDI message has been received. BAPLIE contains the vessel's container stowage plan showing exact position of each container on board.

attributes.name: berth_productivity_target
attributes.description: The target container handling productivity rate for this voyage measured in container moves per hour. Used for terminal resource planning and SLA performance measurement.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Berth Planning - Productivity Standards

attributes.name: call_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating this port's position in the voyage's port call sequence. Used to order intermediate ports of call and support cargo routing logic.

attributes.name: cargo_manifest_received_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether the cargo manifest for this voyage has been received from the shipping line. Critical for customs clearance, cargo planning, and terminal readiness.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework - Advance Cargo Information

attributes.name: coparn_received_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether the COPARN (Container Pre-Announcement) EDI message has been received. COPARN provides advance notice of containers to be discharged and loaded.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this voyage record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_status
attributes.description: Current status of customs clearance for the voyage cargo. Pending indicates awaiting customs processing, cleared indicates all cargo approved for release, inspection_required indicates physical examination needed, hold indicates customs detention, released indicates cargo available for delivery.
attributes.references: WCO Revised Kyoto Convention - Customs Procedures

attributes.name: destination_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the voyage destination port. Five-character code identifying the final port of call for this voyage leg.

attributes.name: empty_teu_onboard
attributes.description: The number of empty containers onboard measured in TEU. Critical for empty container repositioning planning and depot management.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Container Classification and TEU Standard

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the voyage concluded at the destination port. Represents the actual or planned arrival date marking the end of the commercial voyage journey.

attributes.name: eta
attributes.description: The estimated timestamp when the vessel is expected to arrive at the port. Updated throughout the voyage based on vessel position, speed, and weather conditions. Critical for berth planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention - Estimated Arrival Reporting

attributes.name: etb
attributes.description: The estimated timestamp when the vessel is expected to berth at the assigned quay. Accounts for pilotage, towage, and berth availability. Used for terminal operations planning and gate scheduling.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations - Berth Planning Standards

attributes.name: etd
attributes.description: The estimated timestamp when the vessel is expected to depart from the berth. Based on cargo operations completion forecast, customs clearance, and next port schedule requirements.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention - Estimated Departure Reporting

attributes.name: imdg_cargo_onboard_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods) Cargo Onboard Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether the vessel is carrying dangerous goods as classified under IMDG Code. Triggers special safety protocols, segregation requirements, and emergency response planning.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code - Dangerous Goods Classification

attributes.name: is_maiden_call
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the vessel's first-ever call to this port. Maiden calls often receive special ceremonial recognition and may have different operational procedures.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations - Vessel Call Classification

attributes.name: is_omitted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this scheduled port call was omitted or skipped by the vessel. Used for schedule reliability analysis and customer service impact assessment.

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISPS (International Ship and Port Facility Security) Security Level
attributes.description: The ISPS security level applicable to this voyage. Level 1 is normal security, Level 2 is heightened security due to increased risk, Level 3 is exceptional security measures for imminent threat. Determines security protocols and access controls.
attributes.references: IMO ISPS Code - Maritime Security Levels

attributes.name: laden_teu_onboard
attributes.description: The number of laden (full) containers onboard measured in TEU. Used for cargo volume analysis and vessel utilization calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Container Classification and TEU Standard

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this voyage record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute value changes. Critical for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: next_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the next scheduled port of call after the current port. Critical for stowage planning (BAPLIE) and cargo routing decisions.

attributes.name: omission_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation for why a scheduled port call was omitted. Common reasons include weather delays, mechanical issues, insufficient cargo, port congestion, or schedule recovery actions.

attributes.name: oog_cargo_onboard_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: OOG (Out of Gauge) Cargo Onboard Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether the vessel is carrying out-of-gauge cargo that exceeds standard container dimensions. Requires special handling equipment and stowage planning considerations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Container Dimensions and OOG Classification

attributes.name: origin_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations) of the voyage origin port. Five-character code identifying the port where the voyage originated.

attributes.name: pilot_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether pilotage service is required for this voyage. Determined by vessel characteristics, port regulations, and pilotage exemption status.

attributes.name: previous_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port immediately preceding the current port call. Used for cargo manifest reconciliation and vessel movement tracking.

attributes.name: quarantine_status
attributes.description: Health quarantine status of the vessel and crew. Not_required indicates no health concerns, pending indicates awaiting health authority inspection, cleared indicates health clearance granted, restricted indicates quarantine measures in effect.

attributes.name: reefer_teu_onboard
attributes.description: The number of refrigerated containers onboard measured in TEU. Requires special handling, power supply monitoring, and temperature-controlled storage planning.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or additional voyage information not captured in structured fields. Used for inter-departmental communication and operational coordination.

attributes.name: rotation_number
attributes.description: Sequential rotation identifier within the service string. Used by shipping lines to track vessel position within a cyclical service route (e.g., rotation 1, rotation 2). Supports schedule adherence analysis.
attributes.references: Shipping Line Service Management - Industry Practice

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the voyage commenced from the origin port. Represents the actual or planned departure date marking the beginning of the commercial voyage journey.

attributes.name: total_teu_capacity
attributes.description: The total container capacity of the vessel for this voyage measured in TEU. Represents the maximum number of twenty-foot equivalent containers the vessel can carry.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Container Classification and TEU Standard

attributes.name: towage_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether tug assistance is required for berthing and unberthing operations. Based on vessel size, maneuverability, weather conditions, and port regulations.

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique voyage number assigned by the shipping line or port authority. This is the business identifier used in operational communications, manifests, and port call documentation.

attributes.name: voyage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the voyage. Planned indicates initial voyage planning stage, scheduled indicates confirmed berth and resource allocation, in_progress indicates vessel is actively executing the voyage, completed indicates voyage has concluded with vessel departure, cancelled indicates voyage was terminated before execution, delayed indicates voyage is behind schedule.

attributes.name: voyage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the voyage based on direction and scope. Inbound indicates arrival to the port, outbound indicates departure, coastal indicates domestic port-to-port movement, international indicates cross-border movement, feeder indicates short-sea collection/distribution service, and transshipment indicates cargo transfer voyage.

products.name: anchorage
products.description: Transactional record of a vessel anchorage assignment managed by VTS (Vessel Traffic Service). Captures anchorage area code, anchorage position (latitude/longitude), assigned anchor berth number, time of anchoring, expected time to weigh anchor, actual time of departure from anchorage, reason for anchorage (awaiting berth, awaiting tide, customs hold, bunkering, crew change), water depth at anchorage, and VTS officer assignment. Supports anchorage capacity management and vessel traffic sequencing.

attributes.name: anchorage_id
attributes.description: Primary key for anchorage

attributes.name: anchorage_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.anchorage_area. Business justification: Anchorage assignments must reference the physical anchorage area infrastructure for position management, ISPS security zone enforcement, VTS monitoring, and capacity planning. Current denormalized cod

attributes.name: applicable_port_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.port_tariff. Business justification: Anchorage assignments incur anchorage charges defined in port tariff schedules based on vessel size, duration, and anchorage area. While anchorage_charge_amount captures the result, the tariff referen

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Anchorage operations incur costs (VTS monitoring, coordination, safety oversight) allocated to marine services cost centres. Required for operational cost tracking, anchorage service costing, and reso

attributes.name: marine_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.marine_incident. Business justification: Marine incidents can occur during anchorage (dragging anchor, collision at anchor, pollution). Linking anchorage records to marine incidents enables incident investigation to reference the specific an

attributes.name: next_berth_id
attributes.description: Reference to the berth allocated for the vessel after departing anchorage. Links anchorage assignment to subsequent berth allocation.

attributes.name: port_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port call associated with this anchorage assignment. Links the anchorage to the vessel's overall port visit.

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel assigned to this anchorage. Identifies which vessel is anchored.

attributes.name: weather_tide_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.weather_tide_window. Business justification: Anchorage assignments are governed by weather and tidal windows — vessels are held or released based on port entry conditions. Port operations link anchorage records to the prevailing weather/tide win

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.zone. Business justification: Anchorage positions fall within defined port security zones. ISPS requires that vessels at anchor comply with zone-specific security measures. Linking anchorage assignments to the governing security z

attributes.name: actual_anchor_drop_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Anchor Drop Time (ATA - Actual Time of Anchoring)
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vessel dropped anchor at the anchorage position. Recorded by VTS for operational tracking and performance measurement.

attributes.name: actual_weigh_anchor_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Weigh Anchor Time (ATD - Actual Time of Departure from Anchorage)
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vessel weighed anchor and departed the anchorage position. Recorded by VTS for operational tracking and billing purposes.

attributes.name: anchor_berth_number
attributes.description: Specific berth or position number within the anchorage area assigned to the vessel. Used for precise positioning and capacity management.

attributes.name: assignment_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for the anchorage assignment used for sequencing and capacity management. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by VTS to manage vessel traffic flow.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the anchorage assignment. Values: ASSIGNED (anchorage allocated but vessel not yet anchored), ANCHORED (vessel currently at anchor), DEPARTED (vessel has weighed anchor and departed), CANCELLED (assignment cancelled before anchoring).

attributes.name: created_by_user_code
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that created the anchorage assignment record. Supports audit and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the anchorage assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of customs clearance for the vessel at anchorage. Values: PENDING (clearance not yet initiated), CLEARED (customs clearance granted), HOLD (customs hold in place), INSPECTION_REQUIRED (physical inspection needed).

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration the vessel remained at anchorage measured in hours. Calculated from actual anchor drop time to actual weigh anchor time. Used for billing and performance analysis.

attributes.name: expected_weigh_anchor_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Expected Weigh Anchor Time (ETD - Expected Time to Depart Anchorage)
attributes.description: Expected timestamp when the vessel will weigh anchor and depart the anchorage. Used for berth planning and vessel traffic sequencing.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Record Last Modified By User ID
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that last modified the anchorage assignment record. Supports audit and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the anchorage assignment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: pilot_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether pilotage service is required for the vessel to move from anchorage to berth. True if pilot is mandatory, False otherwise.

attributes.name: port_health_clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of port health authority clearance for the vessel at anchorage. Determines whether vessel can proceed to berth or receive services.
attributes.references: International Health Regulations (IHR) - World Health Organization

attributes.name: position_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the vessel's anchorage position in decimal degrees. Used for precise vessel location tracking and VTS monitoring.

attributes.name: position_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the vessel's anchorage position in decimal degrees. Used for precise vessel location tracking and VTS monitoring.

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is under quarantine at anchorage. True if quarantine restrictions apply, False otherwise. Affects boarding permissions and service access.
attributes.references: International Health Regulations (IHR) - World Health Organization

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the vessel anchorage assignment. Supports operational planning and capacity management. Values: AWAITING_BERTH (waiting for berth availability), AWAITING_TIDE (waiting for favorable tide conditions), CUSTOMS_HOLD (customs inspection or clearance hold), BUNKERING (refueling operations), CREW_CHANGE (crew rotation), REPAIRS (maintenance or repair work), QUARANTINE (health or security quarantine). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AWAITING_BERTH|AWAITING_TIDE|CUSTOMS_HOLD|BUNKERING|CREW_CHANGE|REPAIRS|QUARANTINE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the reason for anchorage. Provides additional context beyond the coded reason.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text remarks and notes related to the anchorage assignment. Captures operational observations, special instructions, or incident notes.

attributes.name: scheduled_anchor_drop_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp when the vessel is scheduled to drop anchor at the assigned anchorage position. Used for VTS coordination and sequencing.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Level
attributes.description: ISPS security level applicable to the anchorage at the time of assignment. LEVEL_1 (normal security), LEVEL_2 (heightened security), LEVEL_3 (exceptional security). Determines security protocols and access restrictions.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: tug_assistance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether tug assistance is required for the vessel to move from anchorage. True if tug service is needed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: water_depth_meters
attributes.description: Water depth at the anchorage position measured in meters. Critical for vessel safety and ensuring adequate under-keel clearance.

products.name: movement
products.description: Granular transactional record of each discrete vessel movement event within port waters as tracked by the VTS (Vessel Traffic Service). Captures movement type (arrival, departure, shifting, anchorage entry/exit, canal transit), movement timestamp, position at movement (latitude/longitude), speed over ground, heading, pilot on board flag, tug assistance flag, VTS clearance number, reporting channel, and movement status. Provides the detailed audit trail of vessel traffic for VTMS reporting, safety investigations, and port throughput analytics.
products.reference: VTMS Vessel Tracking / AIS Movement Record

attributes.name: movement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for movement

attributes.name: anchorage_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.anchorage_area. Business justification: Anchor-drop and weigh-anchor movement types must reference the specific anchorage area for VTS traffic management, port authority reporting, and anchorage capacity tracking. origin_location_code/desti

attributes.name: berth_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.berth. Business justification: VTS and pilot coordination require knowing the exact destination/origin berth for each vessel movement. Berth arrival/departure movements drive tug scheduling, mooring gang allocation, and berth occup

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.channel. Business justification: VTS channel traffic management requires linking each vessel movement to the specific channel being transited. Channel capacity, draft restrictions, and two-way traffic rules are enforced per movement.

attributes.name: charge_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.charge_event. Business justification: Individual vessel movements (inbound, outbound, shifting) trigger pilotage and towage charge events. Direct FK enables per-movement charge traceability for pilotage billing reconciliation and tug serv

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Vessel movements generate costs (pilotage, VTS coordination, tug operations oversight) allocated to marine services cost centres. Essential for activity-based costing of vessel traffic management, pil

attributes.name: pilot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marine pilot assigned to guide the vessel during this movement. Null if no pilot was required or assigned.

attributes.name: pilotage_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.pilotage_assignment. Business justification: Each vessel movement is executed under a specific pilotage assignment. VTS and port operations link movement to pilotage_assignment for pilot performance reporting, passage plan deviation tracking, an

attributes.name: pilotage_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.pilotage_tariff. Business justification: Pilotage is charged per vessel movement (inbound/outbound/shift). Port finance teams reconcile pilotage invoices against movement records. Linking movement to the applicable pilotage_tariff directly s

attributes.name: port_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent port call under which this movement occurs. Links the movement to the vessel's overall visit.

attributes.name: towage_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.towage_order. Business justification: Each vessel movement (arrival/departure/shift) is executed under a specific towage order. Port operations and billing teams link movement records to the authorizing towage order for post-movement bill

attributes.name: towage_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.towage_tariff. Business justification: Towage charges are assessed per movement when tug_assistance_flag is set. Movement records are the billing trigger for towage. Linking movement to the applicable towage_tariff supports towage invoice

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel performing this movement. Links to vessel master data.

attributes.name: weather_tide_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.weather_tide_window. Business justification: Vessel movements are authorized within specific weather/tide windows. VTS and port operations record the applicable window per movement for safety compliance, incident investigation, and tidal window

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.zone. Business justification: Vessel movements through port waters must be tracked against security zones for ISPS compliance. VTS and port security operations require knowing which security zone a vessel is transiting to enforce

attributes.name: air_draft_meters
attributes.description: Vertical distance from the waterline to the highest point of the vessel at the time of movement, measured in meters. Critical for clearance under bridges and overhead structures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this movement record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp for record creation.

attributes.name: current_direction_degrees
attributes.description: Water current direction at the time of movement, expressed in degrees (0-360). Indicates the direction toward which the current is flowing.

attributes.name: current_speed_knots
attributes.description: Water current speed at the time of movement, measured in knots. Affects vessel handling and is recorded for navigation safety analysis.

attributes.name: dangerous_cargo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is carrying dangerous goods (IMDG cargo) during this movement. True if dangerous cargo is on board, False otherwise. Triggers special handling and notification procedures.

attributes.name: delay_minutes
attributes.description: Delay time in minutes compared to scheduled movement timestamp. Positive value indicates late movement, zero indicates on-time. Used for SLA (Service Level Agreement) performance tracking.

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for movement delay. References delay reason lookup table. Null if movement was on time.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the ending location of the movement. May reference a berth, anchorage, or port boundary point. For departures, this is typically the port exit or pilot disembarkation point.

attributes.name: draft_aft_meters
attributes.description: Vessel's draft at the aft perpendicular at the time of movement, measured in meters. Used with forward draft to calculate trim and ensure safe passage.

attributes.name: draft_forward_meters
attributes.description: Vessel's draft at the forward perpendicular at the time of movement, measured in meters. Critical for safe navigation and channel depth clearance verification.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the movement from start to completion, measured in minutes. Used for operational efficiency analysis and billing calculations.

attributes.name: heading_degrees
attributes.description: Vessel's heading in degrees (0-360) at the time of movement. 0/360 represents North, 90 represents East, 180 represents South, 270 represents West.

attributes.name: imdg_class
attributes.description: IMDG classification of dangerous goods on board during movement. Null if no dangerous cargo. Multiple classes may be present; this captures the highest-risk class.

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Security Level
attributes.description: ISPS security level in effect at the time of movement. Level 1 is normal, Level 2 is heightened, Level 3 is exceptional. Affects movement procedures and clearance requirements.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this movement record was last modified. Audit trail timestamp for tracking changes to movement details.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the vessel's position at the time of movement event recording. Expressed in decimal degrees, positive for North, negative for South.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the vessel's position at the time of movement event recording. Expressed in decimal degrees, positive for East, negative for West.

attributes.name: movement_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the movement event, typically assigned by VTS (Vessel Traffic Service) or port operations. Externally-known reference number for this movement.

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the movement event. Tracks the movement through its workflow from scheduling to completion.
attributes.references: IALA VTS Manual - Movement Status Reporting

attributes.name: movement_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the movement event occurred. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Recorded in UTC and converted to local port time for operational reporting.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention - Time Recording Standards

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the movement event. Defines the nature of the vessel's movement within port waters: arrival (entering port), departure (leaving port), shifting (moving between berths), anchorage entry/exit, or canal transit.

attributes.name: number_of_tugs
attributes.description: Count of tug vessels assisting with this movement. Zero if no tug assistance was provided. Used for resource planning and billing.

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the starting location of the movement. May reference a berth, anchorage, or port boundary point. For arrivals, this is typically the port entrance or pilot boarding ground.

attributes.name: pilot_on_board_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a marine pilot was on board the vessel during this movement. True if pilot was present, False otherwise. Critical for safety and regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and observations recorded by VTS operators or pilots during the movement. Captures special circumstances, incidents, or noteworthy events.

attributes.name: scheduled_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time for the movement event. Used for comparison against actual movement timestamp to calculate delays and measure operational performance.

attributes.name: speed_over_ground_knots
attributes.description: Vessel's speed over ground at the time of movement, measured in knots. Captured from AIS (Automatic Identification System) or VTS radar tracking.

attributes.name: tide_height_meters
attributes.description: Tidal height above chart datum at the time of movement, measured in meters. Critical for under-keel clearance calculations.

attributes.name: tug_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether tug assistance was provided during this movement. True if tugs were used, False otherwise. Important for operational cost allocation and safety analysis.

attributes.name: vts_clearance_number
attributes.description: Unique clearance reference number issued by VTS (Vessel Traffic Service) authorizing this movement. Required for all movements within VTS-controlled waters per SOLAS regulations.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V - VTS Requirements

attributes.name: vts_reporting_channel
attributes.description: VHF radio channel used for VTS communication during this movement. Typically a designated port operations channel (e.g., Channel 12, Channel 14).

attributes.name: wind_direction_degrees
attributes.description: Wind direction at the time of movement, expressed in degrees (0-360). 0/360 represents wind from North.

products.name: vts_log
products.description: Operational log maintained by the Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) centre recording all VTS communications, instructions, and traffic management actions for vessels within the port's VTS area. Captures VTS centre identifier, watch officer, vessel identifier, communication channel, message type (clearance, instruction, advisory, warning), message content summary, timestamp, and acknowledgement status. Supports ISPS compliance, incident investigation, and VTS performance auditing. Distinct from vessel_movement which tracks positional events.

attributes.name: isps_security_level

attributes.description: The ISPS security level in effect at the time of the VTS communication. Level 1 (normal), Level 2 (heightened), Level 3 (exceptional). Relevant for compliance and incident investigation.

attributes.name: log_timestamp

attributes.name: message_content

attributes.name: message_type

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: record_updated_by

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this VTS log record was last updated in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional free-text remarks or notes recorded by the VTS watch officer regarding this communication or traffic event. Captures context, observations, or follow-up actions.

attributes.name: response_time_seconds
attributes.description: Time elapsed in seconds between the VTS communication being sent and the vessel acknowledgement being received. Used for VTS performance monitoring and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: traffic_density
attributes.description: Assessment of vessel traffic density in the VTS area at the time of the communication. Light (few vessels), Moderate (normal traffic), Heavy (high volume), Congested (capacity constraints).

attributes.name: vessel_course_degrees
attributes.description: Course or heading of the vessel at the time of the VTS communication, measured in degrees (0-360) from true north.

attributes.name: vessel_position_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the vessel at the time of the VTS communication, in decimal degrees. Positive for North, negative for South.

attributes.name: vessel_position_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the vessel at the time of the VTS communication, in decimal degrees. Positive for East, negative for West.

attributes.name: vessel_speed_knots
attributes.description: Speed of the vessel at the time of the VTS communication, measured in knots (nautical miles per hour).

attributes.name: visibility_meters
attributes.description: Visibility distance in meters at the time of the VTS communication. Critical for assessing navigation safety and VTS decision-making.

attributes.name: vts_area_zone
attributes.description: The specific VTS area or zone within the port VTS coverage where the vessel was located during this communication (e.g., Approach Zone, Inner Harbor, Anchorage Area).

attributes.name: vts_centre_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the VTS centre that recorded this log entry. Links to the VTS centre master data.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Description of the prevailing weather conditions at the time of the VTS communication (e.g., clear, fog, heavy rain, strong winds). Relevant for incident investigation and traffic management analysis.

products.name: certificate
products.description: Unified vessel compliance record encompassing statutory/class certificates and Port State Control (PSC) inspections that verify them. For certificates: captures certificate type (SOLAS Safety Construction, Load Line, MARPOL IOPP, ISM DOC/SMC, ISPS ISSC, MLC, Tonnage, Classification, CLC/Bunker Convention), issuing authority (flag state or RO), certificate number, issue date, expiry date, survey due dates (annual, intermediate, renewal), and certificate status (valid, expired, suspended, withdrawn). For PSC inspections: captures inspection date, PSC authority (Paris MOU, Tokyo MOU, Indian Ocean MOU, etc.), inspecting officer, inspection type (initial, expanded, concentrated inspection campaign), deficiency codes per MOU conventions, total deficiencies, detention flag, detention start/end dates, rectification deadline, inspection outcome, and follow-up actions. Provides the unified vessel compliance profile supporting port entry eligibility checks, PSC targeting (ship risk profile calculation), detention history analysis, and flag state performance monitoring.

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paris_mou|tokyo_mou|indian_ocean_mou|caribbean_mou|mediterranean_mou|black_sea_mou|riyadh_mou|abuja_mou|vina_del_mar_mou|uscg|other — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inspection_remarks
attributes.description: Additional remarks, observations, or contextual notes recorded by the PSC inspectors regarding the inspection, vessel condition, or cooperation of the crew.

attributes.name: inspection_start_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the PSC inspection commenced on board the vessel.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the PSC inspection scope: initial (basic checks), more detailed (extended checks based on risk factors), expanded (comprehensive inspection of all areas), concentrated inspection campaign (CIC - focused thematic inspection), or follow-up (verification of previous deficiency rectification).
attributes.references: Paris MOU Section 3.8, IMO Resolution A.1138(31)

attributes.name: isps_security_level_at_inspection
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Security Level at Inspection
attributes.description: ISPS security level in effect at the port facility at the time of the PSC inspection: Level 1 (normal), Level 2 (heightened), or Level 3 (exceptional).

attributes.name: lead_inspector_certificate_number
attributes.description: Official certificate or license number of the lead PSC inspector, verifying their authorization to conduct inspections.
attributes.references: IMO Model Course 3.09 - Port State Control

attributes.name: lead_inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead PSC inspector who conducted the inspection.
attributes.references: Port State Control Officer Certification Standards

attributes.name: master_notified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vessel master was formally notified of the inspection findings and any deficiencies or detention orders.

attributes.name: port_state_control_report_issued_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Port State Control (PSC) Report Issued Date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal PSC inspection report was issued to the vessel master and relevant authorities.
attributes.references: Paris MOU, Tokyo MOU Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: psc_authority_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the PSC authority, typically aligned with country or regional MOU codes.
attributes.references: Paris MOU, Tokyo MOU, Indian Ocean MOU, Caribbean MOU

attributes.name: psc_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the national maritime authority or agency that conducted the inspection (e.g., Maritime and Port Authority, Coast Guard, Flag State Administration).

attributes.name: recognized_organization_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Recognized Organization (classification society) that issued the vessel's statutory certificates was notified of deficiencies related to their certification scope.

attributes.name: record_created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this PSC inspection record.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PSC inspection record was first created in the port management system.

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated this PSC inspection record.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PSC inspection record was last modified in the port management system.

attributes.name: rectification_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which all identified deficiencies must be rectified, as specified by the PSC authority. May be immediate (before departure), within 14 days, or at next port.

attributes.name: ship_risk_profile
attributes.description: Risk classification of the vessel at the time of inspection based on the New Inspection Regime (NIR) ship risk profile calculation, considering flag state performance, recognized organization, vessel type, age, and deficiency history.
attributes.references: Paris MOU NIR, Tokyo MOU NIR

attributes.name: total_deficiencies_found
attributes.description: Total count of deficiencies identified during the PSC inspection across all areas and conventions checked.

products.name: agent_appointment
products.description: Association record linking a vessel or port call to its appointed port agent (shipping agent). Captures agent company reference, agency appointment type (general agent, husbanding agent, cargo agent, protective agent), appointment start and end dates, appointment scope (single call, voyage series, annual), primary contact name, and appointment status. Supports port call coordination, document submission authority, and billing address routing. Distinct from the customer domain which holds the full agent company master record.
products.reference: Port Agency Appointment / FONASBA Standard Agency Agreement

attributes.name: agent_appointment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for agent_appointment

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id

attributes.name: contact_person_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact_person. Business justification: Agent appointments require a named contact person at the shipping agent for operational communications, document submission authority, and emergency escalation. Port operations teams need to identify

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Agent coordination, oversight, and port community system management generate costs allocated to port operations cost centres. Required for agency management cost allocation and operational expense tra

attributes.name: customs_broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.customs_broker. Business justification: Vessel agents appoint customs brokers for cargo clearance and customs declaration submission on behalf of vessel operators. This link enables agent-broker coordination tracking, customs clearance auth

attributes.name: port_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific port call for which the agent is appointed. Nullable for standing appointments not tied to a single call.

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipping agent company appointed to represent the vessel or owner. Links to the participant master record in the customer domain.

attributes.name: receivable_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.receivable_account. Business justification: Shipping agents manage disbursement accounts for port charges on behalf of vessel owners. Replacing denormalized disbursement_account_reference with a proper FK to receivable_account normalizes agent

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel for which the agent is appointed. Links to the vessel master record.

attributes.name: agency_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agent appointment role. General agent handles all vessel matters; husbanding agent provides operational support; cargo agent manages cargo documentation; protective agent represents owner interests; liner agent serves scheduled services; port agent provides local representation.
attributes.references: International Ship Suppliers and Services Association (ISSA) Standards

attributes.name: appointment_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the formal agency agreement or contract document that governs the terms and conditions of the agent appointment.

attributes.name: appointment_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agent appointment expires or is scheduled to terminate. Nullable for indefinite appointments.

attributes.name: appointment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason or circumstances that led to this agent appointment, such as regular service, emergency replacement, or special cargo handling.

attributes.name: appointment_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the agent appointment, often provided by the agent company or vessel operator for tracking and invoicing purposes.

attributes.name: appointment_scope
attributes.description: Defines the coverage extent of the agent appointment. Single call for one port visit; voyage series for a defined set of calls; annual contract for all calls within a year; indefinite for ongoing representation.

attributes.name: appointment_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the agent appointment becomes effective and the agent is authorized to act on behalf of the vessel or owner.

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the agent appointment. Pending awaits confirmation; active is in force; suspended is temporarily inactive; terminated is ended early; expired has reached natural end date.

attributes.name: billing_address_routing
attributes.description: Specifies to whom port invoices and charges should be addressed. Agent routes to agent company; owner to vessel owner; operator to vessel operator; charterer to the charterer.

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage commission rate payable to the agent for services rendered, typically applied to port charges or cargo handling fees.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is authorized to handle customs clearance procedures and submit customs declarations on behalf of the vessel.

attributes.name: document_submission_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is authorized to submit official port and customs documentation on behalf of the vessel or owner. True grants submission rights; false restricts to coordination only.

attributes.name: edi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent company is enabled for electronic data interchange messaging with the port community system for automated document submission and status updates.

attributes.name: edi_participant_code
attributes.description: Unique EDI participant identifier assigned to the agent company within the port community system for message routing and authentication.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24/7 emergency telephone number for the agent company to handle urgent vessel matters outside business hours.

attributes.name: financial_authority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has authority to commit to financial obligations and sign invoices on behalf of the vessel owner or operator.

attributes.name: isps_security_clearance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Clearance Status
attributes.description: Security clearance status of the agent company under ISPS Code requirements. Cleared allows port facility access; pending awaits approval; denied restricts access; expired requires renewal.
attributes.references: ISPS Code - International Ship and Port Facility Security

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the agent's performance during the appointment period. Used for future agent selection and relationship management.

attributes.name: port_facility_access_permit_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the port facility access permit issued to the agent company, required for physical access to restricted port areas.
attributes.references: ISPS Code - International Ship and Port Facility Security

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person at the agent company for operational correspondence and document submission.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the agent company responsible for this appointment. Used for operational coordination and communication.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Telephone number of the primary contact person at the agent company for urgent operational matters and coordination.

attributes.name: proforma_disbursement_account_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a proforma disbursement account statement must be issued before the vessel arrival for advance payment of estimated port charges.

attributes.name: record_created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this agent appointment record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this agent appointment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this agent appointment record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this agent appointment record was last modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments regarding the agent appointment, special instructions, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: service_fee_structure
attributes.description: Defines how the agent is compensated. Fixed per call charges a set amount; percentage commission applies a rate to charges; time and materials bills actual hours; hybrid combines methods.

attributes.name: termination_notice_date
attributes.description: The date on which formal notice of termination was given by either party. Used to track notice period compliance per agency agreement terms.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for early termination of the agent appointment, if applicable. Nullable for active or naturally expired appointments.

products.name: call_schedule
products.description: Forward-looking schedule and service route record representing planned port calls for a vessel over a service rotation or voyage series. Service route attributes: service code, service name, operating shipping line(s), alliance designation, rotation of ports in sequence, service frequency (weekly, bi-weekly), vessel string size, average TEU capacity, service type (mainline, feeder, regional), and service status. Schedule attributes: rotation sequence number, planned ETA, planned ETD, planned berth window, cargo volume forecast (TEU), schedule version, schedule source (shipping line EDI, agent submission, VTS pre-notification), and schedule status (provisional, confirmed, amended, cancelled). Supports berth planning horizon management, resource pre-allocation, volume forecasting, and commercial service agreement management. Distinct from call which is the actual operational record of a realized port visit.

attributes.name: call_schedule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for call_schedule

attributes.name: infrastructure_terminal_id

attributes.name: pilotage_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.pilotage_route. Business justification: Pre-arrival call scheduling requires knowing the pilotage route to assess tidal window constraints, UKC requirements, and minimum tug count before confirming the schedule. Port planners use this link

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.port_community_participant. Business justification: Call schedules are submitted by shipping lines who are registered port community participants. Berth planning, commercial agreement enforcement, and schedule coordination require linking the call sche

attributes.name: port_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.port_tariff. Business justification: Call schedules drive proforma disbursement account (DA) preparation — call_schedule has proforma_disbursement_account_required flag. The applicable port_tariff is required to estimate port charges in

attributes.name: service_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vessel.service_route. Business justification: call_schedule is explicitly described as a 'forward-looking schedule and service route record representing planned port calls for a vessel over a service route.' service_route is the master record of

attributes.name: shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.shipping_line. Business justification: Call schedules are submitted by shipping lines; the port must resolve the EDI partner, commercial account, and tariff group from the schedule. Normalizing operating_shipping_line to masterdata.shippin

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel scheduled for this port call. Links to the vessel master data.

attributes.name: voyage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vessel.voyage. Business justification: call_schedule represents planned port calls for a vessel over a service route, and each planned call is associated with a specific voyage. call_schedule.voyage_number is a denormalized STRING copy of

attributes.name: alliance_designation
attributes.description: Name of the shipping alliance if this service is part of a carrier alliance (e.g., 2M, Ocean Alliance, THE Alliance). Null for independent services.

attributes.name: average_vessel_capacity_teu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Vessel Capacity Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU)
attributes.description: Average container capacity in TEU of vessels deployed on this service. Used for capacity planning and commercial forecasting.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Container Classification and TEU Standards

attributes.name: berth_preference
attributes.description: Preferred berth or berth zone requested by the shipping line or agent for this scheduled call. Used in berth allocation planning.

attributes.name: commercial_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial service agreement or contract governing this scheduled service. Links to tariff and SLA terms.

attributes.name: forecast_cargo_volume_teu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Forecast Cargo Volume Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU)
attributes.description: Forecasted container volume in TEU expected to be loaded and discharged at this port call. Used for yard planning and equipment allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Container Classification and TEU Standards

attributes.name: forecast_discharge_teu
attributes.description: Forecasted number of TEU to be discharged from the vessel at this port call.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Container Classification and TEU Standards

attributes.name: forecast_load_teu
attributes.description: Forecasted number of TEU to be loaded onto the vessel at this port call.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Container Classification and TEU Standards

attributes.name: forecast_restow_teu
attributes.description: Forecasted number of TEU requiring restow operations (containers moved to optimize stowage). Impacts operational planning and berth time.

attributes.name: next_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port immediately following this call in the rotation sequence. Used for cargo routing and stowage planning.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: omission_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why a scheduled port call was omitted or skipped (e.g., weather, operational delays, insufficient cargo). Populated when schedule_status is omitted.

attributes.name: planned_berth_window_hours
attributes.description: Expected duration in hours that the vessel will occupy the berth, calculated from planned ETB to planned ETD. Used for berth utilization planning.

attributes.name: planned_eta
attributes.description: Scheduled estimated time when the vessel is expected to arrive at the port. Forward-looking planning timestamp provided by shipping line or agent.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention - Arrival Notification Standards

attributes.name: planned_etb
attributes.description: Scheduled estimated time when the vessel is expected to berth at the assigned terminal. Used for berth planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: planned_etd
attributes.description: Scheduled estimated time when the vessel is expected to depart from the port. Used for berth window planning and next port coordination.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention - Departure Notification Standards

attributes.name: port_of_call_code
attributes.description: Five-letter UN/LOCODE identifying the port for this scheduled call (e.g., USNYC, SGSIN, NLRTM).
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: previous_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port immediately preceding this call in the rotation sequence. Used for voyage tracking and cargo routing.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for this scheduled call. Higher priority calls receive preferential berth allocation and resource assignment.

attributes.name: record_created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that created this schedule record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule record was first created in the port system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that last modified this schedule record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or operational comments related to this scheduled call.

attributes.name: rotation_port_count
attributes.description: Total number of ports in the complete service rotation. Provides context for the rotation sequence number.

attributes.name: rotation_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this port call within the service rotation. Indicates the order of port visits in the voyage loop (e.g., 1 for first port, 2 for second).

attributes.name: schedule_effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this schedule version becomes effective. Supports schedule versioning and historical tracking.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) Schedule Versioning Standards

attributes.name: schedule_effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this schedule version remains effective. Null for current active schedules. Used for schedule supersession management.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) Schedule Versioning Standards

attributes.name: schedule_published_date
attributes.description: Date when this schedule was first published or communicated to the port. Used for schedule horizon management and planning lead time analysis.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) Schedule Publication Standards

attributes.name: schedule_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule record was received by the port system. Used for audit trail and schedule update tracking.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) Data Receipt Standards

attributes.name: schedule_source
attributes.description: Origin system or channel through which this schedule information was received (e.g., EDI from shipping line, agent portal submission, VTS pre-notification).
attributes.references: EDI IFTMIN - Instruction Message for Transport

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current status of this scheduled port call. Tracks the lifecycle from initial provisional schedule through confirmation, amendments, or cancellation.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) Schedule Management Standards

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this schedule record (e.g., 2024-01-V01). Allows tracking of schedule amendments and revisions over time.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) Schedule Versioning Standards

attributes.name: vessel_string_size
attributes.description: Number of vessels deployed in this service rotation. Indicates the fleet size required to maintain the service frequency.

products.name: draft_survey
products.description: Transactional record of a draft survey conducted on a vessel to determine cargo weight loaded or discharged. Captures survey date and time, surveyor company, survey type (initial, final, intermediate), forward draft, aft draft, midship draft, trim, list, displacement, fresh water allowance (FWA), dock water allowance (DWA), calculated cargo weight (MT), and survey certificate reference. Supports cargo weight verification, demurrage calculations, and load line compliance.
products.reference: Draft Survey Certificate / Load Line Convention

attributes.name: draft_survey_id
attributes.description: Primary key for draft_survey

attributes.name: applicable_wharfage_schedule_id
