attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.berth. Business justification: Draft surveys require berth-specific water depth and tidal data for accurate displacement calculations. Surveyors record the exact berth where the survey was conducted. Cargo weight certification and

attributes.name: cargo_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cargo_category. Business justification: Draft surveys verify cargo weight for specific cargo categories (bulk, liquid bulk, general cargo). Linking to the cargo_category master supports weight verification reporting by cargo type, wharfage

attributes.name: charge_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.charge_event. Business justification: Draft survey results directly trigger wharfage charge events based on calculated_cargo_weight_mt. This is a named billing trigger in bulk cargo port operations. Enables traceability from charge event

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Draft surveys performed by port surveyors generate costs allocated to marine services cost centres. Required for survey service cost allocation, operational expense tracking, and profitability analysi

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Draft surveys determine cargo weight for wharfage invoice calculation. Direct FK enables auditors to verify invoice amounts against survey-calculated cargo weight, a mandatory reconciliation step in p

attributes.name: port_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port call during which this draft survey was conducted. Links the survey to the vessel's visit.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Vessel Planning

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.shipment. Business justification: Draft surveys verify cargo weight against declared shipment weight for freight billing disputes, cargo insurance claims, and port dues calculation. Draft survey→shipment FK enables direct reconciliati

attributes.name: survey_appointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.survey_appointment. Business justification: A draft survey is scheduled and authorized via a survey_appointment. Linking draft_survey to survey_appointment enables end-to-end traceability from appointment scheduling through survey execution and

attributes.name: surveyor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.surveyor. Business justification: Draft surveys must reference the licensed surveyor who performed them for regulatory traceability — cargo weight certification, P&I club disputes, and customs verification all require surveyor identit

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel on which the draft survey was performed.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Ship Identification Number Scheme

attributes.name: aft_draft_port_meters
attributes.description: Draft reading at the aft perpendicular on the port side of the vessel, measured in meters from the waterline to the keel.

attributes.name: aft_draft_starboard_meters
attributes.description: Draft reading at the aft perpendicular on the starboard side of the vessel, measured in meters from the waterline to the keel.

attributes.name: ballast_water_mt
attributes.description: Weight of ballast water on board the vessel at the time of survey, measured in metric tons. Deducted from displacement to calculate cargo weight.
attributes.references: International Convention for the Control and Management of Ships' Ballast Water and Sediments

attributes.name: bunker_fuel_mt
attributes.description: Weight of bunker fuel oil on board the vessel at the time of survey, measured in metric tons. Deducted from displacement to calculate cargo weight.

attributes.name: calculated_cargo_weight_mt
attributes.description: Net weight of cargo loaded or discharged, calculated by subtracting lightship weight, constant, bunkers, water, ballast, and stores from the displacement. Measured in metric tons. This is the principal quantitative result of the draft survey.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Draft Survey Standards

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the draft survey certificate was officially issued by the surveyor.

attributes.name: certificate_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal draft survey certificate has been issued for this survey. True if certificate issued, False otherwise.

attributes.name: constant_mt
attributes.description: Constant correction factor representing the difference between the actual lightship weight and the documented lightship weight, measured in metric tons. Accounts for permanent additions or removals since last lightship survey.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Draft Survey Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this draft survey record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: displacement_mt
attributes.description: Total weight of water displaced by the vessel at the surveyed draft, measured in metric tons. Derived from hydrostatic tables and draft readings.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Draft Survey Standards

attributes.name: dwa_allowance_mm
attributes.description: Dock water allowance correction applied when the vessel is in water of intermediate density between salt and fresh water, measured in millimeters.

attributes.name: forward_draft_port_meters
attributes.description: Draft reading at the forward perpendicular on the port side of the vessel, measured in meters from the waterline to the keel.

attributes.name: forward_draft_starboard_meters
attributes.description: Draft reading at the forward perpendicular on the starboard side of the vessel, measured in meters from the waterline to the keel.

attributes.name: fresh_water_mt
attributes.description: Weight of fresh water on board the vessel at the time of survey, measured in metric tons. Deducted from displacement to calculate cargo weight.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Draft Survey Standards

attributes.name: fwa_allowance_mm
attributes.description: Fresh water allowance correction applied when the vessel is in fresh water or dock water, measured in millimeters. Accounts for the difference in buoyancy between salt and fresh water.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this draft survey record was last updated in the system. Audit trail for record modifications.

attributes.name: lightship_weight_mt
attributes.description: Weight of the vessel in light condition (empty, without cargo, fuel, water, stores), measured in metric tons. Used as baseline for cargo weight calculation.

attributes.name: list_degrees
attributes.description: Transverse inclination of the vessel measured in degrees. Positive value indicates list to starboard, negative indicates list to port.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Draft Survey Standards

attributes.name: mean_aft_draft_meters
attributes.description: Average of port and starboard aft draft readings, used in displacement calculations.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Draft Survey Standards

attributes.name: mean_draft_meters
attributes.description: Overall mean draft of the vessel calculated from forward, midship, and aft draft readings, used as the primary input for displacement calculation.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Draft Survey Standards

attributes.name: mean_forward_draft_meters
attributes.description: Average of port and starboard forward draft readings, used in displacement calculations.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Draft Survey Standards

attributes.name: mean_midship_draft_meters
attributes.description: Average of port and starboard midship draft readings, used in displacement calculations.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Draft Survey Standards

attributes.name: midship_draft_port_meters
attributes.description: Draft reading at the midship section on the port side of the vessel, measured in meters from the waterline to the keel.

attributes.name: midship_draft_starboard_meters
attributes.description: Draft reading at the midship section on the starboard side of the vessel, measured in meters from the waterline to the keel.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or comments recorded by the surveyor regarding the draft survey, including any anomalies, special conditions, or clarifications.

attributes.name: sea_state_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing sea state conditions during the survey (e.g., Douglas Sea Scale 0-9). Affects survey accuracy and reliability.
attributes.references: World Meteorological Organization (WMO) - Sea State Code

attributes.name: stores_provisions_mt
attributes.description: Weight of stores, provisions, and consumables on board the vessel at the time of survey, measured in metric tons. Deducted from displacement to calculate cargo weight.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Draft Survey Standards

attributes.name: survey_accuracy_rating
attributes.description: Surveyor's assessment of the accuracy and reliability of the draft survey results based on conditions and measurement quality: excellent, good, fair, or poor.
attributes.references: International Association of Marine Surveyors - Quality Standards

attributes.name: survey_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the draft survey was conducted. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: survey_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose for conducting the draft survey: cargo weight verification, load line compliance check, demurrage calculation support, charter party contractual requirement, customs declaration, or insurance claim documentation.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Cargo Handling Standards

attributes.name: survey_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or certificate number assigned by the surveyor or survey company for this draft survey.

attributes.name: survey_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the draft survey: draft (in progress), completed (survey finished), certified (certificate issued), disputed (under dispute), or cancelled.

attributes.name: survey_type

products.name: port_call
products.description: This association product represents the operational event of a vessel calling at a specific port location. It captures the complete port call lifecycle including arrival, berthing, operations, and departure. Each record links one vessel to one port location with attributes that track call-specific operational data, performance metrics, and access control decisions. This is the foundational operational record for terminal operations, marine services billing, and vessel performance analytics.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, vessels make multiple calls at multiple port locations throughout their operational life, and each port location receives thousands of vessels over time. Each port call is a distinct operational event with its own lifecycle (arrival, berthing, operations, departure), performance metrics, cargo volumes, charges, and access control decisions. Port calls are actively managed by marine operations teams as standalone business events with rich operational data.

attributes.references: ISPS (International Ship and Port Facility Security) Code; International Maritime Organization (IMO) Security Standards

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the yard block was officially commissioned and made available for container stacking operations. Marks the start of the block's operational lifecycle.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this yard block master data record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and record lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Audit Module

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the yard block was permanently decommissioned and removed from active operations. Null for active blocks. Used for historical capacity analysis and infrastructure lifecycle management.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management Module

attributes.name: drainage_system
attributes.description: Type of water drainage system installed in the yard block to manage rainwater runoff and prevent surface flooding that could disrupt operations or damage containers.
attributes.references: PIANC (World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure) Port Infrastructure Design Standards; Environmental Management System (EMS)

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring
attributes.description: Indicates whether the yard block is equipped with environmental monitoring sensors for air quality, noise levels, or emissions tracking per environmental management system requirements.
attributes.references: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS); International Organization for Standardization (ISO 14001 - Environmental Management); MARPOL (Marine Pollution Convention)

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system
attributes.description: Type of fire suppression system installed in the yard block for dangerous goods and reefer container fire safety. Critical for IMDG-certified blocks handling hazardous materials.
attributes.references: IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code); International Maritime Organization (IMO) Fire Safety Standards; SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) Convention

attributes.name: ground_slot_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of ground-level container positions (slots) available in the yard block. Represents base capacity before vertical stacking. Measured in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit) ground slots.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management Module; International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Container Terminal Capacity Standards

attributes.name: imdg_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the yard block is certified and equipped to handle dangerous goods containers per IMDG Code requirements. Includes segregation zones, safety equipment, and emergency response infrastructure.
attributes.references: IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code); International Maritime Organization (IMO) Dangerous Goods Regulations; SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) Convention

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive or corrective maintenance activity performed on the yard block infrastructure (surface repair, drainage, lighting, reefer racks, etc.).
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management - Preventive Maintenance Module

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the yard block centroid in decimal degrees. Used for GIS integration, asset tracking, and spatial analytics.
attributes.references: International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) Geospatial Standards; WGS84 Coordinate System

attributes.name: length_meters
attributes.description: Physical length of the yard block measured in meters along the bay dimension. Used for spatial planning, equipment travel distance calculations, and capacity modeling.
attributes.references: PIANC (World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure) Port Infrastructure Design Standards

attributes.name: lighting_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the yard block is equipped with operational lighting infrastructure to support 24/7 container handling operations during night shifts.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO 45001 - Occupational Health and Safety); Port Infrastructure Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the yard block centroid in decimal degrees. Used for GIS integration, asset tracking, and spatial analytics.
attributes.references: International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) Geospatial Standards; WGS84 Coordinate System

attributes.name: max_stack_height
attributes.description: Maximum number of container tiers (vertical stacking levels) permitted in this yard block. Determined by equipment capabilities (RTG, ASC safe working load), surface load-bearing capacity, and operational safety standards.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management Module; International Organization for Standardization (ISO 45001 - Occupational Health and Safety); SWL (Safe Working Load) Certification Standards

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned maintenance activity on the yard block infrastructure. Used for maintenance planning and operational capacity forecasting.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management - Preventive Maintenance Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, temporary restrictions, or configuration details not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management Module

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the yard block indicating availability for container stacking operations. Active blocks accept container assignments; inactive/maintenance blocks are temporarily unavailable.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management Module

attributes.name: reefer_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the yard block is equipped with electrical power infrastructure (reefer racks) to support refrigerated containers requiring temperature control.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management Module; IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code) Reefer Container Guidelines

attributes.name: reefer_plug_count
attributes.description: Number of electrical power connection points (reefer plugs) available in the yard block for refrigerated container operations. Null if reefer_capable is false.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management Module

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the yard block is equipped with RFID infrastructure for automated container tracking, gate automation, and real-time inventory visibility.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Container Tracking Module; RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) Standards

attributes.name: row_count
attributes.description: Number of container rows configured in the yard block layout. Rows run perpendicular to the equipment travel path and define the block's width dimension.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management Module

attributes.name: segregation_zone
attributes.description: Designated segregation zone code for dangerous goods container stacking per IMDG Code segregation requirements. Defines compatibility groups and minimum separation distances.
attributes.references: IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code) Segregation Tables; International Maritime Organization (IMO)

attributes.name: surface_type
attributes.description: Type of ground surface material in the yard block. Determines load-bearing capacity, drainage characteristics, equipment compatibility, and maintenance requirements.
attributes.references: PIANC (World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure) Port Infrastructure Design Standards

attributes.name: tier_count
attributes.description: Number of vertical tiers (stacking levels) configured in the yard block. Tier 1 is ground level; higher tiers represent vertical stacking positions. Must not exceed max_stack_height.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management Module

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this yard block record. Used for audit trails, accountability, and change management.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Audit Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this yard block master data record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Audit Module

attributes.name: weight_scale_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the yard block is equipped with weighbridge or container weighing infrastructure to support SOLAS VGM (Verified Gross Mass) compliance and load planning.
attributes.references: SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) Convention - VGM Requirements; International Maritime Organization (IMO)

attributes.name: width_meters
attributes.description: Physical width of the yard block measured in meters along the row dimension. Used for spatial planning, equipment clearance validation, and layout optimization.
attributes.references: PIANC (World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure) Port Infrastructure Design Standards

products.name: yard_slot
products.description: Master data for individual ground slots within yard blocks. Captures slot coordinates (block, row, bay, tier), slot dimensions, slot type (standard, reefer plug, OOG, hazmat), reefer plug availability, current occupancy status, and weight bearing capacity (SWL). Enables precise container positioning and slot-level yard management in the TOS.

attributes.name: yard_slot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual ground slot within the container yard. Primary key for yard slot master data.

attributes.name: container_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.container_type. Business justification: Yard slot physical constraints (OOG approval, reefer plug, TEU capacity) must be matched to container type specifications during pre-marshalling and slot assignment. TOS slot-planning logic and pre-ma

attributes.name: destination_icd_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intermodal.icd_facility. Business justification: Yard slots are pre-marshalled by destination ICD to optimize drayage routing. Linking slot to destination ICD enables yard block allocation by ICD corridor, reduces truck travel distance, and supports

attributes.name: primary_yard_current_container_id
attributes.description: Reference to the container currently occupying this slot. Null if slot is vacant. Enables real-time container location tracking.

attributes.name: rail_visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intermodal.rail_visit. Business justification: Yard slots are pre-marshalled and reserved for specific rail visits — the terminal allocates dedicated yard zones for rail loading/discharge operations. Rail pre-marshalling planning, slot reservation

attributes.name: yard_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent yard block containing this slot. Links slot to its physical block location within the terminal.

attributes.name: accessibility_rating
attributes.description: Operational accessibility rating based on equipment reach, traffic flow, and physical constraints. Affects slot utilization priority.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot is currently active and available for operational use. False if decommissioned or permanently blocked.

attributes.name: bay_number
attributes.description: Bay coordinate within the yard block. Represents the lateral position of the slot in the stacking grid.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the slot was first commissioned and made available for container storage operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this slot record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: customs_inspection_zone
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot is located within a designated customs inspection area. True if subject to enhanced customs controls.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the slot was decommissioned and removed from active service. Null if still active.

attributes.name: distance_to_gate_meters
attributes.description: Distance from this slot to the nearest terminal gate in meters. Used for optimizing container placement and reducing truck turn time.

attributes.name: distance_to_quay_meters
attributes.description: Distance from this slot to the nearest quay crane position in meters. Critical for optimizing vessel loading/discharge operations.

attributes.name: drainage_status
attributes.description: Condition of drainage infrastructure at the slot. Critical for reefer operations and preventing water damage to cargo.

attributes.name: equipment_access_type
attributes.description: Type of handling equipment that can access this slot. Determines operational flexibility and throughput capability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rtg|sts|asc|qc|mhc|reach_stacker|forklift|multi — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hazmat_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot is certified for storing hazardous materials per IMDG Code. True if approved for dangerous goods.

attributes.name: hazmat_class_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IMDG hazard classes permitted in this slot. Empty if no hazmat approved. Example: 3,4.1,9.

attributes.name: height_clearance_meters
attributes.description: Maximum vertical clearance available at this slot position. Critical for high-cube containers and OOG cargo.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent safety and structural inspection of the slot. Used for maintenance scheduling and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_occupied_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a container was last placed in this slot. Used for slot utilization analytics and dwell time calculations.

attributes.name: last_vacated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the slot was last vacated. Used for slot turnover metrics and yard efficiency KPIs.

attributes.name: length_meters
attributes.description: Physical length of the slot in meters. Determines the maximum container size that can be placed (e.g., 20ft, 40ft, 45ft).

attributes.name: lighting_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot has adequate lighting for 24/7 operations. True if lighting meets operational safety standards.

attributes.name: maintenance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording maintenance history, known issues, or special handling instructions for the slot.

attributes.name: max_weight_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum gross weight the slot can safely support in kilograms. Derived from ground bearing capacity and structural limits.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory inspection of the slot. Ensures compliance with safety and operational standards.

attributes.name: occupied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot is currently occupied by a container. True if a container is present, false if vacant.

attributes.name: oog_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot can accommodate out-of-gauge cargo that exceeds standard container dimensions. True if OOG capable.

attributes.name: operational_zone
attributes.description: Logical operational zone or area code within the terminal. Used for yard segmentation and equipment dispatch optimization.

attributes.name: reefer_plug_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot is equipped with a reefer power plug for refrigerated containers. True if plug is installed and operational.

attributes.name: reefer_plug_type
attributes.description: Type of electrical connection available for reefer containers. Specifies voltage and phase configuration of the power supply.

attributes.name: reefer_voltage
attributes.description: Voltage rating of the reefer power supply at this slot in volts. Common values are 220V, 380V, or 440V.

attributes.name: reservation_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the current slot reservation expires. After expiry, the slot becomes available for re-allocation.

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot has been reserved for an incoming container. Supports yard planning and berth discharge operations.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the RFID tag installed at this slot for automated container tracking. Null if no RFID infrastructure.

attributes.name: row_number
attributes.description: Row coordinate within the yard block. Represents the longitudinal position of the slot in the stacking grid.

attributes.name: slot_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the slot within the terminal. Used for operational reference and TOS integration.

attributes.name: slot_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the slot. Indicates whether the slot is available for container placement or restricted.

attributes.name: slot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the slot based on its designated use. Determines what container types can be placed in this slot. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|reefer|oog|hazmat|empty|chassis|special — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMDG Code, NAVIS N4 Yard Management Module

attributes.name: surface_type
attributes.description: Type of ground surface at the slot location. Affects load-bearing capacity and equipment accessibility.

attributes.name: swl_rating_tonnes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safe Working Load (SWL) Rating in Tonnes
attributes.description: Safe Working Load rating for the slot in metric tonnes. Maximum load that can be safely handled by equipment at this position.

attributes.name: teu_capacity
attributes.description: Container capacity of the slot expressed in TEU. Standard slots are 1.0 TEU (20ft) or 2.0 TEU (40ft).

attributes.name: tier_number
attributes.description: Tier (height level) coordinate within the yard block. Represents the vertical stacking position, with 1 being ground level.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this slot record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: width_meters
attributes.description: Physical width of the slot in meters. Standard container width is 2.44m (8ft), but slots may accommodate wider OOG cargo.

products.name: container_visit
products.description: Transactional record of a container's complete terminal visit lifecycle from arrival (gate-in, vessel discharge, or rail-in) to departure (gate-out, vessel load, or rail-out). Captures container number, ISO type code (per BIC/ISO 6346), size (TEU/FEU), visit status (inbound, in-yard, outbound, departed), current yard slot position, vessel visit reference, BOL reference, cargo type, VGM weight (SOLAS), seal numbers, damage flags, reefer temperature settings, IMDG class, TOS tracking identifiers, and dwell time. Core operational entity linking all terminal activities — gate transactions, equipment moves, reefer monitoring, service orders, and hazmat declarations reference this record. Aligns with DCSA Transport Event model for container tracking milestones. SSOT for real-time container position and status within NAVIS N4 and TOPS Expert.

attributes.name: container_visit_id

attributes.name: port_call_id

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Container visit revenue (THC, storage, reefer surcharges) must be attributed to a profit centre for terminal revenue reporting by service line. Port revenue controllers track container handling income

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_incident. attributes.name: shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.shipping_line. Business justification: Carrier-specific free time rules, demurrage schedules, and EDI COPARN/CODECO messaging require direct shipping line reference on container visit records. Demurrage billing, free time calculation, and

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to booking.slot_reservation. Business justification: A slot_reservation authorizes a specific vessel stowage position for a container. When the container is loaded, the container_visit must confirm against the slot_reservation for load list validation,

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.storage_tariff. Business justification: Container visits accumulate storage charges based on dwell time. Port operations calculate storage fees by applying the applicable storage_tariff rate bands to the dwell_time_hours. Essential for bill

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intermodal.transport_order. Business justification: Container visits execute transport orders in multimodal supply chains. Linking enables end-to-end shipment visibility, transport order status updates, and exception management when containers miss sch

attributes.name: verified_gross_mass_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.verified_gross_mass. Business justification: SOLAS regulation mandates VGM confirmation before vessel loading. Linking container_visit to verified_gross_mass enables the terminal to enforce VGM compliance as a gate condition for vessel load oper

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.warehouse. Business justification: CFS (Container Freight Station) operations require tracking which warehouse a container visit is processed in for stuffing/stripping. Port CFS billing, customs bonded warehouse compliance, and contain

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.weighing_station. attributes.name: arrival_mode
attributes.description: Transportation mode by which the container arrived at the terminal. Determines gate processing, yard allocation, and intermodal handling requirements.

attributes.name: booking_number
attributes.description: Carrier booking reference number for the container shipment. Links container to commercial booking and shipping instructions.

attributes.name: cargo_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of cargo carried in the container. Determines handling requirements, equipment assignment, and yard allocation strategy.

attributes.name: consignee_name
attributes.description: Name of the consignee (importer) for this container shipment. Sourced from BOL or booking documentation.
attributes.references: DCSA - Bill of Lading Data Model

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: Unique container identification number following ISO 6346 standard format (4 letters + 7 digits). The globally unique identifier for the physical container unit.
attributes.references: ISO 6346 - Freight containers - Coding, identification and marking

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this container visit record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: damage_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of container damage if damage_flag is true. Documents condition for repair estimates and liability determination.

attributes.name: damage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container has reported damage. Triggers inspection workflow and potential repair work orders.

attributes.name: delivery_order_number
attributes.description: Delivery order number authorizing release of the container to the consignee or their agent. Required document for import container gate-out.

attributes.name: demurrage_start_date
attributes.description: Date when demurrage charges begin to accrue for this container visit. Calculated as arrival date plus free time days.

attributes.name: departure_mode
attributes.description: Planned or actual transportation mode for container departure from the terminal. Null until departure is scheduled or executed.

attributes.name: dwell_time_hours
attributes.description: Total time in hours that the container has remained in the terminal from arrival to current moment (or to departure if departed). Key performance indicator for terminal efficiency and customer service.

attributes.name: final_destination_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the final destination for the container cargo. May differ from POD for transshipment or intermodal movements.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: free_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days of free storage time allowed before demurrage or detention charges begin. Defined by tariff or commercial agreement.
attributes.references: Terminal Tariff - Storage and Demurrage Rules

attributes.name: full_empty_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container is loaded with cargo (full) or empty. Critical for weight calculations, handling procedures, and billing.

attributes.name: gate_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the container physically entered the terminal through the gate. Marks the start of terminal custody and dwell time calculation for truck/rail arrivals.

attributes.name: gate_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the container physically exited the terminal through the gate. Marks the end of terminal custody and completes dwell time calculation for truck/rail departures.

attributes.name: oog_dimensions
attributes.description: Description of OOG measurements if oog_flag is true. Specifies overhang dimensions (front, back, left, right, top) in standard format for equipment planning.

attributes.name: oog_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container or its cargo exceeds standard ISO dimensions (out-of-gauge). Requires special handling equipment and yard allocation.

attributes.name: pod_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port where the container is to be discharged from the vessel. Five-character code per UN/LOCODE standard.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: pol_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port where the container was loaded onto the vessel. Five-character code per UN/LOCODE standard.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: reefer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container is a refrigerated (reefer) unit requiring temperature control and power supply during terminal stay.

attributes.name: reefer_humidity_setpoint_pct
attributes.description: Target relative humidity setting for refrigerated container as percentage. Required for certain cargo types (e.g., fresh produce) to prevent spoilage.

attributes.name: reefer_temperature_setpoint_c
attributes.description: Target temperature setting for refrigerated container in degrees Celsius. Critical for cargo preservation; monitored continuously by terminal reefer management system.

attributes.name: reefer_ventilation_setting
attributes.description: Ventilation configuration for reefer container (e.g., closed, 10 CBM/hr, 20 CBM/hr). Controls fresh air exchange rate for perishable cargo.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier attached to the container for automated tracking and gate processing. Enables touchless identification at gate and yard checkpoints.

attributes.name: seal_number_1
attributes.description: Primary security seal number affixed to the container door. Used for customs verification and cargo security tracking per ISPS Code requirements.

attributes.name: seal_number_2
attributes.description: Secondary or customs seal number if multiple seals are applied. Common for high-security shipments or specific customs requirements.

attributes.name: shipper_name
attributes.description: Name of the shipper (exporter) for this container shipment. Sourced from BOL or booking documentation.
attributes.references: DCSA - Bill of Lading Data Model

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: Empty weight of the container itself in kilograms, excluding cargo. Used for VGM Method 2 calculations and payload verification.

attributes.name: teu_factor
attributes.description: TEU conversion factor for the container. Standard values: 1.0 for 20ft containers, 2.0 for 40ft containers, 2.25 for 45ft containers. Used for capacity planning and billing calculations.

attributes.name: tos_reference_code
attributes.description: Native identifier for this container visit in the source Terminal Operating System (NAVIS N4 or TOPS Expert). Used for system integration and audit trail.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 / TOPS Expert - System Integration

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the specific dangerous goods substance (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Required for hazmat containers per IMDG Code.
attributes.references: IMDG Code - United Nations Dangerous Goods Classification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this container visit record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: vessel_discharge_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the container was discharged from the vessel onto the terminal. Applicable for vessel arrival mode; marks start of terminal custody for vessel-delivered containers.

attributes.name: vessel_load_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the container was loaded onto the vessel from the terminal. Applicable for vessel departure mode; marks end of terminal custody for vessel-bound containers.

attributes.name: vgm_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine VGM: Method 1 (weighing packed container) or Method 2 (weighing contents and adding tare weight). Required for SOLAS compliance documentation.

attributes.name: vgm_weight_kg
attributes.business_glossary_term: Verified Gross Mass (VGM) Weight in Kilograms

products.name: gate_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of every container or vehicle movement through the terminal gate complex. Captures gate lane, transaction type (truck-in, truck-out, rail-in, rail-out), container number (per ISO 6346), truck/vehicle registration, driver identity, appointment reference, COPARN pre-announcement reference, customs release status, radiation portal monitor (RPM) scan result, weight bridge reading, OCR/ANPR capture reference, timestamp of entry/exit, and gate clerk override flags. Supports ISPS Code gate security requirements. SSOT for gate operations in NAVIS N4.

products.name: equipment_dispatch
products.description: Transactional record of individual work instructions dispatched to terminal handling equipment (RTG, STS/QC, ASC, MHC, AGV, reach stacker, forklift). Captures work instruction type (lift, move, load, discharge, shift, restow, rehandle/reshuffle), equipment unit assigned, container or cargo reference, origin and destination positions (slot coordinates), priority level, dispatch and completion timestamps, operator ID, productive/non-productive flag, rehandle reason code (access obstruction, weight segregation, hazmat compliance, reefer relocation, vessel pre-marshalling), crane-specific attributes (hatch/bay position, twin-lift/tandem-lift flag, idle time, spreader type, gross/net crane time for STS/QC operations), and moves-per-hour (MPH) productivity metric. Supports TOS auto-dispatch and manual planner override workflows. SSOT for ALL equipment movement instructions including quay crane lifts and yard rehandles in TOPS Expert and NAVIS N4.

attributes.name: oversized_flag

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: productive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dispatch represents a productive move (True) or non-productive move (False). Productive moves directly contribute to vessel or customer operations; non-productive moves are internal yard housekeeping or rehandles.

attributes.name: reefer_flag

attributes.name: reefer_temperature_celsius

attributes.name: rehandle_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dispatch is a rehandle operation (True) - moving a container to access another container - or a direct move (False). Rehandles negatively impact terminal productivity metrics.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management

attributes.name: rehandle_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code for rehandle operations: access_obstruction (blocking container), weight_segregation (stacking by weight class), hazmat_compliance (IMDG segregation), reefer_relocation (reefer plug availability), vessel_premarshal (pre-stow optimization), damage_inspection (damage assessment access), customs_hold (regulatory inspection). Null for non-rehandle moves. attributes.name: spreader_type

Applicable to crane operations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Configuration

attributes.name: tandem_lift_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this operation uses tandem-lift (True) - two cranes working together on a single heavy lift - or single crane (False). Used for oversized or heavy project cargo.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Equipment Standards

attributes.name: twin_lift_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crane operation is a twin-lift (True) - lifting two 20-foot containers simultaneously - or single lift (False). Applicable only to STS/QC crane operations.

attributes.name: work_instruction_number

attributes.name: work_instruction_type
attributes.description: Type of equipment operation being dispatched: lift (vertical movement), move (horizontal transfer), load (vessel loading), discharge (vessel unloading), shift (yard repositioning), restow (vessel re-stowage), rehandle (access movement), reshuffle (yard optimization). attributes.description: Foreign key linking to terminal.yard_slot. Business justification: reefer_monitoring has yard_slot_position (STRING) which should be normalized to FK for authoritative slot reference. Monitoring events are tied to physical locations where reefer plugs are available.

attributes.name: actual_temperature
attributes.description: The measured actual temperature inside the reefer container at the time of monitoring in degrees Celsius. Critical for cold chain integrity verification.

attributes.name: alarm_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether an alarm condition was triggered during this monitoring event. True indicates an alarm was raised, False indicates normal operation.

attributes.name: alarm_severity
attributes.description: The severity level of the alarm condition. Critical requires immediate action, high requires urgent attention, medium requires scheduled intervention, low is informational.

attributes.name: alarm_type
attributes.description: The category of alarm condition detected. Temperature deviation indicates actual temperature outside acceptable range, power failure indicates loss of electrical supply, door open indicates container door unsealed, humidity deviation indicates moisture level out of range, CO2 deviation indicates gas concentration issue, equipment malfunction indicates refrigeration unit failure.

attributes.name: cargo_type
attributes.description: The classification of perishable cargo being transported in the reefer container. Examples include frozen meat, fresh produce, pharmaceuticals, dairy products, flowers.

attributes.name: co2_level
attributes.description: The carbon dioxide concentration measured inside the reefer container in percentage. Critical for controlled atmosphere cargo such as fruits and vegetables.

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this monitoring event confirms cold chain integrity compliance. True indicates temperature and conditions within acceptable range, False indicates breach of cold chain requirements.

attributes.name: compressor_runtime_hours
attributes.description: The cumulative operating hours of the refrigeration compressor since last reset. Used for maintenance scheduling and equipment lifecycle management.

attributes.name: compressor_status
attributes.description: The operational status of the refrigeration compressor unit. Running indicates active cooling, stopped indicates unit off, standby indicates ready but not cooling, fault indicates malfunction.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Free text description of the corrective action taken or required in response to this monitoring event. Populated when intervention was necessary.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this monitoring event requires corrective action or intervention. True indicates follow-up action needed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this monitoring record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: defrost_cycle_status
attributes.description: The status of the automatic defrost cycle for the refrigeration unit. Active indicates defrost in progress, inactive indicates normal cooling mode, scheduled indicates defrost pending.

attributes.name: door_status
attributes.description: The physical status of the reefer container door. Closed indicates door shut but not sealed, open indicates door ajar or open, sealed indicates door closed with customs or security seal intact.

attributes.name: humidity_reading
attributes.description: The relative humidity percentage measured inside the reefer container. Important for cargo types sensitive to moisture levels such as fresh produce.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this monitoring record was last modified in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: monitoring_source
attributes.description: The method or system that captured this monitoring reading. Automated sensor indicates TOS integration, manual inspection indicates technician reading, remote telemetry indicates IoT device, RFID reader indicates tag-based monitoring.

attributes.name: monitoring_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this monitoring event. Active indicates ongoing monitoring, resolved indicates issue closed, escalated indicates elevated to management, pending review indicates awaiting technician assessment.

attributes.name: monitoring_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the reefer container monitoring reading was captured. Principal business event timestamp for this monitoring transaction.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether an alert notification was sent to stakeholders for this monitoring event. True indicates notification dispatched to customer or operations team.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when alert notification was sent to stakeholders regarding this monitoring event. Null if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: o2_level
attributes.description: The oxygen concentration measured inside the reefer container in percentage. Used for controlled atmosphere monitoring to preserve perishable cargo.

attributes.name: power_status
attributes.description: The electrical power connection status of the reefer container. Connected indicates active power supply, disconnected indicates no power, standby indicates backup power mode.

attributes.name: power_supply_voltage
attributes.description: The electrical voltage being supplied to the reefer container in volts. Standard voltages are 220V, 380V, or 440V depending on terminal infrastructure.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free text field for additional notes, observations, or comments related to this reefer monitoring event. Used by technicians and operations staff for context.

attributes.name: sensor_device_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the monitoring sensor or telemetry device that captured this reading. Used for device calibration tracking and data quality assurance.

attributes.name: set_temperature
attributes.description: The target temperature setting configured for the reefer container in degrees Celsius. This is the temperature the refrigeration unit is programmed to maintain.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this monitoring event represents a breach of customer service level agreement for reefer monitoring. True indicates SLA breach occurred.

attributes.name: technician_inspection_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this monitoring event to a technician inspection work order or maintenance record. Populated when manual intervention occurred.

attributes.name: temperature_deviation
attributes.description: The calculated difference between set temperature and actual temperature in degrees. Positive values indicate warmer than set point, negative values indicate cooler than set point.

attributes.name: temperature_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for temperature readings. Standard is Celsius but Fahrenheit may be used in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: ventilation_rate
attributes.description: The air exchange rate in cubic meters per hour when ventilation is active. Applicable for cargo requiring fresh air circulation.

attributes.name: ventilation_setting
attributes.description: The ventilation mode configured for the reefer container. Closed for frozen cargo, open for fresh air exchange, controlled for modified atmosphere.

products.name: terminal_service_order
products.description: Transactional record of value-added terminal service requests and orders raised by shipping lines, freight forwarders, or cargo owners. Captures service order number, customer reference, service type (reefer monitoring, container washing, fumigation, weighing, lashing/unlashing, OOG handling, customs examination facilitation), container number, requested date, scheduled date, completion date, assigned operator, service status, and charge reference. Supports terminal ancillary revenue and service delivery tracking.

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the service was completed, used for SLA compliance measurement and billing finalization.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service order requires management or customer approval before execution, typically for high-value or non-standard services.

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: cancelled_by

attributes.name: charge_currency

attributes.name: charge_reference

attributes.name: completion_date

attributes.name: completion_remarks
attributes.description: Final remarks or comments recorded upon service completion, including any deviations from standard procedure or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customer_reference_number

attributes.name: estimated_duration_minutes

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: quality_check_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a quality inspection or verification was performed after service completion to ensure standards were met.

attributes.name: quality_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the quality inspection performed after service completion, indicating whether the service met required standards.

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer initially requested the terminal service, used for SLA tracking and service demand analysis.

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the service order was submitted by the customer or created in the system.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Date when the terminal service is planned to be performed, used for resource allocation and customer communication.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp for when the service execution should be completed, used for capacity planning and SLA management.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp for when the service execution should begin, used for precise equipment and operator scheduling.

attributes.name: service_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual duration of the service execution in minutes, calculated from start to completion timestamps for productivity analysis.

attributes.name: service_location_type
attributes.description: Type of terminal location where the service is performed, such as container yard, gate, berth, container freight station (CFS), workshop, or inspection area.

attributes.name: service_notes

attributes.name: service_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the terminal service order, typically formatted as TSO- followed by numeric sequence. Used for customer communication and billing reference.

attributes.name: service_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the terminal service order in the workflow from request through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|scheduled|in_progress|completed|cancelled|on_hold|failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service was completed within the agreed SLA timeframe, used for performance monitoring and customer satisfaction tracking.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: Target turnaround time in hours as defined in the customer service level agreement for this type of service.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Specific instructions or requirements provided by the customer for service execution, such as handling precautions or timing constraints.

attributes.name: work_order_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance or operational work order associated with this service, if applicable.

products.name: equipment
products.description: Master data for all terminal handling equipment (THE) units operated within the terminal. Captures equipment number, equipment type (RTG, STS/QC, ASC, MHC, AGV, reach stacker, empty handler, forklift, terminal tractor), make, model, year of manufacture, SWL (Safe Working Load), operational status (active, under maintenance, standby, decommissioned), current yard zone assignment, fuel/power type, and Maximo asset reference. SSOT for terminal equipment identity within the terminal domain (operational profile; full asset lifecycle owned by asset domain).

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the terminal handling equipment unit. Primary key for the terminal equipment master data.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id

attributes.name: internal_order_id

The existing 'home_terminal' text field is insufficient; equipment dispatch sy

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_zone. Business justification: Equipment home location and current zone assignment required for security patrol verification, zone access control, and asset tracking. Enables security personnel to verify equipment authorization in

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the equipment was acquired by the port authority, either through purchase, lease commencement, or transfer. Used for asset accounting, depreciation start date, and fleet age analysis.

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation for equipment operation. Manual requires on-board operator, semi_automated provides operator assistance systems, fully_automated operates without human intervention (e.g., ASC, AGV), remote_controlled operated from remote control station. Critical for operational planning, safety protocols, and workforce requirements.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Automated Equipment Management

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the equipments current safety certification or inspection certificate. Equipment must not operate beyond this date without recertification per port safety regulations and SOLAS requirements.
attributes.references: SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea); Port State Control (PSC) - Equipment Certification

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the equipment was commissioned and entered active operational service at the terminal. May differ from acquisition date due to installation, testing, and certification periods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: current_yard_zone
attributes.description: Current yard zone or operational area where the equipment is assigned or located. Used for dispatch optimization, equipment utilization tracking, and operational planning. Typically references yard block identifiers from terminal layout.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used for calculating depreciation of the equipment asset. Used for financial reporting, tax compliance, and asset valuation per accounting standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ERP - Asset Accounting; IFRS 16 Leases

attributes.name: emission_standard
attributes.description: Environmental emission standard that the equipment complies with (e.g., EPA Tier 4, Euro Stage V). Used for environmental reporting, regulatory compliance, and green port initiatives. Critical for GHG emissions tracking and air quality management.
attributes.references: MARPOL (Marine Pollution Convention); ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: equipment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the terminal handling equipment unit. Used for operational dispatch, maintenance tracking, and cross-system reference. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by terminal operations or manufacturer.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Master

attributes.name: fuel_power_type
attributes.description: Primary energy source or propulsion type for the equipment. Critical for environmental reporting (GHG emissions), operational cost tracking, refueling/recharging infrastructure planning, and compliance with port environmental regulations.
attributes.references: MARPOL (Marine Pollution Convention) - Port Environmental Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is equipped with active GPS tracking capability for real-time location monitoring. Used for fleet management, utilization analysis, and operational optimization.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Tracking

attributes.name: home_terminal
attributes.description: Primary terminal or facility where the equipment is permanently assigned. Used for multi-terminal port operations to track equipment allocation and inter-terminal transfers.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Multi-Terminal Operations

attributes.name: imdg_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is certified and equipped for handling dangerous goods containers per IMDG Code requirements. Includes specialized safety features, operator training requirements, and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods) Code; SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea)

attributes.name: insurance_policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for the insurance policy covering this equipment. Used for risk management, claims processing, and asset protection. Links to Protection and Indemnity (P&I) or equipment insurance policies.

attributes.name: last_major_overhaul_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major overhaul or refurbishment of the equipment. Used for maintenance planning, remaining useful life estimation, and capital expenditure tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment master record was last modified. Used for data currency verification, change tracking, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: maximo_asset_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier linking this terminal equipment record to the corresponding asset record in Maximo Asset Management system. Enables integration between operational equipment master (TOS) and full asset lifecycle management (EAM) for maintenance, work orders, and asset financial tracking.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management - Asset Master Integration

attributes.name: maximum_lift_height_metres
attributes.description: Maximum vertical lift height of the equipment in metres. Applicable to cranes and lifting equipment, indicates the maximum container stack height or vessel reach capability. Critical for operational planning and safety.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Terminal Equipment Specifications

attributes.name: maximum_reach_metres
attributes.description: Maximum horizontal reach or span of the equipment in metres. Applicable to cranes (STS, QC, MHC, RTG, ASC) and indicates the operational envelope for cargo handling. Used for berth planning and yard layout optimization.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Terminal Equipment Specifications

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned preventive maintenance activity for the equipment. Used for maintenance scheduling, resource planning, and operational availability forecasting.

attributes.name: noise_level_db
attributes.description: Measured operational noise level of the equipment in decibels. Used for occupational health and safety compliance, environmental impact assessment, and noise pollution management per port environmental regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: operating_hours_since_last_service
attributes.description: Operating hours accumulated since the last scheduled maintenance service. Used to trigger interval-based preventive maintenance activities.

attributes.name: operating_hours_total
attributes.description: Cumulative total operating hours recorded for the equipment since commissioning. Used for usage-based maintenance scheduling, depreciation calculations, and equipment lifecycle analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the terminal handling equipment. Active indicates available for dispatch, under_maintenance indicates scheduled or unscheduled maintenance in progress, standby indicates operational but not currently assigned, decommissioned indicates permanently retired from service, out_of_service indicates temporarily unavailable, awaiting_repair indicates breakdown pending repair.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Status Management

attributes.name: operator_certification_required
attributes.description: Type or level of operator certification required to operate this equipment. References specific training programs, licensing requirements, or competency standards per port safety regulations and Maritime Labour Convention.
attributes.references: ILO (International Labour Organization) - Maritime Labour Convention; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership or control arrangement for the equipment. Owned indicates port authority owns the asset, leased indicates long-term lease arrangement, rented indicates short-term rental, contractor_provided indicates equipment supplied by third-party service contractor.

attributes.name: reefer_monitoring_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is equipped with systems to monitor refrigerated container (reefer) parameters during handling or storage. Applicable to yard equipment and critical for cold chain integrity.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Reefer Management

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, operational constraints, or historical information about the equipment. Used for operational knowledge capture and equipment-specific context.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Master

attributes.name: replacement_value
attributes.description: Current estimated replacement cost for the equipment in base currency. Used for insurance valuation, capital planning, and asset management decisions. Updated periodically to reflect market conditions.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the RFID tag attached to the equipment for automated tracking and identification within the terminal. Used for real-time location tracking, automated gate operations, and equipment utilization monitoring.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - RFID Integration

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number for the equipment unit. Used for warranty claims, recall tracking, and asset provenance verification.

attributes.name: spreader_type
attributes.description: Type of spreader attachment fitted to the equipment for container handling. Applicable to cranes and reach stackers. Fixed spreaders handle single container size, telescopic spreaders adjust between 20ft and 40ft containers, tandem spreaders handle two containers simultaneously. Critical for operational flexibility and productivity.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Configuration

attributes.name: swl_tonnes
attributes.description: Maximum safe working load capacity of the equipment expressed in metric tonnes. Critical safety parameter for operational dispatch and cargo handling planning. Must not be exceeded during operations per SOLAS and port safety regulations.
attributes.references: SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) - Cargo Handling Safety; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: tandem_lift_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is capable of lifting two Forty-foot Equivalent Unit (FEU) containers simultaneously. Applicable to high-capacity cranes and represents advanced productivity capability.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Terminal Productivity Standards

attributes.name: telematics_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the telematics system or IoT device installed on the equipment for remote monitoring of performance, diagnostics, and operational parameters. Used for predictive maintenance and real-time equipment health monitoring.

attributes.name: twin_lift_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is capable of lifting two Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU) containers simultaneously. Applicable to cranes and significantly impacts productivity for vessel and yard operations.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Terminal Productivity Standards

attributes.name: year_of_manufacture
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the equipment was manufactured. Used for age-based maintenance planning, depreciation calculations, and lifecycle management decisions.

attributes.name: cargo_type_restriction
attributes.description: Specifies any restrictions on the type of cargo that can be processed through this lane.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the gate lane was first commissioned and put into service.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gate lane record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether customs clearance activities can be performed at this lane.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date when this gate lane configuration became or will become active and operational.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date when this gate lane configuration will cease to be active, null if currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: geo_coordinates_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the gate lane location in decimal degrees format.

attributes.name: geo_coordinates_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the gate lane location in decimal degrees format.

attributes.name: inspection_lane
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is designated for detailed physical inspection of containers and cargo.

attributes.name: lane_length_meters
attributes.description: Physical length of the gate lane measured in meters, from entry point to exit point.

attributes.name: lane_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or label for the gate lane to aid in identification and wayfinding.

attributes.name: lane_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the gate lane, typically displayed on signage and used in operational communications (e.g., 'A1', 'B3', 'TRUCK-05').

attributes.name: lane_type
attributes.description: Classification of the gate lane based on its operational purpose and traffic flow direction.

attributes.name: lane_width_meters
attributes.description: Physical width of the gate lane measured in meters, determining the size of vehicles that can be accommodated.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent maintenance or inspection was performed on the lane equipment and infrastructure.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gate lane record was most recently modified in the system.

attributes.name: maximum_vehicle_height_meters
attributes.description: Maximum permitted height for vehicles using this lane, typically constrained by overhead structures or equipment.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the next planned maintenance or inspection is scheduled for the lane.

attributes.name: ocr_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lane is equipped with OCR cameras for automated license plate and container number recognition.

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily end time for lane operations in HH:MM format (24-hour clock).

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily start time for lane operations in HH:MM format (24-hour clock).

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the gate lane indicating availability for processing traffic.

attributes.name: priority_lane
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is designated for priority or expedited processing of pre-approved or trusted carrier vehicles.

attributes.name: processing_capacity_per_hour
attributes.description: Designed throughput capacity of the lane measured in number of vehicle transactions that can be processed per hour under normal operating conditions.

attributes.name: radiation_scanner_equipped
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lane has radiation detection equipment for security screening of containers.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the gate lane configuration or operations.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lane is equipped with RFID readers for automated container and vehicle identification.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Classification of the security screening intensity applied at this lane.

attributes.name: tos_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lane is integrated with the terminal operating system for real-time transaction processing and data exchange.

attributes.name: traffic_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the permitted direction of vehicle traffic flow through the lane.

attributes.name: twenty_four_hour_operation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lane operates continuously on a 24/7 basis.

attributes.name: vehicle_category
attributes.description: Type of vehicles permitted to use this gate lane based on cargo status or vehicle configuration.

attributes.name: weighbridge_equipped
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lane has an integrated weighbridge for vehicle and cargo weight verification.

attributes.name: xray_scanner_equipped
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lane has X-ray scanning equipment for non-intrusive cargo inspection.

attributes.name: annual_throughput_capacity_teu

attributes.name: cfs_area_sqm

attributes.name: cfs_facility_available

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customs_bonded_area
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal operates a customs bonded area for duty-deferred cargo storage.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_certified

attributes.name: gate_lanes_inbound
attributes.description: Number of dedicated inbound gate lanes for truck entry and container delivery to the terminal.

attributes.name: gate_lanes_outbound
attributes.description: Number of dedicated outbound gate lanes for truck exit and container pickup from the terminal.

attributes.name: iso_28000_certified

attributes.name: isps_compliant

attributes.name: latitude
