attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the terminal location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: max_vessel_draft_m
attributes.description: Maximum vessel draft (depth below waterline) that the terminal berths can accommodate, measured in meters. Determines the size of vessels that can safely berth.

attributes.name: max_vessel_loa_m
attributes.description: Maximum vessel Length Overall (LOA) that the terminal can accommodate, measured in meters. Critical for determining compatible vessel classes.

attributes.name: number_of_asc_cranes
attributes.description: Total count of Automated Stacking Cranes (ASC) deployed for automated container yard operations.

attributes.name: number_of_berths
attributes.description: Total count of vessel berths available at the terminal for simultaneous vessel operations.

attributes.name: number_of_mhc_units
attributes.description: Total count of Mobile Harbour Cranes (MHC) available for multipurpose cargo handling operations.

attributes.name: number_of_reach_stackers
attributes.description: Total count of reach stacker vehicles used for container handling and stacking in the yard.

attributes.name: number_of_rtg_cranes
attributes.description: Total count of Rubber-Tyred Gantry (RTG) cranes used for container stacking and yard operations.

attributes.name: number_of_sts_cranes
attributes.description: Total count of Ship-to-Shore (STS) gantry cranes available for loading and unloading containers from vessels. Also known as Quay Cranes (QC).

attributes.name: operational_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the terminal commenced commercial operations.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the terminal facility in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the company or entity operating the terminal facility.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the terminal location.

attributes.name: reefer_plugs_available
attributes.description: Total number of electrical connection points (plugs) available for refrigerated (reefer) containers requiring temperature control.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal has deployed RFID technology for automated container tracking and gate operations.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province where the terminal is located.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_teu
attributes.description: Maximum container storage capacity measured in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU). Represents the total number of standard 20-foot containers the terminal can hold.

attributes.name: terminal_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the terminal, used in operational systems and external communications. Typically follows port authority or TOS naming conventions.

attributes.name: terminal_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the container terminal facility.

attributes.name: terminal_type
attributes.description: Classification of terminal based on primary cargo handling operations. Container terminals handle TEU/FEU, RoRo handles roll-on/roll-off vehicles, bulk handles commodities.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the terminal location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/Rotterdam).

attributes.name: tos_system
attributes.description: Primary Terminal Operating System deployed for yard management, gate operations, and equipment dispatch. NAVIS N4 and TOPS Expert are industry-leading platforms.

attributes.name: total_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total land area of the terminal facility measured in square meters, including container yards, warehouses, and operational zones.

attributes.name: total_quay_length_m
attributes.description: Total length of quay wall available for vessel berthing, measured in meters.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this terminal record was last modified in the system.

domains.name: cargo
domains.description: Manages cargo handling, loading/discharge operations, stowage planning (BAPLIE), dangerous goods (IMDG), FCL/LCL management, BOL processing, and cargo documentation. Covers cargo manifests, POL/POD tracking, container pre-announcement (COPARN), delivery orders (D/O), HS Code assignment, and cargo condition monitoring. SSOT for cargo movement and handling data.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Core master entity representing a cargo consignment moving through the port, from pre-arrival notification to final delivery or transshipment. Captures shipper/consignee parties, POL/POD routing, cargo type (FCL/LCL/RoRo/LoLo/Bulk), commodity description, HS Code reference, weight (MT), volume (CBM), TEU/FEU count, booking and BOL references, vessel call linkage, IMDG classification where applicable, and cargo lifecycle status. SSOT for cargo consignment identity within the port ecosystem.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cargo shipment consignment moving through the port. Primary key for the shipment entity. System-generated surrogate key used across all port systems to track this cargo movement from pre-arrival notification through final delivery or transshipment.

attributes.description: Reference to the party to be notified upon cargo arrival at the port. Often the consignee's agent, customs broker, or freight forwarder who will arrange delivery.

attributes.description: Reference to the party (organization or individual) shipping the cargo. The consignor who is sending the goods and typically appears on the Bill of Lading as the shipper.

attributes.name: shipment_vessel_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel call (voyage) on which this shipment is being transported. Links the cargo to the specific vessel arrival/departure event at the port.

Real regulatory requirement: export control compliance, sanctions enforcement. Booking systems verify sh

attributes.name: wharfage_schedule_id

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number serving as the contract of carriage and receipt for goods. Critical document reference for cargo ownership, customs clearance, and delivery authorization. May be Master BOL or House BOL depending on shipment type.

attributes.name: cargo_condition
attributes.description: Physical condition of the cargo as observed during handling operations. Documented for liability, insurance claims, and dispute resolution. Updated during discharge, inspection, and delivery.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Cargo Condition Reporting

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the cargo commodity being shipped. Provides human-readable detail about the goods for operational, customs, and commercial purposes. Complements the HS Code classification.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) - Cargo Declaration Standards

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Total number of physical containers (of any size) associated with this shipment. Used for gate operations, yard planning, and equipment tracking. Applicable only to containerized cargo types (FCL/LCL).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment record was first created in the port system. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: declared_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Declared Cargo Value in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Declared commercial value of the cargo in US Dollars. Used for customs valuation, insurance coverage, and liability limits. May differ from actual market value.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) - Customs Valuation Agreement

attributes.name: delivery_order_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the Delivery Order was issued by the shipping line or port authority. Marks the point when cargo becomes available for pickup by the consignee.

attributes.name: delivery_order_number
attributes.description: Delivery Order number authorizing the release of cargo to the consignee or their agent. Required document for gate-out operations and proof of delivery authorization.

attributes.name: discharge_date
attributes.description: Date when the cargo was physically discharged from the vessel at the berth. Key operational milestone for calculating vessel turnaround time and initiating yard operations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Vessel Planning - Discharge Operations

attributes.name: feu_count
attributes.description: Number of Forty-foot Equivalent Units represented by this shipment. Alternative measure for containerized cargo, particularly for larger containers. Used alongside TEU for operational reporting.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) - ISO 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: final_destination_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE for the ultimate destination port if different from POD. Used for transshipment cargo where the current port is an intermediate stop.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Terms indicating who is responsible for freight payment: Prepaid (shipper pays), Collect (consignee pays), or Third-Party (another party pays). Affects billing and revenue allocation.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) - Incoterms Standards

attributes.name: gate_out_date
attributes.description: Date when the cargo exited the port terminal through the gate. Marks final delivery or transfer to inland transport. Used for dwell time calculation and billing finalization.

attributes.name: gross_weight_mt
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment including packaging and container tare weight, measured in metric tons. Used for vessel stowage planning, berth load calculations, and billing.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - SOLAS Verified Gross Mass Requirements

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterm code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between shipper and consignee. Determines liability boundaries and insurance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the cargo insurance policy covering this shipment. Used for claims processing in case of loss, damage, or delay.
attributes.references: International Union of Marine Insurance (IUMI) - Cargo Insurance Standards

attributes.name: is_dangerous_goods
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this shipment contains dangerous goods requiring special handling, storage, and documentation per IMDG Code. Triggers additional safety protocols and segregation requirements.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code

attributes.name: is_oversized
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this shipment contains oversized cargo exceeding standard container or vessel dimensions. Requires special handling equipment, berth planning, and route clearance.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Special Cargo Handling

attributes.name: is_reefer
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this shipment requires refrigeration (reefer container). Triggers temperature monitoring, power supply allocation, and specialized handling procedures.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Yard Management - Reefer Monitoring

attributes.name: is_transshipment
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cargo is being transshipped (transferred to another vessel) rather than being delivered locally. Affects yard allocation, customs procedures, and operational workflow.

attributes.name: net_weight_mt
attributes.description: Net weight of the cargo excluding packaging and container tare weight, measured in metric tons. Used for customs valuation, trade statistics, and commercial invoicing.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) - Customs Valuation Standards

attributes.name: pod_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the port where the cargo will be discharged from the vessel. Determines berth allocation, discharge operations, and onward routing.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: pol_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the port where the cargo was originally loaded onto the vessel. Critical for routing, customs, and trade statistics.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: pre_arrival_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the shipment was first pre-advised to the port via COPARN or other EDI message. Enables advance planning for berth allocation, yard space, and resource scheduling.

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the shipment in its lifecycle through the port. Tracks progression from pre-arrival notification through final delivery or transshipment. Updated by TOS and PCS systems as cargo moves through operational milestones. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Pre-Advised|In-Transit|Arrived|Discharged|Customs-Cleared|Ready-for-Delivery|Delivered|Transshipped — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling requirements or instructions for the cargo (e.g., fragile, keep upright, temperature-sensitive, security escort required). Communicated to operational teams.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Cargo Handling Standards

attributes.name: stowage_position
attributes.description: Six-digit bay-row-tier code indicating the cargo's stowage location on the vessel per BAPLIE standard. Used for discharge planning, load sequencing, and operational coordination with vessel crew.

attributes.name: temperature_setpoint_celsius
attributes.description: Required temperature setpoint in degrees Celsius for refrigerated cargo. Used to configure reefer container settings and monitor temperature compliance. Populated only when is_reefer is true.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Reefer Cargo Handling Standards

attributes.name: teu_count
attributes.description: Number of Twenty-foot Equivalent Units represented by this shipment. Standard measure for containerized cargo capacity. One 40-foot container equals 2.0 TEU. Used for port throughput statistics and capacity planning.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) - ISO 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the specific dangerous substance (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Used for emergency response, handling instructions, and regulatory compliance. Populated only for dangerous goods shipments.
attributes.references: United Nations - Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of the shipment measured in cubic meters. Critical for yard space allocation, warehouse planning, and volumetric billing calculations.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Cargo Measurement Standards

attributes.name: yard_location
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific yard block, row, and slot where the cargo is stored in the container yard or warehouse. Used for retrieval operations and inventory management.

SSOT for container identity and physical attributes within the terminal. Sourced from NAVIS N4 TOS.

attributes.description: Physical condition grade assigned during inspection: A (excellent), B (good), C (fair - minor repairs needed), D (poor - major repairs needed), E (unserviceable). Used for maintenance planning and commercial decisions.

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: Unique container identification number in ISO 6346 format consisting of 4-letter owner code, 6-digit serial number, and 1 check digit. This is the globally recognized identifier for the physical container unit.

attributes.name: container_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the container: full (loaded with cargo), empty (available for loading), damaged (requires inspection/repair), under_repair (in maintenance), retired (out of service), in_transit (moving between locations).
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Container Status Codes

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this container record was first created in the terminal operating system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Data Management Standards

attributes.name: csc_plate_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: CSC (Container Safety Convention) Plate Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the CSC safety approval plate. Containers must be re-certified before this date to remain in service. Critical for regulatory compliance and port acceptance.
attributes.references: CSC (International Convention for Safe Containers); IMO Container Safety Standards

attributes.name: cubic_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Internal cubic capacity of the container in cubic meters (CBM). Used for cargo stowage planning and freight calculations.

attributes.name: current_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the current physical location of the container within the terminal (e.g., yard block, berth, gate, CFS). Used for real-time container tracking and retrieval.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Yard Management; Terminal Location Coding Standards

attributes.name: current_position_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the container was last positioned at its current location. Used for dwell time calculation and operational tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_order_number
attributes.description: Delivery Order number authorizing the release of the container to the consignee or their agent. Required for gate-out operations.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) Delivery Order Processing

attributes.name: final_destination_code
attributes.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE identifying the final inland destination for the container cargo. May differ from POD for transshipment or intermodal movements.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: gate_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the container entered the terminal through the gate. Marks the start of terminal custody and dwell time calculation.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Gate Operations Module

attributes.name: gate_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the container exited the terminal through the gate. Marks the end of terminal custody and completion of dwell time.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Gate Operations Module

attributes.name: hazmat_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification or approval number for containers authorized to carry dangerous goods. Null for non-certified or non-hazmat containers. Required for IMDG compliance.

attributes.name: height_ft
attributes.description: Physical height of the container in feet. Standard values: 8.5 ft (standard), 9.5 ft (high cube).

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the container holds dangerous goods requiring special handling, stowage, and documentation per IMDG Code. True if hazmat cargo present, False otherwise.
attributes.references: IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods) Code; SOLAS Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: is_oversize
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the container carries oversize cargo extending beyond standard container dimensions (e.g., open top, flat rack with protruding cargo). Affects stowage planning and handling requirements.
attributes.references: Terminal Operating System (TOS) Oversize Cargo Handling Rules

attributes.name: is_overweight
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the container exceeds standard weight limits, requiring special handling equipment or stowage restrictions. Critical for crane operations and vessel stability.
attributes.references: SOLAS Container Weight Verification; Port Safety Standards

attributes.name: is_reefer
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the container is a refrigerated (reefer) unit requiring temperature control and power supply. True for reefer containers, False for dry containers.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Reefer Management Module

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inspection of the container for structural integrity, condition grading, and safety compliance. Used to schedule periodic inspections and maintenance.
attributes.references: IICL Container Inspection Standards; Port Safety Regulations

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this container record was last updated in the terminal operating system. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Data Management Standards

attributes.name: length_ft
attributes.description: Physical length of the container in feet. Standard values: 20, 40, 45 feet.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date when the container was manufactured. Used to determine container age, depreciation, and remaining service life.

attributes.name: max_gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum allowable gross weight (container + cargo) in kilograms as per ISO standards. Typically 30,480 kg for standard containers.
attributes.references: ISO 668 Container Weight Standards; SOLAS Container Weight Verification

attributes.name: max_payload_kg
attributes.description: Maximum cargo weight capacity in kilograms, calculated as max gross weight minus tare weight. Represents the maximum cargo load the container can safely carry.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory container inspection. Ensures compliance with safety regulations and maintenance schedules.
attributes.references: IICL Container Inspection Standards; ISO 1496 Periodic Testing

attributes.name: owner_code
attributes.description: Four-letter code identifying the legal owner of the container. May differ from operator_code if container is leased.
attributes.references: Bureau International des Conteneurs (BIC) Owner Registry

attributes.name: pod_code
attributes.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE identifying the port where the container will be discharged from the vessel. Used for cargo routing and delivery planning.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: pol_code
attributes.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE identifying the port where the container was loaded onto the vessel. Used for cargo tracking and customs documentation.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: reefer_plug_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the reefer container requires electrical power connection at the terminal. True if plug-in required, False if not applicable or self-powered.

attributes.name: reefer_set_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Target temperature setting for refrigerated containers in degrees Celsius. Null for non-reefer containers. Critical for maintaining cargo cold chain integrity.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Reefer Management; Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique seal number applied to the container door to ensure cargo security and detect tampering. Critical for customs clearance and cargo integrity verification.
attributes.references: ISO 17712 High Security Seals; ISPS Code Security Requirements

attributes.name: seal_type
attributes.description: Type of security seal applied: bolt (high security bolt seal), cable (cable seal), electronic (e-seal with tracking), barrier (barrier seal). Determines security level and customs acceptance.
attributes.references: ISO 17712 Seal Classification; WCO Security Standards

attributes.name: size_teu
attributes.description: Container size expressed in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units). Standard values: 1.0 for 20ft, 2.0 for 40ft, 2.25 for 45ft containers. Used for capacity planning and billing calculations.

attributes.name: swl_kg
attributes.description: Safe Working Load in kilograms - the maximum load that can be safely lifted by the container's lifting points. Critical for crane operations and cargo handling safety.
attributes.references: ISO 1496 Container Testing and Certification; Port Safety Regulations

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: Empty weight of the container in kilograms. Used to calculate net cargo weight and verify VGM (Verified Gross Mass) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 668 Container Weight Standards; SOLAS VGM Requirements

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: UN Number (United Nations Dangerous Goods Number)
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the specific dangerous substance (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Null for non-hazmat containers. Used for regulatory compliance and emergency response.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: width_ft
attributes.description: Physical width of the container in feet. Standard value: 8 feet.

SSOT for cargo title documentation. Sourced from Port Community System (PCS).

attributes.name: cargo_description

attributes.name: freight_terms

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg

attributes.name: hs_code

attributes.name: imdg_class

attributes.name: is_dangerous_goods

attributes.name: issuing_agent_name

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent amendment or correction to this Bill of Lading.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - Bill of Lading Amendment Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this Bill of Lading record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: net_weight_kg

attributes.name: notify_party_address

attributes.name: notify_party_name

attributes.name: place_of_receipt

attributes.name: pod_name

attributes.name: pol_code

attributes.name: pol_name

attributes.name: shipper_name

products.name: manifest
products.description: Transactional record of the cargo manifest submitted per vessel call, including individual line items representing each BOL or container entry. Captures manifest number, vessel call reference, voyage number, manifest type (import/export/transshipment/coastal), submission date/time, submitting agent, total BOL count, total TEU count, total weight (MT), total CBM, customs submission status, PCS acknowledgement reference, amendment version, and manifest closure timestamp. Line-level detail includes BOL number, container number, cargo description, HS Code, package type/count, gross weight (KG), volume (CBM), shipper, consignee, POL, POD, freight terms, dangerous goods flag, IMDG class, UN number, temperature requirement, and customs declaration status. Enables granular cargo-level manifest reconciliation and customs processing. Mandatory for customs clearance and trade compliance. Sourced from Port Community System (PCS).

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel requiring pilotage services. Links to the vessel master record in the vessel operations domain.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V; VTMS Vessel Registry

attributes.name: vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_master. Business justification: Pilotage safety planning requires authoritative vessel master data (LOA, DWT, draft limits) for passage plan approval, pilot licensing verification, and SOLAS compliance. Removes denormalized vessel d

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: Pilotage tariff calculation, pilot licensing requirements (vessel type endorsements), and tug requirement determination depend on vessel type classification (container, tanker, LNG carrier) from maste

attributes.name: voyage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel voyage record associated with this pilotage assignment, linking pilotage service to the broader vessel traffic management context.
attributes.references: VTMS Vessel Traffic Management System; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: weather_tide_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.weather_tide_window. Business justification: pilotage_assignment currently stores tidal_window_start, tidal_window_end, tide_height_m, wind_speed_knots, wind_direction_degrees, and visibility_nm as inline columns. weather_tide_window is the SSOT

attributes.name: actual_boarding_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time at which the pilot boarded the vessel. Used for service performance measurement, billing, and SOLAS compliance logging.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V; VTMS Pilotage Log

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the pilotage assignment, used in operational communications, billing, and regulatory reporting. Format: PLT-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: VTMS Pilotage Scheduling Module; Port Community System (PCS) Messaging Standards

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pilotage assignment. Tracks progression from scheduling through active pilotage to completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|active|completed|cancelled|diverted|suspended — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: VTMS Pilotage Scheduling Module; IMO SOLAS Chapter V

attributes.name: billing_status
attributes.description: Current billing status of the pilotage assignment. Tracks the progression from service completion through invoicing to payment or dispute resolution. Feeds into the port billing and tariff management system.
attributes.references: Port Tariff Billing Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAPH Commercial Standards

attributes.name: boarding_method
attributes.description: Method used for pilot transfer to the vessel. Determines safety compliance requirements under SOLAS and informs launch boat dispatch scheduling.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 23; ISO 799 Pilot Ladders

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pilotage assignment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement from scheduling to execution.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Port Management Information System (PMIS) Audit Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the pilotage service charge amount (e.g., USD, EUR, SGD). Supports multi-currency port operations and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: deviation_from_passage_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pilot deviated from the approved passage plan during the pilotage. Triggers mandatory deviation narrative entry and may require post-incident review under SOLAS Chapter V.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 34; Port Authority Passage Plan Compliance Policy

attributes.name: deviation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for any deviation from the approved passage plan. Mandatory when deviation_from_passage_plan is True. Supports SOLAS Chapter V compliance and post-incident analysis.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 34; Port Authority Incident Reporting Procedures

attributes.name: incident_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated marine incident record when incident_reported is True. Links pilotage assignment to the incident management record for investigation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V; National Maritime Safety Authority Incident Reporting; MARPOL

attributes.name: incident_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether a marine incident was reported during or as a result of this pilotage assignment. Triggers mandatory incident record creation and P&I club notification workflow.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V; MARPOL; National Maritime Safety Authority Incident Reporting; P&I Club Notification Requirements

attributes.name: isps_compliance_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Compliance Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ISPS Code security compliance was verified for the vessel prior to commencement of pilotage. Mandatory check under ISPS Code Part A for port facility security.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A; IMO SOLAS Chapter XI-2; National Maritime Security Authority

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pilotage assignment record was last modified. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Capture Standards; PMIS Audit Standards

attributes.name: min_ukc_recorded_m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Under-Keel Clearance (UKC) Recorded in Metres
attributes.description: Minimum Under-Keel Clearance (UKC) recorded during the pilotage passage in metres. Critical safety metric for SOLAS compliance and post-passage audit. Must meet or exceed route UKC requirements.
attributes.references: PIANC UKC Guidelines; IMO SOLAS Chapter V; Port Authority UKC Policy

attributes.name: passage_distance_nm
attributes.description: Total distance of the pilotage passage in nautical miles as recorded upon completion. Used for billing, performance benchmarking, and route validation.
attributes.references: IHO Chart Standards; Port Tariff Billing Standards

attributes.name: passage_narrative
attributes.description: Structured narrative of the pilotage passage including key helm orders, manoeuvres, waypoints transited, and significant events. Forms part of the official pilotage completion log for SOLAS compliance and post-incident analysis.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 34; Port Authority Pilotage Log Requirements

attributes.name: pi_club_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel's Protection and Indemnity (P&I) club has been notified of an incident arising from this pilotage assignment. Required for insurance and liability management.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs Rules; IMO SOLAS Chapter V; Port Authority Liability Procedures

attributes.name: pilot_licence_class
attributes.description: Classification of the pilot's licence indicating the scope of authorisation (e.g., vessel size limits, route restrictions). Ensures the assigned pilot holds the appropriate licence class for the vessel and route.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Licensing; IMO STCW Convention

attributes.name: pilot_off_vessel_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pilot disembarked the vessel, marking the official end of the pilotage service. Used for billing duration calculation and service completion logging.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V; VTMS Pilotage Log; Port Tariff Billing Standards

attributes.name: pilot_on_board_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pilot assumed navigational advisory responsibility on the bridge, marking the official commencement of the pilotage service. Distinct from boarding time if transfer involved a pilot ladder or boat.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 23; IAPH Pilotage Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_boarding_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time at which the pilot is scheduled to board the vessel at the boarding station. Used for pilot dispatch planning and Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) coordination.
attributes.references: VTMS Pilotage Scheduling Module; IMO SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 23

attributes.name: scheduled_disembarkation_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time at which the pilot is scheduled to disembark the vessel at the disembarkation point. Used for pilot rotation planning and launch boat scheduling.
attributes.references: VTMS Pilotage Scheduling Module; IAPH Port Operations Standards

attributes.name: service_charge_amount
attributes.description: Gross pilotage service charge amount in the port's operating currency, calculated based on the applicable tariff code, vessel DWT, and passage distance. Used for invoice generation and revenue reporting.
attributes.references: Port Tariff Schedule; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAPH Commercial Standards

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pilotage service indicating the nature of the vessel movement: inbound (arrival), outbound (departure), shifting (berth-to-berth), canal transit, or anchorage movement.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations Standards; National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: speed_over_ground_avg_knots
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Speed Over Ground (SOG) in Knots
attributes.description: Average speed over ground in knots recorded during the pilotage passage. Used for passage time analysis, route compliance, and post-incident review.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V; VTMS Vessel Tracking Data

attributes.name: tug_count
attributes.description: Number of tugs deployed to assist the vessel during the pilotage. Determined by pilot based on vessel size, weather conditions, and berth configuration. Used for towage billing and resource planning.
attributes.references: IAPH Tug Assistance Guidelines; Port Tariff Billing Standards

attributes.name: tug_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether tug assistance was required for this pilotage assignment based on vessel characteristics, weather conditions, or port authority requirements.
attributes.references: IAPH Tug Assistance Guidelines; Port Safety Procedures

attributes.name: vhf_channel_primary
attributes.description: Primary VHF radio channel used for communication between the pilot and Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) during the pilotage passage. Recorded for communications audit and incident investigation.
attributes.references: ITU Radio Regulations; IMO SOLAS Chapter IV; IALA VTS Standards

attributes.name: vts_reporting_point_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) Reporting Point Count
attributes.description: Number of mandatory Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) reporting points transited during the pilotage passage. Used for VTS compliance verification and passage plan adherence assessment.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.857(20) VTS Guidelines; IALA VTS Standards

products.name: pilot
products.description: Master record for each licensed marine pilot authorised to conduct pilotage operations at the port. Captures pilot licence number, IMO-recognised competency class, authorised vessel size limits (LOA, DWT, GRT), authorised fairway sections, licence expiry date, medical fitness certificate status, language proficiencies, emergency contact, and current duty status. SSOT for pilot identity, qualifications, and authorisation data.
products.reference: SOLAS Chapter V / National Maritime Safety Authority Pilot Licensing

attributes.name: pilot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each licensed marine pilot record in the port authority system. Primary key for the pilot master data product.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23) — Recommendations on Training and Certification of Maritime Pilots

attributes.name: access_credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.access_credential. Business justification: ISPS mandates all persons accessing port facilities hold valid access credentials. Pilots board vessels in restricted security zones daily; their credential status must be verified per ISPS Code. pilo

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Pilots (employees or contractors) are assigned to a finance cost centre for labour cost allocation, payroll overhead distribution, and headcount reporting. Port authority finance teams track pilot man

attributes.name: home_port_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.port. Business justification: Pilots are licensed by and stationed at a specific port authority. home_port_code is a denormalized text field. Port-level pilot roster management, licence renewal tracking, and regulatory reporting o

attributes.name: home_port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Pilot rostering and deployment planning requires linking pilots to their home port location. Port authority scheduling systems assign pilots to shifts by port; home_port_code is a denormalized string

attributes.name: nationality_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Pilot licensing authority verification, STCW certification validation, and port access credential issuance require country master data (IMO member status, STCW ratification) for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: competency_class
attributes.description: IMO-recognised competency class of the pilot licence, defining the category of vessels and waterways the pilot is authorised to handle (e.g., Class 1, Class 2, Class 3). Determines assignment eligibility in VTMS scheduling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Class 1|Class 2|Class 3|Class 4|Class 5 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the pilot. Used for age verification, mandatory retirement age compliance, and medical fitness scheduling under national maritime authority regulations.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006; National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: deep_sea_pilot_endorsement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pilot holds a deep sea pilotage endorsement, authorising operations beyond the standard port approach limits. Relevant for ports with extended pilotage districts.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: duty_status
attributes.description: Current operational duty status of the pilot indicating availability for pilotage assignments. Drives real-time scheduling logic in the Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS). Values: on_duty (actively available), off_duty (not available), standby (on-call), leave (approved absence), suspended (regulatory action), retired (no longer active).
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); VTMS Operational Procedures; National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the pilot's designated emergency contact person. Required for safety and incident management procedures under SOLAS and OHS regulations.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter III; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the pilot's designated emergency contact. Used by port operations and marine services teams in the event of an incident or emergency involving the pilot.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter III; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact person to the pilot (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling). Provides context for emergency communications.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pilot's employment arrangement with the port authority. Determines applicable HR policies, entitlements, and billing arrangements. Values: permanent, contract, casual, seconded.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006; Oracle HCM Cloud HR Module

attributes.name: english_proficiency_level
attributes.description: Assessed level of English language proficiency for maritime communications, as English is the IMO-mandated working language for international pilotage. Values: basic, operational, proficient, expert.
attributes.references: IMO Standard Marine Communication Phrases (SMCP); STCW Convention; IMO Resolution A.960(23)

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the licensed marine pilot as recorded on the pilot licence and identity documents. Used for scheduling, manifests, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); GDPR Article 4; ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: incident_count_ytd
attributes.description: Number of marine incidents or near-misses recorded against this pilot in the current calendar year. Used for safety performance monitoring, P&I club notifications, and SOLAS/MARPOL compliance reporting. Not a calculated KPI — sourced directly from the incident management system.
attributes.references: SOLAS; MARPOL; P&I Club Reporting Requirements; ISO 45001; IMO Casualty Investigation Code

attributes.name: isps_clearance_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Clearance Level
attributes.description: ISPS security clearance level granted to the pilot, determining access permissions to restricted port areas and vessels. Aligned with the ISPS Code security framework. Values: level_1 (normal), level_2 (heightened), level_3 (exceptional).
attributes.references: ISPS Code (International Ship and Port Facility Security Code); SOLAS Chapter XI-2; IMO

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the national maritime authority or regulatory body that issued the pilot licence (e.g., Australian Maritime Safety Authority, Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore). Required for regulatory correspondence and PSC inspections.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: language_proficiencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639-1 language codes representing languages in which the pilot is proficient for maritime communications. IMO requires English as the working language; additional languages support multi-national vessel operations. Example: 'EN,ZH,AR'.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 14 (Language for Communications); IMO Standard Marine Communication Phrases (SMCP)

attributes.name: last_incident_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent marine incident or near-miss recorded against this pilot. Used for safety trend analysis and to trigger mandatory review processes under SOLAS and port safety procedures.
attributes.references: SOLAS; MARPOL; IMO Casualty Investigation Code; ISO 45001

attributes.name: licence_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pilot's current licence expires and must be renewed. Used for proactive renewal alerts and to prevent scheduling of pilots with lapsed licences.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: licence_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current pilot licence was issued by the national maritime authority. Used for licence tenure tracking and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: licence_number
attributes.description: Officially issued pilot licence number assigned by the national maritime authority. Serves as the primary external business identifier for the pilot across regulatory and operational systems including VTMS and PCS.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: licence_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory status of the pilot's licence as maintained by the national maritime authority. Determines whether the pilot is legally authorised to conduct pilotage operations. Values: active, expired, suspended, revoked, pending_renewal.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations; IMO Resolution A.960(23)

attributes.name: max_dwt_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Authorised Deadweight Tonnage (DWT) in Metric Tonnes
attributes.description: Maximum vessel Deadweight Tonnage (DWT) in metric tonnes that this pilot is authorised to handle. Used alongside LOA and GRT limits to determine vessel assignment eligibility in VTMS scheduling.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: max_grt
attributes.description: Maximum vessel Gross Registered Tonnage (GRT) that this pilot is authorised to handle. Complements LOA and DWT limits for comprehensive vessel size authorisation management.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); IHO Standards; National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: max_loa_m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Authorised Length Overall (LOA) in Metres
attributes.description: Maximum vessel Length Overall (LOA) in metres that this pilot is authorised to handle, as specified on the pilot licence. Used by VTMS to validate pilot-vessel assignment eligibility.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); PIANC Guidelines; National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: medical_cert_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pilot's current medical fitness certificate expires. Triggers renewal workflow and prevents scheduling of pilots with expired medical certificates.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006 (MLC 2006) Regulation 4.1; STCW Convention Regulation I/9

attributes.name: medical_cert_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the pilot's current medical fitness certificate issued by an approved medical examiner. Used for regulatory verification and audit purposes.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006 (MLC 2006) Regulation 4.1; STCW Convention Regulation I/9

attributes.name: medical_cert_status
attributes.description: Current status of the pilot's medical fitness certificate as required under maritime health standards. A valid certificate is a prerequisite for active pilotage duty. Values: valid, expired, suspended, pending_review.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006 (MLC 2006) Regulation 4.1; STCW Convention Regulation I/9; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: night_pilotage_authorised
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pilot is authorised to conduct pilotage operations during night-time hours. Some pilots may have restrictions based on experience level or port-specific regulations.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations; PIANC Guidelines

attributes.name: pilotage_commencement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pilot first commenced licensed pilotage operations at this port. Used to calculate seniority, experience tenure, and for workforce planning analytics.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: pni_club_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the port's Protection and Indemnity (P&I) club has been notified of any incident involving this pilot. Required for liability management and insurance claim processing.
attributes.references: P&I Club Rules; SOLAS; IMO Casualty Investigation Code

attributes.name: port_authority_employee_number
attributes.description: Internal employee or contractor reference number assigned by the port authority's HR system (Oracle HCM Cloud). Links the pilot master record to the workforce management system for payroll, scheduling, and HR administration.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud HR Module; ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: radar_arpa_endorsement
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radar and Automatic Radar Plotting Aid (ARPA) Endorsement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pilot holds a valid Radar/ARPA endorsement, confirming competency in radar navigation and collision avoidance systems. Required for pilotage in restricted visibility conditions.
attributes.references: STCW Convention Regulation II/1; IMO Resolution A.960(23)

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pilot master record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation point for data governance and regulatory compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability); Port Authority Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pilot master record was most recently updated. Supports data lineage tracking, change auditing, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Port Authority Data Governance Policy; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: refresher_training_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the pilot must complete the next mandatory refresher or recurrent training programme. Triggers training scheduling workflows and compliance alerts.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); STCW Convention; National Maritime Safety Authority Pilotage Regulations

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or administrative remarks pertaining to the pilot record. May include details on licence restrictions, special authorisations, or operational caveats not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Port Authority Operational Procedures; IMO Resolution A.960(23)

attributes.name: simulator_training_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pilot last completed mandatory bridge simulator training. Used to track recurrent training compliance and schedule upcoming simulator sessions per IMO and national authority requirements.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); STCW Convention Regulation I/6; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: stcw_cert_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standards of Training Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW) Certificate Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the pilot's STCW certificate. Drives compliance monitoring and renewal scheduling to ensure continuous regulatory validity.
attributes.references: STCW Convention (as amended by Manila Amendments 2010); IMO

attributes.name: stcw_cert_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standards of Training Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW) Certificate Number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued under the STCW Convention confirming the pilot meets international standards for training, certification, and watchkeeping. Required for IMO compliance and PSC inspections.
attributes.references: STCW Convention (as amended by Manila Amendments 2010); IMO; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: vhf_radio_operator_cert
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pilot holds a valid VHF (Very High Frequency) radio operator certificate, required for maritime communications during pilotage operations. True = certificate held and valid.
attributes.references: ITU Radio Regulations; STCW Convention; IMO SMCP

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total number of years of active pilotage experience accumulated by the pilot. Used for competency assessment, assignment prioritisation for complex manoeuvres, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23); IAPH Pilotage Best Practice Guidelines

products.name: towage_order
products.description: Transactional record for each towage service request and execution within port waters. Captures requesting shipping line or vessel agent, vessel details (name, IMO, LOA, DWT), number and class of tugs required, bollard pull requirements, tug attachment configuration (bow, stern, breast), towage commencement and completion timestamps, tug master identifiers, weather conditions, service outcome (completed, aborted, cancelled), and any safety observations. Links to individual tug_assignment records for multi-tug operations. SSOT for towage service delivery events.

attributes.name: towage_order_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each towage service order record. Primary key for the towage_order data product.

attributes.name: agent_appointment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipping agent or vessel operator who requested the towage service. Primary party reference linking the towage order to the commercial counterparty responsible for the vessel.

attributes.name: berth_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.towage_tariff. Business justification: Towage billing process: each towage_order must reference the applicable towage_tariff to calculate charges, validate billing amounts, and support invoice reconciliation. Maritime-logistics billing exp

attributes.name: vessel_call_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to booking.call_booking. Business justification: Towage orders are raised from vessel call bookings specifying tug requirements. Booking drives tug resource allocation, scheduling, and billing. Core operational link between booking and towage servic

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel requiring towage assistance. Links to the vessel master data product for full vessel details.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Identification Number Scheme; SOLAS Chapter XI-1 Reg 3

attributes.name: vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_master. Business justification: Towage planning and tug assignment calculations require vessel master data (LOA, beam, DWT, GRT) for bollard pull determination, tariff calculation, and P&I club verification. Removes denormalized ves

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: Towage tariff calculation, tug count determination, and bollard pull requirements depend on vessel type classification (container, tanker, bulk carrier) for service specification and pricing. Vessel t

attributes.name: weather_tide_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.weather_tide_window. Business justification: towage_order stores wind_speed_knots, wind_direction, and visibility_category inline. These operational conditions are authoritatively captured in weather_tide_window. Adding this FK normalises towage

attributes.name: abort_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for aborting or cancelling the towage operation. Mandatory when service_outcome is 'aborted' or 'cancelled'. Used for root cause analysis and operational improvement.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter V; Port Incident Reporting Procedures

attributes.name: actual_commencement
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the towage operation commenced, defined as first tug line made fast to the vessel. Used for KPI measurement, billing, and SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; Port Billing Tariff Schedule

attributes.name: actual_completion
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the towage operation was completed, defined as last tug line cast off from the vessel. Used for duration calculation, billing, and KPI reporting.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; Port Billing Tariff Schedule

attributes.name: billing_status
attributes.description: Current billing and invoicing status of the towage order. 'pending' = charge calculated but not yet invoiced; 'invoiced' = invoice raised; 'disputed' = charge under dispute; 'paid' = payment received; 'waived' = charge waived by port authority.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Accounting; Port Billing Procedures

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the towage order record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the towage charge amount (e.g., USD, EUR, SGD, AUD). Required for multi-currency port operations and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: current_speed_knots
attributes.description: Recorded tidal current speed in knots at the berth or channel location at the time of towage. Critical environmental parameter influencing tug power requirements and safety assessment.
attributes.references: IHO Hydrographic Standards; PIANC Guidelines for Towage; SOLAS Chapter V

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the towage operation in minutes, calculated from actual_commencement to actual_completion. Used for billing, performance benchmarking, and port throughput analytics.
attributes.references: Port Billing Tariff Schedule; IAPH Port Performance Indicators

attributes.name: imdg_hazmat_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Hazardous Material Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is carrying International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) classified hazardous cargo at the time of towage. True = hazardous cargo on board. Influences tug safety protocols and emergency response readiness.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); SOLAS Chapter VII; MARPOL Annex III

attributes.name: min_bollard_pull_tonnes
attributes.description: Minimum total bollard pull force in metric tonnes required for the towage operation, calculated based on vessel DWT, environmental conditions, and port-specific towage assessment criteria.
attributes.references: PIANC Guidelines for Towage; IMO MSC Circular 1331; Bureau Veritas Tug Standards

attributes.name: order_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known human-readable reference number assigned to the towage order, used in communications with shipping agents, tug operators, and port authority. Format: TOW-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the towage order. 'requested' = initial request received; 'confirmed' = tugs allocated and confirmed; 'in_progress' = towage operation underway; 'completed' = service successfully delivered; 'aborted' = commenced but terminated early; 'cancelled' = cancelled before commencement.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; IMO Resolution A.994(25)

attributes.name: port_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Location Code (UN/LOCODE) Port Code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character port code identifying the port where the towage service is performed. Supports multi-port operations and regulatory reporting to IMO and national maritime authorities.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE Standard (UNECE Recommendation 16); IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the towage service was formally requested by the shipping agent or vessel operator. Principal business event timestamp marking the start of the towage order lifecycle.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: safety_observation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a safety observation, near-miss, or safety concern was recorded during the towage operation. True = safety observation exists. Triggers mandatory safety review process per SOLAS and ISPS requirements.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter V; ISPS Code; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: safety_observation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of any safety observations, near-misses, or hazards identified during the towage operation. Populated when safety_observation_flag is True. Used for safety management system reporting.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter V; ISPS Code; ISO 45001; MARPOL Annex I

attributes.name: scheduled_commencement
attributes.description: Planned date and time for the towage operation to commence, aligned with the vessel's Estimated Time of Berthing (ETB) or Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) schedule.
attributes.references: VTMS Vessel Traffic Management System; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: service_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the towage service delivery. 'completed' = full service delivered successfully; 'aborted' = commenced but terminated before completion; 'cancelled' = cancelled before commencement; 'partial' = service partially delivered due to operational constraints.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; Port SLA Framework

attributes.name: shipping_line_code
attributes.description: Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) of the shipping line or vessel operator on whose behalf the towage is requested. Four-letter uppercase code per NMFTA standard.
attributes.references: NMFTA SCAC Code Standard; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for any special operational instructions, constraints, or requirements for the towage operation, such as restricted manoeuvring areas, hazardous cargo considerations, or vessel-specific handling notes.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter V; IMDG Code; Port Operations Manual

attributes.name: towage_charge_amount
attributes.description: Gross towage service charge amount in the port's base currency, calculated per the applicable port tariff schedule based on vessel GRT, towage type, duration, and number of tugs. Used for billing and revenue reporting.
attributes.references: Port Tariff Schedule; SAP S/4HANA FI Billing; IAPH Port Tariff Guidelines

attributes.name: towage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the towage operation by purpose. 'arrival' = vessel inbound to berth; 'departure' = vessel outbound from berth; 'shifting' = vessel moving between berths within port; 'emergency' = unplanned emergency towage; 'dry_dock' = towage to/from dry dock facility.
attributes.references: PIANC Guidelines for Towage; IMO Resolution A.994(25)

attributes.name: tug_attachment_bow
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tug is required to be attached at the bow (forward) of the vessel as part of the towage configuration. True = bow tug required.
attributes.references: PIANC Guidelines for Towage; Port Towage Procedures Manual

attributes.name: tug_attachment_breast
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tug is required to be attached breast (alongside) the vessel as part of the towage configuration. True = breast tug required.
attributes.references: PIANC Guidelines for Towage; Port Towage Procedures Manual

attributes.name: tug_attachment_stern
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tug is required to be attached at the stern (aft) of the vessel as part of the towage configuration. True = stern tug required.
attributes.references: PIANC Guidelines for Towage; Port Towage Procedures Manual

attributes.name: tugs_assigned
attributes.description: Actual number of tug vessels assigned and dispatched for the towage operation. May differ from tugs_required if operational adjustments are made.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; PIANC Guidelines for Towage

attributes.name: tugs_required
attributes.description: Total number of tug vessels required to safely execute the towage operation as determined by the port's towage assessment based on vessel LOA, DWT, wind, and current conditions.
attributes.references: PIANC Guidelines for Towage; Port Towage Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the towage order record was last modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.

products.name: tug
products.description: Master record for each tug vessel operated or contracted at the port, including tug name, IMO number, flag state, bollard pull rating (tonnes), engine power (kW), tug type (ASD, conventional, voith), LOA, beam, draught, fire-fighting class (FiFi), escort tug certification, current operational status, and owning/operating company. SSOT for tug asset identity.
products.reference: IMO Ship Identification / Port Tug Registry

attributes.name: tug_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tug vessel record in the port's marine services master data. Primary key for the tug asset identity table. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Identification Number Scheme; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Tugs are capital assets requiring depreciation, maintenance capex tracking, insurance valuation, and asset register compliance. Core fixed asset management requirement for maritime fleet financial rep

attributes.name: flag_state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.flag_state. Business justification: Tug regulatory compliance, PSC inspection targeting, and flag state survey requirements depend on flag state master data (PSC targeting factor, flag state authority, MOU membership) for operational co

attributes.name: home_berth_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.berth. Business justification: Tugs are stationed at specific tug berths for dispatch readiness. Tug mobilisation time calculations, berth allocation planning, and port asset management all require knowing each tug's home berth. Cr

attributes.name: home_port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Tug fleet deployment planning and dry-dock scheduling requires linking tugs to their home port. Port operations managers allocate tugs by home port; home_port is a denormalized string that should refe

attributes.name: operating_company_port_community_participant_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Company Port Community Participant Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.port_community_participant. Business justification: Tug operating companies are licensed port_community_participants. Linking tug to its operating company enables contract management, ISPS compliance verification, insurance tracking, and regulatory rep

attributes.name: port_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.port. Business justification: Tugs are licensed and operated within a specific port. home_port is a denormalized text field. Port-level tug fleet management, regulatory licensing, and towage service availability reporting require

attributes.name: vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_master. Business justification: Tugs are vessels requiring vessel master data (classification society, P&I club, flag state authority, PSC inspection history) for regulatory compliance, insurance verification, and operational status

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: Tug classification (harbor tug, ocean-going tug, AHTS, escort tug) requires vessel type master data for capability categorization, tariff classification, and service assignment matching. Tug_type fiel

attributes.name: ahts_capable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Anchor Handling and Towing Supply (AHTS) Capable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tug vessel is equipped and certified for anchor handling and towing supply (AHTS) operations, including offshore anchor deployment and retrieval. True = AHTS capable; False = harbour towage only. Relevant for ports serving offshore oil and gas support operations.
attributes.references: Classification Society AHTS Notation Rules; IMO Guidelines for Offshore Supply Vessels

attributes.name: ais_transponder_class
attributes.description: Class of the Automatic Identification System (AIS) transponder fitted on the tug vessel. Class A transponders are mandatory for SOLAS vessels and provide full dynamic data; Class B transponders are used on smaller non-SOLAS vessels with reduced transmission frequency. Determines the vessel's real-time tracking capability within the port's VTS system.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 19; ITU-R M.1371; IMO Resolution MSC.74(69); VTS Operational Procedures

attributes.name: beam_m
attributes.description: Maximum breadth (beam) of the tug vessel in metres measured at the widest point of the hull. Used in navigation clearance calculations, dry dock planning, and assessing compatibility with port infrastructure such as lock chambers and fendering systems.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Measurement Convention; PIANC Harbour Design Standards

attributes.name: bollard_pull_tonnes
attributes.description: Certified static bollard pull force of the tug in metric tonnes, as measured and certified under controlled test conditions. The principal performance metric used to match tug capability to vessel assistance requirements based on the assisted vessel's DWT, LOA, and environmental conditions. Critical for berth allocation planning and safe towage operations.
attributes.references: IMO MSC/Circ.884 Tug Bollard Pull Certification; PIANC Working Group Reports; ISO 3828 Bollard Pull Test

attributes.name: build_shipyard
attributes.description: Name of the shipyard where the tug vessel was constructed. Retained for asset provenance records, warranty claims, technical documentation retrieval, and historical maintenance reference in Maximo Asset Management.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management Asset Record; IMO Ship Construction Certificate

attributes.name: call_sign
attributes.description: International radio call sign assigned to the tug vessel by the flag state telecommunications authority. Used for VHF radio communications with Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) and port control during towage and escort operations.
attributes.references: ITU Radio Regulations; IMO SOLAS Chapter IV; VTS Operational Procedures

attributes.name: class_notation
attributes.description: Full classification notation string assigned by the classification society, describing the vessel's structural class, machinery class, and any additional notations (e.g., fire-fighting, escort, ice class). Provides a concise technical summary of the vessel's certified capabilities and construction standards.
attributes.references: IACS Unified Requirements; Classification Society Rules for Tugs and Workboats

attributes.name: class_survey_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next mandatory classification society survey (annual, intermediate, or special/renewal) must be completed to maintain the vessel's class certificate in good standing. Used in maintenance planning and operational availability forecasting in Maximo Asset Management.
attributes.references: IACS Survey Requirements; Classification Society Survey Schedules; IMO SOLAS Chapter I

attributes.name: classification_society
attributes.description: Name of the international classification society (e.g., Lloyd's Register, DNV, Bureau Veritas, ABS, ClassNK) that has classed the tug vessel and issues its class certificates. Determines the survey regime, structural standards, and equipment certification applicable to the vessel.
attributes.references: IACS (International Association of Classification Societies) Member Rules; IMO SOLAS Chapter II

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tug vessel was formally commissioned into service at the port, either as a new build delivery or upon commencement of a charter/contract arrangement. Marks the start of the vessel's operational lifecycle record in Maximo Asset Management and the port's marine services SSOT.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management Asset Commissioning; IMO Ship Delivery Certificate; SAP S/4HANA PM Asset Master

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current charter or service contract for the tug vessel is scheduled to expire. Nullable for open-ended arrangements. Used to trigger contract renewal workflows and ensure continuity of towage service capacity planning.
attributes.references: BIMCO Charter Party Terms; SAP S/4HANA FI Contract Management

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current charter or service contract for the tug vessel became effective. Applicable for chartered or contracted tugs. Used in commercial management, billing cycle determination, and contract renewal planning in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: BIMCO Charter Party Terms; SAP S/4HANA FI Contract Management

attributes.name: crew_complement
attributes.description: Minimum number of crew members required to safely operate the tug vessel as specified in the vessel's Safe Manning Certificate issued by the flag state. Used in workforce planning, shift rostering, and compliance with ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006) crewing requirements.
attributes.references: IMO Safe Manning Certificate (SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 14); ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006); National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: decommissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tug vessel was formally withdrawn from service at the port, either permanently or for an extended lay-up period. Nullable for vessels currently in service. Used to close the asset lifecycle record and trigger final compliance and financial close-out processes.
