attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management Asset Retirement; SAP S/4HANA PM Asset Lifecycle; IMO Ship Recycling Convention

attributes.name: draught_m
attributes.description: Maximum operational draught of the tug vessel in metres. Used to assess navigability in shallow harbour areas, tidal windows for operations, and compliance with port water depth restrictions. Critical for safe operations in ports with tidal or dredging constraints.
attributes.references: IMO Load Line Convention; IHO Hydrographic Survey Standards; PIANC Dredging Guidelines

attributes.name: engine_power_kw
attributes.description: Total installed main engine power output of the tug vessel measured in kilowatts (kW). Used alongside bollard pull rating to assess tug capability, fuel consumption planning, and compliance with port emission standards. Sourced from the vessel's engine certificate and classification society records.
attributes.references: IMO MARPOL Annex VI NOx Technical Code; Classification Society Engine Certification; ISO 3046 Reciprocating Internal Combustion Engines

attributes.name: escort_bollard_pull_tonnes
attributes.description: Certified escort bollard pull force in metric tonnes, measured under dynamic escort conditions as distinct from static bollard pull. Applicable only to escort-certified tugs. Used to determine the maximum DWT of tankers and gas carriers the tug can safely escort through the port approach channel.
attributes.references: IACS Unified Requirement W31; IMO MSC Guidelines on Escort Tug Operations

attributes.name: escort_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tug vessel holds a valid escort tug certification from its classification society, confirming it meets the structural, stability, and equipment standards required for escort towage of large tankers and gas carriers in restricted waterways. True = certified for escort operations; False = not certified.
attributes.references: IACS Unified Requirement W31 Escort Tug; IMO MSC Guidelines on Escort Tug Operations; PIANC Escort Tug Standards

attributes.name: fifi_class
attributes.description: IMO/classification society fire-fighting system class notation of the tug vessel. FiFi1 denotes basic fire-fighting capability; FiFi1+WS includes water spray; FiFi2 and FiFi3 denote progressively higher capacity systems. 'none' indicates no certified fire-fighting equipment. Determines eligibility for fire-fighting standby duties and emergency response assignments in the port.
attributes.references: IMO MSC/Circ.1239 Fire-Fighting Systems; SOLAS Chapter II-2; Classification Society FiFi Notation Rules

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel type used by the tug vessel's main engines. HFO = Heavy Fuel Oil; MGO = Marine Gas Oil; MDO = Marine Diesel Oil; LNG = Liquefied Natural Gas; methanol = methanol fuel; hybrid = dual-fuel or battery-hybrid arrangement. Used in emissions reporting under MARPOL Annex VI, GHG tracking, and port environmental management.
attributes.references: MARPOL Annex VI; IMO MEPC GHG Strategy; Environmental Monitoring System (EMS); ISO 14001

attributes.name: gross_tonnage
attributes.description: Gross Registered Tonnage (GRT) of the tug vessel as certified under the International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships. Used for port dues calculation, PSC inspection scheduling, and regulatory reporting to maritime authorities.
attributes.references: IMO Tonnage Convention 1969; IAPH Port Dues Tariff Framework

attributes.name: ice_class
attributes.description: Ice class notation assigned by the classification society indicating the tug vessel's structural capability to operate in ice-covered waters. Ranges from 'IA Super' (highest) to 'ID' (lowest ice class) or 'none' for no ice capability. Relevant for ports in seasonal ice regions and for compliance with IACS Polar Class requirements.
attributes.references: IACS Unified Requirements for Polar Class Ships; Finnish-Swedish Ice Class Rules; IMO Polar Code

attributes.name: isps_cert_expiry
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Certificate Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the International Ship Security Certificate (ISSC) issued under the ISPS Code. Confirms the vessel has an approved Ship Security Plan and complies with SOLAS Chapter XI-2 security requirements. Required for port access and monitored by port facility security officers.
attributes.references: ISPS Code (SOLAS Chapter XI-2); IMO MSC/Circ.1192; National Maritime Security Authority

attributes.name: last_dry_dock_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tug vessel most recently completed a dry docking for hull inspection, underwater maintenance, and classification society survey. Used in maintenance planning to calculate the next scheduled dry dock and assess hull condition for operational readiness.
attributes.references: Classification Society Dry Dock Survey Requirements; Maximo Asset Management Preventive Maintenance; IACS Survey Guidelines

attributes.name: loa_m
attributes.description: Length Overall (LOA) of the tug vessel in metres, measured from the foremost point to the aftermost point of the hull. Used in berth planning, harbour navigation clearance assessments, and determining operational constraints within the port basin.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Measurement Convention; PIANC Harbour Design Standards; IHO Hydrographic Survey Standards

attributes.name: marpol_cert_expiry
attributes.description: Expiry date of the vessel's MARPOL compliance certificate (International Oil Pollution Prevention Certificate or equivalent), confirming the tug meets IMO Marine Pollution Convention requirements for prevention of pollution from ships. Monitored for environmental compliance and PSC inspection readiness.
attributes.references: MARPOL 73/78 Annex I; IMO MEPC Resolutions; Environmental Monitoring System (EMS)

attributes.name: max_speed_knots
attributes.description: Maximum service speed of the tug vessel in knots under normal operating conditions. Used in marine service scheduling to calculate transit times to vessel rendezvous positions, optimise tug dispatch timing, and assess response capability for emergency towage.
attributes.references: Classification Society Sea Trial Records; IAPH Tug Performance Standards

attributes.name: mmsi_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Maritime Mobile Service Identity number used for Automatic Identification System (AIS) transmissions and Digital Selective Calling (DSC) communications. Enables real-time vessel tracking via VTS and port monitoring systems.
attributes.references: ITU-R M.585; IMO Resolution MSC.74(69) Annex 3; SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 19

attributes.name: net_tonnage
attributes.description: Net Registered Tonnage (NRT) of the tug vessel as certified under the International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships. Represents the vessel's earning capacity and is used in certain port tariff calculations and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IMO Tonnage Convention 1969; IAPH Port Dues Tariff Framework

attributes.name: next_dry_dock_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the tug vessel's next dry docking. Used in long-term maintenance scheduling, operational availability planning, and budget forecasting for CAPEX dry dock expenditure in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Classification Society Survey Schedules; Maximo Asset Management Preventive Maintenance Planning; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: official_number
attributes.description: National official registration number assigned by the flag state maritime authority at the port of registry. Complements the IMO number as a domestic regulatory identifier used in national maritime administration and port authority records.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Registration Regulations; Flag State Ship Registration Act

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle and availability status of the tug vessel within port marine services operations. 'available' indicates ready for dispatch; 'assigned' indicates currently engaged on a towage or escort job; 'maintenance' indicates undergoing scheduled or unscheduled maintenance; 'out_of_service' indicates temporarily non-operational; 'laid_up' indicates long-term decommissioning or storage.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations Guidelines; Maximo Asset Management Lifecycle States; IMO ISM Code

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commercial arrangement under which the port or towage operator controls the tug vessel. 'owned' = port authority or operator owns the vessel outright; 'bareboat_charter' = vessel chartered without crew; 'time_charter' = vessel chartered with crew for a fixed period; 'contracted' = third-party towage company provides the vessel under a service contract.
attributes.references: BIMCO Standard Charter Party Forms; SAP S/4HANA FI Contract Management; IAPH Commercial Guidelines

attributes.name: owning_company
attributes.description: Legal name of the company that holds registered ownership of the tug vessel. May differ from the operating company in cases of bareboat charter or leasing arrangements. Used in commercial contracts, insurance documentation, P&I Club notifications, and port authority vessel registration records.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Registration; P&I Club Membership Rules; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: pi_club
attributes.description: Name of the Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club providing third-party liability insurance coverage for the tug vessel. P&I insurance covers liabilities arising from towage operations including collision, pollution, and crew injury. Required for port entry and towage service authorisation under ISPS and port authority regulations.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs Rules; IMO SOLAS; IAPH Port Entry Requirements

attributes.name: pi_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current P&I Club insurance certificate expires. Used to trigger renewal alerts and ensure continuous insurance coverage. Tugs with expired P&I cover must not be dispatched for towage operations under port authority rules.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs Rules; IAPH Port Entry Requirements; IMO ISM Code

attributes.name: pi_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy or certificate number of the current P&I Club insurance cover for the tug vessel. Used in incident reporting, claims management, and port authority compliance verification. Required to be presented during PSC inspections and port entry clearance.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs Certificate of Entry; IMO ISM Code; ISPS Code

attributes.name: port_of_registry
attributes.description: Name of the port where the tug vessel is officially registered as recorded on the vessel's certificate of registry. Displayed on the vessel's stern and used in official maritime documentation and PSC inspections.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Registration Standards; UNCLOS Article 91

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording operational notes, special conditions, known limitations, or temporary restrictions applicable to the tug vessel that are not captured in structured fields. Examples include temporary equipment deficiencies, operational restrictions imposed by the classification society, or special port authority conditions.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations Guidelines; IMO ISM Code Deficiency Reporting

attributes.name: safety_management_cert_expiry
attributes.description: Expiry date of the Safety Management Certificate (SMC) issued under the ISM Code, confirming the vessel's safety management system complies with IMO requirements. Tugs operating under the ISM Code must maintain a valid SMC. Used in compliance monitoring and PSC inspection preparation.
attributes.references: IMO ISM Code (Resolution A.741(18)); SOLAS Chapter IX; PSC Inspection Procedures

attributes.name: tug_name
attributes.description: Official registered name of the tug vessel as recorded on the vessel's certificate of registry. Used as the primary human-readable identity label in port operations, VTS communications, and marine service scheduling.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Registration Standards; IAPH Port Operations Guidelines

attributes.name: tug_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tug vessel by propulsion and manoeuvring system design. ASD (Azimuth Stern Drive) tugs offer 360-degree thrust; conventional tugs use fixed propellers; voith tugs use Voith-Schneider cycloidal propellers; tractor tugs use forward-mounted azimuth drives; rotor tugs use a hybrid arrangement. Determines operational capability and assignment suitability for specific towage tasks.
attributes.references: IAPH Tug Classification Standards; IMO MSC Circular on Tug Operations

attributes.name: year_built
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the tug vessel was constructed and delivered from the shipyard. Used in asset lifecycle management, maintenance planning, insurance valuation, and assessing compliance with age-related regulatory requirements under PSC and flag state rules.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Construction Standards; Maximo Asset Management Lifecycle; Classification Society Rules

products.name: mooring_operation
products.description: Transactional record for each mooring and unmooring service performed at a berth, buoy, or dolphin within port waters. Captures mooring gang assigned, number and configuration of lines deployed (head, breast, spring, stern), mooring equipment used (capstans, bollards, quick-release hooks), SWL compliance verification, commencement and completion timestamps, tide height and weather conditions, vessel movement type (arrival, departure, shift), and any mooring irregularities or safety observations. SSOT for all mooring service delivery events.

attributes.name: mooring_operation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each mooring or unmooring service event recorded in the port. Primary key for the mooring_operation data product.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.1045(27) — Pilotage and Mooring Services

attributes.name: berth_id
attributes.description: Reference to the berth, buoy, or dolphin at which the mooring operation is performed. Links to the berth/facility master record for infrastructure details.
attributes.references: PIANC MarCom Report 121 — Harbour Approach Channels; Port Infrastructure Registry

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Mooring gangs operate under specific cost centres (stevedoring dept, marine operations). Essential for labour cost allocation, gang productivity analysis, and operational budgeting in maritime termina

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Mooring operations (line handling, gang deployment) are chargeable services. Each operation must be invoiced to recover costs. Links operation to invoice for billing verification and service charge re

attributes.name: marine_service_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marine service order or work order under which this mooring operation was dispatched. Links to the service order management record for billing and scheduling context.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module; SAP S/4HANA PM Work Order Management

attributes.name: mooring_provider_port_community_participant_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mooring Provider Port Community Participant Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.port_community_participant. Business justification: Mooring operations are performed by licensed mooring service providers (port_community_participants). Tracking the performing provider at operation level enables billing reconciliation, performance mo

attributes.name: mooring_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.mooring_tariff. Business justification: Mooring billing process: each mooring_operation references the mooring_tariff applied to calculate charge_amount and support billing reconciliation. The operational event record must carry the tariff

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Mooring operations generate revenue attributed to the mooring services profit centre for P&L reporting. Port finance management accounts report mooring revenue and gang cost margins by profit centre —

attributes.name: quay_wall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.quay_wall. Business justification: Mooring lines secure to quay wall bollards; structural load calculations, bollard SWL compliance verification, and safety inspections depend on quay wall identification. Engineering and safety require

attributes.name: service_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.service_code. Business justification: Mooring billing and revenue reporting requires linking each mooring operation to the service catalogue. Finance teams reconcile mooring charges against service_code GL accounts; tariff_code is a denor

attributes.name: vessel_call_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to booking.call_booking. Business justification: Mooring operations are executed for booked vessel calls. Booking specifies mooring requirements that drive gang allocation and scheduling. Essential for operational coordination and billing reconcilia

attributes.name: vessel_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel call (port visit) record associated with this mooring operation. A vessel call may have multiple mooring operations (arrival, departure, shifts). Links to the vessel_call data product.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention Form 1; VTMS Vessel Call Management

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel master record for the vessel receiving the mooring service. Links to the vessel data product for vessel particulars including LOA, DWT, and GRT.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Identification Number Scheme (IMO Resolution A.1078(28))

attributes.name: vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_master. Business justification: Mooring gang sizing, line specification (SWL), and bollard selection require vessel master data (LOA, beam, DWT) for safe mooring operations and SOLAS compliance. Removes denormalized vessel identifie

attributes.name: weather_tide_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.weather_tide_window. Business justification: mooring_operation stores wind_speed_knots, wind_direction, visibility_category, and tide_height_m inline. weather_tide_window is the SSOT for these operational conditions. Linking via FK normalises mo

attributes.name: billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this mooring operation is subject to a tariff charge to the vessel operator or shipping agent. Non-billable operations may include emergency services or internal port movements.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Tariff Standards; NAVIS N4 Billing Module; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: bollards_used_count
attributes.description: Number of shore-side bollards engaged during the mooring operation. Used for infrastructure utilisation tracking, SWL compliance, and berth equipment maintenance scheduling in Maximo.
attributes.references: OCIMF Mooring Equipment Guidelines (MEG4); Maximo Asset Management — Berth Equipment

attributes.name: breast_lines_count
attributes.description: Number of breast lines (mooring lines running perpendicular to the vessel's centreline) deployed during the mooring operation. Critical for lateral restraint and SWL compliance verification.
attributes.references: OCIMF Mooring Equipment Guidelines (MEG4); SOLAS Chapter II-1

attributes.name: capstans_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether shore-side capstans (powered mooring winches) were utilised during this mooring operation to assist in line tensioning and vessel positioning.
attributes.references: OCIMF Mooring Equipment Guidelines (MEG4); Port Equipment Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: charge_amount
attributes.description: Gross charge amount levied for this mooring operation in the port's operating currency, as calculated from the applicable tariff code and gang size/duration. Used for revenue recognition and billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Tariff Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting; Port Tariff Schedule

attributes.name: commencement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the mooring operation physically commenced, i.e., when the first line was passed or the unmooring sequence began. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; IAPH Port Operations Standards; NAVIS N4 Billing Module

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the mooring operation was fully completed, i.e., all lines secured and vessel confirmed fast, or all lines cast off and vessel clear. Used for duration calculation and billing.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; IAPH Port Operations Standards; NAVIS N4 Billing Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this mooring operation record was first created in the system, representing the audit trail creation point. Used for data lineage and compliance auditing.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standards; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the charge amount (e.g., USD, AUD, SGD). Supports multi-currency port operations and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: current_speed_knots
attributes.description: Recorded water current speed in knots at the berth location during the mooring operation. Relevant for mooring load assessment and safety compliance.
attributes.references: IHO Hydrographic Standards; PIANC MarCom Report 121

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from commencement to completion of the mooring operation. Captured as a business field from the operational system for KPI reporting and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators; PMIS KPI Framework

attributes.name: gang_size
attributes.description: Number of mooring personnel deployed for this operation. Used for resource planning, billing calculation, and compliance with minimum manning requirements.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006); Port Labour Standards

attributes.name: gang_supervisor
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the supervisor leading the mooring gang for this operation. Used for accountability, incident investigation, and performance management.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006); ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: head_lines_count
attributes.description: Number of head lines (forward mooring lines running ahead of the vessel) deployed during the mooring operation. Part of the line configuration record for SWL compliance and operational audit.
attributes.references: OCIMF Mooring Equipment Guidelines (MEG4); SOLAS Chapter II-1

attributes.name: incident_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal marine incident report was raised as a result of this mooring operation. When true, the incident is tracked in the marine incident management system aligned with SOLAS and MARPOL requirements.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter XI-1 Reg 6; MARPOL; IMO Casualty Investigation Code (Res. MSC.255(84))

attributes.name: irregularity_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any mooring irregularity, safety observation, equipment deficiency, or non-conformance observed during the operation. Populated when irregularity_observed is true. Used for incident investigation and safety reporting.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter II-1; ISO 45001; MARPOL Annex I; ISPS Code

attributes.name: irregularity_observed
attributes.description: Indicates whether any mooring irregularity, safety observation, or non-conformance was recorded during this operation. When true, details are captured in the irregularity_description field.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter II-1; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; ISPS Code

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this mooring operation record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standards; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: line_material_type
attributes.description: Material composition of the mooring lines used in this operation. Relevant for SWL compliance verification and equipment condition assessment. HMPE = High Modulus Polyethylene (e.g., Dyneema).
attributes.references: OCIMF Mooring Equipment Guidelines (MEG4); ISO 1140 Fibre Ropes

attributes.name: mooring_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical mooring location type where the vessel is secured: conventional berth alongside a quay, single-point or multi-buoy mooring, dolphin structure, jetty, or open quay face.
attributes.references: PIANC MarCom Report 121; Port Infrastructure Classification Standards

attributes.name: operation_ref
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number assigned to this mooring or unmooring service event, used in billing, port management information system (PMIS) records, and inter-agency communications.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations Standards; PMIS Reference Numbering Convention

attributes.name: operation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the mooring operation, tracking progression from planning through execution to completion or cancellation.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations Standards; SOLAS Chapter V — Safety of Navigation

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the mooring service performed: mooring (securing vessel on arrival), unmooring (releasing vessel on departure), shifting (moving vessel between berths), or re-mooring (re-securing after adjustment).
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.1045(27); PIANC Working Group Reports

attributes.name: pi_club_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel's Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club insurer was notified of an incident or irregularity arising from this mooring operation. Relevant for liability and insurance claim management.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs Rules; IMO Casualty Investigation Code

attributes.name: pilot_on_board
attributes.description: Indicates whether a marine pilot was on board the vessel during this mooring operation. Relevant for coordination between pilotage and mooring services and for incident liability determination.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.960(23) — Recommendations on Training and Certification of Maritime Pilots; SOLAS Chapter V Reg 23

attributes.name: quick_release_hooks_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether quick-release mooring hooks were deployed during this operation. Quick-release hooks are critical safety equipment for emergency vessel release and are tracked for compliance and maintenance purposes.
attributes.references: OCIMF Mooring Equipment Guidelines (MEG4); PIANC MarCom Report 121

attributes.name: spring_lines_count
attributes.description: Number of spring lines (mooring lines running at an angle fore and aft to prevent surging) deployed during the mooring operation. Part of the full line configuration record.
attributes.references: OCIMF Mooring Equipment Guidelines (MEG4); SOLAS Chapter II-1

attributes.name: stern_lines_count
attributes.description: Number of stern lines (aft mooring lines running astern of the vessel) deployed during the mooring operation. Part of the line configuration record for SWL compliance and operational audit.
attributes.references: OCIMF Mooring Equipment Guidelines (MEG4); SOLAS Chapter II-1

attributes.name: swl_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all mooring lines and equipment used in this operation were verified to be within their Safe Working Load (SWL) limits at the time of the operation. Mandatory compliance check per OCIMF and port safety regulations.
attributes.references: OCIMF Mooring Equipment Guidelines (MEG4); ISO 45001; SOLAS Chapter II-1

attributes.name: total_lines_count
attributes.description: Total number of mooring lines deployed across all configurations (head, stern, breast, spring) for this operation. Used for equipment inventory reconciliation and billing.

attributes.name: towage_assist_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether tug assistance was used in conjunction with this mooring operation to manoeuvre the vessel to or from the berth. Used for service coordination and billing linkage to towage operations.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations Standards; IMO Resolution A.1045(27)

attributes.name: vessel_movement_type
attributes.description: Indicates the vessel movement context for which the mooring service is being performed: arrival at berth, departure from berth, or an intra-port shift between berths or positions.
attributes.references: VTMS Vessel Movement Classification; IMO FAL Convention

products.name: launch_dispatch
products.description: SSOT for the complete launch boat service including fleet asset management and operational dispatch. Captures launch boat master data (vessel name, registration, hull type, engine configuration, passenger capacity, SWL for cargo, certification status, survey dates, assigned berth/jetty, operational availability) and each dispatch event (purpose — pilot transfer, crew change, chandler delivery, inspection, surveyor boarding — vessel served, departure/return times, sea state, passengers carried, coxswain identity, safety observations). Supports 24/7 pilot transfer operations and anchorage service delivery.
products.reference: SOLAS Chapter III — Life-Saving Appliances / Port Launch Operations

attributes.name: launch_dispatch_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each launch boat dispatch event record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the launch_dispatch data product.

attributes.name: charge_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.charge_event. Business justification: Launch dispatch services generate charge events for pilot boat fees and crew transfer charges. Direct link to charge_event enables granular billing traceability per dispatch, required for launch servi

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Launch/pilot boat operations are cost-tracked by marine services cost centre for fuel, maintenance, and crew cost allocation. Required for marine services departmental budgeting and cost recovery calc

attributes.name: destination_anchorage_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.anchorage_area. Business justification: Launch boats transfer pilots and crew to vessels at anchorage; destination_location and anchorage_block currently text. Essential for pilot boat routing, fuel planning, and service coordination.

attributes.name: marine_service_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.marine_service_order. Business justification: Launch dispatch is the operational execution of launch services ordered via marine_service_order. The marine_service_order product has launch_service_required flag and launch_trip_count, indicating it

attributes.name: pilot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marine pilot record transported on this dispatch, applicable when dispatch_purpose is 'pilot_transfer'. Enables traceability between pilot assignments and launch dispatch operations.
attributes.references: VTMS Pilotage Scheduling Module; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: pilotage_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated pilotage order or marine service request that triggered this launch dispatch, enabling traceability between the service request and the physical dispatch execution.
attributes.references: VTMS Pilotage Scheduling Module; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: served_vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel record that this launch boat dispatch is serving (e.g., the ship receiving the pilot, crew, or surveyor). Links to the vessel master data product.

attributes.name: served_vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_master. Business justification: Launch dispatch to vessels requires vessel master data for ISPS security verification, pilot boarding ground determination, and P&I club notification protocols. Role-prefixed to distinguish from launc

attributes.name: vessel_call_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to booking.call_booking. Business justification: Launch services (pilot boats) are dispatched to serve booked vessel calls for pilot transfer. Booking triggers launch resource planning and scheduling. Operational necessity for pilot boarding/disemba

attributes.name: weather_tide_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.weather_tide_window. Business justification: launch_dispatch stores wind_speed_knots, visibility_nm, and sea_state_code inline. These operational conditions are authoritatively captured in weather_tide_window. Adding this FK normalises launch bo

attributes.name: actual_departure_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the launch boat departed the jetty. Compared against scheduled departure time to measure on-time performance and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: VTMS; IMO FAL Convention; Port KPI Framework

attributes.name: actual_return_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the launch boat returned to the departure jetty after completing the dispatch mission. Used to calculate total mission duration and vessel availability.
attributes.references: VTMS; Port KPI Framework; IAPH Port Performance Indicators

attributes.name: billing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this dispatch event to the port billing and tariff management system (NAVIS N4 Billing module or SAP FI) for invoicing of launch boat service charges (THC, launch fees).
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module; SAP S/4HANA FI; Port Tariff Schedule

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text reason for cancellation or abort of this dispatch, populated when dispatch_status is 'cancelled' or 'aborted'. Used for operational analysis and SLA dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Port Operations Standing Orders; IAPH Port Performance Indicators

attributes.name: cargo_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight in kilograms of any cargo or stores carried on this dispatch (e.g., chandler supplies, spare parts, provisions). Must not exceed the launch boat's Safe Working Load (SWL). Null if no cargo carried.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter VI; IMO MSC Guidelines; SWL Certification

attributes.name: coxswain_licence_number
attributes.description: Official maritime authority licence number of the coxswain, verified at dispatch to confirm the operator holds a valid and current certification to operate the launch vessel.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority; STCW Convention; MLC 2006

attributes.name: coxswain_name
attributes.description: Full name of the coxswain operating the launch boat for this dispatch, retained in the dispatch log for accountability, incident investigation, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 ILO Maritime Labour Convention; SOLAS Chapter V; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dispatch record was first created in the system, providing the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the service charge amount (e.g., USD, SGD, AUD). Supports multi-currency port operations and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: departure_jetty
attributes.description: Name or code of the jetty, berth, or landing point from which the launch boat departed for this dispatch mission. Used for operational planning and berth utilisation reporting.

attributes.name: destination_location
attributes.description: Target location or anchorage position where the launch boat is dispatched to (e.g., anchorage block, berth number, pilot boarding ground coordinates). Supports route planning and safety monitoring.

attributes.name: dispatch_authorised_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the port operations officer or VTS controller who authorised this launch boat dispatch, providing an accountability trail for operational decisions.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; VTMS Standing Orders; ISM Code

attributes.name: dispatch_priority
attributes.description: Operational priority classification of this dispatch. 'routine' = standard scheduled service; 'urgent' = expedited service required; 'emergency' = immediate response (e.g., medical evacuation, safety incident).
attributes.references: Port Standing Orders; SOLAS Chapter V; ISO 45001 OHS

attributes.name: dispatch_purpose
attributes.description: Primary operational purpose of the launch boat dispatch. Drives resource allocation, safety protocols, and billing tariff selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pilot_transfer|crew_change|chandler_delivery|inspection|surveyor_boarding|customs_boarding|medical_evacuation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; ISPS Code; SOLAS Chapter V

attributes.name: dispatch_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number assigned to this dispatch event, used for cross-system tracking and communication with vessel agents, pilots, and port operations. Format: LD-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: VTMS Pilotage Scheduling Module; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: dispatch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the launch boat dispatch event. 'scheduled' = assigned and awaiting departure; 'in_progress' = launch underway; 'completed' = mission accomplished and returned; 'cancelled' = cancelled before departure; 'aborted' = mission terminated mid-operation.
attributes.references: VTMS Pilotage Scheduling Module; ISPS Code

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_litres
attributes.description: Volume of fuel consumed in litres during this dispatch mission, recorded for fleet cost management, GHG emissions tracking, and MARPOL environmental reporting.
attributes.references: MARPOL Annex VI; IMO DCS (Data Collection System); ISO 14001; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: incident_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal marine incident or near-miss report was raised in connection with this dispatch event. True = incident report filed; False = no incident. Triggers P&I club notification workflow when True.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter IX ISM Code; MARPOL; P&I Club Notification Requirements; ISO 45001

attributes.name: isps_clearance_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Clearance Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ISPS security clearance was verified for all persons and cargo on this dispatch prior to departure. Mandatory for port facility security compliance.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 16; SOLAS Chapter XI-2; IMO

attributes.name: life_jackets_worn
attributes.description: Indicates whether all persons on board the launch boat wore life jackets for the duration of this dispatch, as required by SOLAS and port safety standing orders.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter III Regulation 20; ISO 45001 OHS; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: marpol_compliance_checked
attributes.description: Indicates whether MARPOL environmental compliance checks (e.g., no illegal discharge, waste handling) were completed for this dispatch. Mandatory for environmental management system (EMS) audit trails.
attributes.references: MARPOL 73/78 Annexes I-VI; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; IMO

attributes.name: mission_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from actual departure to actual return for this dispatch mission. Stored as a raw operational field to support billing, SLA analysis, and fleet utilisation reporting.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators; Port Tariff Management

attributes.name: night_operation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dispatch was conducted during night hours (typically between sunset and sunrise as defined by port standing orders). Night operations attract additional safety requirements and may carry premium tariff rates.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter V; National Maritime Safety Authority; Port Tariff Schedule

attributes.name: passengers_carried
attributes.description: Total number of persons (pilots, crew, surveyors, inspectors, chandlers) transported on this dispatch. Must not exceed the launch boat's certified passenger capacity. Critical for SOLAS safety compliance.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter III; National Maritime Safety Authority; IMO MSC Circular

attributes.name: pi_club_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel's Protection and Indemnity (P&I) club has been formally notified of an incident arising from this dispatch. Required for insurance and liability management.
attributes.references: P&I Club Rules; IMO ISM Code; SOLAS Chapter IX

attributes.name: pilot_boarding_ground
attributes.description: Name or code of the designated pilot boarding/disembarking ground where the pilot transfer took place (e.g., anchorage block, outer roads, inner harbour). Defined by port authority standing orders.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter V Regulation 23; IMO Resolution A.1045(27); VTS

attributes.name: safety_observation
attributes.description: Free-text field for the coxswain or dispatcher to record any safety observations, near-misses, equipment anomalies, or unusual conditions encountered during the dispatch mission. Feeds into the port safety management system.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter IX ISM Code; ISO 45001 OHS; MARPOL Annex I

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_time
attributes.description: Planned departure timestamp for the launch boat from the jetty, aligned with the pilotage schedule or service request. Used for SLA monitoring and resource scheduling.
attributes.references: VTMS Pilotage Scheduling Module; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: service_charge_amount
attributes.description: Gross charge amount levied for this launch boat dispatch service as per the port tariff schedule. Expressed in the port's operating currency. Used for revenue recognition and billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: Port Tariff Schedule; SAP S/4HANA FI-CO; IAPH Port Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this dispatch record, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking in the silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

products.name: surveyor
products.description: Master record for each marine surveyor authorised to operate within port jurisdiction. Covers classification society surveyors, P&I correspondents, cargo surveyors, condition surveyors, and draught surveyors. Captures surveyor name, accreditation body (Lloyd's, DNV, Bureau Veritas, ClassNK, ABS), surveyor type, scope of authorisation, contact details, company affiliation, port access credentials, insurance validity, and current active status. SSOT for surveyor identity and authorisation within port waters.
products.reference: IACS — International Association of Classification Societies

attributes.name: surveyor_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each marine surveyor record. Primary key for the surveyor master data product within the marine domain.

attributes.name: access_credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.access_credential. Business justification: Surveyors access restricted berths and vessel areas under ISPS; their port access credential must be validated before each survey appointment. surveyor.port_access_credential_number and port_access_ex

attributes.name: company_port_community_participant_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surveyor Company Port Community Participant Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.port_community_participant. Business justification: Surveying firms are port_community_participants holding accreditations and billing accounts. Linking surveyor to their company participant enables accreditation management, billing, and multi-port aut

attributes.name: home_port_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.port. Business justification: Surveyors are authorised per port by the port authority. home_port_code is a denormalized text field. Port-level surveyor accreditation management, availability scheduling, and regulatory authorisatio

attributes.name: nationality_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Surveyor port access credential verification, passport validation, and accreditation body recognition require country master data (IMO member status, MOU membership) for security clearance and authori

attributes.name: primary_port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Surveyor deployment and authorisation management requires linking surveyors to their primary port. Port authority authorisation records are port-specific; home_port_code is a denormalized string that

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Name of the classification society or professional body that has accredited and authorised the surveyor to conduct marine surveys. Determines the scope of surveys the individual may certify. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Lloyds|DNV|Bureau Veritas|ClassNK|ABS|RINA|CCS|BKI|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.739(18); IACS Unified Requirements

attributes.name: authorisation_granted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the port authority formally granted the surveyor authorisation to operate within port jurisdiction. Marks the start of the surveyor's active engagement lifecycle at the port.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 18; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: authorisation_revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surveyor's port authorisation was revoked or permanently withdrawn. Null if the surveyor has never been revoked. Used for compliance audit trails and ISPS security records.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 18; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: authorisation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the surveyor's authorisation to operate within port jurisdiction. Controls gate access, survey report acceptance, and P&I notification eligibility. Active = fully authorised; Suspended = temporarily restricted; Expired = credentials lapsed; Revoked = permanently withdrawn; Pending = application under review.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 18; National Maritime Safety Authority Port Access Regulations

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current operational availability of the surveyor for new survey assignments. Used by the Port Management Information System (PMIS) and marine services scheduling to dispatch surveyors to vessels in a timely manner.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations Standards; SLA Management

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary professional email address for the surveyor. Used for survey appointment notifications, P&I club correspondence, port access credential communications, and EDI messaging via the Port Community System (PCS).

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the marine surveyor as registered with their accreditation body and port authority. Used for identification on survey reports, port access credentials, and P&I correspondence.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; ISPS Code Section 9

attributes.name: imdg_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveyor is certified to survey and certify the handling, stowage, and transport of dangerous goods in accordance with the International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code; SOLAS Chapter VII

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surveyor's professional indemnity insurance coverage expires. Port access authorisation is contingent on valid insurance; this date triggers renewal alerts and access suspension workflows.
attributes.references: P&I Club Rules; ISPS Code; National Maritime Safety Authority Port Access Regulations

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy reference number for the surveyor's professional indemnity insurance. Recorded for port authority compliance verification and P&I club notification processes.
attributes.references: P&I Club Rules; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: insurance_provider
attributes.description: Name of the insurance company or P&I Club providing professional indemnity coverage for the surveyor. Required as part of port authorisation to ensure liability coverage for survey activities within port waters.
attributes.references: P&I Club Rules; IMO Guidelines on Liability; ISO 28000

attributes.name: languages_spoken
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639-1 language codes for languages the surveyor is proficient in. Relevant for vessel boarding communications, survey report preparation, and coordination with international vessel crews.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance audit or vetting review conducted by the port authority or accreditation body on the surveyor's credentials, insurance, and operational performance. Supports Port State Control (PSC) readiness.
attributes.references: PSC Memoranda of Understanding; ISPS Code; ISO 28000

attributes.name: licence_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surveyor's current licence or accreditation certificate expires. Port access and survey report acceptance are automatically restricted when this date is passed and authorisation_status is not renewed.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.739(18); ISPS Code; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: licence_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surveyor's current licence or accreditation certificate was issued by the authorising body. Used to calculate licence age and determine renewal eligibility.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.739(18); National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: licence_number
attributes.description: Official licence or certificate number issued by the accreditation body or national maritime authority authorising the surveyor to conduct marine surveys. Referenced on all survey certificates and port access documentation.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.739(18); National Maritime Safety Authority Licensing Regulations

attributes.name: marpol_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveyor holds a valid certification to conduct surveys and inspections under the International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL). Required for pollution prevention and environmental compliance surveys.

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile/cell phone number for the surveyor in E.164 international format. Used for on-call survey dispatch, real-time vessel boarding coordination, and emergency contact during port operations.

attributes.name: multi_port_authorised
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveyor holds authorisation to operate across multiple port facilities within the port authority's jurisdiction, beyond their primary home port. Relevant for port groups managing multiple terminals.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; National Maritime Safety Authority Port Access Regulations

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory compliance audit or credential review of the surveyor. Drives proactive renewal workflows and prevents lapsed authorisations from disrupting port operations.
attributes.references: PSC Memoranda of Understanding; ISPS Code; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes recorded by port authority staff regarding the surveyor's credentials, special conditions of authorisation, known limitations, or relevant historical context. Not used for structured reporting.

attributes.name: on_call_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveyor is currently designated as on-call for emergency or after-hours survey dispatch, including marine incident response, P&I notifications, and urgent cargo condition surveys.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations Standards; SOLAS Chapter I

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: Passport number of the surveyor as recorded for ISPS port security screening and identity verification. Required for international surveyors accessing restricted port areas.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 18; IMO FAL Convention; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the surveyor in E.164 international format. Used for urgent survey dispatch, marine incident response coordination, and P&I club notifications.

attributes.name: pi_club_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club for which the surveyor acts as a correspondent or appointed representative. Relevant for P&I surveyors handling cargo claims, collision liability, and pollution incidents within port waters.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs Rules; IMO Guidelines

attributes.name: port_access_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the port access credential was issued to the surveyor. Used for access lifecycle management and ISPS compliance auditing.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: The surveyor's preferred channel for receiving survey dispatch notifications and port communications. Options include email, phone, mobile, pcs_message (Port Community System message), or edi (Electronic Data Interchange).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the surveyor master record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail entry point for the surveyor's lifecycle within the port's data systems, aligned with Silver Layer lineage requirements.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the surveyor master record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason for revocation of the surveyor's port authorisation, where applicable. Supports compliance investigations, PSC audit responses, and ISPS security incident records.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; PSC Memoranda of Understanding; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: scope_of_authorisation
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific survey activities, vessel types, cargo categories, or operational areas the surveyor is authorised to cover within port jurisdiction. May reference SOLAS, MARPOL, IMDG, or classification society-specific survey categories.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter I Regulation 6; MARPOL Annex I; IACS Unified Requirements

attributes.name: seaman_book_number
attributes.description: Seafarer's identity document or continuous discharge book number, where applicable. Some classification society and P&I surveyors hold seafarer credentials that facilitate vessel boarding under ILO Maritime Labour Convention requirements.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: solas_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveyor holds a valid certification to conduct surveys under the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS). Required for structural, safety equipment, and load line surveys.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter I Regulation 6; IACS Unified Requirements

attributes.name: specialisation_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specialisation codes indicating the surveyor's certified areas of expertise, such as IMDG dangerous goods, MARPOL pollution prevention, SOLAS structural surveys, draught surveys, or reefer cargo. Drives survey assignment matching in the Port Management Information System (PMIS).
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS; MARPOL; IMDG Code; IACS Unified Requirements

attributes.name: surveyor_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the surveyor by the port authority or accreditation body. Used as the business-facing identifier on survey certificates, gate access systems, and Port Community System (PCS) messaging.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Access Standards; ISPS Code

attributes.name: surveyor_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the surveyor's primary function within port operations. Values: classification (classification society surveyor), pi_correspondent (P&I Club correspondent), cargo (cargo surveyor), condition (condition/on-hire/off-hire surveyor), draught (draught survey specialist).
attributes.references: IAPH; IMO MSC Guidelines; P&I Club Correspondent Standards

attributes.name: vessel_type_authorisations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vessel types the surveyor is authorised to survey, such as container vessels, bulk carriers, tankers, RoRo vessels, LNG carriers, or passenger ships. Ensures correct surveyor-to-vessel matching for survey assignments.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter I; IACS Unified Requirements; Classification Society Rules

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total number of years of professional marine surveying experience. Used for surveyor capability assessment, complex survey assignment eligibility, and SLA performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: IAPH Surveyor Competency Standards; IMO STCW Convention

products.name: survey_appointment
products.description: Transactional record for each marine survey engagement at the port, capturing the survey type (condition survey, draught survey, damage survey, pre-loading survey, hatch inspection), vessel being surveyed, appointed surveyor, survey commencement and completion timestamps, berth or anchorage location, cargo or equipment scope, survey outcome, and certificate or report reference number.
products.reference: IACS Unified Requirements / P&I Club Survey Procedures

attributes.name: survey_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each marine survey appointment record. Primary key for the survey_appointment data product.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.744(18) — Guidelines on the Enhanced Programme of Inspections

attributes.name: anchorage_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.anchorage_area. Business justification: Draft surveys, bunker surveys, and condition surveys conducted at anchorage; anchorage_reference currently text. Required for surveyor dispatch, launch coordination, and survey report accuracy.

attributes.name: berth_id
attributes.description: Reference to the berth where the vessel is moored at the time of the survey, linking to the berth master data product.

attributes.description: Reference to the specific port call or vessel visit during which the survey is conducted, linking to the port call or vessel visit record.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Requesting Party Port Community Participant Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.port_community_participant. attributes.name: actual_commencement
attributes.description: The actual date and time at which the survey commenced on board or at the survey location. Used for SLA performance measurement and billing.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; IAPH Port Performance KPI Framework

attributes.name: actual_completion
attributes.description: The actual date and time at which the survey was concluded and the surveyor departed the vessel or survey location. Used for duration calculation and billing.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; IAPH Port Performance KPI Framework

attributes.name: appointment_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the survey appointment, used in correspondence with surveyors, P&I clubs, and port stakeholders. Format: SVY-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Management Standards; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the survey appointment, tracking progression from scheduling through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_progress|completed|cancelled|postponed|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IAPH Port Management Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for cancellation or postponement of the survey appointment when appointment_status is 'cancelled' or 'postponed'. Captures operational context such as vessel departure, weather, surveyor unavailability.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; IAPH Port Management Standards

attributes.name: cargo_quantity_mt
attributes.description: Quantity of cargo in metric tonnes within the scope of the survey, particularly relevant for draught surveys and pre-loading surveys where cargo weight determination is the primary objective.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter VI; IMO Draught Survey Guidelines; PIANC

attributes.name: cargo_scope
attributes.description: Description of the cargo or equipment included within the scope of the survey, including commodity type, quantity, and relevant cargo identifiers (e.g., Bill of Lading numbers, container numbers, bulk cargo description).
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code; SOLAS Chapter VI — Carriage of Cargoes; BOL Standards

attributes.name: certificate_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the survey certificate or formal survey report issued upon completion of the survey, used for regulatory compliance tracking and document management.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter I Regulation 12 — Certificates; IMO FAL Convention; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the survey appointment record was first created in the system, providing the audit trail creation marker.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: deficiency_count
attributes.description: Number of deficiencies or non-conformances identified during the survey. Used for PSC inspection risk profiling and vessel performance tracking.
attributes.references: PSC MOU Tokyo MOU / Paris MOU Inspection Procedures; SOLAS Chapter I

attributes.name: deficiency_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of deficiencies, non-conformances, or observations identified during the survey. Provides qualitative context beyond the deficiency count.
attributes.references: PSC MOU Inspection Procedures; IMO Resolution A.744(18); SOLAS

attributes.name: draught_aft_m
attributes.description: Aft draught reading of the vessel in metres at the time of the survey, recorded for draught surveys to determine cargo weight by displacement calculation.
attributes.references: IMO Draught Survey Guidelines; SOLAS Chapter VI; ICS Draught Survey Procedures

attributes.name: draught_forward_m
attributes.description: Forward draught reading of the vessel in metres at the time of the survey, recorded for draught surveys to determine cargo weight by displacement calculation.
attributes.references: IMO Draught Survey Guidelines; SOLAS Chapter VI; ICS Draught Survey Procedures

attributes.name: draught_midship_m
attributes.description: Midship draught reading of the vessel in metres at the time of the survey, used in conjunction with forward and aft draughts for accurate displacement and cargo weight calculation.
attributes.references: IMO Draught Survey Guidelines; SOLAS Chapter VI; ICS Draught Survey Procedures

attributes.name: isps_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ISPS Code security requirements were verified as part of the survey scope, applicable for condition surveys and port facility security assessments.
attributes.references: ISPS Code — IMO SOLAS Chapter XI-2; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the survey appointment record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: marpol_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether MARPOL-related environmental compliance aspects were assessed during the survey, particularly relevant for condition surveys and damage surveys involving potential pollution risk.
attributes.references: MARPOL 73/78 Convention — IMO; Environmental Monitoring System (EMS)

attributes.name: pi_club_name
attributes.description: Name of the P&I club insuring the vessel, notified in connection with damage surveys or marine incidents (e.g., UK P&I Club, Gard, Skuld, West of England).
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs; SOLAS; MARPOL Convention

attributes.name: pi_club_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel's P&I (Protection and Indemnity) club has been formally notified of the survey appointment, particularly relevant for damage surveys and incident-related surveys.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs Rules; SOLAS; MARPOL

attributes.name: pi_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the P&I club was formally notified of the survey or marine incident, used for insurance claim timeline management.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs Rules; IMO SOLAS

attributes.name: psc_inspection_triggered
attributes.business_glossary_term: Port State Control (PSC) Inspection Triggered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the survey outcome or deficiencies identified triggered a formal Port State Control inspection by the relevant PSC authority.
attributes.references: PSC MOU (Tokyo MOU / Paris MOU) Inspection Procedures; SOLAS Chapter I Regulation 19

attributes.name: rectification_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which identified deficiencies must be rectified and evidence of rectification submitted to the surveying authority. Applicable when survey outcome is 'failed' or 'conditional_pass'.
attributes.references: PSC MOU Detention and Deficiency Procedures; SOLAS Chapter I Regulation 19

attributes.name: report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the detailed survey report document produced by the surveyor, distinct from the certificate number. Used for document retrieval and audit trail.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.744(18); IACS Unified Requirements; ISO 9001

attributes.name: scheduled_commencement
attributes.description: The planned date and time at which the survey is scheduled to commence, used for surveyor dispatch planning and vessel scheduling coordination.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; PMIS Survey Scheduling

attributes.name: solas_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the survey was conducted in compliance with SOLAS requirements, confirming that mandatory SOLAS survey protocols were followed.
attributes.references: SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) Convention — IMO; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: survey_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from actual survey commencement to actual completion. Used for operational performance analysis and billing verification.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance KPI Framework; ISO 9001

attributes.name: survey_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical location where the survey is conducted, distinguishing between berth-side, anchorage, dry dock, buoy mooring, or offshore positions.
attributes.references: PIANC Port Infrastructure Guidelines; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: survey_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and observations recorded by the surveyor or port marine services team regarding the survey appointment, including special conditions, access arrangements, or supplementary findings.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; IAPH Port Management Standards

attributes.name: survey_outcome
attributes.description: The formal result or finding of the survey engagement. 'passed' indicates satisfactory condition, 'failed' indicates deficiencies requiring rectification, 'conditional_pass' indicates minor deficiencies with conditions attached, 'inconclusive' indicates insufficient evidence for determination, 'deferred' indicates survey could not be completed and must be rescheduled.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter I — Survey and Certification; IMO Resolution A.744(18); PSC MOU Inspection Outcomes

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: Classification of the marine survey engagement indicating the nature and scope of the inspection. Values include: condition survey (general vessel condition assessment), draught survey (cargo weight determination by displacement), damage survey (assessment of vessel or cargo damage), pre-loading survey (cargo readiness inspection before loading), hatch inspection (hatch cover integrity and weathertightness check).
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.744(18); SOLAS Chapter XI-1; ICS Ship Inspection Report Programme

attributes.name: surveying_organisation
attributes.description: Name of the classification society, P&I club surveying firm, or independent marine surveying organisation that appointed the surveyor (e.g., Lloyd's Register, Bureau Veritas, DNV, ABS).
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.739(18); IACS (International Association of Classification Societies) Unified Requirements

products.name: marine_incident
products.description: SSOT for all marine incident records and their investigation lifecycle within port waters. Covers the full incident-to-closure process: initial reporting of near-misses, collisions, groundings, allisions, mooring failures, pollution events, and man-overboard events; formal investigation under IMO Casualty Investigation Code including root cause analysis, contributing factor classification, and corrective actions; and regulatory notification dispatch (AMSA, PSC, flag state, IMO). Captures incident datetime, location (lat/long and berth/fairway reference), vessels involved, incident category (SOLAS/MARPOL classification), immediate cause, injuries/fatalities, environmental impact, investigation team, findings, and closure status.
products.reference: SOLAS Chapter XI-1 / MARPOL Annex I–VI / IMO Casualty Investigation Code

attributes.name: amsa_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Australian Maritime Safety Authority (AMSA) Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Australian Maritime Safety Authority (AMSA) has been formally notified of the incident as required under national maritime safety regulations.

attributes.name: contributing_factors
attributes.description: Structured narrative of secondary contributing factors identified during investigation, such as weather conditions, equipment state, crew fatigue, or procedural non-compliance. Supports multi-causal analysis.

attributes.name: corrective_actions_due_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the incident record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: datetime
attributes.description: The precise date and time (UTC) at which the marine incident occurred or was first observed. This is the principal real-world event timestamp used for regulatory reporting and investigation timelines.

attributes.name: estimated_damage_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated total financial cost of damage to vessel, cargo, and port infrastructure resulting from the incident, expressed in USD. Used for insurance claims, P&I notifications, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: fatalities_count
attributes.description: Total number of fatalities directly resulting from the incident. A non-zero value triggers mandatory IMO Very Serious Casualty classification and flag-state notification.

attributes.name: flag_state_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel's flag state administration has been formally notified of the incident as required under SOLAS Chapter XI-1 Regulation 6.

attributes.name: human_factor_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether a human factor (crew error, pilot error, shore-side decision) was identified as a contributing cause of the incident. Used for safety trend analysis and training programme targeting.
attributes.references: IMO Casualty Investigation Code; ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC)

attributes.name: immediate_cause
attributes.description: Narrative description of the direct, proximate cause of the incident as determined during initial reporting (e.g., 'Mooring line parted under excessive load', 'Engine failure during berthing manoeuvre'). May be updated during formal investigation.
attributes.references: IMO Casualty Investigation Code Chapter 3; ISO 28000

attributes.name: imo_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMO has been formally notified of the incident. Required for Very Serious Casualties under the IMO Casualty Investigation Code.

attributes.description: Description of the requirements the master must fulfill for certificate renewal, such as minimum number of passages, re-examination, medical fitness, or continuing education.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pilotage exemption certificate was permanently revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for permanent revocation of the pilotage exemption certificate, if applicable (e.g., serious safety violation, loss of master license, fraudulent application).

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pilotage exemption certificate was suspended.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for suspension of the pilotage exemption certificate, if applicable (e.g., safety incident, medical unfitness, regulatory non-compliance).

attributes.name: total_passages_under_exemption
attributes.description: The cumulative number of passages the master has completed using this pilotage exemption certificate since it was issued.

products.name: marine_service_order
products.description: Commercial service order record capturing the formal request and authorisation for bundled marine services (pilotage, towage, mooring, launch, surveyor boarding) for a specific vessel call. Captures requesting agent, vessel call reference, services requested with estimated service windows, approved service providers, agreed tariff codes, priority/urgency classification, and order lifecycle status (requested, confirmed, in-progress, completed, cancelled). Acts as the commercial anchor linking marine service delivery to the billing and tariff domains. SSOT for marine service commercials.
products.reference: Port Community System (PCS) — Service Order Workflow

attributes.name: marine_service_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marine service order. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: agent_appointment_id

attributes.name: authorized_security_zone_id
