attributes.name: berth_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.berth. Business justification: Marine service orders are raised for vessel calls at specific berths, coordinating pilotage, towage, and mooring services. Berth-level service scheduling, resource allocation, and operational readines

attributes.name: billing_participant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.participant_account. Business justification: Marine service orders generate charges billed to a specific participant_account. The billing/AR process requires this direct link to apply credit limits, post charges, and generate account statements

attributes.name: booking_service_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to booking.booking_service_order. Business justification: Booking service orders (commercial requests) generate marine service orders (operational execution). Port operations require end-to-end workflow traceability from the booked service request to its mar

attributes.name: contact_person_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact_person. Business justification: Marine service orders require a named operational contact for coordination, notifications, and confirmations (e.g., pilot boarding time alerts, tug readiness notifications). Port operations teams rout

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Service orders are fulfilled by specific operational cost centres. Essential for service costing, profitability analysis by service line, and transfer pricing between port authority business units.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.customs_declaration. Business justification: Marine service orders (pilotage, towage, mooring) require customs clearance status verification before service authorization. Port community systems check customs declaration status before approving s

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Port finance creates internal orders for project-based marine service cost control and settlement. Major vessel calls (LNG, cruise, emergency) require internal order tracking for capex/opex reporting

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Marine service orders bundle pilotage, towage, mooring, and launch services for a vessel call. The order is invoiced as a package. Links service order to final invoice for consolidated marine service

attributes.name: marsec_level_change_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.marsec_level_change. Business justification: ISPS requires all marine service orders (pilotage, towage, mooring) to be executed under the prevailing MARSEC level, which dictates additional security measures, screening requirements, and access co

attributes.name: mooring_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.mooring_tariff. Business justification: Marine service orders reference specific mooring tariffs for billing. Currently has tariff_code_mooring as a string. Adding FK to tariff.mooring_tariff enables proper tariff application and rate looku

attributes.name: pilotage_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.pilotage_tariff. Business justification: Marine service orders reference specific pilotage tariffs for billing. Currently has tariff_code_pilotage as a string. Adding FK to tariff.pilotage_tariff enables proper tariff application and rate lo

attributes.name: port_dues_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.port_dues_schedule. Business justification: Pre-arrival cost estimation and port call billing: the marine_service_order is the central billing document for a vessel call and must reference the applicable port_dues_schedule to calculate total po

attributes.name: primary_marine_port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed pilotage service provider assigned to deliver pilotage services for this order. Must be an authorized pilot organization per port regulations.

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Marine service orders generate revenue attributed to profit centres (pilotage, towage, mooring service lines) for P&L reporting. Port finance P&L statements report marine services revenue by profit ce

attributes.name: service_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.service_code. Business justification: Marine service order billing, tariff application, GL account mapping, and revenue recognition require service code master data (billing basis, tax code, tariff schedule) for financial processing and r

attributes.name: tertiary_marine_approved_mooring_provider_port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mooring service provider assigned to deliver line handling services for this order. Must be a certified mooring contractor with trained personnel.
attributes.references: International Labour Organization (ILO) - Maritime Labour Convention

attributes.name: towage_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.towage_tariff. Business justification: Marine service orders reference specific towage tariffs for billing. Currently has tariff_code_towage as a string. Adding FK to tariff.towage_tariff enables proper tariff application and rate lookup.

attributes.name: vessel_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific vessel call for which marine services are being ordered. Links this service order to the vessel visit event.

attributes.name: actual_service_end
attributes.description: Actual date and time when all marine services were completed. Used for final billing calculation and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) measurement.

attributes.name: actual_service_start
attributes.description: Actual date and time when marine services commenced. Recorded for billing accuracy, Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance, and operational performance tracking.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for order cancellation if status is cancelled. Examples: vessel schedule change, weather delay, agent request, service provider unavailability.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the marine service order was cancelled. Used to calculate cancellation fees per tariff terms and conditions.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all marine services in the order were marked as completed and the order was closed. Triggers final billing and invoicing processes.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the marine service order was confirmed by the port authority or service coordinator. Marks the transition from requested to confirmed status.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the marine service order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and order lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this order. Typically the local port currency unless otherwise agreed with the agent.

attributes.name: estimated_service_end
attributes.description: Estimated date and time when all requested marine services are expected to be completed. Used for resource planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: estimated_service_start
attributes.description: Estimated date and time when the marine services are expected to commence. Typically aligned with vessel Estimated Time of Berthing (ETB) or Estimated Time of Departure (ETD).

attributes.name: estimated_total_charge
attributes.description: Estimated total charge for all marine services in this order, calculated from applicable tariff rates and estimated service parameters. Excludes taxes and adjustments.

attributes.name: launch_service_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether launch boat services are requested for personnel transfer between shore and vessel, or between vessels.
attributes.references: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Convention

attributes.name: launch_trip_count
attributes.description: Number of launch boat trips requested for personnel or light cargo transfer. Each round trip between shore and vessel counts as one trip.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified the marine service order record. Tracks accountability for order changes and updates.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the marine service order record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: mooring_gang_size
attributes.description: Number of mooring personnel required for the line handling operation. Typically ranges from 4 to 12 personnel depending on vessel size and berth configuration.
attributes.references: Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) - Marine Operations

attributes.name: mooring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether mooring services (line handling and securing vessel to berth) are requested as part of this service order.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: number_of_tugs
attributes.description: Number of tug boats requested for the towage operation. Determined by vessel size, weather conditions, and port regulations. Typically ranges from 1 to 4 tugs.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the marine service order, used in communications with agents, service providers, and billing systems. Format: MSO-YYYYNNNN.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the marine service order. Tracks progression from initial request through service delivery completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the marine service order based on urgency and scheduling requirements. Emergency orders receive priority dispatch and may incur premium charges.

attributes.name: pilot_boarding_location
attributes.description: Designated location where the marine pilot will board or disembark the vessel. Typically specified as a named pilot station, anchorage, or berth identifier.

attributes.name: pilotage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether marine pilotage services are requested as part of this service order. Pilotage is typically mandatory for vessels above certain size thresholds per port regulations.

attributes.name: pilotage_type
attributes.description: Specific type of pilotage service requested. Inbound covers entry from sea to berth, outbound covers departure from berth to sea, shifting covers berth-to-berth movements within port.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for service delivery scheduling and resource allocation. Critical priority is reserved for safety-related or emergency situations.

attributes.name: service_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of marine service delivery in minutes, calculated from actual start to actual end. Used for billing time-based charges and productivity analysis.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special handling instructions, safety requirements, or operational notes relevant to the marine service delivery. Examples: dangerous cargo notifications, restricted maneuvering areas, VIP vessel handling.

attributes.name: surveyor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a marine surveyor boarding is requested for cargo inspection, damage assessment, or compliance verification purposes.

attributes.name: surveyor_type
attributes.description: Type of marine survey requested. Cargo surveys verify quantity and condition, hull surveys assess vessel structure, draft surveys measure cargo weight via vessel displacement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cargo|hull|bunker|draft|damage|pre_loading|post_discharge — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: towage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether towage (tug boat) services are requested as part of this service order. Towage assists with vessel maneuvering, berthing, and unberthing operations.

attributes.name: tug_horsepower_required
attributes.description: Minimum total horsepower (HP) required for the towage operation, calculated based on vessel deadweight tonnage (DWT), length overall (LOA), and environmental conditions.

attributes.name: weather_restrictions
attributes.description: Weather or environmental conditions under which the marine services cannot be safely delivered. Examples: maximum wind speed, minimum visibility, sea state limits.
attributes.references: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Convention

products.name: tug_assignment
products.description: Transactional record linking specific tugs to towage orders, capturing tug identifier, assigned position (bow/stern/standby), tug master on duty, mobilisation and demobilisation timestamps, actual bollard pull applied, fuel consumption, and assignment outcome. Enables tracking of individual tug utilisation per towage event when multiple tugs serve a single vessel.

attributes.name: tug_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tug assignment record. Primary key for the tug assignment entity.

attributes.name: berth_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.berth. Business justification: Tug assignments are executed at specific berths when assisting vessel berthing/unberthing. Berth-level tug utilisation reporting, towage billing reconciliation, and berth operational planning all requ

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.channel. Business justification: Escort towage assignments occur within specific channels. Channel-level tug escort requirements (mandated by port directions for certain vessel sizes/types) and channel traffic management reporting re

attributes.name: charge_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.charge_event. Business justification: Individual tug assignments generate charge events (per-tug billing based on bollard pull, duration, and engagement time). Each assignment creates a billable event. Links tug assignment to charge event

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Individual tug deployments are cost-tracked for fuel, crew, and maintenance allocation to operational cost centres. Required for activity-based costing and tug fleet profitability analysis in port ope

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Individual tug assignments for emergency response or project-based deployments are settled against internal orders for cost attribution. Port finance requires tug assignment costs to be traceable to s

attributes.name: reassigned_tug_assignment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on tug_assignment (reassigned_tug_assignment_id)

attributes.name: security_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_incident. Business justification: Tug operations in restricted waters trigger security incidents when tugs enter unauthorized security zones, violate MARSEC-level movement restrictions, or experience security breaches during vessel es

attributes.name: towage_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent towage order that this tug assignment fulfills. Links the individual tug assignment to the overall towage service request.

attributes.name: tug_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific tug vessel assigned to this towage operation. Identifies which tug from the fleet is performing the service.

attributes.name: weather_tide_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.weather_tide_window. Business justification: tug_assignment stores wind_speed_knots, wind_direction_degrees, visibility_nm, sea_state_code, tide_height_m, and weather_conditions inline. weather_tide_window is the SSOT for all these operational c

attributes.name: abort_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation if the tug assignment was aborted before completion. Captures operational, safety, or environmental factors that prevented completion.

attributes.name: actual_demobilisation_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the tug returned to its berth or anchorage after completing the towage assignment. Used for utilisation tracking and billing.

attributes.name: actual_mobilisation_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the tug departed from its berth or anchorage to commence the towage assignment. Used for performance tracking and billing.

attributes.name: assigned_position
attributes.description: The designated attachment position or role of the tug relative to the vessel being assisted. Critical for operational coordination and safety planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bow|stern|port_bow|starboard_bow|port_quarter|starboard_quarter|standby|escort — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assignment_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the tug assignment from mobilisation to demobilisation, measured in minutes. Used for billing and performance analysis.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Business reference number for this tug assignment, used for operational tracking and communication. May follow port-specific numbering conventions.

attributes.name: assignment_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the tug assignment. Indicates whether the towage operation was completed successfully or encountered issues.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tug assignment. Tracks the progression from scheduling through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|mobilising|on_station|engaged|demobilising|completed|cancelled|aborted — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tug assignment is billable to the customer. Some assignments may be non-billable due to operational reasons or contractual arrangements.

attributes.name: billing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this tug assignment to the billing system. Used for revenue recognition and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: bollard_pull_applied_tonnes
attributes.description: Actual bollard pull force applied by the tug during the towage operation, measured in tonnes. Critical for safety assessment and performance verification.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation if the tug assignment was cancelled before mobilisation. Captures business or operational reasons for cancellation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tug assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: current_direction_degrees
attributes.description: Water current direction during the towage operation, measured in degrees (0-360, where 0/360 is North). Affects vessel handling and tug positioning.

attributes.name: current_speed_knots
attributes.description: Water current speed during the towage operation, measured in knots. Critical environmental factor affecting towage safety and difficulty.

attributes.name: disengagement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tug disengaged from the vessel (lines cast off or push ceased). Marks the end of active towage.

attributes.name: engagement_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of active towage engagement (from engagement to disengagement), measured in minutes. Distinguishes active towing time from standby time.

attributes.name: engagement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tug physically engaged with the vessel (lines made fast or push commenced). Marks the start of active towage.

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_litres
attributes.description: Volume of fuel consumed by the tug during this assignment, measured in litres. Used for cost allocation and environmental reporting.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel used by the tug during this assignment. Relevant for emissions calculations and MARPOL compliance reporting.

attributes.name: incident_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal incident was reported during or as a result of this tug assignment. Triggers incident investigation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Casualty Investigation Code

attributes.name: max_bollard_pull_applied_tonnes
attributes.description: Peak bollard pull force applied by the tug during the towage operation, measured in tonnes. Used for safety analysis and equipment stress assessment.

attributes.name: on_station_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tug arrived at the designated position and was ready to commence towage operations. Marks the start of active service.

attributes.name: operational_narrative
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the towage operation, including key events, decisions, and outcomes. Provides comprehensive operational record.

attributes.name: pi_club_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Protection and Indemnity (P&I) club was notified of any incident or potential claim arising from this tug assignment.
attributes.references: International Group of Protection and Indemnity Clubs

attributes.name: pi_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the Protection and Indemnity (P&I) club was notified of the incident or potential claim. Critical for claims management and compliance.
attributes.references: International Group of Protection and Indemnity Clubs

attributes.name: safety_observation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any safety observations, near-misses, or concerns were noted during the tug assignment. Triggers review and follow-up actions.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: safety_observation_notes
attributes.description: Detailed description of any safety observations, near-misses, or concerns noted during the tug assignment. Used for safety management and continuous improvement.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: scheduled_mobilisation_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the tug is scheduled to depart from its berth or anchorage to commence the towage assignment.

attributes.name: tow_line_length_m
attributes.description: Length of the tow line deployed during the towage operation, measured in meters. Affects the mechanical advantage and safety margin.

attributes.name: tow_line_type
attributes.description: Type of tow line used for the towage operation. Different line types have different strength, elasticity, and handling characteristics.

attributes.name: tug_master_licence_number
attributes.description: The professional licence or certificate number of the tug master, verifying their competency and authorization to command the tug.
attributes.references: Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers (STCW)

attributes.name: tug_master_name
attributes.description: Full name of the tug master on duty for this assignment. Captured for operational records and incident investigation purposes.
attributes.references: International Labour Organization (ILO) Maritime Labour Convention

attributes.name: tug_master_remarks
attributes.description: Free-text remarks and observations recorded by the tug master regarding the towage operation. Captures operational insights and lessons learned.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tug assignment record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vhf_channel_primary
attributes.description: Primary VHF radio channel used for communication during the tug assignment. Essential for operational coordination and safety communications.

products.name: weather_tide_window
products.description: Operational record of weather and tidal conditions affecting marine service delivery windows within port waters. Captures tide height predictions and actuals (referenced to chart datum), tidal stream rates, wind speed/direction, visibility, swell height, current readings at key fairway points, and derived go/no-go decisions for pilotage, towage, and mooring operations. Used for real-time service scheduling decisions and post-event analysis. SSOT for marine-operational weather and tide data within port jurisdiction.

attributes.name: weather_tide_window_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the weather and tidal condition observation record. Primary key for the weather_tide_window product.
attributes.references: Internal Port Authority Data Management Standard

attributes.name: anchorage_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.anchorage_area. Business justification: Weather restrictions affect anchorage safety (wind exposure, holding ground); determines when vessels can safely anchor or must depart. Operational planning and VTS advisory requirement.

attributes.name: berth_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.berth. Business justification: Weather/tide windows impose mooring restrictions at specific berths (mooring_restriction_flag exists). Berth operational status decisions, vessel scheduling, and port authority notices to mariners req

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.channel. Business justification: Tidal windows determine channel navigability; fairway_point_reference currently text. Critical for VTS coordination, pilotage scheduling, and vessel movement planning based on channel depth and tidal

attributes.name: port_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.port. Business justification: Weather/tide windows are issued by port authorities for port-wide operational planning. Port-level weather window aggregation for vessel traffic management, port closure decisions, and VTS operational

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Vessel scheduling and tidal window planning requires linking weather observations to port location. VTS operators query tidal windows by port location for berth allocation; observation_location is a d

attributes.name: revised_weather_tide_window_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on weather_tide_window (revised_weather_tide_window_id)

attributes.name: air_temperature_c
attributes.description: The ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius at the observation location and timestamp.

attributes.name: barometric_pressure_hpa
attributes.description: The atmospheric pressure in hectopascals (hPa) at the observation location. Rapid pressure changes can indicate approaching weather systems and affect tidal predictions.

attributes.name: chart_datum_reference
attributes.description: The vertical datum reference system used for tide height measurements (e.g., Lowest Astronomical Tide - LAT, Mean Lower Low Water - MLLW, Mean Sea Level - MSL).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this weather and tide observation record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Audit trail field.

attributes.name: forecast_source
attributes.description: The meteorological or hydrographic agency or system that provided the forecast data used for predicted values (e.g., National Weather Service, Bureau of Meteorology, port tide prediction model).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this weather and tide observation record was last updated or modified in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Audit trail field.

attributes.name: marpol_environmental_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether environmental conditions (e.g., high winds, heavy seas) pose a risk for MARPOL compliance during cargo or bunkering operations (True = environmental risk present, False = no risk).

attributes.name: max_vessel_draft_permitted_m
attributes.description: The maximum vessel draft in meters permitted to transit or berth under the observed tidal conditions, ensuring adequate under keel clearance (UKC).
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) SOLAS Chapter V

attributes.name: max_vessel_loa_permitted_m
attributes.description: The maximum vessel LOA (Length Overall) in meters permitted to conduct marine operations under the observed conditions. Larger vessels may be restricted due to wind, current, or UKC constraints.

attributes.name: mooring_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether mooring operations are restricted or suspended due to the observed weather and tidal conditions (True = restricted, False = unrestricted).

attributes.name: observation_reference
attributes.description: Human-readable unique reference number for the weather and tide observation window, formatted as WTW-YYYYMMDD-NNNN.

attributes.name: observation_remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context provided by the observer or VTS operator regarding the weather and tidal conditions.

attributes.name: observation_source
attributes.description: The source or method by which the observation was captured: automated sensor, manual reading by marine personnel, VTS (Vessel Traffic Service) report, weather station, tide gauge, or forecast model.
attributes.references: Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS) Data Standards

attributes.name: observation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the observation record: preliminary (initial reading), validated (quality-checked), revised (corrected after review), final (confirmed and locked), or superseded (replaced by newer reading).

attributes.name: observation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the weather and tidal conditions were observed or recorded, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). This is the principal real-world event time for this observation.

attributes.name: pilotage_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether pilotage operations are restricted or suspended due to the observed weather and tidal conditions (True = restricted, False = unrestricted).

attributes.name: precipitation_mm
attributes.description: The amount of precipitation (rain, snow, sleet) in millimeters recorded during the observation period. Heavy precipitation can affect visibility and deck operations.

attributes.name: restriction_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why marine service restrictions were imposed, referencing specific threshold breaches (e.g., wind speed exceeds 25 knots, visibility below 1 NM, tide height insufficient for UKC).
attributes.references: Port Authority Marine Operations Safety Manual

attributes.name: sea_state_code
attributes.description: The Douglas Sea State code (0-9) describing sea surface conditions: 0=calm (glassy), 1=calm (rippled), 2=smooth, 3=slight, 4=moderate, 5=rough, 6=very rough, 7=high, 8=very high, 9=phenomenal.
attributes.references: World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Sea State Code

attributes.name: service_window_status
attributes.description: The derived operational decision for marine service delivery based on observed conditions: go (safe to proceed), no-go (unsafe, operations suspended), conditional (proceed with restrictions), or restricted (limited operations only).
attributes.references: Port Authority Marine Operations Safety Manual

attributes.name: solas_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the observation and any resulting operational decisions comply with SOLAS Chapter V navigation safety requirements (True = compliant, False = non-compliant or under review).
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) SOLAS Chapter V

attributes.name: swell_height_m
attributes.description: The height of ocean swell in meters at the observation location. Swell is long-period wave motion distinct from locally generated wind waves.
attributes.references: World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Sea State Standards

attributes.name: tidal_phase
attributes.description: The current phase of the tidal cycle at observation time: high water (peak tide), low water (minimum tide), flood (rising tide), ebb (falling tide), or slack water (minimal current between flood and ebb).

attributes.name: tidal_stream_direction_degrees
attributes.description: The direction of the tidal current flow in degrees true (0-360), where 0/360 is north, 90 is east, 180 is south, and 270 is west.

attributes.name: tidal_stream_rate_knots
attributes.description: The speed of the tidal current or stream in knots at the observation location and timestamp. Critical for pilotage and towage planning.

attributes.name: tidal_window_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the favorable tidal window closes for vessel movements requiring specific tide heights or UKC, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: Port Authority Tidal Window Planning Standard

attributes.name: tidal_window_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the favorable tidal window opens for vessel movements requiring specific tide heights or UKC, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: Port Authority Tidal Window Planning Standard

attributes.name: tide_height_actual_m
attributes.description: The actual observed tidal height in meters above chart datum at the observation timestamp, measured by tide gauge or sensor. May differ from predicted due to meteorological effects (storm surge, barometric pressure).

attributes.name: tide_height_predicted_m

products.name: pilot_route_authorisation
products.description: This association product represents the formal Contract between a licensed marine pilot and a pilotage route, as issued and maintained by the port authority. It captures the regulatory authorisation lifecycle (application, endorsement, renewal, suspension, expiry) and the route-specific vessel-size constraints applicable to each pilot-route combination. Each record links one pilot to one pilotage_route and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific authorisation — they cannot be stored on the pilot master (which holds global limits) or the route master (which holds physical constraints) alone. This is the operational SSOT for answering 'Is Pilot X currently authorised to conduct pilotage on Route Y, and under what vessel-size conditions?'. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, a licensed marine pilot must hold formal route-specific authorisations before conducting pilotage on any given fairway or channel. A single pilot is authorised for multiple routes (e.g., main channel, inner harbour, anchorage approach), and each route is authorised for multiple pilots. The port authority actively manages these authorisations as a lifecycle entity — issuing, renewing, suspending, and expiring them — with vessel-size constraints and endorsement statuses that belong neither to the pilot master record nor to the route master record alone.

attributes.name: bollard_swl_tonnes

attributes.name: construction_material

attributes.name: crane_rail_gauge_mm
attributes.description: Distance in millimeters between crane rails if present, defining the track gauge for quay crane operations.
attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

attributes.name: crane_rail_present

attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: current_depth_m
attributes.description: Current actual water depth alongside the quay wall measured in meters from chart datum, as determined by the most recent hydrographic survey. May differ from design depth due to sedimentation or dredging.

attributes.name: design_depth_m
attributes.description: Design water depth alongside the quay wall measured in meters from chart datum, indicating the maximum vessel draft that can be accommodated.

attributes.name: design_load_capacity_kn_per_m2
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Load Capacity (Kilonewtons per Square Meter)
attributes.description: Maximum design load capacity of the quay wall surface expressed in kilonewtons per square meter (kN/m²), representing the safe working load for cargo handling operations and equipment.
attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

attributes.name: design_standard
attributes.description: Engineering design standard or code under which the quay wall was designed and constructed (e.g., BS 6349, PIANC guidelines, Eurocode 7).
attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quay wall area is equipped with environmental monitoring systems for air quality, water quality, noise, or emissions tracking.

attributes.name: fender_system_type
attributes.description: Type of fender system installed on the quay wall for vessel berthing protection: cylindrical, cone, cell, arch, pneumatic, foam-filled, or none if no fender system is present. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cylindrical|cone|cell|arch|pneumatic|foam_filled|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

attributes.name: geographic_coordinates
attributes.description: Geographic coordinates of the quay wall centerpoint in decimal degrees format (latitude, longitude) for GIS integration and port layout planning.

attributes.name: imdg_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quay wall infrastructure meets International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code requirements for handling dangerous goods cargo.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the insurance policy covering the quay wall infrastructure asset.

attributes.name: isps_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quay wall facility meets International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code requirements for maritime security.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: last_dredging_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent dredging operation performed alongside the quay wall to maintain design depth.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent comprehensive structural inspection of the quay wall by qualified marine structural engineers.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quay wall record was most recently updated in the system.

attributes.name: lighting_system_type
attributes.description: Type of lighting system installed along the quay wall for night operations: LED, halogen, sodium vapor, or none.

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility
attributes.description: Entity responsible for ongoing maintenance of the quay wall structure: port authority, terminal operator, external contractor, or shared responsibility.

attributes.name: max_vessel_dwt_tonnes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Vessel Deadweight Tonnage (DWT) in Tonnes
attributes.description: Maximum Deadweight Tonnage (DWT) in tonnes of vessels that can be safely accommodated at this quay wall.

attributes.name: max_vessel_loa_m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Vessel Length Overall (LOA) in Meters
attributes.description: Maximum Length Overall (LOA) in meters of vessels that can be safely accommodated at this quay wall, based on structural and operational constraints.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory structural inspection of the quay wall based on regulatory requirements and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the quay wall: operational (fully available), restricted (limited use due to conditions or repairs), closed (not available for vessel operations), under maintenance (scheduled maintenance in progress), under construction (new construction or major upgrade).

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, operational restrictions, or historical information about the quay wall structure.

attributes.name: replacement_value_usd
attributes.description: Estimated replacement value of the quay wall structure in United States Dollars (USD) for insurance and asset management purposes.

attributes.name: seismic_design_category
attributes.description: Seismic design classification indicating the level of earthquake resistance incorporated into the quay wall structure based on regional seismic hazard assessment.
attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

attributes.name: structural_condition_rating
attributes.description: Current overall structural condition assessment of the quay wall based on the most recent engineering inspection: excellent (no defects), good (minor wear), fair (moderate deterioration), poor (significant defects requiring attention), critical (unsafe, requires immediate intervention).

attributes.name: tidal_range_m
attributes.description: Mean tidal range in meters at the quay wall location, representing the vertical difference between mean high water and mean low water levels.

attributes.name: total_length_m
attributes.description: Total linear length of the quay wall structure measured in meters along the waterfront.
attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

attributes.name: utility_services
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of utility services available at the quay wall (e.g., electrical power, potable water, fire water, compressed air, telecommunications, sewage).

attributes.name: wall_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the quay wall structure, used in port infrastructure documentation and AVEVA Marine Engineering system integration.
attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

attributes.name: wall_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the quay wall structure (e.g., North Quay Wall, Container Terminal Wharf A).
attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

attributes.name: wall_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quay wall based on structural construction method: gravity (mass concrete), sheet pile (interlocking steel), caisson (prefabricated box), piled (supported on piles), diaphragm (continuous reinforced concrete), or cellular (steel sheet pile cells).
attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

attributes.name: year_built
attributes.description: Calendar year when the quay wall structure was originally constructed and commissioned.
attributes.references: PIANC - World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure

SSOT for port layout, zone capacity planning, and terminal configuration management.

PFSO tracks zone-specific security levels, access restrictions, and PFSP co

Critical for concession management, zone operator billing, performance monitoring, and access control. Role pref

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Terminal zones are operational areas within port locations. Essential for yard planning, container tracking, customs zone mapping, and linking operational zones to master port location data for logist

attributes.name: primary_equipment_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.equipment_type. Business justification: Terminal zones are equipped with specific handling equipment types (RTG cranes, reach stackers, forklifts). handling_equipment_type is a plain text denormalization of equipment_type. Port planners use

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Terminal zones (container yard, reefer area, dangerous goods zone) generate distinct revenue streams with separate P&L accountability. Zone-level profitability reporting and revenue allocation in term

attributes.name: access_control_system
attributes.description: Technology used to control personnel and equipment entry to the zone. RFID gate for automated vehicle identification, biometric for high-security areas, card reader for personnel access, manual for guard-controlled entry, none for unrestricted areas. Integrates with Port Access Permit system.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this zone record is currently active in the master data registry. True: active and available for operational use. False: logically deleted or archived. Used for soft-delete pattern and historical record retention without physical deletion.
attributes.references: Data Management Best Practices - Soft Delete Pattern

attributes.name: boundary_coordinates_wkt
attributes.description: Geographic boundary of the zone represented as Well-Known Text (WKT) POLYGON geometry. Enables GIS integration with AVEVA Marine Engineering for port layout visualization, spatial analysis, and automated equipment routing in Terminal Operating Systems.
attributes.references: ISO 19125 Geographic Information - Simple Feature Access

attributes.name: cctv_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone is monitored by CCTV surveillance system. True: full video surveillance for security and incident investigation. False: no camera coverage. Required for ISPS Level 2+ zones and cargo theft prevention.

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the zone geometric center in decimal degrees. Used for distance calculations, equipment dispatch optimization, and integration with Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS) for cargo location tracking.

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the zone geometric center in decimal degrees. Used for distance calculations, equipment dispatch optimization, and integration with Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS) for cargo location tracking.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the zone was officially opened and entered operational service. Used for asset age calculations, depreciation schedules, and infrastructure lifecycle planning in SAP PM (Plant Maintenance).

attributes.name: customs_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone is under customs authority control as a bonded area or free trade zone. True: customs-controlled area requiring special clearance procedures. False: non-bonded domestic area. Impacts cargo movement restrictions and documentation requirements in Port Community System (PCS).

attributes.name: design_capacity_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Target operational utilization percentage for the zone as designed by port planners. Typically 70-85% to allow operational flexibility. Used as benchmark for KPI reporting and capacity expansion trigger analysis. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 75.00 for 75%).

attributes.name: drainage_system_type
attributes.description: Stormwater management infrastructure type installed in the zone. Storm sewer for direct discharge, retention pond for controlled release, permeable pavement for infiltration, none for natural drainage. Critical for environmental compliance per MARPOL and local water quality regulations tracked in Environmental Monitoring System (EMS).
attributes.references: MARPOL Annex V - Marine Pollution Prevention

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone has installed environmental sensors for air quality, noise, or emissions tracking. True: active monitoring integrated with Environmental Monitoring System (EMS). False: no environmental instrumentation. Required for zones near sensitive receptors or handling bulk materials.

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system
attributes.description: Fire protection infrastructure installed in the zone. Hydrant network for general fire response, foam system for flammable liquid storage, sprinkler for warehouse protection, none for open yard areas. Required for IMDG hazmat zones and insurance compliance.

attributes.name: ground_slot_capacity_teu
attributes.description: Number of Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU) ground slots available for container placement at single-stack height. Represents the base stacking capacity before vertical stacking. Used for yard utilization KPI calculations.

attributes.name: hazmat_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone is certified and equipped for storage and handling of dangerous goods per International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code. True: approved for IMDG cargo with appropriate safety infrastructure. False: non-hazmat zone. Drives cargo acceptance rules in Terminal Operating System.
attributes.references: IMDG Code - International Maritime Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal infrastructure inspection for safety, structural integrity, and regulatory compliance. Drives preventive maintenance scheduling in Maximo Asset Management and Port State Control (PSC) readiness.

attributes.name: last_resurfacing_date
attributes.description: Date when the zone pavement was last resurfaced or rehabilitated. Used to calculate pavement age, predict maintenance cycles, and schedule preventive maintenance in Maximo Asset Management system.

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Commercial arrangement governing zone usage rights. Port operated: directly managed by port authority. Leased terminal operator: long-term concession to terminal operator. Leased cargo owner: dedicated to specific shipper/consignee. Subleased: operator has subleased to third party. Vacant: available for lease. Drives revenue recognition and billing in SAP FI.

attributes.name: lighting_type
attributes.description: Type of illumination infrastructure installed in the zone for 24/7 operations. LED high mast for energy-efficient area lighting, halogen flood for legacy installations, none for daylight-only operations. Impacts operational hours, safety compliance, and energy consumption tracking in Environmental Management System (EMS).

attributes.name: maximum_stack_height
attributes.description: Maximum number of container tiers (vertical stacking levels) permitted in this zone based on pavement strength, equipment Safe Working Load (SWL), and operational safety requirements. Typically ranges from 3-6 tiers for yard operations.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory infrastructure inspection. Calculated based on regulatory requirements, pavement condition, and operational intensity. Triggers work order generation in Maximo for inspection planning.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the zone. Operational: actively in use for cargo handling. Maintenance: temporarily unavailable for scheduled or emergency maintenance. Closed: administratively closed but not decommissioned. Planned: approved for construction but not yet operational. Decommissioned: permanently removed from service.

attributes.name: paved_area_sqm
attributes.description: Surface area with hard pavement (concrete or asphalt) suitable for heavy equipment operations and container stacking in square meters (m²). Critical for determining operational capacity and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: pavement_condition_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of pavement structural integrity and surface condition. Excellent: no defects, full load capacity. Good: minor wear, full operational capacity. Fair: moderate deterioration, reduced heavy equipment operations. Poor: significant cracking/rutting, maintenance required. Critical: structural failure risk, immediate repair needed. Drives CAPEX maintenance planning.

attributes.name: rail_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone has direct rail track access for intermodal rail operations. True: rail-connected for on-dock rail loading/unloading. False: truck-only access. Critical for intermodal logistics planning and rail operator coordination.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this terminal zone record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated or last updated this zone record. NAVIS N4 for TOS-managed zones, AVEVA Marine for engineering-designed zones, manual entry for ad-hoc additions, GIS import for spatial data loads, legacy migration for historical data conversion. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework - System of Record Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this terminal zone record was last modified. Tracks data currency for change data capture, synchronization with operational systems (NAVIS N4, AVEVA), and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: reefer_plug_count
attributes.description: Number of electrical connection points (reefer plugs) available for refrigerated container (reefer) power supply. Critical for cold chain cargo capacity planning and reefer slot allocation in Terminal Operating System.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, temporary restrictions, or historical context not captured in structured fields. Used by terminal planners and operations managers for knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code security level assigned to the zone. Level 1: normal operations with minimum security measures. Level 2: heightened risk requiring additional security. Level 3: imminent threat requiring maximum protective measures. Drives access control and surveillance requirements.
attributes.references: ISPS Code - International Ship and Port Facility Security

attributes.name: total_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total surface area of the zone in square meters (m²). Includes paved, unpaved, and built-up areas. Used for capacity planning, lease calculations, and infrastructure investment analysis.

attributes.name: total_capacity_teu
attributes.description: Maximum theoretical container capacity in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU) when stacked to maximum allowable height. Calculated as ground_slot_capacity_teu × maximum_stack_height. Used for strategic capacity planning and terminal expansion analysis.

attributes.name: truck_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone has direct road access for truck operations. True: truck-accessible for drayage and delivery operations. False: restricted access requiring internal transfer. Impacts gate operations and dwell time calculations.

attributes.name: vessel_side_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone is located directly adjacent to berth/quay for ship-to-shore operations. True: vessel-side zone for direct discharge/loading operations. False: landside zone requiring horizontal transport. Affects Ship-to-Shore (STS) crane reach and vessel operation efficiency.

attributes.name: weighbridge_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zone has an integrated weighbridge (truck scale) for container/cargo weight verification. True: weighbridge installed for SOLAS VGM (Verified Gross Mass) compliance. False: no weighing capability. Mandatory for container export zones per SOLAS Amendment.

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the zone by its primary operational function. Determines handling equipment requirements, stacking rules, and capacity calculation methods. Container Yard (CY) for TEU/FEU stacking, Container Freight Station (CFS) for LCL consolidation, RoRo for Roll-on Roll-off operations, bulk storage for dry/liquid bulk, warehouse for covered storage, gate complex for entry/exit processing, rail yard for intermodal rail transfer, intermodal transfer for truck-rail interchange, empty depot for empty container storage. attributes.name: max_forklift_capacity_tonnes

attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the closure was triggered by a safety incident or Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) concern requiring immediate action.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Degree of operational impact on the infrastructure asset. Full closure prevents all use; partial restriction limits specific operations; reduced capacity allows operations at lower throughput.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Operational Standards

products.name: permit
products.description: Master record for regulatory permits, approvals, and consents required for port infrastructure construction, dredging, disposal, reclamation, and operations. Captures permit number, permit type (environmental impact assessment, building/construction, dredging, reclamation, heritage/archaeological, marine discharge, noise), issuing authority (national maritime authority, environmental protection agency, local planning authority), permit title, scope description, conditions summary, key conditions with compliance deadlines, issue date, expiry date, renewal lead time, renewal date, compliance monitoring requirements, audit/inspection schedule, non-compliance history, and permit status (applied, granted, active, suspended, expired, revoked). Supports regulatory compliance across IMO conventions, national maritime authority requirements, and environmental agency mandates. SSOT for all infrastructure-related regulatory authorizations.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the infrastructure permit record. Primary key for the infrastructure permit entity.

Real business pro

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.port_community_participant. This FK supports permit renewal notifications, compliance mon

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.terminal. Business justification: Operational permits are issued for terminal operations (dangerous goods handling, customs bonded area, ISPS facility designation). These permits are terminal-specific and need to be linked to the term

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.project. Business justification: Regulatory permits are obtained for specific CAPEX infrastructure projects (construction permits, environmental approvals, reclamation consents). While dredging_campaign already references permit via

attributes.name: appeal_deadline_date
attributes.description: Final date by which an appeal or objection to permit conditions or denial can be lodged with the regulatory authority or administrative tribunal.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit application was formally submitted to the issuing authority. Used to track processing timelines and regulatory response times.

attributes.name: audit_inspection_schedule
attributes.description: Schedule of regulatory audits, site inspections, or compliance reviews mandated by the permit. Includes frequency, scope, and advance notice requirements.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code - Audit Requirements

attributes.name: compliance_monitoring_requirements
attributes.description: Description of ongoing monitoring, measurement, and reporting obligations required to demonstrate permit compliance. Includes frequency, parameters, and submission requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 - Environmental Management Systems - Monitoring and Measurement

attributes.name: conditions_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of the key conditions, restrictions, and obligations imposed by the permit. Provides an overview of compliance requirements without exhaustive detail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this permit record was first created in the port management information system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or URL pointing to the official permit documentation including the approval letter, conditions schedule, and supporting materials.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the permit becomes legally effective and enforceable. May differ from issue date if the permit includes a delayed commencement clause.

attributes.name: environmental_sensitivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the permitted activities are in or adjacent to environmentally sensitive areas requiring enhanced monitoring and protection measures. True if the area has special environmental significance.
attributes.references: MARPOL - Marine Pollution Convention - Special Areas

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit validity period ends and the authorization ceases to be enforceable. Nullable for permits with indefinite validity subject to ongoing compliance.

attributes.name: financial_security_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the required financial security instrument in the port operating currency. Nullable if no financial security is required.

attributes.name: financial_security_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial security amount. Examples include USD, EUR, GBP.

attributes.name: financial_security_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the permit requires the posting of a financial bond, guarantee, or insurance policy to cover potential environmental remediation or restoration costs. True if financial security is mandated.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Financial Assurance Guidelines

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Description of the geographic area, zone, or specific infrastructure locations covered by this permit. May reference berth numbers, channel sections, or port facility coordinates.
attributes.references: International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) - Geographic Data Standards

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit was officially issued or granted by the regulatory authority. Marks the beginning of the permit validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or government agency that issued the permit. Examples include National Maritime Authority, Environmental Protection Agency, Local Planning Authority, or Port State Control Authority.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - Member State Authority Registry

attributes.name: issuing_authority_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or identifier for the issuing authority used for system integration and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) - Authority Identifier Standards

attributes.name: key_conditions
attributes.description: Detailed listing of critical permit conditions that must be met for ongoing compliance. Includes specific technical requirements, operational constraints, monitoring obligations, and reporting deadlines.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - MARPOL Convention Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection or compliance audit conducted under this permit. Used to track inspection history and compliance trends.

attributes.name: last_inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the most recent regulatory inspection indicating compliance status. Non-compliant outcomes may trigger corrective action requirements or enforcement proceedings.
attributes.references: Port State Control (PSC) - Inspection Outcome Classification

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this permit record. Used for change tracking and data currency verification.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next regulatory inspection or compliance audit. Used for operational planning and readiness preparation.

attributes.name: non_compliance_count
attributes.description: Total number of non-compliance incidents or violations recorded against this permit since issuance. Used for risk assessment and compliance performance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 - Occupational Health and Safety - Performance Evaluation

attributes.name: non_compliance_history
attributes.description: Record of past non-compliance incidents, violations, or breaches associated with this permit. Includes dates, nature of violations, and corrective actions taken.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 - Environmental Management Systems - Nonconformity and Corrective Action

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Official permit number or reference code issued by the regulatory authority. This is the externally-known identifier used in all regulatory correspondence and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - Port State Control Guidelines

attributes.name: permit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the permit indicating its validity and enforceability. Active status indicates the permit is currently valid and enforceable; expired or revoked status indicates the permit is no longer valid. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: applied|under_review|granted|active|suspended|expired|revoked|withdrawn — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the permit based on the nature of the infrastructure activity being authorized. Determines the regulatory framework and compliance requirements applicable to the permit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: environmental_impact_assessment|building_construction|dredging|reclamation|heritage_archaeological|marine_discharge|noise|air_emissions|waste_disposal|coastal_works — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Environmental Management Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Citation of the primary legislation, regulation, or international convention under which this permit was issued. Examples include MARPOL Annex, national environmental protection acts, or local planning ordinances.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or contextual information about the permit that does not fit into structured fields. May include historical context, special circumstances, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Target date for permit renewal application or renewal decision. Used for proactive compliance management and to avoid lapses in authorization.

attributes.name: renewal_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days before expiry that the renewal application must be submitted to the issuing authority. Critical for compliance planning and avoiding operational disruptions.
attributes.references: Port State Control (PSC) - Permit Management Best Practices

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Name of the internal port department or business unit responsible for managing compliance with this permit. Typically Infrastructure Development, Engineering, or Environmental Management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems - Organizational Roles

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit was permanently revoked by the issuing authority. Revocation terminates the authorization and may prevent future applications for a specified period.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of the grounds for permit revocation including the serious violations, misrepresentations, or conditions that led to permanent cancellation of the authorization.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the infrastructure activities, works, or operations covered under this permit. Includes the nature, scale, and location of authorized activities.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit was suspended by the issuing authority due to non-compliance or other regulatory concerns. Nullable if the permit has never been suspended.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of the grounds for permit suspension including the specific violations or conditions that triggered the suspension action.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - Port State Control Procedures

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official title or name of the permit as stated in the regulatory approval documentation.

attributes.name: validity_period_months
attributes.description: Duration of the permit validity period expressed in months from the effective date. Used for planning renewal cycles and compliance calendars.
attributes.references: International Labour Organization (ILO) - Maritime Labour Convention
