attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the terminal facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details (building, suite, zone). Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: annual_throughput_capacity_teu
attributes.description: Maximum annual container handling capacity of the terminal measured in TEU. Represents the theoretical maximum throughput under optimal operating conditions. Applicable to container terminals only.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the terminal is located.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the terminal was officially commissioned and began commercial operations. Used for asset lifecycle tracking and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: crane_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of crane types available at the terminal (e.g., STS gantry, RTG, mobile harbor crane, bulk handling crane). Supports equipment capability assessment and vessel compatibility planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this terminal record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: customs_facility_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal has on-site customs inspection and clearance facilities. True if customs office and inspection zones exist, false otherwise.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for terminal operations and business inquiries. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: environmental_certification
attributes.description: Environmental management certifications held by the terminal (e.g., ISO 14001, EcoPorts, Green Marine). Comma-separated list if multiple certifications exist.

attributes.name: free_trade_zone
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal operates within a designated free trade zone or foreign trade zone with special customs and tax treatment. True if FTZ status applies, false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_expansion_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major capacity expansion or infrastructure upgrade project completion. Null if no expansions have occurred since commissioning.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the terminal center point in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analysis, navigation planning, and GIS integration.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the terminal center point in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analysis, navigation planning, and GIS integration.

attributes.name: max_draft_m
attributes.description: Maximum vessel draft (depth below waterline) that can be safely accommodated at the terminal, measured in meters. Determined by channel depth, berth depth, and tidal variations.

attributes.name: max_vessel_beam_m
attributes.description: Maximum beam (width) of vessel that can be accommodated at the terminal, measured in meters. Constrained by berth width and approach channel dimensions.

attributes.name: max_vessel_length_m
attributes.description: Maximum length of vessel that can be accommodated at the terminal, measured in meters. Constrained by berth length and maneuvering basin dimensions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this terminal record was last updated in the system. Used for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next major maintenance shutdown or infrastructure inspection. Used for operational planning and capacity forecasting.

attributes.name: number_of_berths
attributes.description: Total count of vessel berths available at the terminal for simultaneous vessel operations.

attributes.name: number_of_cranes
attributes.description: Total count of cargo handling cranes deployed at the terminal, including ship-to-shore gantry cranes, mobile harbor cranes, and rail-mounted gantry cranes.

attributes.name: open_storage_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total uncovered outdoor storage area at the terminal measured in square meters. Used for container stacking, bulk cargo stockpiling, and vehicle parking.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the terminal in its lifecycle. Operational indicates active cargo handling, under construction indicates development phase, maintenance indicates temporary closure for repairs or upgrades, decommissioned indicates permanent closure, planned indicates future development, and suspended indicates temporary operational halt.

attributes.name: operator_type
attributes.description: Classification of the terminal operating model. Port authority indicates direct government or port authority operation, private operator indicates fully privatized operation, joint venture indicates shared ownership between multiple entities, and public-private partnership indicates collaborative government-private sector arrangement.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the terminal operations center. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the terminal location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: rail_connection_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal has direct rail connectivity for intermodal cargo transfer. True if on-dock rail facilities exist, false otherwise.

attributes.name: rail_track_length_m
attributes.description: Total length of rail tracks within the terminal facility measured in meters. Null if no rail connection exists.

attributes.name: reefer_plug_capacity
attributes.description: Number of refrigerated container electrical connection points available at the terminal for temperature-controlled cargo. Applicable to container terminals handling perishable goods.

attributes.name: security_certification
attributes.description: Highest level of international security certification held by the terminal. ISPS (International Ship and Port Facility Security Code) is mandatory for international ports, C-TPAT (Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism) is US program, AEO (Authorized Economic Operator) is EU/international program.

attributes.name: shore_power_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal provides shore-side electrical power (cold ironing) to berthed vessels, allowing them to shut down auxiliary engines and reduce emissions. True if shore power infrastructure exists, false otherwise.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the terminal is located.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_teu
attributes.description: Maximum container storage capacity of the terminal measured in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units). Applicable to container terminals only. Null for non-container terminals.

attributes.name: terminal_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the terminal for operational identification and system integration. Used in vessel manifests, cargo documentation, and port authority reporting.

attributes.name: terminal_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the terminal facility.

attributes.name: terminal_type
attributes.description: Classification of terminal based on primary cargo handling capability. Container terminals handle containerized cargo, bulk terminals handle dry or liquid bulk commodities, ro-ro terminals handle roll-on/roll-off vehicles and equipment, general cargo terminals handle break-bulk and non-containerized goods, cruise terminals handle passenger vessels, and multipurpose terminals support mixed operations.

attributes.name: total_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total land area of the terminal facility measured in square meters, including berths, storage yards, warehouses, and operational zones.

attributes.name: total_quay_length_m
attributes.description: Combined linear length of all quay walls and wharves at the terminal measured in meters. Determines the total vessel berthing capacity.

attributes.name: truck_gate_lanes
attributes.description: Number of truck entry and exit gate lanes at the terminal for road cargo transfer. Determines truck processing capacity and gate throughput.

attributes.name: warehouse_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total covered warehouse and storage facility area at the terminal measured in square meters. Used for cargo consolidation, temporary storage, and value-added services.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL of the terminal for public information and service details.

attributes.description: The legal name of the organization or entity that owns the rail wagon. May be a rail operator, leasing company, or port authority.

attributes.name: refrigeration_capable

attributes.name: registration_country_code

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: The official registration number issued by the registration authority, distinct from the wagon number and used for regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: International Union of Railways (UIC) - Registration Standards

attributes.name: residual_value
attributes.description: The estimated residual or salvage value of the wagon at the end of its useful life, used for depreciation calculations.
attributes.references: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) - Asset Valuation

attributes.name: rfid_tag_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the RFID tag attached to the wagon for automated tracking and identification in rail yards and terminals.

attributes.name: swl_rating_kg
attributes.description: The Safe Working Load rating in kilograms, representing the maximum load the wagon can handle under normal operating conditions including dynamic forces during transport.

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: The empty weight of the rail wagon in kilograms, excluding any cargo or containers. Used for load planning and compliance with weight restrictions.

attributes.name: wagon_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique identification number assigned to the rail wagon by the owner or registration authority. This is the business identifier used in operational systems and documentation.

attributes.name: wagon_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rail wagon based on its structural design and intended cargo type. Flat wagons have a flat deck, well wagons have a recessed center for double-stacking containers, spine wagons have a central spine for container placement.

attributes.name: width_m
attributes.description: The width of the rail wagon in meters, important for clearance verification and loading gauge compliance.

attributes.description: Reference to the vessel visit if this intermodal booking is for cargo arriving or departing on a specific vessel. Links to vessel operations.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanctions_screening. Business justification: Slot bookings involve cargo owners and operators who must be screened against sanctions lists before booking confirmation. Linking each slot booking to its sanctions screening record is a mandatory AM

attributes.name: service_id
attributes.description: Reference to the intermodal service (rail or truck route) for which this slot is booked. Links to the service schedule and capacity plan.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.shipment. Business justification: A slot booking on an intermodal service is made for cargo belonging to a specific shipment. Port community systems and intermodal operators link slot bookings to shipments for capacity planning, cargo

attributes.name: slot_reservation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to booking.slot_reservation. Business justification: An intermodal slot booking must be linked to the corresponding vessel slot reservation to confirm end-to-end space allocation from inland origin to vessel. Shipping lines and terminal planners use thi

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to terminal.terminal. Business justification: Slot bookings are made at a specific terminal — terminal capacity planning, slot utilization reporting by terminal, and commercial agreements between shipping lines and terminal operators all require

attributes.name: thc_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.thc_schedule. Business justification: Slot bookings involve container moves attracting THC. The THC schedule at booking level enables upfront cost disclosure and billing — required for customer invoicing, booking confirmation with cost br

attributes.name: transport_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intermodal.transport_order. Business justification: Slot bookings reserve intermodal capacity for transport orders. The booking is the capacity reservation; the transport order is the instruction. Linking allows retrieval of AWB and BOL from transport_

attributes.name: actual_transport_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the intermodal transport service was executed. Used for on-time performance measurement and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: booking_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the booking was submitted. Used for channel performance analysis and digital adoption tracking.

attributes.name: booking_date
attributes.description: Date when the slot booking was created or submitted by the customer. Used for booking lead time analysis and service level tracking.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Rail Operations - Booking Management

attributes.name: booking_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique booking reference number issued to the customer for this intermodal slot reservation. Used for customer communication and tracking.

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the slot booking. Tracks progression from initial request through fulfillment or cancellation.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Rail Operations - Booking Workflow

attributes.name: booking_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the booking was created in the system. Used for audit trail and first-come-first-served slot allocation.

attributes.name: booking_type
attributes.description: Type of intermodal transport mode for this booking. Determines handling procedures and capacity allocation rules.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Intermodal Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for booking cancellation. Used for root cause analysis and service improvement.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Rail Operations - Cancellation Management

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the booking was cancelled. Null if booking is active. Used for cancellation analysis and capacity recovery.

attributes.name: cargo_type
attributes.description: Classification of cargo being transported. Determines handling requirements and equipment allocation for the intermodal service.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the booking status changed to confirmed. Used for service level measurement and customer notification tracking.

attributes.name: confirmed_slot_date
attributes.description: Actual date confirmed for the intermodal transport slot. Null if booking is pending or waitlisted.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Rail Operations - Slot Confirmation

attributes.name: confirmed_slot_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time window confirmed for the intermodal transport departure or pickup. Used for gate appointment coordination.

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Total number of containers included in this slot booking, regardless of size. Used for slot allocation and capacity planning.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Rail Operations - Capacity Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this booking record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_reference_number
attributes.description: Customer's own internal reference or purchase order number for this booking. Used for reconciliation and customer reporting.

attributes.name: edi_message_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the EDI message (IFTMIN, COPARN, or AWB) that initiated or confirmed this booking. Used for EDI reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this booking includes hazardous materials requiring special handling and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: IMDG Code - International Maritime Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this booking record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: no_show_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the customer failed to utilize the confirmed slot. Used for no-show penalty assessment and capacity planning.

attributes.name: oversized_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this booking includes oversized or out-of-gauge cargo requiring special equipment or routing.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms agreed for this booking. Determines billing and collection procedures.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module - Payment Terms

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Service priority level for this booking. Determines slot allocation preference and service level agreement targets.

attributes.name: reefer_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this booking includes refrigerated containers requiring temperature-controlled transport.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional free-text remarks or notes about this booking. Used for operational communication and exception handling.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Rail Operations - Booking Management

attributes.name: requested_transport_date
attributes.description: Date requested by the customer for the intermodal transport service. May differ from confirmed slot date based on availability.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system that originated this booking record. Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special handling requirements, routing instructions, or operational notes for this booking.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Rail Operations - Booking Notes

attributes.name: teu_quantity
attributes.description: Total capacity of this booking expressed in TEU. Calculated from container sizes (20ft=1 TEU, 40ft=2 TEU, 45ft=2.25 TEU). Used for capacity utilization reporting.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of cargo in this booking expressed in cubic meters. Used for space utilization and capacity planning.
attributes.references: International System of Units (SI) - Volume Measurement

attributes.name: weight_tonnes
attributes.description: Total gross weight of cargo in this booking expressed in metric tonnes. Used for load planning and compliance with weight restrictions.
attributes.references: International System of Units (SI) - Mass Measurement

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all port community participants including shipping lines, freight forwarders, cargo owners, consignees, importers, exporters, customs brokers, trucking companies, and port agents. Manages entity profiles, accounts, accreditations, contact hierarchies, contracts, service agreements, and SLA management. Integrates with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Port Community System.

products.name: port_community_participant
products.description: Master entity representing all port community participants — shipping lines, freight forwarders, cargo owners, consignees, importers, exporters, customs brokers, trucking companies, and port agents. This is the SSOT for all legal entities and organisations that interact with the port. Captures entity type, legal registration, IMO company number, ISPS accreditation status, tax identifiers, country of incorporation, and operational status. Sourced from Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM (Account entity) and Port Community System (PCS) stakeholder registry.

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each port community participant record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this master entity. Entity role: MASTER_PARTY.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Country of incorporation determines trade compliance requirements, sanctions screening protocols, customs procedures, WCO membership status, and regulatory jurisdiction for all port community particip

attributes.name: flag_state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.flag_state. Business justification: Vessel operators and shipping lines are registered under flag states; essential for PSC targeting, sanctions screening, regulatory compliance, and maritime authority jurisdiction determination in port

attributes.name: shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.shipping_line. Business justification: port_community_participant has vessel_operator_flag and carrier_code (denormalized). When participant_type is a shipping line, this FK links to the canonical shipping_line master for SCAC code validat

attributes.name: aeo_certification_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Authorised Economic Operator (AEO) Certification Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the participant's AEO certification. Customs compliance teams must monitor this date to ensure continued eligibility for expedited customs clearance. Null if AEO certification is not held.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework; WCO AEO Guidelines

attributes.name: aeo_certification_number
attributes.description: Authorised Economic Operator (AEO) certification number issued by the national customs authority. AEO status indicates a trusted trader with streamlined customs clearance privileges. Applicable to importers, exporters, freight forwarders, and customs brokers.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework Pillar 2; WCO AEO Guidelines; ISO 28000

attributes.name: annual_teu_volume_estimate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU) Volume Estimate
attributes.description: Estimated annual container throughput volume in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU) for this participant. Used for capacity planning, berth scheduling, equipment allocation, and commercial negotiations. Sourced from CRM account profiling.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Statistics Standards; NAVIS N4 Billing Module; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: billing_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address designated for receipt of invoices, Terminal Handling Charges (THC), wharfage (WHR), demurrage (DMG), and detention (DET) billing communications. May differ from the primary operational contact.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IAPH Port Community System Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: credit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the credit limit and financial transactions with this participant (e.g., USD, EUR, SGD). Determines the currency basis for invoicing and accounts receivable.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum credit amount extended to the participant for port services before prepayment or guarantee is required. Expressed in the port's base operating currency. Managed in SAP S/4HANA FI and enforced by NAVIS N4 billing controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; NAVIS N4 Billing Module

attributes.name: crm_account_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier from Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Account entity. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the CRM and the port community master data. Enables traceability back to the originating CRM record.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Account Entity; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: customer_tier
attributes.description: Commercial segmentation tier assigned to the participant based on volume, revenue contribution, and strategic importance to the port. Determines applicable service level agreements (SLA), tariff schedules, and priority berth allocation. Managed in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; IAPH Commercial Best Practices

attributes.name: customs_registration_number
attributes.description: Official customs authority registration or accreditation number assigned to the participant (e.g., Authorised Economic Operator number, customs broker licence number, or importer/exporter code). Required for customs clearance and trade compliance operations.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework; WCO AEO Guidelines; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the participant is approved to handle, declare, or transport International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) classified cargo through the port. Approval requires IMDG certification and compliance with SOLAS Chapter VII.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; SOLAS Chapter VII; IMO MSC/Circ.1442; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the participant's account was deactivated or suspended. Null for currently active participants. Used for historical reporting, regulatory audit trails, and reactivation workflows.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: freight_forwarder_licence_number
attributes.description: National freight forwarding licence or accreditation number issued by the relevant transport authority. Required for participants classified as freight forwarders to legally arrange cargo transport and issue House Bills of Lading (BOL). Null for non-freight-forwarder participant types.
attributes.references: FIATA Standards; National Maritime Safety Authority; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: imo_company_number
attributes.description: Unique seven-digit IMO company identification number assigned by IHS Markit on behalf of the IMO. Mandatory for shipping companies and ship operators under IMO Resolution A.1078(28). Provides a permanent, globally unique identifier for maritime entities.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.1078(28); SOLAS Chapter XI-1 Regulation 3-1

attributes.name: isps_accreditation_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Accreditation Expiry Date
attributes.description: Date on which the participant's ISPS accreditation expires. Port security management must be notified prior to expiry to ensure uninterrupted access to secure port areas. Null if ISPS accreditation is not applicable.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 16; SOLAS Chapter XI-2

attributes.name: isps_accreditation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Accreditation Status
attributes.description: Current ISPS Code accreditation status of the participant. Determines eligibility for access to restricted port security zones and handling of security-sensitive cargo. Mandatory for shipping lines and port agents operating under SOLAS Chapter XI-2.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A and B; SOLAS Chapter XI-2; IMO MSC/Circ.1192

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent operational activity recorded for this participant (e.g., vessel call, container gate-in/out, cargo manifest submission). Used to identify dormant participants and support account review processes.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the port community participant as recorded in the official business registry of the country of incorporation. Used for all formal documentation, contracts, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; ISPS Code

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the participant was formally onboarded and approved to conduct operations within the port community. Marks the start of the participant's active relationship with the port for SLA measurement and tenure reporting.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Community System Standards; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the participant's account within the port community system. Controls access to port services, gate entry, and TOS operations. 'suspended' indicates temporary restriction; 'blacklisted' indicates permanent exclusion pending regulatory review.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B; IMO MSC/Circ.1192; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: p_and_i_club_name
attributes.description: Name of the Protection and Indemnity (P&I) insurance club providing liability coverage to the participant, particularly relevant for shipping lines and port agents. Used in claims management and incident response coordination.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs; IMO LLMC Convention

attributes.name: p_and_i_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the participant's P&I insurance coverage. Required for port entry of vessels and for processing liability claims arising from cargo damage, pollution incidents, or port infrastructure damage.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs; IMO LLMC Convention; MARPOL

attributes.name: participant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the participant's primary role within the port community ecosystem. Determines applicable workflows, tariff schedules, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shipping_line|freight_forwarder|customs_broker|trucking_company|port_agent|cargo_owner|consignee|importer|exporter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAPH Port Community System Standards; IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code applicable to this participant for port service invoices (e.g., NET30, NET60, PREPAID, COD). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI customer master and governs invoice due date calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; NAVIS N4 Billing Module

attributes.name: pcs_participant_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the participant within the Port Community System (PCS) for EDI messaging, cargo manifest submissions, and stakeholder communications. Used as the primary operational identifier in PCS integrations.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Community System Standards; UN/EDIFACT EDI Standards

attributes.name: preferred_edi_format
attributes.description: Preferred EDI message format used by the participant for electronic communications with the port, including cargo manifests, COPARN pre-announcements, BAPLIE stowage plans, and IFTMIN transport instructions. Drives PCS integration configuration.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT Standards; IAPH Port Community System Standards; NAVIS N4 EDI Module

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary operational contact at the participant organisation. Used for EDI notifications, vessel arrival alerts, cargo status updates, and billing communications from the Port Community System.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; UN/EDIFACT EDI Standards; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary operational contact person at the participant organisation. Used for day-to-day port operations communications, notifications, and service coordination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: International format telephone number of the primary operational contact at the participant organisation. Used for urgent operational communications including vessel scheduling, berth changes, and security incidents.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the participant record was first created in the port community master data system. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and GDPR data retention policy enforcement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; ISO 28000; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the participant record in the port community master data system. Used for change data capture (CDC), data quality monitoring, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; ISO 28000; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: registered_address_city
attributes.description: City of the participant's official registered business address. Used in conjunction with registered_address_line1 and country_of_incorporation for complete address resolution.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the participant's official registered business address as recorded in the company registry. Used for formal correspondence, legal notices, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: registered_address_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the participant's official registered business address. Required for formal correspondence and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: sanctions_last_screened_date
attributes.description: Date on which the participant was most recently screened against international sanctions lists. Compliance policy typically requires periodic re-screening (e.g., quarterly or upon each vessel call). Supports audit trail for trade compliance reporting.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; UN Security Council Sanctions; WCO SAFE Framework; ISO 28000

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: Current status of the participant's screening against international sanctions lists (OFAC SDN, UN Security Council, EU Consolidated List). Flagged participants are blocked from port services pending compliance review. Critical for trade compliance and anti-money laundering obligations.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; UN Security Council Sanctions; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; ISO 28000

attributes.name: sap_customer_account_number
attributes.description: Customer account number assigned in SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) module. Used for invoicing, accounts receivable management, and financial reconciliation of port charges including THC, wharfage, and pilotage fees.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: sla_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the applicable Service Level Agreement (SLA) tier governing turnaround times, berth priority, equipment availability, and dispute resolution timelines for this participant. Links to the SLA master reference for KPI monitoring.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Community System Standards; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service Module

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number (TIN) or VAT registration number of the participant in their country of incorporation. Required for customs declarations, invoicing, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework; IMO FAL Convention; ISO 28000

attributes.name: tos_account_code
attributes.description: Account code assigned to the participant in the Terminal Operating System (NAVIS N4 or TOPS Expert). Used for container tracking, equipment dispatch authorisation, yard management, and billing within the TOS. Links participant master data to TOS operational records.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; TOPS Expert Terminal Operating System

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: Commercial or operating name used by the participant in day-to-day port operations, which may differ from the registered legal name. Used in operational communications and TOS displays.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Community System Standards; NAVIS N4 Account Management

attributes.name: trucking_licence_number
attributes.description: Road transport operator licence number issued by the national transport authority. Required for trucking companies accessing the port gate for container pickup and delivery. Used in gate management within NAVIS N4 for vehicle pre-registration.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations Module

attributes.name: vessel_operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the participant operates vessels calling at the port. When true, the participant is subject to vessel scheduling, berth allocation, and VTMS coordination requirements. Drives integration with the Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS).
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; SOLAS; VTMS Integration Standards

products.name: participant_account
products.description: Commercial account record for each port community participant, representing the billing and trading relationship between the participant and the port. Tracks account number, credit limit, payment terms, account status, currency, outstanding balance, and account tier. Distinct from the participant master — one participant may hold multiple accounts (e.g., separate accounts per terminal or service line). Sourced from Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and NAVIS N4 billing module.
products.reference: CRM Account / NAVIS N4 Billing Account

attributes.name: participant_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the participant account record in the port community system. Primary key for the participant_account data product.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Multi-entity port operators manage participant accounts under specific legal entities for financial reporting, tax compliance, and regulatory segregation. Essential for consolidated financial statemen

attributes.name: customs_broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.customs_broker. Business justification: Port operations assign a licensed customs broker to a participant account for declaration processing and billing. Account managers and port billing systems need this link to identify which broker hand

attributes.name: infrastructure_terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.terminal. Business justification: Participant accounts are scoped to specific terminals for terminal-specific tariff schedules, billing, and credit management (e.g., a shipping line's account at Terminal A vs Terminal B). The particip

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent participant (port community member) who holds this account. One participant may hold multiple accounts across terminals or service lines.

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Accounts are often terminal-specific or berth-specific; required for location-based tariff application, access control enforcement, billing reconciliation, and operational capacity planning at specifi

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Participant accounts are managed by specific profit centres (container terminal, bulk cargo, RoRo, cruise) for revenue attribution, P&L reporting, and business segment performance analysis. Essential

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.rate_card. Business justification: Port billing requires resolving the negotiated rate card governing each account for charge calculation and invoice generation. participant_account.tariff_schedule_code is a denormalized reference to t

attributes.name: reconciliation_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Accounts Receivable Sub-ledger Reconciliation: each participant account maps to a reconciliation GL account (AR control account) in the port's ERP/SAP sub-ledger. This is a standard port finance contr

attributes.name: shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.shipping_line. Business justification: Participant accounts for shipping line operators must reference the canonical shipping_line master for tariff group assignment, EDI configuration, alliance membership tracking, and vessel call plannin

attributes.name: account_close_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the participant account was closed or terminated. Null for active accounts. Used for lifecycle reporting and regulatory record retention compliance.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Account Entity; SAP S/4HANA ERP - FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Commercial trading name of the participant account as registered with the port. May differ from the legal entity name of the participant (e.g., a shipping line may have a separate account name per service line).
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Account Entity; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric account number assigned to the participant account. Used on invoices, billing statements, and Terminal Handling Charge (THC) documentation. Sourced from NAVIS N4 billing module and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Billing Module; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: account_open_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the participant account was formally opened and activated for trading with the port. Marks the effective start of the billing and commercial relationship.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Account Entity; SAP S/4HANA ERP - FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the participant account governing whether the account may transact with the port. 'suspended' indicates temporary restriction (e.g., overdue balance); 'on_hold' indicates pending credit review; 'blacklisted' indicates regulatory or compliance-driven prohibition.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Billing Module; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Commercial tier classification of the participant account reflecting volume, strategic importance, and service priority. Determines priority berthing, dedicated account management, and preferential Terminal Handling Charge (THC) rates.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Customer Segmentation; IAPH Port Commercial Best Practices

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the participant account by the type of port community role. Determines applicable tariff schedules, service entitlements, and regulatory obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shipping_line|freight_forwarder|cargo_owner|customs_broker|trucking_company|port_agent|consignee|importer|exporter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Port Community System Standards; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: annual_teu_volume_commitment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU) Volume Commitment
attributes.description: Contracted annual Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU) throughput volume committed by the participant under their service agreement. Basis for volume-based discount tiers and tariff schedule assignment.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; IAPH Port Throughput Reporting Standards

attributes.name: auto_suspension_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is configured for automatic suspension when credit utilisation exceeds the defined threshold or invoices become overdue beyond the permitted days. Controlled by NAVIS N4 billing credit management rules.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Billing Module; SAP S/4HANA ERP - FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: billing_address
attributes.description: Full postal billing address for invoice delivery to this participant account. Used for physical invoice dispatch and regulatory correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA ERP - FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the designated billing contact person at the participant organisation responsible for invoice receipt, query resolution, and payment authorisation for this account.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Contact Entity; SAP S/4HANA ERP - FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which invoices are generated and issued to this participant account. 'per_vessel_call' is common for shipping lines where charges are consolidated per port call.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Billing Module; IAPH Tariff Management Best Practices

attributes.name: billing_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic invoice delivery and billing notifications for this account. Used for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) invoice transmission and automated dunning communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA ERP - FI Financial Accounting; UN/EDIFACT EDI Standards

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the master service agreement or port access contract governing this account. Null for open-ended agreements. Triggers renewal workflow in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM when approaching.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the master service agreement or port access contract governing this account's commercial relationship with the port. Links to the contract management module in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Contract Management; IAPH Port Commercial Best Practices

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the master service agreement or port access contract governing this account. Determines when contracted tariff rates, SLA commitments, and volume discounts become applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this participant account record was first created in the system. Audit trail field aligned with ISO/IEC 27001 data governance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding balance (in account currency) the port will extend to this participant account before requiring payment or suspending services. Used by NAVIS N4 billing module to enforce credit controls on Terminal Handling Charge (THC) and other port dues.

products.name: accreditation
products.description: Single source of truth for all accreditations, certifications, permits, official documents, and access credentials held by port community participants and their personnel/vehicles. Covers entity-level accreditations (ISPS facility security, customs broker licensing, freight forwarder registration, dangerous goods handling certification, stevedoring company accreditation), official documents (trade licences, insurance certificates including P&I cover, vessel operator certificates), and individual-level permits (port access permits for personnel and vehicles, ISPS security zone access authorisations, biometric-linked access credentials, contractor access passes). Captures document/certificate type, scope level (entity, individual, vehicle), permit holder reference, issuing authority, certificate/document number, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, verification status, file reference, security zone access level, biometric reference, revocation status, and linked compliance requirements. This product subsumes what were previously separate participant_document and port_access_permit concepts — all official documents and access permits are managed here as a single SSOT. Critical for compliance gating in PCS and VTMS workflows, ISPS Code enforcement, port zone access control, and audit readiness.

attributes.description: The internal or external application reference number assigned when the accreditation application was lodged with the issuing authority or the port. Used to track the application through the approval workflow and to correspond with the issuing authority during the renewal or initial application process.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); WCO SAFE Framework; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: biometric_reference
attributes.description: Tokenised reference identifier linking this access credential to the holder's biometric record stored in the port's biometric access control system. This is a non-reversible token, not raw biometric data. Populated only for biometric-linked access credentials. Classified as restricted PII biometric data.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); ISO/IEC 19794 Biometric Data Interchange; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: coverage_scope_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific operational scope, geographic coverage, or service categories covered by this accreditation (e.g., 'Authorised for FCL and LCL customs clearance at Port of Melbourne', 'Stevedoring operations limited to container terminal berths 1-6'). Provides context beyond the accreditation type classification.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework; ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this accreditation record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation point for data lineage, compliance reporting, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: ISO 28000; ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: crm_record_reference
attributes.description: The record identifier from Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM corresponding to this accreditation. Enables bidirectional synchronisation between the accreditation data product and the CRM system for customer-facing compliance status visibility and service request management.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The official externally-assigned certificate, licence, permit, or document number as issued by the relevant authority (e.g., customs broker licence number, ISPS facility security certificate number, port access permit number). This is the primary business identifier used in compliance gating and audit trails.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; ISO 28000

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation, certificate, or permit ceases to be valid. Null for open-ended or permanent accreditations. Used as the primary trigger for renewal workflows, compliance gating in PCS and VTMS, and automated expiry alerts. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; ISO 28000; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: file_reference
attributes.description: Storage path, URL, or document management system reference to the scanned or digital copy of the original accreditation document or certificate. Enables direct retrieval of source documents for audit, compliance verification, and Port State Control inspections.
attributes.references: ISO 28000; ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The maximum indemnity coverage amount specified in the insurance certificate, expressed in the currency indicated by insurance_currency_code. Populated only for insurance certificate accreditation types. Used to verify that minimum coverage thresholds required by port bylaws are met. Classified as confidential financial data.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs; IMO FAL Convention; National Maritime Safety Authority; ISO 28000

attributes.name: insurance_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the insurance coverage amount (e.g., USD, EUR, AUD). Populated only when insurance_coverage_amount is present.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; International Group of P&I Clubs; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this accreditation is a mandatory regulatory or port bylaw requirement for the participant to conduct operations. True indicates the accreditation is legally or contractually required. False indicates it is voluntary or supplementary. Used in compliance gating logic to determine whether a missing or expired accreditation blocks operations.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; National Maritime Safety Authority; Port Bylaws

attributes.name: is_revoked
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this accreditation has been formally revoked by the issuing authority or the port. True indicates the accreditation is revoked and must not be used for compliance gating. Provides a fast-path check for access control systems independent of the full status field.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO Resolution A.1119(30); National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation, certificate, or permit was officially issued by the issuing authority. Establishes the effective start of the document's validity period and is used in compliance age calculations.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; ISPS Code; ISO 28000; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: issuing_authority_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction under which the accreditation was issued. Critical for cross-border trade compliance, mutual recognition agreements, and Port State Control verification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Full name of the government body, regulatory authority, classification society, or port authority that issued the accreditation, certificate, or permit (e.g., National Maritime Safety Authority, Customs Authority, Port State Control, IMO-recognised organisation). Used for verification and audit purposes.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; ISPS Code; ISO 28000

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this accreditation record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail completeness in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 28000; ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the accreditation was verified against the issuing authority's records or through a formal audit process. Used to determine whether re-verification is required and to support Port State Control inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; ISO 28000; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, conditions, restrictions, or remarks associated with this accreditation record. May include special conditions imposed by the issuing authority, port-specific operational restrictions, or compliance officer observations.
attributes.references: ISO 28000; ISPS Code; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: pcs_document_reference
attributes.description: The document identifier assigned by the Port Community System (PCS) to this accreditation record. Enables direct cross-reference between the accreditation data product and the PCS for customs integration, cargo manifest compliance gating, and stakeholder messaging workflows.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: permit_holder_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued identity document number (passport, national ID, seafarer's identity document) of the individual permit holder. Populated only when scope_level is 'individual'. Used for identity verification at port access control points and ISPS security zone entry. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention Form 5; ILO Seafarers Identity Documents Convention (No. 185); GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: permit_holder_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual person (personnel, contractor, driver) who holds this permit or access credential when scope_level is 'individual'. Null for entity-level or vehicle-level accreditations. Classified as restricted PII as it directly identifies a natural person.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IMO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006); ISPS Code; ILO MLC

attributes.name: pi_insurance_policy_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Insurance Policy Number
attributes.description: The Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club insurance policy number associated with this insurance certificate accreditation. Populated only when accreditation_type is 'pi_insurance_certificate'. P&I cover is a mandatory requirement for vessel operators and stevedoring companies operating within the port. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs; IMO FAL Convention; SOLAS; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the renewal application must be submitted to the issuing authority to avoid a lapse in accreditation. Typically calculated as a fixed lead-time before the expiry_date (e.g., 30 or 60 days prior). Drives automated renewal reminder workflows and compliance monitoring dashboards.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; ISO 28000; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Tracks the current state of the renewal process for this accreditation. Not Due indicates the document is current and renewal is not yet required. Renewal Initiated indicates internal renewal preparation has begun. Renewal Submitted indicates the renewal application has been lodged with the issuing authority. Renewal Approved indicates the renewed document has been received. Renewal Overdue indicates the document has expired and renewal has not been completed.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; ISO 28000; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation was formally revoked by the issuing authority or the port authority. Null when the accreditation has not been revoked. Used in audit trails and compliance investigations.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO Resolution A.1119(30); Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for revocation of the accreditation, as recorded by the revoking authority or port compliance officer. Null when not revoked. Critical for audit readiness and ISPS Code enforcement documentation.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO Resolution A.1119(30); ISO 28000

attributes.name: rfid_tag_number
attributes.description: The Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tag number embedded in the physical access card or vehicle transponder associated with this accreditation. Used for automated gate access control and security zone entry tracking in NAVIS N4 gate operations.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations; ISO/IEC 18000 RFID Standards

attributes.name: scope_level
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accreditation applies at the entity (organisation/company) level, individual (person/personnel) level, or vehicle level. Drives compliance gating logic in PCS and VTMS workflows and determines which permit holder reference fields are populated.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation was suspended by the issuing authority or the port. Null when the accreditation has not been suspended. Used in compliance investigations and audit trails to track the duration of suspension periods.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; IMO Resolution A.1119(30)

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for suspension of the accreditation, as recorded by the suspending authority or port compliance officer. Null when not suspended. Required for ISPS Code enforcement documentation and Port State Control audit readiness.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; ISO 28000

attributes.name: vehicle_registration_number
attributes.description: Official vehicle registration plate number for vehicle-level access permits. Populated only when scope_level is 'vehicle'. Used for automated gate access control, RFID matching, and port security zone vehicle authorisation in NAVIS N4 gate operations.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; National Maritime Safety Authority; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle for which the access permit is issued. Populated only when scope_level is 'vehicle'. Determines applicable port zones, weight restrictions, and operational areas within the terminal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truck|trailer|forklift|reach_stacker|agv|private_vehicle|motorcycle|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISPS Code; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accreditation or document has been independently verified against the issuing authority's records. Unverified indicates the document has been received but not yet checked. Verified indicates successful confirmation with the issuing authority. Verification Failed indicates the document could not be confirmed as authentic. Pending Verification indicates verification has been initiated and is in progress.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; WCO SAFE Framework; ISO 28000; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

products.name: sla_profile
products.description: Single source of truth for Service Level Agreement definitions, targets, and measured performance outcomes for port community participants. Defines performance commitments including vessel turnaround time targets, container dwell time limits, gate processing time SLAs, documentation processing windows, and billing dispute resolution timeframes. Captures SLA tier name, metric type, target value, unit of measure, measurement window, breach threshold, and penalty/credit terms. Also stores all operational performance measurement records: measurement period, actual value, variance from target, breach flag, breach severity, remediation action taken, responsible party, and measurement timestamp. This product subsumes what was previously a separate sla_performance concept — both SLA definitions and their measured outcomes are managed here as a single SSOT. Assigned to participants via service agreements. Enables SLA reporting, penalty/credit calculation, performance trending, breach alerting, and continuous improvement tracking.
products.reference: Port SLA Framework / PMIS SLA Configuration

attributes.name: sla_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the SLA profile record. Serves as the primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: cargo_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cargo_category. Business justification: SLA profiles in port operations are frequently cargo-category-specific: reefer cargo has different dwell time SLAs than dry bulk or dangerous goods. Linking sla_profile to cargo_category enables categ

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
