attributes.name: infrastructure_terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.terminal. Business justification: SLA profiles are scoped to specific terminals in port operator contracts (e.g., crane productivity SLA at Terminal A). The sla_profile has port_location_id but not terminal_id. Terminal-level SLA prof

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant (shipping line, freight forwarder, cargo owner, customs broker, trucking company, or port agent) to whom this SLA profile is assigned. Links to the customer master in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Port Community System (PCS).
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS); IAPH Stakeholder Management

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: SLAs are often berth-specific or terminal-specific (container terminal vs bulk terminal); performance measurement, crane availability commitments, and turnaround time targets require precise location

attributes.name: service_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.service_code. Business justification: SLA profiles are defined against specific port service codes (crane moves, gate processing, reefer monitoring). Linking sla_profile to service_code enables SLA target-setting per billable service, dri

attributes.name: vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_master. Business justification: sla_profile has imo_number as plain text — a clear denormalization of vessel_master. Vessel-specific SLA profiles (e.g., named vessel turnaround guarantees negotiated by shipping lines) require a FK t

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: SLA targets vary fundamentally by vessel category (container, bulk, tanker); turnaround time commitments, pilotage requirements, and berth allocation priorities differ by vessel type in port service a

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Actual Performance Value
attributes.description: The measured actual performance value for the metric_type during the measurement period. For example, actual vessel turnaround time of 26.5 hours, actual container dwell time of 4.2 days, or actual gate processing time of 12 minutes. Expressed in unit_of_measure. Sourced from NAVIS N4 TOS, VTMS, or PCS operational data.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Performance Reporting; IAPH Port Performance Indicators Framework; VTMS

attributes.name: bol_reference
attributes.description: The Bill of Lading reference number associated with the cargo or container for which this SLA measurement applies. Relevant for cargo handling, documentation processing, and customs clearance SLA types. Links to PCS cargo manifest and trade documentation records.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); WCO Customs Data Model; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: breach_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of SLA breach events recorded within the current measurement_window period. Used to determine if escalating penalty tiers apply (e.g., first breach = warning, third breach = critical escalation) and to track chronic underperformance patterns.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators Framework; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Escalation Framework

attributes.name: breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual_value exceeded the breach_threshold for this measurement period, constituting a formal SLA breach. When True, triggers penalty/credit calculation workflows in SAP S/4HANA FI and escalation notifications in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Billing Module; SAP S/4HANA FI; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: breach_severity
attributes.description: Classification of the severity level when a breach of the SLA threshold occurs. Critical breaches trigger immediate escalation and maximum penalty/credit terms; warning-level breaches initiate remediation planning without financial penalty. Used in SLA breach alerting and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Escalation Framework; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: breach_threshold
attributes.description: The value at which an SLA breach is formally triggered. May differ from target_value to allow a tolerance band (e.g., target vessel turnaround = 24 hours, breach threshold = 28 hours). Expressed in the same unit_of_measure as target_value. Used for automated breach alerting in NAVIS N4 and PCS.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators Framework; NAVIS N4 TOS Billing Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this SLA profile record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance, lineage tracking, and compliance reporting in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: credit_cap_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Credit Cap Value
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative credit or penalty amount that can be applied within a single measurement_window period, expressed in penalty_currency_code. Protects the port operator from unlimited financial exposure under a single SLA agreement. Confidential commercial contract term.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO; IAPH Commercial Best Practices

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Effective End Date
attributes.description: The date on which this SLA profile definition ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended profiles. When populated, triggers profile_status transition to 'expired'. Aligns with contract expiry management in SAP S/4HANA and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Effective Start Date
attributes.description: The date from which this SLA profile definition becomes binding and applicable to assigned service agreements. Aligns with contract commencement dates in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and SAP S/4HANA contract management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: escalation_contact
attributes.description: Name or role designation of the primary escalation contact responsible for managing SLA breach resolution on behalf of the port operator. Typically a Port Operations Manager or Commercial Manager. Confidential internal business contact information.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Escalation Framework; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: force_majeure_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether force majeure clauses apply to this SLA profile, suspending breach penalties during declared force majeure events (e.g., severe weather, port closures, ISPS security incidents). When True, breach measurements are paused during force majeure periods.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Convention; ISPS Code; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this SLA profile record was most recently modified. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer, change data capture (CDC) processing, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: measurement_period_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Period End Timestamp
attributes.description: The precise end timestamp of the performance measurement period for this SLA record. For vessel-call SLAs, this is the Actual Time of Departure (ATD); for gate processing SLAs, this is the gate-out timestamp. Captured from NAVIS N4 TOS or VTMS event feeds.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Event Management; VTMS Vessel Tracking; IMO Port Efficiency Guidelines

attributes.name: measurement_period_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Period Start Timestamp
attributes.description: The precise start timestamp of the performance measurement period for this SLA record. For vessel-call SLAs, this is the Actual Time of Arrival (ATA); for gate processing SLAs, this is the gate-in timestamp. Captured from NAVIS N4 TOS or VTMS event feeds.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Event Management; VTMS Vessel Tracking; IMO Port Efficiency Guidelines

attributes.name: measurement_source_system
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Source System
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the actual_value measurement was sourced. Ensures data lineage traceability for SLA disputes and audit purposes. NAVIS N4 is the primary source for container terminal metrics; VTMS for vessel operations; PCS for documentation processing times. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NAVIS_N4|VTMS|PCS|TOPS|SAP|DYNAMICS_CRM|MANUAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS; VTMS; Port Community System (PCS); TOPS Expert TOS; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp at which the SLA performance measurement was recorded or calculated. Provides the exact point-in-time reference for the actual_value observation. Sourced from NAVIS N4 TOS event timestamps, VTMS vessel event feeds, or PCS document processing logs.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Event Management; VTMS; Port Community System (PCS); IMO Port Efficiency Guidelines

attributes.name: measurement_window
attributes.description: The time window over which SLA performance is measured and evaluated. 'per_call' applies to individual vessel calls or gate transactions; 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly' apply to aggregated operational periods. Determines the frequency of SLA reporting cycles.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators Framework; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM SLA Configuration

attributes.name: metric_type
attributes.description: The specific performance metric being governed by this SLA profile (e.g., 'vessel_turnaround_time', 'container_dwell_time', 'gate_in_processing_time', 'documentation_processing_window', 'billing_dispute_resolution_time', 'crane_productivity_moves_per_hour', 'customs_clearance_time'). Aligns with IAPH KPI framework and NAVIS N4 performance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vessel_turnaround_time|container_dwell_time|gate_processing_time|documentation_processing_window|billing_dispute_resolution_time|crane_productivity|customs_clearance_time|berth_occupancy_time — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators Framework; NAVIS N4 TOS KPI Module; IMO Port Efficiency Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational context, commercial commentary, or exception notes related to this SLA profile or measurement record. Used by port commercial managers and operations teams to document special circumstances, dispute context, or improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service Module; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: penalty_amount_applied
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Amount Applied
attributes.description: The actual financial penalty or credit amount applied for this specific breach event, expressed in penalty_currency_code. May differ from the standard penalty_value if partial waivers, caps, or commercial adjustments were applied. Feeds into SAP S/4HANA FI credit memo or debit note processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Accounting; NAVIS N4 TOS Billing Module; IAPH Tariff Standards

attributes.name: penalty_basis
attributes.description: The basis on which the penalty_value is calculated when an SLA breach occurs. 'per_event' applies a flat fee per breach; 'per_hour' or 'per_day' applies a rate for each unit of time in breach; 'per_teu' applies to container volume; 'percentage_of_invoice' applies a percentage of the relevant THC or service charge.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Billing; NAVIS N4 TOS Billing Module; IAPH Tariff Standards

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Currency Code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the penalty_value (e.g., USD, EUR, SGD, AUD). Ensures correct financial processing in SAP S/4HANA FI for multi-currency port operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: penalty_type
attributes.description: The type of financial remedy applied when an SLA breach occurs. 'credit' reduces future invoices; 'rebate' is a cash payment back to the participant; 'liquidated_damages' are contractually pre-agreed fixed amounts per breach event; 'none' indicates a non-financial SLA with reporting obligations only.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Billing; IAPH Commercial Best Practices; IMO Port Service Agreements

attributes.name: penalty_value
attributes.description: The financial penalty or credit amount applied per SLA breach event, expressed in the currency defined by penalty_currency_code. For percentage-based penalties, this represents the percentage of the applicable invoice or THC charge. Confidential as it reflects commercial contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Controlling; IAPH Tariff and Commercial Standards

attributes.name: penalty_waiver_reason
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Waiver Reason
attributes.description: Free-text justification for waiving or reducing the standard penalty_value for a breach event. Common reasons include force majeure, port congestion beyond operator control, mutual agreement, or first-time breach goodwill waiver. Required for audit trail in SAP S/4HANA and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail; IAPH Commercial Best Practices; IMO Port Service Agreements

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the SLA profile, used in Port Community System (PCS) messaging, EDI exchanges, and customer-facing documentation. Follows the format SLA-[ALPHANUMERIC].
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) EDI Standards; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the SLA profile (e.g., 'Premium Shipping Line Tier 1', 'Standard Freight Forwarder SLA'). Used in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM service agreement records and customer-facing communications.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service Module; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SLA profile definition. 'draft' indicates the profile is under review; 'active' means it is currently governing service agreements; 'suspended' means temporarily paused (e.g., during force majeure); 'expired' means the profile has passed its effective_end_date.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service Module; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: profile_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SLA profile by operational domain. Determines which port business process the SLA governs: vessel operations (turnaround, berthing), container terminal (dwell time, crane productivity), gate processing, documentation (customs, manifests), billing dispute resolution, or cargo handling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vessel_operations|container_terminal|gate_processing|documentation|billing_dispute|cargo_handling — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Billing Module; IAPH Port Performance Indicators Framework

attributes.name: remediation_action
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective or remediation action taken in response to an SLA breach or near-breach event. Examples include 'Additional quay crane deployed', 'Gate lane capacity increased', 'Vessel scheduling adjusted'. Captured in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM service request records.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service Module; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Remediation Due Date
attributes.description: The target date by which the remediation_action must be completed and verified. Drives service request SLA tracking in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and ensures timely resolution of performance issues.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service Module; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the remediation action for an SLA breach event. 'open' indicates no action taken yet; 'in_progress' means corrective measures are underway; 'completed' means the issue is resolved; 'waived' means the breach penalty has been waived by commercial agreement; 'escalated' means the issue has been raised to senior management.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service Module; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Identifies which party bears primary responsibility for meeting the SLA target. In maritime logistics, responsibility may rest with the port operator (crane productivity, berth allocation), the shipping line (vessel arrival punctuality), or be shared between parties. Determines penalty applicability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: port_operator|shipping_line|freight_forwarder|customs_broker|trucking_company|port_agent|shared — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAPH Port Management Best Practices; IMO Port Service Agreements; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: review_frequency

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for escalation of the service request. Supports root cause analysis of escalation patterns and identification of systemic operational issues.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Escalation Reason; IAPH Customer Service Framework

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service request was formally escalated. Null if escalation_flag is false. Used to track escalation response times and management intervention patterns.

attributes.name: imdg_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service request involves dangerous goods classified under the IMDG Code, including misdeclaration complaints, handling incidents, documentation disputes, or storage compliance issues for hazardous cargo.
attributes.references: IMDG Code - International Maritime Dangerous Goods; IMO MSC.122(75); SOLAS Chapter VII

attributes.name: isps_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service request relates to an ISPS Code security matter, including access control breaches, security level changes, security incidents, or ISPS compliance complaints. Triggers mandatory security officer review and potential regulatory notification.
attributes.references: ISPS Code - International Ship and Port Facility Security; IMO Resolution MSC.104(73); SOLAS Chapter XI-2

attributes.name: lodgement_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the service request was formally lodged by the customer or captured in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp and the anchor point for all SLA response time calculations.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Created On; ISO 8601

attributes.name: pcs_message_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the originating Port Community System (PCS) message (e.g., COPARN, IFTMIN, or stakeholder message) that triggered or is associated with this service request. Enables traceability back to the PCS transaction for EDI reconciliation.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; UN/EDIFACT COPARN; IFTMIN

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the service request, determining SLA response and resolution targets. Critical priority applies to vessel safety, ISPS security incidents, or cargo at imminent risk. High applies to operational disruptions affecting vessel or terminal schedules.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Priority; IMO SOLAS; ISPS Code

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the service request at lodgement. Used in all customer-facing communications, Port Community System (PCS) messaging, and EDI exchanges. Format: SR-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Number; Port Community System (PCS) Messaging Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority to which this service request must be or has been notified (e.g., IMO, National Maritime Safety Authority, Port State Control, WCO, ILO). Populated when regulatory_notification_required is true.
attributes.references: IMO; ISPS Code Administration; National Maritime Safety Authority; PSC Authorities; WCO

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service request requires formal notification to a regulatory authority such as the National Maritime Safety Authority, Port State Control (PSC), IMO, or customs authority. Triggered for ISPS security incidents, MARPOL environmental complaints, SOLAS safety violations, or customs fraud allegations.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS; MARPOL Convention; ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; WCO

attributes.name: reopen_count
attributes.description: Number of times this service request has been reopened after a previous resolution or closure. A high reopen count indicates unresolved root causes or customer dissatisfaction with the initial resolution. Used in quality and recurrence analysis.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Reopen Count; ISO 10002 - Complaints Handling

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service request from lodgement through investigation to resolution. Drives workflow routing and SLA monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|open|in_progress|pending_customer|resolved|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Status; IAPH Port Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the customer interaction. Distinguishes between general enquiries, formal complaints, billing disputes, operational service requests, incident reports, permit applications, and documentation requests. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enquiry|complaint|dispute|service_request|incident_report|permit_application|documentation_request — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Type; IAPH Customer Service Framework

attributes.name: resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardised outcome code applied at case closure indicating how the service request was resolved (e.g., resolved_in_favour_of_customer, resolved_in_favour_of_port, partial_credit_issued, no_action_required, referred_to_regulator, withdrawn_by_customer). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resolved_customer_favour|resolved_port_favour|partial_credit|no_action|referred_regulator|withdrawn|information_provided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Resolution Code; IAPH Dispute Resolution Framework

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the resolution actions taken, findings of investigation, decisions made, and any remedial actions or credits applied. Captured by the assigned case handler at resolution. Forms part of the audit trail for regulatory and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Resolution Description; ISO 10002 - Customer Satisfaction Complaints Handling

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service request was formally resolved and a resolution communicated to the customer. Used to calculate total resolution time and SLA compliance for resolution targets.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Resolve By; IAPH Customer Service KPI Framework

attributes.name: service_request_category
attributes.description: Primary business domain category of the service request (e.g., Vessel Operations, Container Handling, Billing and Tariffs, Customs Clearance, Gate Operations, Yard Management, Berth Allocation, Marine Services). Aligns with port operational domains for routing and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vessel_operations|container_handling|billing_tariffs|customs_clearance|gate_operations|yard_management|berth_allocation|marine_services|infrastructure|safety — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Category; NAVIS N4 TOS Domain Classification

attributes.name: service_request_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the service request, complaint, dispute, or enquiry as provided by the customer. Captures the complete context of the issue including relevant operational details such as vessel name, container numbers, BOL references, or terminal locations.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Description; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: sla_resolution_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA resolution target was breached for this service request. True if the resolved_timestamp exceeded sla_resolution_target or if the case remains unresolved past the target. Used for SLA compliance reporting and penalty calculations.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA Breach; IAPH KPI Framework

attributes.name: sla_resolution_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Target Timestamp
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which the port must fully resolve this service request, calculated from lodgement_timestamp based on the applicable SLA tier, request type, and priority level.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI; IAPH Port Service Level Agreement Standards

attributes.name: sla_response_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA first-response target was breached for this service request. True if the acknowledged_timestamp exceeded sla_response_target or if no acknowledgement was sent before the target. Used for SLA compliance reporting and KPI dashboards.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA Breach; IAPH KPI Framework

attributes.name: sla_response_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Target Timestamp
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which the port must send an initial response to the customer for this service request, calculated from lodgement_timestamp based on the applicable SLA tier and priority level.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI; IAPH Port Service Level Agreement Standards

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing granular context within the primary category. Examples include: THC dispute, demurrage claim, container damage, vessel delay, ISPS access, dangerous goods documentation, BOL amendment. Supports detailed analytics and specialist routing.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Sub-Category; NAVIS N4 TOS

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief, descriptive title summarising the nature of the service request as provided by the customer or captured by the port agent at lodgement. Used in case lists, dashboards, and customer communications.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this service request record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

products.name: credit_assessment
products.description: Credit assessment records for port community participants, capturing credit application details, assessed credit limit, credit rating, assessment methodology, supporting financial documents, assessor identity, assessment date, approval status, and next review date. Tracks credit history and limit changes over time. Used by the billing domain for credit control and by commercial teams for account onboarding decisions.
products.reference: CRM Credit Management / SAP FI Credit Control

attributes.name: credit_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each credit assessment record within the port community participant credit management system.

attributes.name: company_code_id

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.customs_declaration. Business justification: Credit assessments for importers/exporters reference specific customs declaration history — duty payment compliance, declaration volumes, rejection rates — as part of creditworthiness methodology. Por

attributes.name: participant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.participant_account. Business justification: Credit assessments evaluate specific accounts, not just participants. Large shipping lines or freight forwarders maintain multiple accounts with different credit profiles, payment terms, and risk rati

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant (shipping line, freight forwarder, cargo owner, customs broker, trucking company, or port agent) for whom this credit assessment is conducted.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Credit Risk by Business Unit reporting: port operators segment credit exposure by profit centre (e.g., container terminal vs. ro-ro terminal). Finance risk reports require credit_assessment linked to

attributes.name: violation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation. Business justification: Credit assessments explicitly evaluate compliance violation history — penalty amounts, recurrence flags, payment status — when determining risk category and credit limits. Port credit teams reference

attributes.name: annual_revenue
attributes.description: The port community participant's most recently reported annual revenue, sourced from submitted financial statements and used as a key input to the credit assessment and limit determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the port community participant formally submitted the credit application or the credit assessment was initiated by the commercial team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit assessment was formally approved by the authorised approver, marking the point from which the credit limit becomes effective.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The organisational approval authority level at which the credit assessment was approved, reflecting the port's delegated authority framework based on credit limit thresholds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_officer|credit_manager|finance_director|cfo|board — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; ISO 28000

attributes.name: approved_credit_limit
attributes.description: The final credit limit formally approved by the authorised approver, which may differ from the assessed limit following management review or escalation. This is the enforceable credit ceiling for the participant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorised approver who approved or rejected the credit assessment, captured at the time of decision for audit trail and governance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Oracle HCM Cloud

attributes.name: assessed_credit_limit
attributes.description: The credit limit amount determined by the assessor following evaluation of the participant's financial standing, payment history, and risk profile. This is the operative limit used by the billing domain for credit control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit assessor formally conducted and completed the credit evaluation, distinct from the application submission date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology or combination of methods used to conduct the credit assessment, such as financial statement analysis, external credit bureau reports, trade references, or the port's internal scoring model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: financial_statement_analysis|credit_bureau_report|trade_reference|internal_scoring_model|combined|external_agency — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative notes recorded by the assessor documenting key findings, risk factors, qualitative observations, and rationale for the credit decision. Supports audit trail and future review context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference number assigned to this credit assessment, used in correspondence with the port community participant and referenced in billing and commercial onboarding workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit assessment record, tracking its progression from initial submission through review, approval or rejection, and eventual expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|expired|withdrawn — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit assessment indicating whether it is an initial assessment for new account onboarding, a scheduled periodic review, a triggered review due to payment behaviour changes, or a credit limit adjustment request. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial|periodic_review|triggered_review|limit_increase|limit_decrease|onboarding — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the credit assessor who conducted the evaluation, captured at the time of assessment for audit and reporting purposes. Complements the assessor_employee_id for human-readable audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Oracle HCM Cloud

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this credit assessment record was first created in the system, used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; SAP S/4HANA FI; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: credit_bureau_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or report identifier from an external credit bureau or trade credit agency report obtained as part of the assessment process. Enables traceability back to the source credit report.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: credit_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of any trade credit insurance arrangement covering the port community participant's credit exposure, where the port has obtained insurance to mitigate default risk. Null if no insurance is in place.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; P&I Club Insurance Standards

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal credit rating assigned to the port community participant following assessment, using a standardised rating scale aligned with international credit rating conventions. Drives review frequency and credit terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score derived from the assessment methodology, representing the port community participant's creditworthiness on the port's internal scoring scale. Used to determine credit rating tier and approved limit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM opportunity or account onboarding record that initiated this credit assessment, enabling traceability between commercial pipeline activities and credit decisions.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limits and financial assessments are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, AUD). Aligns with the port's billing currency configuration in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: days_past_due_count
attributes.description: The number of days the port community participant's outstanding invoices were past due at the time of assessment, sourced from SAP S/4HANA accounts receivable. A key input to the credit scoring model.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Receivable; NAVIS N4 Billing

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the assessed credit limit and terms become binding and active for the port community participant, used by the billing domain for credit control enforcement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Billing and Tariff Management

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current credit assessment expires and a review must be conducted. Nullable for open-ended credit arrangements. Triggers automated review workflow in the commercial team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: financial_statement_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year of the financial statements submitted by the port community participant as supporting documentation for the credit assessment (e.g., 2023). Used to assess recency and relevance of financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: is_watch_list
attributes.description: Indicates whether the port community participant has been placed on the credit watch list due to deteriorating payment behaviour, adverse financial news, or elevated risk signals, triggering enhanced monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; ISPS Code; WCO Trade Compliance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this credit assessment record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail, change tracking, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; SAP S/4HANA FI; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic credit review of the port community participant, set based on credit rating tier and risk policy. Used to trigger review workflows in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The total outstanding accounts receivable balance owed by the port community participant at the time of the credit assessment, sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI. Used as a key input to limit utilisation and risk evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Receivable; NAVIS N4 Billing

attributes.name: payment_history_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the port community participant's historical payment behaviour based on analysis of invoice settlement patterns in SAP S/4HANA accounts receivable. A primary input to the credit scoring model.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Receivable; NAVIS N4 Billing; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms code assigned to the port community participant based on the credit assessment outcome, defining the number of days allowed for invoice settlement (e.g., NET30, NET60, IMMEDIATE). Feeds directly into NAVIS N4 billing configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; NAVIS N4 Billing; Billing and Tariff Management

attributes.name: previous_credit_limit
attributes.description: The credit limit that was in effect prior to this assessment, enabling tracking of credit limit changes over time and trend analysis of the participant's credit standing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: previous_credit_rating
attributes.description: The credit rating assigned in the immediately preceding assessment, enabling tracking of rating migrations and trend analysis. Null for initial assessments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Structured reason code or narrative explanation for the rejection of a credit application or reduction of a requested credit limit. Populated only when assessment_status is 'rejected'. Used for participant communication and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: requested_credit_limit
attributes.description: The credit limit amount requested by the port community participant in their credit application, expressed in the port's operating currency. Used as the baseline for the assessor's evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Broad risk classification assigned to the port community participant based on the credit assessment outcome, used to determine credit control measures, payment terms, and security deposit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: sap_credit_account_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA customer credit account number associated with this assessment, enabling direct linkage between the credit assessment record and the operative credit master data in the ERP system.

attributes.name: security_deposit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the security deposit required from the port community participant as a condition of credit approval, denominated in the currency specified by currency_code. Null if no deposit is required.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: security_deposit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credit assessment outcome requires the port community participant to lodge a security deposit (cash, bank guarantee, or letter of credit) before credit facilities are activated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: security_deposit_type
attributes.description: The form of security instrument lodged or required from the port community participant as collateral for the credit facility, such as cash deposit, bank guarantee, or letter of credit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; UCP 600 Letters of Credit

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document management system path for the supporting financial documents submitted with the credit application (e.g., audited financial statements, bank references, trade references). Enables document retrieval for audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: watch_list_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason the port community participant was placed on the credit watch list. Populated only when is_watch_list is True. Used for enhanced monitoring and escalation decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; ISPS Code

attributes.references: IAPH Port Community Classification; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Account Segment

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has provided consent for their relationship data to be shared with third-party port community system participants or regulatory bodies. Supports privacy compliance and data governance obligations.

attributes.name: handover_date

attributes.name: handover_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting key customer context, open issues, relationship history, and action items transferred during the assignment handover. Classified as confidential due to commercially sensitive customer relationship intelligence.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Notes Entity; IAPH Commercial Management Guidelines

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary relationship manager assignment for the customer. A customer may have multiple assigned managers across different service lines, but only one should be flagged as primary for default CRM routing and escalation.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Primary Contact Flag

attributes.name: isps_clearance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Clearance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned relationship manager requires International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code clearance to access restricted port areas when meeting with this customer. Supports security compliance and access management.
attributes.references: ISPS Code - International Ship and Port Facility Security; IMO MSC/Circ.1111

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal account review meeting conducted by the relationship manager with the customer. Used to track engagement cadence and identify overdue reviews.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Activity History; ISO 8601

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the next scheduled formal account review meeting between the relationship manager and the customer. Drives CRM calendar scheduling and proactive engagement workflows.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Activity Scheduling; ISO 8601

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the relationship manager to record contextual notes about the customer relationship, special instructions, or account-specific considerations not captured in structured fields. Classified as confidential due to commercially sensitive content.

attributes.name: pcs_participant_code
attributes.description: The participant code assigned to the customer within the Port Community System (PCS). Used to correlate the relationship manager assignment with PCS messaging, cargo manifests, and trade documentation workflows.
attributes.references: Port Community System - PCS Participant Registry; WCO Data Model

attributes.name: preferred_contact_channel
attributes.description: The customer's preferred communication channel for engagement with their assigned relationship manager. Supports CRM workflow configuration and communication preference management. EDI and PCS messaging are standard channels in maritime logistics.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Communication Preferences; Port Community System - PCS Messaging

attributes.name: preferred_contact_language
attributes.description: The ISO 639-1 language code representing the customer's preferred language for communication with their relationship manager (e.g., en, zh-CN, ar, fr). Supports multilingual port community engagement.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 - Language Codes; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Language Preference

attributes.name: relationship_health_score
attributes.description: A manually assessed or CRM-system-generated integer score (typically 1-100) reflecting the overall health and strength of the customer relationship at the time of last review. Used for portfolio risk management and proactive engagement prioritisation.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Relationship Analytics; IAPH Commercial Management Guidelines

attributes.name: response_time_target_hours
attributes.description: The contractually or operationally agreed maximum response time in hours for the assigned relationship manager to respond to customer enquiries or service requests under this assignment. Supports SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: IAPH SLA Management Guidelines; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed frequency at which the relationship manager conducts formal account review meetings with the customer. Supports scheduling of Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reviews and service performance discussions.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Account Review Schedule; IAPH Commercial Management Guidelines

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assigned staff member's role in managing the customer relationship. Defines the nature of engagement and authority level within the port organisation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: key_account_manager|commercial_manager|port_agent_liaison|customer_success_manager|trade_development_manager|operations_liaison — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Role Classification; IAPH Port Commercial Management Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: The SLA tier applicable to this customer relationship assignment, determining response time commitments, service priority, and escalation thresholds. Platinum and gold tiers typically apply to major shipping lines and key accounts.
attributes.references: IAPH Port SLA Management Guidelines; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA Entity

attributes.name: strategic_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is classified as a strategic account requiring executive-level engagement and enhanced service delivery. Strategic accounts typically represent major shipping lines or high-volume cargo owners critical to port revenue.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Account Classification; IAPH Commercial Management Guidelines

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for terminating this relationship manager assignment. Populated when assignment_status transitions to terminated. Supports workforce analytics and customer retention reporting.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Assignment Closure Reason; Oracle HCM Cloud - Termination Reason

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this relationship manager assignment record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data loading in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity

products.name: port_access_permit
products.description: Port access permits issued to port community participant personnel and vehicles, granting authorised access to restricted port zones in compliance with ISPS Code requirements. Captures permit holder (person or vehicle), permit type (personnel, vehicle, contractor), ISPS security zone access level, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, biometric reference, and revocation status. Distinct from accreditation (which is entity-level) — this is individual-level access control.
products.reference: ISPS Port Access Control / Port Security Permit

attributes.name: port_access_permit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each port access permit record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: access_credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.access_credential. Business justification: ISPS compliance requires traceability from the formal permit authorization document to the physical/digital access credential issued against it. Port security officers use this link for revocation wor

attributes.name: authorized_access_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.access_point. Business justification: Permits specify which access points holder may use for entry/exit. Essential for access control system integration and permit validation at gates. Role prefix clarifies this is authorized entry point,

attributes.name: contact_person_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact_person. Business justification: Port access permits are issued to specific individuals who must be registered in the port community system. The contact_person table already carries port_access_badge_number, confirming the cross-refe

attributes.name: infrastructure_terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.terminal. Business justification: Under the ISPS Code, port access permits specify which terminal(s) the holder is authorized to access. The port_access_permit has port_location_id but not terminal_id. Terminal-scoped access control i

attributes.name: isps_facility_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.isps_facility_record. Business justification: Port access permits must validate against ISPS facility security requirements and current security level. Port security officers require this link to enforce zone access restrictions based on facility

attributes.description: Source system identifier for this permit record in the Port Community System (PCS). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and integration between the PCS and the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); EDI Integration Standards

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant entity (shipping line, freight forwarder, trucking company, port agent, etc.) under whose sponsorship this permit was issued. Links to the customer master.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Access permits grant entry to specific terminals, berths, or ISPS security zones; physical access control enforcement, gate validation, and security zone management require precise location-level auth

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanctions_screening. Business justification: Port access permits require sanctions screening of the permit holder prior to issuance, per ISPS and national port security regulations. Port security operations must record which sanctions screening

attributes.name: sponsoring_vessel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vessel.vessel. Business justification: ISPS Code requires port access permits for crew and visitors to be sponsored by the vessel they are boarding. Port security teams must link access permits to the specific vessel for security zone comp

attributes.name: sponsoring_vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_master. Business justification: port_access_permit has sponsoring_vessel_imo_number as plain text — strong denormalization of vessel_master. Under ISPS Code requirements, crew and vessel agent port access permits are sponsored by a

attributes.name: access_time_restriction
attributes.description: Time-of-day restriction applied to this permit. Unrestricted permits allow 24/7 access; other values limit access to defined operational windows. Enforced at gate entry systems and ISPS checkpoints.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP)

attributes.name: application_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the original permit application submitted through the Port Community System (PCS) or port authority portal. Links the issued permit back to the application workflow for audit and traceability.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); ISPS Code Part A Section 2

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) at which the permit application was formally approved by the issuing authority. Distinct from issue_date which records the calendar date of issuance. Supports ISPS audit trail with precise approval timing.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the security background check was completed for this permit holder. Used to determine whether a re-check is required at renewal based on the port's ISPS security policy interval.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; National Maritime Safety Authority Security Screening Guidelines

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the security background check conducted on the permit holder prior to issuance. Passed status is a prerequisite for active permit issuance under ISPS requirements. Waived may apply to certain visitor categories under escort.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; National Maritime Safety Authority Security Screening Guidelines

attributes.name: badge_number
attributes.description: Physical badge or access card number printed on the permit holder's port ID badge. Used by gate access control systems, RFID readers, and security checkpoints to validate physical access. May differ from permit_number.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: biometric_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique reference token linking this permit to the holder's biometric record stored in the port's secure biometric identity management system (fingerprint, iris, or facial recognition template). The actual biometric template is NOT stored here — only the reference token. Null for vehicle permits.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); ISO/IEC 19794 Biometric Data Interchange

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) at which this permit record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and lineage tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: crm_contact_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding contact record in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM for the permit holder or their sponsoring organisation. Enables cross-system traceability between the access permit and the CRM customer engagement record.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: escort_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the permit holder must be accompanied by an authorised port escort at all times while within restricted ISPS zones. True for visitor and certain contractor permit types; False for credentialed personnel with full unescorted access.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the port access permit ceases to be valid. After this date the permit_status transitions to expired and physical access is denied. Renewal must be initiated before this date to maintain uninterrupted access.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: holder_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the individual permit holder in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for identity verification, background screening, and ISPS compliance records. Null for vehicle permits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ISPS Code Part A Section 2

attributes.name: holder_employer_name
attributes.description: Name of the organisation that employs or sponsors the permit holder (e.g., shipping line, stevedoring company, customs broker, trucking company). Used to link the individual to their sponsoring port community participant for accountability and audit.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ILO MLC 2006

attributes.name: holder_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual permit holder (person) as it appears on their government-issued identity document. Populated for personnel, contractor, visitor, crew, and emergency permit types. Null for vehicle-only permits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006

attributes.name: holder_id_document_number
attributes.description: The unique number of the government-issued identity document (passport number, national ID number, seafarer book number, etc.) used to verify the permit holder's identity during the application process.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; GDPR Article 4; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: holder_id_document_type
attributes.description: Type of government-issued identity document presented by the permit holder at the time of application and verification. Used for ISPS compliance audit and background check records.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; IMO FAL Convention; ILO MLC 2006

attributes.name: holder_nationality
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the nationality of the individual permit holder. Required for ISPS background screening and customs/immigration compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ISPS Code Part A Section 2; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.description: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code security level at which this permit was issued. Level 1 is normal operations; Level 2 is heightened threat; Level 3 is exceptional threat. Permits issued at higher security levels may carry additional access restrictions.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2.1; IMO MSC/Circ.1192; SOLAS Chapter XI-2

attributes.name: isps_zone_access
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISPS-designated restricted port zones to which this permit grants access (e.g., berth_side|container_yard|gate_complex|bonded_warehouse|control_room). Defined per the port's ISPS Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: berth_side|container_yard|gate_complex|bonded_warehouse|control_room|vessel_deck|hazmat_area — promote to reference product for zone management]
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2.1; SOLAS Chapter XI-2; IMO MSC/Circ.1192

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the port access permit was formally issued and became effective. Marks the start of the permit's validity period.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the port authority department or designated security officer responsible for issuing this permit (e.g., Port Security Office, ISPS Compliance Unit). Required for audit trail and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: max_entry_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of gate entries permitted under this access permit within its validity period. Null indicates unlimited entries (applicable to permanent and multi-entry permits). Enforced by the gate access control system.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations

attributes.name: permit_category
attributes.description: Operational category of the permit defining its usage scope. Permanent permits are issued for long-term employees; temporary permits cover short-term contractors or visitors; single-entry permits are for one-time access events; multi-entry permits allow repeated access within the validity period.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP)

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique permit reference number assigned by the port authority at issuance. Used on physical badges, gate scanners, and ISPS audit trails. Format: PAP-<PORT_CODE>-<SEQUENCE>.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; IMO MSC/Circ.1192

attributes.name: permit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the port access permit. Active permits grant physical access; suspended permits are temporarily blocked pending investigation; revoked permits are permanently cancelled; expired permits have passed their expiry date without renewal.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port State Control (PSC) Inspection Guidelines

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the access permit indicating whether it covers a person (personnel, contractor, visitor, crew, emergency responder) or a vehicle. Drives the applicable ISPS security zone rules and badge colour coding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: personnel|vehicle|contractor|visitor|crew|emergency — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2.1; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: previous_permit_number
attributes.description: Permit number of the immediately preceding permit that this record renews or replaces. Enables lineage tracing across permit renewal cycles for ISPS audit and compliance history.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or special conditions associated with this permit (e.g., restricted to specific berth, requires safety induction completion, hazardous cargo handling certification required). Captured by the issuing security officer.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP)

attributes.name: renewal_count
attributes.description: Number of times this permit has been renewed since its original issuance. Tracks the renewal history for compliance reporting and to identify long-standing permit holders who may require periodic re-vetting under ISPS policy.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the permit was formally revoked prior to its natural expiry. Populated only when permit_status is revoked. Null for active, suspended, or expired permits.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the permit was revoked. Required when permit_status is revoked to support ISPS audit trails and incident reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: security_breach|employment_terminated|document_expired|disciplinary_action|voluntary_surrender|lost_stolen|other — promote to reference product if additional reasons are required]
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; National Maritime Safety Authority Incident Reporting

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) chip embedded in the permit holder's access badge or vehicle transponder. Enables automated gate entry/exit tracking and real-time zone monitoring within the port.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 18000 RFID Standards; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date on which the permit was placed into suspended status pending investigation or administrative review. Populated only when permit_status is suspended. Null for all other statuses.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port State Control (PSC) Inspection Guidelines

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for suspending the permit. Populated when permit_status is suspended. Supports security incident investigation and ISPS compliance audit.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) at which this permit record was last modified. Supports change detection, incremental loading in the lakehouse, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: vehicle_registration_number
attributes.description: Official government-issued registration plate number of the vehicle for vehicle-type permits. Null for personnel permits. Used at gate entry/exit for automated plate recognition and ISPS vehicle access control.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; National Maritime Safety Authority Vehicle Access Regulations

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle covered by a vehicle-type permit. Determines applicable port zone access rules, weight restrictions, and escort requirements. Null for personnel permits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truck|trailer|forklift|crane|passenger_vehicle|motorcycle|heavy_equipment — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Infrastructure Safety Regulations

domains.name: tariff
domains.description: Owns the complete port services pricing catalog including THC (Terminal Handling Charges), wharfage (WHR), pilotage fees, demurrage (DMG), detention (DET), PIL, BAF, CAF, storage tariffs, and SLA-linked service rate cards. Covers rate cards, pricing rules, discount structures, and tariff schedules. SSOT for all commercial pricing and tariff definitions.

products.name: port_tariff
products.description: Master catalog of all port tariff schedules published by the port authority, organized by charge type discriminator. Supported charge types include THC (Terminal Handling Charges by container type/movement/zone), wharfage (WHR by cargo type/HS code/tonnage), pilotage (by LOA/GRT band/zone/time), towage (by GRT/DWT band/tug count/operation type), mooring (by LOA band/gang count/time), port dues (light dues, conservancy, anchorage by vessel GRT/flag), storage (by container status/type/zone with escalating bands), demurrage (DMG by container type/day with free time and escalation), and detention (DET for off-terminal equipment retention). Each record defines a named tariff schedule with its charge type classification, effective period, applicable trade lanes, vessel categories, cargo types, terminal zones, regulatory approval status, and filing reference. New charge types are added as new rows with a charge_type discriminator — no schema changes required. Supports multiple concurrent schedules per charge type. This is the SSOT for all tariff schedule definitions — individual charge amounts are held in tariff_item.

attributes.description: Comma-separated list of trade lanes or routes to which this tariff applies (e.g., 'Asia-Europe', 'Transpacific', 'Intra-Asia'). Null if applicable to all lanes.

products.name: item
products.description: Individual line-item charge definition within a port tariff schedule. Represents a single billable service rate (e.g., THC per TEU by container type, wharfage per GRT by cargo category, pilotage per LOA band by zone, storage per day per TEU by escalation tier, towage per GRT band by operation type). products.name: rate_card
products.description: Negotiated or published rate card defining specific pricing applicable to a customer segment, shipping line, cargo owner, or trade lane. A rate card references one or more tariff items and overrides or discounts the base tariff rates for a defined period. Supports standard commercial rate cards and SLA-linked rate cards with service performance tiers (Gold/Silver/Bronze), committed KPIs (vessel turnaround time, crane productivity moves/hour, gate processing time), penalty/premium clauses, measurement periods, and escalation clauses. Captures rate card name, version, effective and expiry dates, applicable customer tier, trade lane, service type, SLA tier (if applicable), currency, approval workflow status, and link to originating tariff_negotiation. An SLA tier discriminator distinguishes standard rate cards from performance-linked rate cards — no separate entity required. Serves as the commercial pricing instrument linking the tariff catalog to customer agreements and SLA-based billing adjustments.

products.name: surcharge_rule
products.description: Unified definition of all applicable surcharges and adjustment factors layered on top of base tariff rates, maintained as versioned time-series records. Covers BAF (Bunker Adjustment Factor) with fuel index references (Platts, MOPS, Singapore), calculation method (flat per TEU or percentage), and trade lane scope; CAF (Currency Adjustment Factor) with currency pair, percentage, and calculation base (percentage of freight or THC); PIL (Port Infrastructure Levy); ISPS security surcharge; peak season surcharge; hazardous cargo (IMDG) surcharge; OOG (out-of-gauge) surcharge; cold ironing surcharge; and any other periodic or conditional surcharge. Each record defines the surcharge type discriminator, calculation method (flat fee, percentage of base, per unit), rate amount or percentage, applicable index reference, effective period, trade lane scope, vessel type applicability, publication authority, and applicability conditions. New surcharge types are added as new rows — no schema changes required. Enables historical surcharge reconstruction for billing disputes and audit.

products.name: pricing_rule
products.description: Configurable business rule defining conditional logic for charge calculation, rate selection, tariff applicability, and conflict resolution. Captures rule name, rule type (tiered pricing, conditional surcharge, minimum charge enforcement, free period calculation, tariff selection, applicability matrix, conflict resolution), trigger conditions (cargo type, vessel class, trade direction, customer segment, terminal zone, service type, trade lane), priority order for conflict resolution when multiple tariffs could apply, effective period, and rule expression or decision logic. Includes the full applicability matrix specifying which tariff applies to which combination of customer segment, vessel type, cargo category, trade lane, terminal zone, and service type — serving as the deterministic tariff selection engine. Used by the billing engine and TOS charge calculation to select the correct tariff and rate for each billable event without ambiguity. New applicability dimensions are added as rule conditions — no separate entity required.
