attributes.name: superseded_by_schedule_port_dues_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port dues schedule that replaces this schedule. Nullable for current active schedules. Maintains version history and audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: Port dues are fundamentally structured around vessel type alongside GRT/LOA bands. Regulatory port dues filings and billing require vessel_type master reference. Replaces denormalized 'vessel_type' te

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority officially approved this port dues schedule for implementation.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: base_rate_amount
attributes.description: Base monetary amount for the port dues charge before any discounts, surcharges, or adjustments. Represents the standard statutory rate for the defined vessel classification and dues type.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: call_frequency_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to port dues for vessels meeting the call frequency tier criteria. Incentivizes regular service commitments and port loyalty.

attributes.name: call_frequency_tier
attributes.description: Classification tier based on vessel call frequency at the port. First call applies to vessels making their inaugural visit, regular applies to standard service schedules, frequent applies to high-frequency callers, and premium applies to vessels with committed service agreements. Higher frequency tiers may attract discounted dues rates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this port dues schedule record was first created in the system. Part of mandatory audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the port dues are denominated and payable.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_surcharge_percentage
attributes.description: Additional percentage surcharge applied to port dues for vessels carrying International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) classified cargo. Reflects additional risk management and safety oversight costs.

attributes.name: dues_type
attributes.description: Classification of the statutory port dues charge type levied on vessels. Light dues cover navigational aids, conservancy dues cover channel maintenance, port entry fee is the basic vessel call charge, anchorage dues apply to vessels at anchor, navigation dues cover vessel traffic services, and pilotage dues cover mandatory pilotage services.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Port Dues Framework

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this port dues schedule becomes legally binding and applicable to vessel calls. Aligns with regulatory publication requirements.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this port dues schedule remains valid. Nullable for open-ended schedules subject to regulatory review.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: environmental_levy_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage levy added to port dues to fund environmental protection initiatives, emissions monitoring, and compliance with MARPOL (Marine Pollution Convention) requirements.

attributes.name: exemption_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed description of the criteria under which vessels may be exempt from port dues under this schedule. Typically includes naval vessels, government vessels on official duty, vessels in distress, and humanitarian mission vessels.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dues schedule includes provisions for exemptions. True if certain vessel categories (e.g., naval vessels, emergency response vessels, vessels in distress) may be exempt from dues under this schedule.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: grt_band_max
attributes.description: Maximum Gross Registered Tonnage for the vessel size band to which this dues schedule applies. Nullable for open-ended upper bands.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Tonnage Measurement Convention

attributes.name: grt_band_min
attributes.description: Minimum Gross Registered Tonnage for the vessel size band to which this dues schedule applies. GRT is the primary metric for vessel-based port dues calculation.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Tonnage Measurement Convention

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage penalty applied to overdue port dues payments. Calculated as a percentage of the outstanding amount per period (typically per month or per day).

attributes.name: loa_band_max_meters
attributes.business_glossary_term: Length Overall (LOA) Band Maximum in Meters
attributes.description: Maximum vessel Length Overall in meters for this dues schedule band. Nullable for open-ended upper bands.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Vessel Measurement Standards

attributes.name: loa_band_min_meters
attributes.business_glossary_term: Length Overall (LOA) Band Minimum in Meters
attributes.description: Minimum vessel Length Overall in meters for this dues schedule band. LOA may be used as a supplementary classification criterion for berth allocation and dues calculation.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Vessel Measurement Standards

attributes.name: maximum_charge_amount
attributes.description: Maximum port dues charge amount applicable as a cap. Protects large vessel operators from excessive dues and maintains port competitiveness for mega-vessels.

attributes.name: measurement_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days over which call frequency is measured for discount eligibility. Typically 30, 90, or 365 days depending on service agreement terms.

attributes.name: minimum_calls_per_period
attributes.description: Minimum number of vessel calls required within the measurement period to qualify for the call frequency discount. Used to enforce service commitment thresholds.

attributes.name: minimum_charge_amount
attributes.description: Minimum port dues charge amount applicable regardless of calculated rate. Ensures a floor revenue per vessel call for small vessels where tonnage-based calculation would yield negligible amounts.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this port dues schedule record was last modified in the system. Part of mandatory audit trail for regulatory compliance and version control.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or clarifications regarding the application of this port dues schedule. May include references to specific regulatory provisions or commercial agreements.

attributes.name: nrt_band_max
attributes.description: Maximum Net Registered Tonnage for the vessel size band. Nullable for open-ended upper bands.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Tonnage Measurement Convention

attributes.name: nrt_band_min
attributes.description: Minimum Net Registered Tonnage for the vessel size band. NRT represents the earning capacity of the vessel and may be used as an alternative or supplementary metric for dues calculation in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Tonnage Measurement Convention

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from vessel departure or invoice date within which port dues must be paid. Standard terms are typically 7, 14, or 30 days depending on customer credit standing.

attributes.name: port_dues_schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the port dues schedule. Draft schedules are under development, active schedules are in force, suspended schedules are temporarily inactive, expired schedules have passed their validity period, superseded schedules have been replaced by newer versions, and withdrawn schedules have been permanently removed.

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date on which this port dues schedule was published in the official gazette or public tariff book. Statutory port dues must be publicly disclosed prior to enforcement.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: rate_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the base rate calculation. Per GRT and per NRT are tonnage-based, per call is a flat fee per vessel visit, per meter LOA is length-based, per day applies to anchorage dues, and flat fee is a fixed charge regardless of vessel size.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Tariff Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_reference
attributes.description: Official reference number or gazette notification number issued by the regulatory authority approving this port dues schedule. Required for legal enforceability and audit compliance.
attributes.references: National Maritime Safety Authority Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government or regulatory body that has jurisdiction over this port dues schedule. Port dues are statutory charges requiring regulatory approval and oversight.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the port dues schedule, used for external reference and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Tariff Standards

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the port dues schedule for business identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: security_levy_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage levy added to port dues to fund International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code compliance measures and port security infrastructure.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: trade_type
attributes.description: Classification of trade type for which this dues schedule applies. International trade involves cross-border cargo, coastal trade is between domestic ports, domestic trade is within national waters, cabotage is domestic cargo carriage reserved for national flag vessels, and transshipment involves cargo transfer without customs clearance.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Trade Classification Framework

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Manages invoicing, revenue collection, payment processing, accounts receivable, billing disputes, credit management, financial settlements, and revenue recognition for all port services rendered. Covers invoice generation from TOS (NAVIS N4), payment tracking, chargebacks, and EBITDA-level revenue reporting. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI. SSOT for all revenue transactions and customer billing.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core billing document issued to port community participants (shipping lines, freight forwarders, cargo owners) for all port services rendered. Generated from NAVIS N4 TOS and integrated with SAP S/4HANA FI. Captures invoice number, invoice date, due date, billing period, total amount, currency, tax amount, invoice status (draft/issued/paid/disputed/cancelled), payment terms, vessel call reference, BOL reference, service type (THC, wharfage, pilotage, demurrage, detention), port of loading/discharge, and SAP document number. SSOT for all revenue billing documents.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount

attributes.name: baf_amount

attributes.name: bol_number

attributes.name: caf_amount

attributes.name: credit_note_number

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: delivery_method

attributes.name: discount_amount

attributes.name: dispute_reason

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is expected per the agreed payment terms. Used for accounts receivable aging and overdue calculation.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was officially issued to the customer. Principal business event timestamp for revenue recognition and accounts receivable aging.

attributes.name: invoice_number

attributes.name: modified_by_user

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.name: payment_received_date

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Bank transaction reference or remittance advice number provided with payment. Used for payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: pod_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the port of discharge for the cargo. Used for trade lane analysis and tariff determination.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text remarks or special instructions related to this invoice. Used for billing notes, customer communications, or internal annotations.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which revenue from this invoice is recognized in financial statements per IFRS 15 criteria. May differ from invoice date.

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI accounting document number for this invoice. Links billing record to financial accounting system of record.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Primary category of port service being billed. Includes Terminal Handling Charge (THC), wharfage, pilotage, demurrage, detention, and other maritime services. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: thc|wharfage|pilotage|demurrage|detention|towage|mooring|berth_hire|reefer|storage — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of all line items before taxes, adjustments, and discounts. Base amount for revenue calculation.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the invoice, including VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes per jurisdiction.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the tax exemption certificate on file justifying tax exemption status. Required for audit compliance.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is exempt from taxation due to customer status, service type, or regulatory exemption.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code determining which tax rates and rules apply to this invoice. ISO country code or regional tax authority identifier.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount due including subtotal, taxes, discounts, and adjustments. Net amount payable by customer.

products.name: invoice_line
products.description: Individual line items on a port services invoice, each representing a discrete chargeable service or tariff component. Captures line number, service code, service description, tariff item reference, quantity (TEUs, FEUs, CBM, hours, moves), unit of measure, unit rate, line amount, tax code, tax amount, net amount, container number, BOL reference, vessel call ID, charge category (THC, WHR, DMG, DET, BAF, CAF, pilotage, towage, storage), and NAVIS N4 charge code. Enables granular revenue analysis at the service level.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is under dispute by the customer. True if disputed, False otherwise. Affects accounts receivable aging and collection processes.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for dispute if dispute_flag is True. Captures customer objections and billing discrepancies.

attributes.name: line_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount for this line item before tax. Calculated as quantity multiplied by unit rate, plus any applicable adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Invoice Line Amount

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the invoice. Determines the ordering and display sequence of line items on the invoice document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Invoice Line Item

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount for this line item including tax. Sum of line amount and tax amount. Contributes to the invoice total.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this line item. Captures special instructions, billing clarifications, or operational context.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module - Line Item Notes

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the service rendered. May represent TEUs, FEUs, CBM, hours, moves, or other units depending on the service type.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module - Charge Calculation

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue for this line item is recognized in the financial statements. May differ from invoice date based on revenue recognition policies.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: service_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the service was completed. Used to calculate duration-based charges and service level agreement compliance.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module - Service Event Timestamp

attributes.name: service_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the service commenced. Used for time-based charges such as storage, demurrage, and detention calculations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module - Service Event Timestamp

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount calculated for this line item. Derived from line amount multiplied by tax rate.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code determining the tax treatment for this line item. References the tax jurisdiction and rate applicable to the service.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Tax Code Master

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Tax rate percentage applied to this line item. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10% tax).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity. TEU=Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit, FEU=Forty-foot Equivalent Unit, CBM=Cubic Meter. Aligns with maritime logistics industry standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TEU|FEU|CBM|HOUR|MOVE|TON|UNIT|DAY — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: Rate per unit of measure. The price charged for one unit of the service (e.g., rate per TEU, rate per hour).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: payer_account_number

attributes.name: payer_bank_name

attributes.name: payment_date

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment in the accounts receivable lifecycle. Tracks payment from receipt through clearing and application to invoices.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of payment purpose. Distinguishes between advance payments, payments on account, invoice settlements, refunds, and credit note applications.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was first received or recorded in the system. Principal business event timestamp. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: reconciled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was reconciled. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of payment reconciliation against bank statements and invoice records. Tracks whether payment has been matched and verified.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External payment reference number provided by the payer or payment system. Used for reconciliation and customer inquiries.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_reference
attributes.description: Reference number from the remittance advice document sent by the payer. Links payment to payer's accounts payable records.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was reversed or bounced. Null if payment has not been reversed. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for payment reversal if payment status is reversed. Documents reason for chargeback, NSF (non-sufficient funds), or cancellation.

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount not yet allocated to invoices. Held on account for future invoice settlement or refund.

products.name: payment_allocation

Critical for accurate accounts receivable aging, bank reconciliation, cash application automation, and financial close in SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.description: Reference to the billing dispute case if allocation is disputed. Links to dispute resolution workflow. Nullable when no dispute exists.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Currency exchange rate applied when payment currency differs from invoice currency. Used for multi-currency allocation and foreign exchange gain/loss calculation.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which the allocation belongs. Supports financial reporting and year-end close processes.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Allocated amount converted to the company code local currency using the exchange rate. Used for financial reporting in local GAAP.

attributes.name: modified_by_user

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the allocation. Used for documenting special circumstances, manual adjustments, or reconciliation details.

attributes.description: The remaining unpaid balance on the invoice after this allocation is applied. Zero indicates invoice is fully paid. Critical for accounts receivable aging reports.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation was reversed or cancelled. Nullable for active allocations. Used for audit trail and financial period correction.

attributes.name: reversal_document
attributes.description: SAP FI document number of the reversal transaction. Links to the offsetting entry that undoes the original allocation. Nullable for non-reversed allocations.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for reversing or cancelling the allocation. Nullable when allocation is not reversed. Examples: payment error, invoice dispute, incorrect amount, duplicate payment.

attributes.name: sap_clearing_document

attributes.name: withholding_tax_deducted

attributes.name: aging_bucket_31_60_days
attributes.description: Total outstanding balance for invoices aged 31 to 60 days past due date. Indicates moderate collection risk.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_61_90_days
attributes.description: Total outstanding balance for invoices aged 61 to 90 days past due date. Indicates elevated collection risk requiring escalation.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_over_90_days
attributes.description: Total outstanding balance for invoices aged over 90 days past due date. Indicates high collection risk; may require legal action or write-off consideration.

attributes.name: auto_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled in automatic payment via direct debit or standing order. True means invoices are auto-settled on due date.

attributes.name: average_days_to_pay
attributes.description: Rolling average number of days from invoice date to payment receipt over the last 12 months. Key metric for credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the postal address to which invoices and statements are sent. Typically contains street number and name.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing postal address. Used for suite/floor/building details or additional address information.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality component of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the billing address country.

attributes.name: billing_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for sending invoices, statements, and billing-related communications.

attributes.name: billing_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for billing inquiries and dispute resolution. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code component of the billing address. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region component of the billing address. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: consolidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices for this account should be consolidated with parent account for statement purposes. True enables group-level billing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this receivable account record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is currently on credit hold. True means no new services can be rendered until outstanding balance is reduced.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding balance allowed for this account before credit hold is triggered. Expressed in the account's base currency.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal or external credit rating assessment for this account. Used to determine credit limits and payment terms. D indicates default risk. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D|unrated — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispute_count_ytd
attributes.description: Number of billing disputes raised by this account in the current calendar year. High counts indicate service quality or billing accuracy issues.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current collections escalation level (0=none, 1=reminder, 2=warning, 3=final notice, 4=legal action). Increments with each overdue period.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred channel for delivering invoices to the customer. EDI is common for large shipping lines; email for smaller customers.

attributes.name: last_invoice_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent invoice issued to this account. Used to identify dormant accounts.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent payment received from this account in the account's base currency.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received from this account. Used to calculate average days to pay and payment behavior trends.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this receivable account record was last updated. Updated automatically on any field change.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current total amount owed by the customer across all unpaid invoices. Updated in real-time as invoices are issued and payments are received.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms defining the number of days from invoice date until payment is due. Net 7/14/30/60 are common port industry terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_7|net_14|net_30|net_60|net_90|due_on_receipt|cod — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: preferred_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for invoicing this account. All invoices will be issued in this currency unless overridden at transaction level.

attributes.name: sap_customer_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA customer master number (KNA1/KNB1) linking this receivable account to the ERP financial accounting module. Ten-digit numeric identifier.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Customer Master Data

attributes.name: statement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which account statements summarizing all invoices and payments are generated and sent to the customer.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the primary tax jurisdiction for this account. Determines applicable tax rates and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: Tax registration identifier for VAT/GST purposes. Required for invoicing and tax compliance reporting. Format varies by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: write_off_amount_ytd
attributes.description: Total amount written off as bad debt for this account in the current calendar year. Impacts credit rating and future credit decisions.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) to which this revenue recognition event is allocated. Used for period-end financial close and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any adjustment applied to the base revenue amount, such as discounts, surcharges (BAF, CAF), rebates, or contractual adjustments. Positive values represent surcharges; negative values represent discounts or credits.
attributes.references: Port Tariff Schedule, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: adjustment_reason

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the revenue recognition event. Pending approval indicates awaiting finance manager review; Approved indicates cleared for GL posting; Rejected indicates the event was declined and must be corrected.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the revenue recognition event was approved for GL posting. ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this revenue event record was first created in the system. ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the recognized and deferred revenue amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency port operations.

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The amount of revenue deferred to future accounting periods. Applicable for services delivered over time (e.g., storage, lease agreements, long-term contracts).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (YYYY) to which this revenue recognition event belongs. Supports multi-year financial analysis and annual reporting.

attributes.name: gl_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA FI document number assigned to the general ledger posting for this revenue recognition event. Used for financial audit and reconciliation. 10-digit numeric format.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the revenue recognition event was posted to the SAP S/4HANA FI general ledger. May differ from recognition_date due to period-end close timing or batch processing.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this revenue event record was last modified. ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, explanations, or audit notes related to the revenue recognition event. Used for documenting special circumstances, manual adjustments, or compliance annotations.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of service units delivered that generated the revenue (e.g., number of TEUs handled, number of pilotage hours, number of storage days, tonnage moved). Unit of measure is context-dependent on service type.

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue is recognized in the accounting system. This is the business event date for revenue realization, distinct from invoice date or service delivery date.

attributes.name: recognition_event_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the revenue recognition event, formatted as REV- followed by 10 digits. Used for audit trails and financial reporting.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: The method used to recognize revenue for this event. Point-in-time applies to discrete services (THC, pilotage, towage); Over-time applies to continuous services (storage, lease); Milestone applies to project-based services; Proportional applies to usage-based services; Straight-line applies to subscription or fixed-term contracts.

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the revenue recognition event. Pending indicates awaiting approval; Recognized indicates revenue has been posted to GL; Deferred indicates revenue is held for future periods; Reversed indicates a correction or cancellation; Adjusted indicates a modification post-recognition; Cancelled indicates the event was voided.

attributes.name: recognized_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The amount of revenue recognized in this event, posted to the general ledger. Represents the portion of the invoice or service order value that is realized in the current accounting period.

attributes.name: revenue_stream_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the revenue stream for strategic reporting and EBITDA analysis. Vessel services include pilotage, towage, berth fees; Cargo handling includes THC, stevedoring; Storage/demurrage includes container yard charges; Marine services include launch, survey; Facility lease includes terminal, warehouse rental; Ancillary services include utilities, security.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this revenue event is a reversal or correction of a previously recognized revenue event. True indicates a reversal; False indicates a normal recognition event.

attributes.name: service_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the underlying port service was delivered or completed (e.g., vessel departure, container discharge completion, pilotage service completion). Used to determine point-in-time vs over-time recognition.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the transaction in the source system (e.g., NAVIS N4 billing transaction ID, SAP FI document number). Used for data lineage and reconciliation back to the source system.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the service quantity. TEU = Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit; FEU = Forty-foot Equivalent Unit; TON = Metric ton; CBM = Cubic meter; HOUR = Service hour; DAY = Calendar day; MOVE = Container move; UNIT = Generic unit count; KG = Kilogram; MT = Metric tonne. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TEU|FEU|TON|CBM|HOUR|DAY|MOVE|UNIT|KG|MT — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: The rate per unit of measure applied to calculate the revenue amount. Represents the tariff or contracted price per TEU, per hour, per day, etc.

products.name: run
products.description: Batch billing execution records capturing each scheduled or ad-hoc billing cycle run that generates invoices from NAVIS N4 TOS charge data. Captures billing run reference, run type (periodic/vessel-call/ad-hoc/final), billing period start and end dates, run date and time, total invoices generated, total invoice value, currency, run status (scheduled/in-progress/completed/failed/cancelled), operator ID, NAVIS N4 export batch reference, and SAP posting batch reference. Provides full audit trail of invoice generation cycles.
products.reference: NAVIS N4 - Billing Batch / SAP S/4HANA FI - Billing Run

attributes.name: run_type

attributes.name: start_timestamp

attributes.name: total_charge_lines_processed

products.name: charge_event
products.description: Granular chargeable service events captured from NAVIS N4 TOS and other operational systems, representing all raw billable activities before invoice consolidation. Covers commercial charges (container moves, gate transactions, crane hire, reefer connections, hazardous handling, storage days) and statutory/regulatory charges (wharfage assessments based on cargo weight/volume, port dues based on vessel GRT/NRT, pilotage levies, navigation fees). Also captures demurrage and detention charge calculations including free time start/end, excess days, and daily rates. Captures charge event reference, event type, event timestamp, container number, vessel call ID, vessel IMO/GRT/NRT, BOL number, cargo weight/volume, equipment ID, quantity, unit of measure, applicable tariff code, calculated charge amount, currency, billing status (unbilled/billed/disputed/waived), exemption flag, free time days allowed, excess days, statutory authority reference, and source system reference. SSOT for all pre-invoice chargeable activity including commercial, statutory, and demurrage/detention charges.
products.reference: NAVIS N4 - Charge Event / TOS Billable Activity

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: reefer_flag

attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the charge event, used for tracking and reconciliation across systems.

attributes.name: source_system_reference

products.name: statement_of_account
products.description: Periodic accounts receivable statement documents issued to port customers summarizing all billing activity (invoices raised, payments received, credit/debit memos applied, outstanding balance) for a defined statement period. Captures statement number, customer account reference, statement date, statement period (monthly/quarterly), opening balance, total invoices raised, total payments received, total adjustments, closing balance, aging summary (current/30/60/90/90+ days), statement delivery method, and customer acknowledgement. Supports regulatory requirements for periodic AR disclosure, customer reconciliation, and dispute prevention. Generated as part of month-end billing close process.

attributes.name: statement_of_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the statement of account record. Primary key.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Statements of account are issued per legal entity in multi-entity port operators; company code scoping is required for statutory AR reporting and customer communication from the correct legal entity.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_cycle. Business justification: Statements of account are generated per billing cycle. The billing_cycle table contains the authoritative period dates and fiscal period information. Adding billing_cycle_id normalizes period tracking

attributes.name: participant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer receivable account for which this statement is issued. Links to the billing account master.

attributes.name: prior_statement_of_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on statement_of_account (prior_statement_of_account_id)

attributes.name: receivable_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.receivable_account. Business justification: A statement of account is a periodic AR summary document issued to a specific customer's receivable account. The receivable_account is the SSOT for customer billing identity, contact details, and AR b

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing run batch process during which this statement was generated as part of the month-end or period-end billing close.

attributes.name: acknowledged_by_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the customer contact person who acknowledged the statement on behalf of the customer organization.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer formally acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the statement.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the statement, raised a dispute, or has not responded.

attributes.name: aging_31_60_days
attributes.description: The portion of the closing balance representing invoices that are overdue by 31-60 days from their due date.

attributes.name: aging_61_90_days
attributes.description: The portion of the closing balance representing invoices that are overdue by 61-90 days from their due date.

attributes.name: aging_current
attributes.description: The portion of the closing balance representing invoices that are current or overdue by 0-30 days from their due date.

attributes.name: aging_over_90_days
attributes.description: The portion of the closing balance representing invoices that are overdue by more than 90 days from their due date. Indicates high collection risk.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statement was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for cancelling the statement, if the statement status is cancelled. Used for audit and process improvement.

attributes.name: closing_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding accounts receivable balance at the end of the statement period. Calculated as opening balance plus invoices and debit adjustments minus payments and credit adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the statement record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: credit_adjustment_count
attributes.description: The total number of credit adjustment transactions applied to the customer account during the statement period.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts on this statement are denominated.

attributes.name: debit_adjustment_count
attributes.description: The total number of debit adjustment transactions applied to the customer account during the statement period.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The channel through which the statement was delivered to the customer. Aligns with customer communication preferences.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the statement was successfully delivered to the customer through the specified delivery method.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has raised a dispute or discrepancy regarding the statement contents or balances.

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique reference number of the billing dispute case raised by the customer in relation to this statement, if applicable.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which the statement period falls.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the statement period falls, used for financial reporting and period alignment.

attributes.name: invoice_count
attributes.description: The total number of invoices issued to the customer during the statement period.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the statement record was last modified in the system. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional remarks, special instructions, or contextual information related to the statement.

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding accounts receivable balance at the beginning of the statement period. Represents carried-forward balance from prior period.

attributes.name: payment_count
attributes.description: The total number of payment transactions received from the customer during the statement period.

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA FI document number associated with the statement generation or posting transaction in the financial system.

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statement was generated and issued to the customer. Represents the as-of date for all balances and transactions included.

attributes.name: statement_frequency
attributes.description: The periodic cadence at which this statement is generated for the customer account. Aligns with billing cycle configuration.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique statement reference number issued to the customer. Format: SOA-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the statement. Tracks progression from draft through issuance, customer acknowledgement, and closure.

attributes.name: total_credit_adjustments
attributes.description: The aggregate value of all credit notes, credit memos, and favorable adjustments applied to the customer account during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_debit_adjustments
attributes.description: The aggregate value of all debit notes, debit memos, and unfavorable adjustments applied to the customer account during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_invoices_raised
attributes.description: The aggregate value of all invoices issued to the customer during the statement period. Increases the receivable balance.

attributes.name: total_payments_received
attributes.description: The aggregate value of all payments received from the customer during the statement period. Reduces the receivable balance.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this billing cycle record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the billing cycle, such as 'Monthly Container Services - January 2024' or 'Quarterly Vessel Operations Q1-2024'.

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing cycle. Active cycles are open for transaction posting; closed cycles are finalized for revenue recognition.

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing cycle frequency. Determines the recurring pattern for invoice generation and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: dispute_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date during which customers can raise billing disputes for invoices in this cycle. Typically 30-90 days.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the billing cycle period. All transactions with service dates on or before this date are eligible for inclusion in this cycle.

attributes.name: external_cycle_reference
attributes.description: External reference number or identifier used by upstream systems (NAVIS N4, SAP) to identify this billing cycle. Used for system integration and reconciliation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (1-12 for monthly, 1-4 for quarterly). Used for period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter number (1-4) to which this billing cycle belongs, used for quarterly financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this billing cycle belongs, used for annual financial reporting and budget tracking.

attributes.name: gl_period
attributes.description: The general ledger accounting period in YYYYMM format to which this billing cycle is assigned for financial reporting.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which financial transactions for this billing cycle are posted to the SAP S/4HANA general ledger for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: integration_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which billing cycle data originates, typically NAVIS N4 TOS or SAP S/4HANA FI.

attributes.name: invoice_generation_date
attributes.description: The date on which invoices for this billing cycle are generated and issued to customers. Typically occurs after the cycle end date.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing cycle record is currently active and available for use. Inactive cycles are retained for historical reference but not used in current operations.

attributes.name: is_adjustment_cycle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a special adjustment or correction cycle used to process chargebacks, credit memos, or billing corrections outside the regular billing schedule.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this billing cycle record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: late_fee_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether late payment fees are applicable for invoices in this billing cycle if payment is received after the due date.

attributes.name: late_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to overdue invoice amounts as a late payment penalty. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 1.5 for 1.5% per month).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes for internal use, capturing operational comments, exceptions, or special handling instructions for this billing cycle.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment for invoices in this billing cycle must be received to avoid late fees or penalties. Calculated based on payment terms.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days from invoice date to payment due date for this billing cycle. Common values are 30, 45, or 60 days.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which revenue for this billing cycle is recognized in the general ledger for financial reporting and EBITDA calculation.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: The primary category of port services covered by this billing cycle. Used to segment revenue streams and align with Terminal Operating System (TOS) NAVIS N4 service classifications.

attributes.name: start_date

domains.name: booking
domains.description: Handles booking requests, slot reservations, vessel call appointments, service order lifecycle, and pre-arrival coordination. Manages the commercial intake process from booking to service confirmation. SSOT for service booking and appointment data.

products.name: call_booking
products.description: Core master record for a vessel call booking request submitted by a shipping line or agent. Represents the commercial intake of a vessel visit to the port, capturing vessel identity (IMO number, vessel name), expected arrival/departure windows (ETA/ETD/ETB), requested berth, service requirements summary, voyage details (voyage number, service rotation, last/next port), booking status lifecycle (nominated, pending, confirmed, cancelled, completed), and pre-arrival coordination data. Central SSOT for all vessel call bookings — all other booking domain entities reference this record. Aligned with DCSA booking model concepts. Sourced from Port Community System (PCS) and NAVIS N4.

products.description: Transactional record for a specific port service request (pilotage, towage, mooring, stevedoring, crane allocation, bunkering, fresh water, waste reception) linked to a vessel call booking. attributes.description: Planned timestamp when the vessel is expected to berth and commence mooring operations. Used for berth slot planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: etd

attributes.name: expected_teu_volume

attributes.name: high_tide_time

attributes.name: imdg_class

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Security Level
attributes.description: ISPS security level applicable to this berth reservation. Determines security protocols and access controls during the vessel visit.

attributes.name: loa_meters
attributes.description: Maximum length of the vessel from bow to stern in meters. Used to validate berth length capacity and ensure adequate berth space allocation.

attributes.name: low_tide_time
attributes.description: Timestamp of the next low tide event relevant to this berth reservation. Used to validate minimum under-keel clearance during the berthing period.

attributes.name: mooring_gang_size
attributes.description: Number of mooring personnel required for line handling operations during berthing and unberthing. Based on vessel size and mooring configuration.

attributes.name: number_of_tugs
attributes.description: Number of tugboats required to assist with berthing and unberthing operations. Determined by vessel size, weather conditions, and port regulations.

attributes.name: pilotage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether marine pilotage services are mandatory for this vessel berthing operation based on vessel size, cargo type, or port regulations. True if pilot is required.

attributes.name: planning_source
attributes.description: Identifies the system or module that created or last updated this berth reservation. Tracks data lineage for berth planning decisions.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this berth reservation. Influences berth allocation decisions during conflicts or capacity constraints.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: General free-text notes and comments related to this berth reservation. Used for operational coordination and information sharing among port stakeholders.

attributes.name: reservation_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this berth reservation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and booking lead time analysis.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique business identifier for the berth reservation. Used for external communication and tracking. Format: BR followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the berth reservation. Tracks progression from initial booking through vessel departure or cancellation.

attributes.name: reservation_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this berth reservation record was last modified. Tracks changes to berth allocation, timing, or status throughout the booking lifecycle.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of cargo service or vessel operation associated with this berth reservation. Determines required berth facilities and handling equipment.
attributes.references: SMDG Vessel and Voyage Data Standard

attributes.name: special_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling, equipment, or operational requirements for this berth reservation. Examples include reefer power, fresh water supply, or security protocols.

attributes.name: tidal_window_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel requires specific tidal conditions for safe berthing or departure due to draft constraints. True if tidal window planning is mandatory.

attributes.name: towage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether tugboat assistance is required for safe berthing or unberthing operations. True if towage services are needed.

attributes.name: under_keel_clearance_meters
attributes.description: Minimum required clearance between the vessel keel and the seabed in meters. Ensures safe navigation and berthing operations considering tidal variations.
attributes.references: PIANC Harbour Approach Channels Design Guidelines

attributes.name: weather_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this berth reservation is subject to weather-related operational restrictions. True if weather conditions may impact berthing operations.

products.name: cargo_booking
products.description: Master record for cargo booked against a vessel call, consolidating commercial booking, slot allocation, and pre-arrival manifest declaration into a single cargo-level SSOT. Captures BOL reference, cargo type (FCL/LCL/RoRo/LoLo/bulk), commodity/HS Code, TEU/FEU count, gross weight, POL/POD, shipper/consignee references, IMDG DG class, temperature-controlled flag, stowage position (bay-row-tier from BAPLIE), manifest reference, customs entry status, and booking confirmation status. Aligned with DCSA transport document and UN/EDIFACT IFTMBF booking message standards. Sourced from PCS and NAVIS N4.

products.name: slot_reservation
products.description: Container slot reservation on a vessel for a specific cargo booking, representing the physical bay-row-tier stowage position (BAPLIE reference) allocated to cargo. Captures slot type (20ft/40ft/HC/RF/OOG), slot status (reserved, confirmed, cancelled, substituted), weight class, reefer plug requirement, and allocation source (shipping line nomination or terminal allocation). Manages the commercial slot allocation negotiation between shipping lines and the terminal operator. Links to cargo_booking as the commercial parent. Sourced from NAVIS N4 vessel planning module.

attributes.name: vessel_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific vessel call on which this slot is reserved. Identifies the voyage and port call for the container stowage.

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for slot allocation when multiple bookings compete for limited space. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Typically based on booking time, customer tier, contract terms, or cargo urgency. Used by auto-allocation algorithms.

attributes.name: allocation_source
attributes.description: Origin of the slot allocation decision. Shipping Line Nomination: slot requested by carrier. Terminal Allocation: terminal assigned slot based on operational optimization. Auto Allocation: system-generated based on rules. Manual Override: planner manually assigned slot. Tracks allocation authority and negotiation outcome.

attributes.name: bay_position
attributes.description: Longitudinal bay number on the vessel where the container is stowed. Part of the BAPLIE stowage coordinate system (bay-row-tier). Odd numbers typically indicate 20ft bays, even numbers indicate 40ft bays.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT BAPLIE Message, SMDG Stowage Coordination Group

attributes.name: cancelled_at
attributes.description: Date and time when the slot reservation was cancelled. Null if not cancelled. Cancellation releases the slot back to available inventory and may trigger rebooking or penalty assessment.

attributes.name: confirmed_at
attributes.description: Date and time when the shipping line confirmed the slot reservation. Null if not yet confirmed. Confirmation locks the slot and triggers downstream gate and yard planning processes.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: System timestamp when this slot reservation record was first created in the terminal operating system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that created this slot reservation record. Used for audit trail, accountability, and operational quality tracking.

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the unconfirmed reservation will automatically expire and be released. Typically set based on terminal policy (e.g., 24-48 hours from reservation). Null for confirmed reservations.

attributes.name: final_destination
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the ultimate destination for the cargo, which may differ from port of discharge if transshipment or inland transport is involved. Used for end-to-end supply chain visibility.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: oversize_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cargo exceeds standard container dimensions. Standard: fits within ISO container envelope. Out of Gauge: exceeds one or more dimensions. Over Height: exceeds standard height. Over Width: exceeds standard width. Over Length: exceeds standard length. OOG cargo requires special stowage planning and may incur surcharges.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Freight Container Classification, NAVIS N4 Vessel Planning

attributes.name: port_of_discharge
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port where the container will be discharged from the vessel. Five-character code. Determines discharge sequence planning and onward transport coordination.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: port_of_loading
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port where the container will be loaded onto the vessel. Five-character code (2-letter country + 3-letter location). Used for routing, customs, and manifest generation.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: reefer_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot requires a reefer plug connection for refrigerated container power supply. True for temperature-controlled cargo requiring continuous power during voyage.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Vessel Planning Module, IMDG Code Class 9

attributes.name: reefer_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Required temperature setting in degrees Celsius for refrigerated containers. Null for non-reefer slots. Typical range: -30°C to +30°C. Critical for perishable cargo integrity.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Vessel Planning Module, Reefer Container Operating Standards

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the slot reservation, used in communications with shipping lines and customers. May follow terminal-specific numbering convention.

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the slot reservation. Reserved: initial allocation pending confirmation. Confirmed: shipping line has confirmed the slot. Cancelled: reservation voided before use. Substituted: replaced by another slot. Released: slot returned to available pool. Expired: reservation lapsed without confirmation. No Show: container did not arrive for loading. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reserved|confirmed|cancelled|substituted|released|expired|no_show — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reserved_at
attributes.description: Date and time when the slot was initially reserved. Marks the start of the reservation lifecycle. Used for reservation expiry calculations and slot utilization analytics.

attributes.name: restow_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this container requires restowing (shifting) during the voyage or at an intermediate port to access containers beneath it. True for containers that will be temporarily moved and re-stowed. Impacts operational cost and vessel schedule.

attributes.name: row_position
attributes.description: Transverse row number on the vessel where the container is stowed. Part of the BAPLIE stowage coordinate system. Odd numbers port side, even numbers starboard side, with 00 at centerline.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT BAPLIE Message, SMDG Stowage Coordination Group

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique seal number applied to the container door to ensure cargo integrity and detect tampering. Recorded at stuffing and verified at unstuffing. Required for customs and security compliance (ISPS, C-TPAT).
attributes.references: ISO 17712 - Freight Container Seals, ISPS Code, WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: slot_rate_amount
attributes.description: Commercial rate charged for this slot reservation. May be per TEU, per container, or per booking depending on tariff structure. Null if slot is allocated under volume contract without per-slot pricing. Used for revenue recognition and billing.

attributes.name: slot_rate_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the slot rate amount. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP. Null if slot_rate_amount is null.

attributes.name: slot_type
attributes.description: Physical container type and size for which the slot is allocated. Determines TEU/FEU calculation, stowage constraints, and handling requirements. Standard: dry cargo. High Cube: 9ft 6in height. Reefer: refrigerated. Open Top: removable roof. Flat Rack: collapsible sides. Tank: liquid cargo. Platform: flat base only. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard_20|standard_40|high_cube_40|high_cube_45|reefer_20|reefer_40|open_top_20|open_top_40|flat_rack_20|flat_rack_40|tank_20|platform_20|platform_40 — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 6346 - Freight Containers, NAVIS N4 Equipment Types

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special stowage, handling, or operational instructions for this slot. Examples: 'Keep away from heat sources', 'Load last for priority discharge', 'Requires customs inspection'. Used by vessel planners and stevedores.

attributes.name: stowage_location
attributes.description: General stowage area classification on the vessel. Below Deck: in cargo holds. On Deck: above deck stacked. Hatch Cover: on top of cargo hold covers. Affects cargo safety, insurance, and handling sequence.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter VI - Cargo Stowage and Securing, NAVIS N4 Vessel Planning

attributes.name: teu_count
attributes.description: TEU equivalent of this slot reservation. 20ft containers = 1.0 TEU, 40ft containers = 2.0 TEU, 45ft containers = 2.25 TEU. Used for vessel capacity planning and terminal throughput metrics.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Freight Container Classification, IAPH Port Performance Indicators

attributes.name: tier_position
attributes.description: Vertical tier number on the vessel where the container is stowed. Part of the BAPLIE stowage coordinate system. 02, 04, 06 etc. for below deck; 82, 84, 86 etc. for on deck.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT BAPLIE Message, SMDG Stowage Coordination Group

attributes.name: transshipment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this container will be transshipped to another vessel at the port of discharge rather than being delivered to final consignee. True for transshipment cargo requiring onward vessel connection.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Vessel Planning Module, UN/EDIFACT COPARN

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for dangerous goods (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Null for non-hazardous cargo. Used for regulatory compliance, emergency response, and stowage segregation per IMDG Code.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: System timestamp when this slot reservation record was last modified. Updated on any field change. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this slot reservation record. Used for change audit trail and operational accountability.

attributes.name: verified_gross_mass_kg
attributes.description: Verified Gross Mass of the container in kilograms, as required by SOLAS VGM regulation. Mandatory for all packed containers since July 2016. Used for vessel stability calculations and safe stowage planning.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter VI Regulation 2 - VGM, IMO MSC.1/Circ.1475

attributes.name: vgm_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the container gross mass per SOLAS VGM regulation. Method 1: weighing the packed container. Method 2: weighing all contents and adding tare weight. Both methods are acceptable; method must be documented.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter VI Regulation 2, IMO MSC.1/Circ.1475

attributes.name: vgm_verified_at
attributes.business_glossary_term: Verified Gross Mass (VGM) Verified At Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the VGM was verified. Must be before vessel loading per SOLAS requirements. Used for compliance audit trail and operational gate planning.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter VI Regulation 2, ISO 8601 DateTime Standard

attributes.name: vgm_verified_by

attributes.description: Nominated volume of import containers to be discharged at this port, expressed in TEU. Critical for yard planning and equipment allocation.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: next_port_of_call
attributes.description: Next scheduled port in the vessel's itinerary after this call. Provides context for transshipment cargo routing and vessel schedule reliability.

attributes.name: nominated_eta
attributes.description: Shipping line's initial estimate of vessel arrival time at port limits. First signal in the vessel scheduling process, typically provided 7-14 days before arrival.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Vessel Reporting Standards

attributes.name: nominated_etb
attributes.description: Requested berthing time window start. Represents the shipping line's preferred time to commence cargo operations.

attributes.name: nominated_etd
attributes.description: Planned departure time from berth as nominated by the shipping line. Used for berth occupancy planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: nomination_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the voyage nomination, typically provided by the shipping line or generated by the Port Community System (PCS). Used for external communication and tracking.

attributes.name: nomination_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the nomination was first received by the port system. Used for SLA tracking and nomination lead-time analysis.

attributes.name: nomination_source
attributes.description: Channel or system through which the nomination was received. Tracks data quality and integration pathway.

attributes.name: nomination_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the voyage nomination. Tracks progression from initial nomination through acceptance or rejection by port authority.

attributes.name: oversized_count
attributes.description: Number of out-of-gauge or oversized containers (open-top, flat-rack, or containers with cargo exceeding standard dimensions) nominated for this call. Requires special yard slots and handling equipment.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: pilotage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether marine pilotage services are required for this vessel call. Drives pilot scheduling and marine services coordination.

attributes.name: reefer_count
attributes.description: Number of refrigerated containers (reefers) nominated for this call. Requires special yard planning for power plug availability and monitoring.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for why the nomination was rejected (e.g., berth unavailable, vessel dimensions exceed berth capacity, insufficient advance notice). Null if nomination was accepted.

attributes.name: rejection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the nomination was rejected by the port authority. Null if nomination was accepted or is still pending.

attributes.name: restow_teu
attributes.description: Nominated volume of containers requiring restow operations (discharge and reload on same vessel for improved stowage). Impacts berth time and crane productivity.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: special_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling requirements, operational constraints, or service requests submitted with the nomination (e.g., 'Requires mobile crane for heavy lift', 'Priority berthing requested').

attributes.name: total_moves
attributes.description: Total number of container handling moves nominated for this vessel call (sum of all discharge and load operations). Key metric for crane hour estimation and berth productivity planning.

attributes.name: towage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether tug boat assistance is required for berthing and unberthing operations. Drives towage resource planning.

attributes.name: transhipment_teu
attributes.description: Nominated volume of transhipment containers (discharge and reload) at this port, expressed in TEU. Represents containers moving between vessels without leaving port custody.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this voyage nomination record was last modified. Tracks data currency and change frequency for operational monitoring.

products.name: service_requirement
products.description: Declared service requirements submitted by a shipping line or cargo owner as part of a vessel call booking. Captures required service types (pilotage, towage, mooring, stevedoring, reefer monitoring, dangerous goods handling, OOG cargo handling), quantity, special handling instructions, equipment requirements (STS crane, MHC, RTG), compliance requirements (IMDG class, ISPS security level), and priority indicators. Acts as the demand signal that drives service_order creation and terminal resource planning. Distinct from service_order in that requirements represent declared needs before scheduling, while service_orders represent committed execution plans.

attributes.name: service_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service requirement record. Primary key for the service requirement entity.

attributes.name: berth_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.berth. Business justification: Service requirements for mooring, line handling, gangway, and shore power are operationally tied to a specific berth. Resource scheduling and SLA tracking for berth-side services require this link. Th

attributes.name: call_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vessel call booking that this service requirement is part of. Links the service requirement to the overall booking context.

attributes.name: contact_person_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact_person. Business justification: requester_contact_name, requester_contact_email, requester_contact_phone are denormalized text fields on service_requirement. Replacing with a contact_person FK enables CRM notification workflows and

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Service requirements carry estimated_cost and billing_reference, indicating cost-tracked operations. Port operators assign service requirement costs (crane hire, specialist labour, equipment) to cost

Port operators need to link the service requirement to the triggerin

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Service requirements with estimated_cost and billing_reference are linked to internal orders for project-based cost tracking (e.g. special equipment mobilisation, OOG handling projects). Port finance

attributes.name: item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.item. Business justification: Service requirements reference specific chargeable service items for cost estimation before a service order is raised. Port billing teams need the tariff item to pre-calculate charges and validate ser

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.participant_account. Business justification: Service requirements are raised by participants against their account for billing and SLA tracking. requester_organization is a plain text denorm; the proper account reference enables credit checks an
