attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.port_community_participant. Business justification: requester_organization is a plain text denorm on service_requirement. The requesting party is a port_community_participant. Proper FK enables billing, SLA tracking, PCS workflow, and eliminates the de

attributes.name: service_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.service_code. Business justification: service_type field exists. FK to service_code master enables service catalog validation, pricing lookup, billing integration, UOM standardization, and approval workflow routing for service requirement

attributes.name: terminal_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.terminal_zone. Business justification: Service requirements for yard equipment, reefer monitoring, and cargo handling are assigned to a terminal zone for resource dispatch and SLA compliance tracking. Zone-level service allocation drives e

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: Service requirements are vessel-type-specific — pilotage, towage, mooring gang size, and crane compatibility all depend on vessel type. Service planners use vessel type to validate equipment availabil

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service requirement was formally approved and authorized for service order creation. Marks the transition from demand signal to committed execution plan.

attributes.name: billing_reference
attributes.description: Customer-provided reference number for billing and invoicing purposes. Links the service requirement to the customer's internal purchase order or cost center for financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Financial Accounting Module

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the service requirement was cancelled by the requester or port authority. May cite vessel schedule changes, cargo plan modifications, or force majeure events. Populated only when requirement_status is cancelled.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Service Request Standards

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field documenting regulatory compliance considerations, customs requirements, or trade documentation needs associated with the service requirement. May reference SOLAS, MARPOL, or local port authority regulations.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) - Trade Compliance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service requirement record was first created in the system. Represents the initial capture of the demand signal, which may precede formal submission.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost. Typically USD for international maritime transactions, but may vary based on port jurisdiction and customer agreement.

attributes.name: equipment_type_required
attributes.description: Specific type of terminal equipment required to fulfill the service. Critical for equipment dispatch planning and capacity validation. STS = Ship-to-Shore crane, MHC = Mobile Harbour Crane, RTG = Rubber Tyred Gantry, AGV = Automated Guided Vehicle.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Preliminary cost estimate for the requested service based on tariff schedules and service parameters. Provided for customer budgeting and approval purposes prior to service order confirmation.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module - Tariff Management

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Expected duration in hours for completing the requested service. Used for resource scheduling, berth planning, and service order timeline estimation.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier from the source system or customer system that originated this service requirement. Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation with external booking platforms or EDI messages.
attributes.references: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) - IFTMIN Message Standard

attributes.name: imdg_class
attributes.description: IMDG classification for dangerous goods handling requirements. Mandatory when service_type includes dangerous goods handling. Drives compliance protocols and specialized equipment allocation.
attributes.references: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code - IMO

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.description: Required ISPS security level for the service execution. Level 1 = normal, Level 2 = heightened, Level 3 = exceptional. Determines access control, screening procedures, and security resource allocation.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service requirement record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the requirement for audit trail and data freshness purposes.

attributes.name: oog_cargo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service requirement involves Out of Gauge cargo that exceeds standard container dimensions. Triggers specialized handling procedures and equipment requirements.
attributes.references: Terminal Operating System (TOS) - Cargo Classification Standards

attributes.name: oog_dimensions
attributes.description: Detailed dimensional specifications for OOG cargo in format Length x Width x Height (meters). Required when oog_cargo_flag is true for safe handling and stowage planning.
attributes.references: SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) - Cargo Securing Manual

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority indicator for the service requirement. Influences scheduling sequence and resource allocation decisions in terminal operations.
attributes.references: Port Management Information System (PMIS) - Priority Classification

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the service quantity field. Defines how the service volume is quantified for billing and resource allocation purposes.

attributes.name: reefer_humidity_required
attributes.description: Target humidity level as percentage for refrigerated container monitoring. Applicable for specific cargo types requiring controlled atmosphere.
attributes.references: Container Freight Station (CFS) - Reefer Management Standards

attributes.name: reefer_temperature_required
attributes.description: Target temperature setting in Celsius for refrigerated container monitoring service. Critical for maintaining cold chain integrity for perishable cargo.
attributes.references: Container Freight Station (CFS) - Reefer Management Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the service requirement was rejected. May cite capacity constraints, regulatory non-compliance, incomplete information, or operational conflicts. Populated only when requirement_status is rejected.

attributes.name: requested_service_date
attributes.description: Target date when the service is required to be performed, typically aligned with vessel ETB (Estimated Time of Berthing) or cargo operation schedule.
attributes.references: Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS) - Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: requested_service_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the service is required to commence, providing hour-level scheduling granularity for operational planning.

attributes.name: requirement_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the service requirement, typically formatted as SR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for external communication and tracking.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Service Request Standards

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service requirement. Tracks progression from initial declaration through approval or rejection.

attributes.name: service_quantity
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of the service required, measured in service-specific units (e.g., number of tugs for towage, number of crane hours for stevedoring, number of containers for reefer monitoring).
attributes.references: Terminal Operating System (TOS) - Resource Planning Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system or channel through which the service requirement was submitted. Supports data lineage tracking and integration troubleshooting. EDI = Electronic Data Interchange, PCS = Port Community System.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing specific operational instructions, safety requirements, or handling procedures that must be followed during service execution. May include temperature settings for reefer cargo, securing requirements for OOG (Out of Gauge) cargo, or IMDG class-specific protocols.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service requirement was formally submitted by the shipping line or cargo owner for processing. Represents the official business event timestamp for requirement intake.

attributes.name: vessel_dwt
attributes.description: Deadweight Tonnage of the vessel, representing total carrying capacity. Used for berth allocation validation and service fee calculation. DWT = Deadweight Tonnage in metric tons.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - Vessel Measurement Standards

attributes.name: vessel_loa
attributes.description: Length Overall of the vessel for which services are being requested. Critical for pilotage and towage resource planning. LOA = Length Overall, measured in meters.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - Vessel Measurement Standards

products.name: anchorage_booking
products.description: Manages booking and reservation of anchorage positions for vessels awaiting berth availability, tidal windows, customs clearance, or performing at-anchor operations (bunkering, STS transfer). Captures vessel identity, requested anchorage area or designated buoy, planned anchor drop and weigh anchor times, reason for anchorage, anchorage status (requested, confirmed, occupied, departed), and VTS coordination reference. Distinct from berth_reservation as anchorage has separate planning rules and capacity constraints. Sourced from VTMS.

attributes.name: anchorage_booking_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the anchorage booking record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: agent_appointment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipping agent or representative who submitted the anchorage booking request on behalf of the vessel owner or operator.

attributes.name: anchorage_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designated anchorage area or zone requested for this booking. Links to anchorage area master data defining capacity and operational constraints.

attributes.name: anchorage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vessel.anchorage. Business justification: Port control matches anchorage bookings (pre-arrival requests) to actual anchorage assignments for dues billing and operational tracking. The booking_anchorage_booking is the request; vessel.anchorage

attributes.name: berth_reservation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated berth reservation if the vessel is anchoring while awaiting berth availability. Links anchorage to the planned berth allocation. Null if no berth reservation exists.

attributes.name: call_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to booking.call_booking. Business justification: An anchorage booking is made for a vessel that is awaiting berth availability as part of a port call. The booking_anchorage_booking should directly reference the originating call_booking to establish

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Anchorage services (VTS monitoring, pilot boat operations, buoy maintenance) incur costs allocated to marine services cost centre for anchorage operations cost tracking and anchorage fee pricing.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Anchorage bookings incur anchorage dues calculated by vessel tonnage and duration at anchorage. Port authorities must link invoices to anchorage bookings for statutory charge calculation, compliance w

attributes.name: isps_facility_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.isps_facility_record. Business justification: Anchorage area assignments require ISPS security level validation and DoS coordination. Anchorage areas are designated port facilities under ISPS Code. Maritime security requirement.

attributes.name: marsec_level_change_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.marsec_level_change. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.participant_account. Business justification: Anchorage bookings are made by vessel agents or shipping lines under their participant_account. Anchorage dues billing and credit utilisation tracking require the account reference. No existing FK to

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.port_community_participant. Business justification: Anchorage bookings are requested by vessel agents who are port_community_participants. ISPS compliance, billing, and PCS workflow require identifying the requesting participant. No existing FK to port

attributes.name: port_dues_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.port_dues_schedule. Business justification: Anchorage bookings incur port dues based on vessel GRT, anchorage duration, and applicable port dues schedule. Real business process: anchorage charge calculation and billing to vessel agent.

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Anchorage charges are a distinct port revenue stream that must be attributed to a profit centre for port authority P&L reporting. Finance teams require profit centre attribution on anchorage bookings

attributes.name: towage_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.towage_tariff. Business justification: Anchorage bookings include tug_assistance_required_flag for vessels requiring tug assistance at anchorage. The towage tariff governs tug charges. booking_berth_reservation links towage_tariff for bert

attributes.name: vessel_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific vessel call or port visit associated with this anchorage booking. Links to the vessel call record.

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel requesting anchorage. Links to the vessel master data.

attributes.name: vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_master. Business justification: vessel_id FK exists to vessel domain, but imo_number also present. FK to vessel_master enables independent vessel specification lookup for anchorage area compatibility, swinging circle calculation, an

attributes.name: weather_tide_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marine.weather_tide_window. Business justification: Anchorage bookings carry weather_restriction_flag and require tidal window coordination. Port VTS and anchorage planners link anchorage bookings to specific weather/tide windows to validate safe ancho

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_zone. Business justification: Anchorage areas are designated security zones with specific MARSEC measures, patrol requirements, and access restrictions. Links booking to zone for security patrol assignment, VTS coordination, and e

attributes.name: actual_anchor_drop_time
attributes.description: Actual recorded date and time when the vessel dropped anchor, as reported by VTS or pilot. Used for billing and performance tracking.

attributes.name: actual_anchorage_duration_hours
attributes.description: Actual duration of anchorage in hours, calculated from actual anchor drop and weigh anchor times. Used for billing and performance analysis.

attributes.name: actual_weigh_anchor_time
attributes.description: Actual recorded date and time when the vessel weighed anchor and departed anchorage, as reported by VTS or pilot. Marks end of anchorage occupancy.

attributes.name: anchorage_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total anchorage fee charged for this booking, calculated based on vessel size, duration, and applicable tariff rates. Excludes additional service charges.

attributes.name: anchorage_charge_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the anchorage charge amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: anchorage_reason_code
attributes.description: Primary reason for the vessel requesting anchorage. Determines operational handling and priority. STS = Ship-to-Ship transfer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: awaiting_berth|tidal_window|customs_clearance|bunkering|sts_transfer|crew_change|repairs|quarantine|weather|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Anchorage Classification

attributes.name: anchorage_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text detailed explanation of the anchorage reason, providing additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: booking_cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the anchorage booking was cancelled, either by the vessel agent or port authority. Null if booking was not cancelled.

attributes.name: booking_confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the anchorage booking was confirmed and allocated by VTS or port operations. Represents formal acceptance of the request.

attributes.name: booking_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique reference number for the anchorage booking, used in communications with vessel agents and VTS. Format: ANC-YYYYMMDD-XXXX.

attributes.name: booking_requested_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the anchorage booking request was initially submitted to the port authority or VTS. Marks the start of the booking lifecycle.

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the anchorage booking. Tracks progression from initial request through confirmation, occupation, and departure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|confirmed|allocated|occupied|departed|cancelled|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: buoy_number
attributes.description: Specific buoy or mooring point assigned within the anchorage area, if applicable. Format varies by port (e.g., A-12, NW-5).

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the anchorage booking was cancelled. Null if booking was not cancelled.

attributes.name: confirmed_anchor_drop_time
attributes.description: VTS-confirmed date and time when the vessel is authorized to drop anchor. May differ from requested time due to capacity or operational constraints.

attributes.name: confirmed_weigh_anchor_time
attributes.description: VTS-confirmed date and time when the vessel is expected or authorized to weigh anchor and depart. Subject to operational adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this anchorage booking record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: hazmat_cargo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is carrying hazardous or dangerous goods as defined by IMDG Code. True if hazmat cargo is present, requiring special anchorage area assignment and safety protocols.

attributes.name: imdg_class_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Class Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IMDG hazard class codes for dangerous goods on board (e.g., 1.1, 3, 5.1). Null if no hazmat cargo. Used for anchorage area segregation and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this anchorage booking record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: pilot_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether pilotage service is required for the vessel to navigate to or from the anchorage area. True if pilot is mandatory per port regulations or vessel characteristics.

attributes.name: planned_anchorage_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated duration of anchorage in hours, calculated from requested anchor drop and weigh anchor times. Used for capacity planning.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for the anchorage request. Emergency and urgent requests receive expedited handling and preferential allocation.

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is under quarantine or health hold, requiring isolation anchorage. True if quarantine is in effect, restricting vessel movement and requiring health authority clearance.
attributes.references: International Health Regulations (IHR) - World Health Organization (WHO)

attributes.name: requested_anchor_drop_time
attributes.description: Vessel agent's requested date and time for the vessel to drop anchor and commence anchorage. Used for capacity planning and VTS coordination.

attributes.name: requested_weigh_anchor_time
attributes.description: Vessel agent's requested date and time for the vessel to weigh anchor and depart anchorage. Used for duration estimation and capacity release planning.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Level
attributes.description: Current ISPS security level applicable to this anchorage booking. Level 1 = normal, Level 2 = heightened, Level 3 = exceptional. Affects anchorage area access and monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system that originated this anchorage booking record. VTMS = Vessel Traffic Management System, PCS = Port Community System, NAVIS = Terminal Operating System, MANUAL = manually entered.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for any special operational instructions, requirements, or notes related to this anchorage booking. Used for coordination between vessel agent, VTS, and port operations.

attributes.name: tug_assistance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether tug (towage) assistance is required for the vessel to safely anchor or depart the anchorage area. True if tugs are needed due to vessel size, weather, or operational constraints.
attributes.references: Marine Pilotage and Towage Services Standards

attributes.name: vts_coordination_reference
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by the Vessel Traffic Service for coordination and tracking of this anchorage event. Links to VTS operational logs.

attributes.name: weather_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the anchorage booking is subject to weather-related restrictions or holds. True if adverse weather conditions (wind, swell, visibility) prevent safe anchoring or departure.

domains.name: compliance
domains.description: Manages customs clearance, trade documentation, regulatory filings, ISPS security compliance, PSC (Port State Control) inspections, HS Code validation, sanctions screening, import/export controls, and EDI messaging (IFTMIN). Covers customs integration via Port Community System and regulatory reporting to WCO, IMO, and national maritime authorities. SSOT for trade compliance and regulatory adherence.

products.name: customs_declaration
products.description: Core transactional record of import/export customs declarations submitted to national customs authorities via the Port Community System (PCS). Captures declaration type (import/export/transit), declarant details, HS codes, cargo description, declared value, duty amounts, VAT, customs regime, declaration status lifecycle (submitted/assessed/cleared/rejected/cancelled), customs reference number, BOL reference, vessel call reference, port of loading (POL), port of discharge (POD), country of origin, country of destination, incoterms, consignee, consignor, freight forwarder, broker license number, submission timestamp, assessment timestamp, clearance timestamp, and WCO message standard version (WCO Data Model 3.x). SSOT for all customs clearance events processed through the port. Supports IMO FAL Form 3 (Cargo Declaration) reporting obligations.
products.reference: WCO Data Model / SAD (Single Administrative Document)

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id

attributes.references: WCO Data Model 3.x - Transport Document Reference

attributes.description: Reference to the vessel call during which this cargo arrived or departed, linking the declaration to the specific vessel visit.

attributes.name: vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_master. Business justification: Customs declarations must reference vessel master data by IMO number for sanctions screening, flag state verification, and compliance history tracking. Enables direct access to vessel ownership, class

attributes.name: cargo_description

attributes.name: charges_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all duty, tax, and charge amounts.

attributes.name: consignor_address

attributes.name: consignor_identifier

attributes.name: consignor_name

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: declarant_identifier

attributes.name: declarant_name

attributes.name: declaration_reference_number

attributes.name: declaration_status

attributes.name: declared_value_amount

attributes.name: duty_amount

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: net_weight_kg

attributes.name: package_count

attributes.name: package_type

attributes.name: port_of_loading

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status

attributes.name: submission_timestamp

attributes.name: total_charges_amount

attributes.name: vat_amount

attributes.name: wco_message_version

products.name: hs_code
products.description: Reference master for Harmonized System (HS) commodity classification codes as maintained by the World Customs Organization (WCO). Captures HS code (6-digit international + national extension), commodity description, chapter, heading, subheading, duty rate, VAT rate, prohibited/restricted flag, IMDG dangerous goods flag, CITES flag, dual-use flag, applicable trade controls, effective date, expiry date, and issuing authority. Used for customs declaration validation, duty calculation, and trade compliance screening across all cargo movements.

attributes.name: hs_code_id
attributes.description: Primary key for hs_code

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: HS codes with duty_rate_percentage and vat_rate_percentage must map to specific GL accounts for automated duty and tax posting in port customs systems. Customs finance controllers use this mapping for

attributes.name: anti_dumping_duty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether anti-dumping duties are applicable to this commodity to protect domestic industry from unfairly priced imports.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Anti-Dumping

attributes.name: chapter
attributes.description: The first two digits of the HS code representing the chapter-level classification (e.g., Chapter 01 = Live Animals, Chapter 84 = Machinery). Highest level of HS hierarchy.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: cites_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is subject to CITES regulations governing international trade in endangered species of wild fauna and flora. True if CITES-controlled, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES)

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Full textual description of the commodity or goods category represented by this HS code. Provides human-readable explanation of what goods fall under this classification.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Nomenclature

attributes.name: commodity_description_short
attributes.description: Abbreviated or short-form description of the commodity for display in space-constrained interfaces and reports.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Nomenclature

attributes.name: countervailing_duty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether countervailing duties are applicable to this commodity to offset foreign government subsidies.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the jurisdiction for which this HS code classification and tariff rates apply (e.g., USA, GBR, SGP, AUS).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this HS code record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dual_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is classified as dual-use goods (items that can be used for both civilian and military purposes), subject to export controls and licensing requirements.
attributes.references: Wassenaar Arrangement on Export Controls for Conventional Arms and Dual-Use Goods and Technologies

attributes.name: duty_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The standard customs duty rate applied to imports of this commodity, expressed as a percentage of the customs value. Used for duty calculation in customs clearance.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Customs Valuation Agreement

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this HS code classification, duty rates, and associated rules become effective and applicable for customs declarations.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: excise_duty_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Additional excise duty rate applicable to specific commodity categories (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, fuel), expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this HS code classification or associated rules cease to be valid. Null if the code is currently active with no planned expiry.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The first four digits of the HS code representing the heading-level classification. Provides intermediate granularity between chapter and subheading.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: The full HS commodity classification code including 6-digit international standard code plus national extension digits (up to 10 digits total). Used for customs declaration, duty calculation, and trade compliance screening.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Nomenclature

attributes.name: hs_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this HS code record. Active = currently in use, Inactive = temporarily disabled, Superseded = replaced by a newer code, Pending = awaiting activation, Deprecated = phased out.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: hs_version
attributes.description: The version year of the WCO Harmonized System nomenclature that this code is based on (e.g., HS2017, HS2022). The HS is updated every 5 years.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: imdg_class
attributes.description: The IMDG hazard class for dangerous goods (e.g., 1 = Explosives, 2.1 = Flammable Gases, 3 = Flammable Liquids, 4.1 = Flammable Solids, 5.1 = Oxidizing Substances, 6.1 = Toxic Substances, 7 = Radioactive Material, 8 = Corrosives, 9 = Miscellaneous). Null if not dangerous goods.

attributes.name: imdg_dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Dangerous Goods Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is classified as dangerous goods under the IMDG Code, requiring special handling, stowage, and documentation in maritime transport.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The national customs authority or regulatory body that issued and maintains this HS code classification and associated tariff rates (e.g., National Customs Authority, Ministry of Trade).

attributes.name: license_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an import or export license is required for this commodity. True if licensing is mandatory, False if no license needed.
attributes.references: National Customs Authority Import/Export Licensing Regulations

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: The type or category of license required for this commodity (e.g., General License, Specific License, Open General License, Strategic Export License). Null if no license required.
attributes.references: National Customs Authority Import/Export Licensing Regulations

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this HS code record was last modified or updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to the classification, duty calculation, or compliance requirements for this HS code.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Explanatory Notes

attributes.name: origin_certificate_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a certificate of origin is required for customs clearance of this commodity to verify the country of manufacture or production.

attributes.name: phytosanitary_certificate_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a phytosanitary certificate is required for plant and plant product commodities to certify they are free from pests and diseases.

attributes.name: preferential_tariff_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is eligible for preferential tariff treatment under free trade agreements or preferential trade arrangements.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Rules of Origin

attributes.name: prohibited_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether import or export of this commodity is prohibited under national or international law. True if prohibited, False if allowed.

attributes.name: quota_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is subject to import or export quotas limiting the quantity that can be traded within a specific period.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Safeguards

attributes.name: restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether import or export of this commodity is subject to restrictions, licensing requirements, or special permits. True if restricted, False if unrestricted.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether shipments of this commodity require sanctions screening against restricted parties, countries, or entities (e.g., OFAC, UN, EU sanctions lists).
attributes.references: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Sanctions Programs

attributes.name: statistical_suffix
attributes.description: Additional national statistical suffix digits appended to the 6-digit HS code for more granular trade statistics and reporting purposes. Length varies by country.

attributes.name: subheading
attributes.description: The first six digits of the HS code representing the internationally standardized subheading-level classification. This is the core 6-digit HS code recognized globally.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: trade_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the applicable free trade agreement or preferential trade arrangement that may provide reduced duty rates for this commodity (e.g., USMCA, CPTPP, EU-FTA).
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Regional Trade Agreements Database

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: The four-digit UN number assigned to dangerous goods for identification in international transport (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Null if not dangerous goods.
attributes.references: United Nations Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The standard unit of measure used for duty calculation and statistical reporting for this commodity (e.g., KGM for kilograms, LTR for liters, MTR for meters, PCE for pieces).

attributes.name: vat_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The applicable VAT or sales tax rate for this commodity category, expressed as a percentage. Used for tax calculation on imported goods.

attributes.name: veterinary_certificate_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a veterinary health certificate is required for animal and animal product commodities to certify they meet health and safety standards.
attributes.references: World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) Terrestrial Animal Health Code

Captures document type, number, issuing party, dates, status lifecycle (draft/submitted/accepted/rejected/expired), vessel call and cargo references, customs declaration linkage, electronic/paper flag, EDI message type, and file reference. SSOT for trade documentation lifecycle managed via Port Community System.

attributes.name: expiry_date

products.name: isps_facility_record

Security alert records capture alert reference, type (security_threat/suspicious_activity/unauthorized_access/cyber_incident/vessel_security_alert), source, severity, affected zone, response actions, escalation chain, and resolution details. products.name: marpol_record
products.description: Comprehensive MARPOL (Marine Pollution Convention) compliance record for vessels and port reception facilities, covering all six MARPOL Annexes and the BWM Convention at full operational granularity. Annex I: oil record book entries and oily bilge water/sludge reception. Annex II: noxious liquid substance cargo residue records. Annex IV: sewage discharge records. Annex V: garbage management plans and garbage record book entries. Annex VI: air emissions (SOx, NOx, PM), EEDI/EEXI compliance, and CII ratings. BWM Convention: ballast water management method (exchange/treatment/retention), treatment system type and IMO type approval number, ballast water volume, source coordinates, exchange/treatment location, discharge details, and compliance status. Port waste reception: waste type, quantity received (m³/MT), reception facility operator, reception timestamp, waste manifest number, disposal method, disposal contractor, disposal certificate reference, and port authority endorsement. Captures vessel IMO number, operation type, quantities, officer signatures, port authority endorsement, compliance status, and associated PSC inspection reference. SSOT for all MARPOL, BWM Convention, and port waste reception compliance documentation at the port.
products.reference: MARPOL 73/78 Annexes I-VI / IMO MEPC Resolutions

attributes.name: follow_up_audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up audit is required to verify implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions. True if follow-up is mandated (typically for major findings or conditional outcomes), False if no follow-up is required.

attributes.name: minor_findings_count

attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about the audit that do not fit in structured fields. May include special circumstances, auditor observations, or follow-up actions.

attributes.description: Number of observations or opportunities for improvement noted during the audit. Observations are not non-conformities but represent areas where processes could be enhanced or best practices could be adopted. No mandatory corrective action required.

attributes.name: overall_audit_outcome
attributes.description: Summary conclusion of the audit.
