attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the accrual amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique business document number assigned to the accrual entry in the financial system. Used for audit trail and reference purposes.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the local currency amount. Nullable if transaction and local currencies are the same.
attributes.references: IAS 21 - Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year to which this accrual is assigned. Typically ranges from 1 to 12 for monthly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this accrual belongs, used for annual financial reporting and budgeting alignment.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified the accrual record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the accrual record was last modified in the source system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The accrual amount converted to the local reporting currency of the company code. Used for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: IAS 21 - Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments providing supplementary information about the accrual entry for audit, review, or operational purposes.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrual entry was posted to the general ledger. Used for period-end closing and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Date Control

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accrual entry indicating whether it is in draft, posted to the general ledger, reversed, or cancelled.

attributes.name: posting_text
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context and explanation for the accrual entry. Used for audit trail and user reference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Text Standards

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason for creating the accrual, such as service rendered but not invoiced, goods received but not invoiced, or period-end matching requirement.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number such as a purchase order, delivery order (D/O), bill of lading (BOL), or service request number that provides business context for the accrual.

attributes.name: reference_key_1
attributes.description: First flexible reference field for capturing additional business identifiers such as vessel visit number, container number, or booking reference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reference Field Standards

attributes.name: reference_key_2
attributes.description: Second flexible reference field for capturing supplementary business identifiers or cross-reference keys.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reference Field Standards

attributes.name: reference_key_3
attributes.description: Third flexible reference field for capturing tertiary business identifiers or cross-reference keys.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reference Field Standards

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrual entry is scheduled to be automatically reversed in the subsequent accounting period. Nullable for accruals that do not require automatic reversal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accrual Reversal Logic

attributes.name: reversal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period in which the accrual is scheduled to be reversed. Used in conjunction with reversal_date for period-end automation.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrual was fully settled or cleared against an actual transaction. Nullable for open accruals.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accrual has been settled against an actual invoice or payment. Used to track the lifecycle from accrual to final settlement.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the accrued amount and the actual invoiced or settled amount. Used for variance analysis and accrual accuracy assessment.

products.name: ap_invoice_clearing
products.description: This association product represents the Invoice Clearing event between ap_payment and ap_invoice in the SAP FI-AP module. It captures the operational act of applying a specific payment (or portion thereof) to a specific invoice, recording the exact amount applied, discount taken, withholding tax, and clearing reference. Each record links one ap_payment to one ap_invoice with attributes that exist only in the context of this clearing relationship — enabling full payment application traceability, partial settlement tracking, and AP reconciliation for port authority vendor obligations.. Existence Justification: In SAP FI-AP, the payment-to-invoice clearing relationship is a well-established operational concept called 'invoice clearing' or 'payment application'. A single payment run can clear multiple invoices (confirmed by ap_payment.invoice_count), and a single invoice can be partially settled across multiple payments (installment payments, partial settlements common in large port CAPEX procurement). This is not an analytical correlation — AP clerks actively create, manage, and reconcile these clearing records as part of the daily payment run process.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_clearing_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ap Invoice Clearing - Ap Invoice Clearing Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the ap_invoice_clearing association

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ap Invoice Clearing - Ap Invoice Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the AP invoice being cleared by the payment

attributes.name: ap_payment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ap Invoice Clearing - Ap Payment Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the AP payment that was applied to clear the invoice

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the payment amount applied to this specific invoice in the clearing event. May be less than the full invoice amount for partial settlements or less than the full payment amount when one payment clears multiple invoices.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this specific invoice-payment pairing was cleared in the SAP FI-AP system. May differ from the payment bank clearing date when invoices are cleared in a subsequent posting step.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The financial document number generated during the clearing process that links the invoice to its payment transaction. [Moved from ap_invoice: clearing_document_number on ap_invoice is the SAP document number for the clearing event. In a multi-payment scenario, an invoice may have multiple clearing documents. This attribute belongs to each individual clearing record in the association, not to the invoice header.]

attributes.name: discount_taken
attributes.description: The early payment discount amount captured at the individual invoice clearing level. Represents the cash discount deducted from this specific invoice as part of this clearing event.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The SAP clearing document reference number that links this specific payment application to the invoice. Used for AP reconciliation and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_applied
attributes.description: The withholding tax amount deducted at source for this specific invoice clearing event. Applicable for vendor payments subject to withholding tax obligations under port authority tax compliance requirements.

domains.name: masterdata
domains.description: Governs enterprise-wide reference and master data including vessel types, container types, cargo classifications, equipment codes, port codes, UN/LOCODE location references, commodity codes, currency tables, unit-of-measure standards (TEU, FEU, CBM, DWT), calendar data, RFID/EDI partner identifiers, and standardized code lists. SSOT for all shared reference data used across operational and business domains.

products.name: vessel_master
products.description: Enterprise master record for every vessel recognised by the port, capturing IMO number (unique 7-digit identifier), vessel name, call sign, MMSI, flag state (FK to country), vessel type (FK to vessel_type), LOA, beam, maximum draft, summer DWT, GRT, NRT, TEU capacity, FEU capacity, year built, classification society code, P&I club, registered owner, commercial operator (FK to shipping_line), and operational status (active, laid-up, scrapped). Includes effectivity dating (valid_from/valid_to) for vessel name changes and ownership transfers. SSOT for vessel identity referenced across vessel operations, marine services, cargo, billing, and compliance domains. Data steward: Marine Operations; updated via Lloyd's List Intelligence feed and vessel pre-arrival notifications.

attributes.name: vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the vessel master record. Primary key for the vessel master entity.

attributes.name: flag_state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.flag_state. Business justification: Vessel master records reference flag state (country of vessel registration). Currently stores flag_state_code as STRING; normalizing to FK allows joining to flag_state for full regulatory compliance d

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Port Of Registry Location Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Vessel master records reference the port of registry (home port) as a location. Currently stores port_of_registry as STRING; normalizing to FK allows joining to port_location for full location data (U

attributes.name: shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.shipping_line. Business justification: Vessel master records reference the shipping line (ocean carrier) that commercially operates the vessel. Currently stores commercial_operator_code as STRING; normalizing to FK allows joining to shippi

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: Vessel master records reference vessel type classification (container ship, bulk carrier, etc.). Currently stores vessel_type_code as STRING; normalizing to FK allows joining to vessel_type for full t

attributes.name: beam_meters
attributes.description: Maximum width of the vessel at its widest point. Used for berth compatibility assessment and safe navigation channel clearance calculations.
attributes.references: International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships

attributes.name: builder_name
attributes.description: Name of the shipyard or shipbuilding company that constructed the vessel. Relevant for technical specifications and spare parts sourcing.

attributes.name: call_sign
attributes.description: International radio call sign assigned to the vessel for maritime communication and identification in Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) operations.

attributes.name: classification_society_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the classification society that certifies the vessel meets structural and mechanical standards (e.g., Lloyd's Register, DNV, ABS). Impacts insurance and port acceptance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vessel master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Business unit or role responsible for maintaining the accuracy and completeness of this vessel master record. Typically Marine Operations department.

attributes.name: engine_type
attributes.description: Type and model of the vessel's main propulsion engine. Used for emissions tracking, fuel consumption estimation, and environmental compliance under MARPOL.

attributes.name: feu_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of forty-foot equivalent containers the vessel can carry. Supplementary capacity metric for container vessel planning.

attributes.name: grt
attributes.description: Total internal volume of the vessel measured in register tons (100 cubic feet). Used for regulatory compliance, port dues calculation, and statistical reporting.
attributes.references: International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships 1969

attributes.name: hull_number
attributes.description: Shipyard construction number assigned during vessel building. Used for tracking vessel lineage and construction specifications.

attributes.name: ice_class
attributes.description: Classification indicating the vessel's capability to operate in ice-covered waters. Relevant for seasonal port access and route planning in northern latitudes.
attributes.references: IACS Unified Requirements for Polar Ships

attributes.name: imo_number
attributes.description: Unique seven-digit ship identification number assigned by the International Maritime Organization. Permanent identifier that remains unchanged through changes of name, ownership, or flag. SSOT for global vessel identity.

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the current active version of the vessel master record. True for the latest version, False for historical versions.

attributes.name: isps_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vessel holds a valid International Ship Security Certificate (ISSC) and complies with ISPS Code requirements. Mandatory for port entry.

attributes.name: issc_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship Security Certificate (ISSC) Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vessel's International Ship Security Certificate. Vessels with expired certificates may be denied port entry or subjected to enhanced Port State Control inspection.

attributes.name: last_psc_inspection_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Port State Control (PSC) Inspection Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent Port State Control inspection. Used for risk assessment and targeting of vessels for inspection under regional PSC memoranda of understanding.
attributes.references: Paris MOU / Tokyo MOU on Port State Control

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this vessel master record. Used for data freshness monitoring and change data capture processing.

attributes.name: lloyds_list_intelligence_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by Lloyd's List Intelligence maritime data service. Used for cross-referencing vessel data with external maritime intelligence feeds.

attributes.name: loa_meters
attributes.description: Maximum length of the vessel measured from the foremost point of the bow to the aftermost point of the stern. Critical dimension for berth allocation and port infrastructure planning.
attributes.references: International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships

attributes.name: marpol_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vessel complies with MARPOL convention requirements for prevention of pollution from ships (oil, chemicals, sewage, garbage, air emissions).

attributes.name: maximum_draft_meters
attributes.description: Maximum vertical distance between the waterline and the bottom of the hull (keel). Determines minimum water depth requirements for safe berthing and navigation.

attributes.name: mmsi
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier used in the Automatic Identification System (AIS) and Digital Selective Calling (DSC) for vessel tracking and communication.

attributes.name: nrt
attributes.description: Volume of cargo-carrying spaces measured in register tons. Represents earning capacity and is used for port tariff and canal dues calculation.
attributes.references: International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships 1969

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the vessel. Active vessels are in service; laid-up vessels are temporarily out of service; scrapped vessels are decommissioned; under construction vessels are not yet delivered; detained vessels are held by authorities.

attributes.name: pi_club_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Protection and Indemnity insurance club providing third-party liability coverage for the vessel. Required for port entry and cargo operations.

attributes.name: propulsion_power_kw
attributes.description: Maximum continuous rated power output of the main propulsion engine in kilowatts. Used for environmental reporting and vessel performance assessment.

attributes.name: psc_deficiency_count
attributes.description: Total number of deficiencies identified during the last PSC inspection. High deficiency counts indicate elevated risk and may trigger enhanced inspection or detention.
attributes.references: Paris MOU / Tokyo MOU on Port State Control

attributes.name: registered_owner
attributes.description: Legal entity name of the registered owner as recorded in the ship registry. May differ from commercial operator. Subject to change through ownership transfers tracked via effectivity dating.
attributes.references: United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS)

attributes.name: solas_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vessel meets SOLAS convention requirements for construction, equipment, and operation. Fundamental requirement for international maritime operations.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system or external feed that provided this vessel master data (e.g., Lloyd's List Intelligence, NAVIS N4, Vessel Traffic Management System, manual entry via Port Community System).

attributes.name: summer_dwt
attributes.description: Maximum weight in metric tons that the vessel can safely carry (cargo, fuel, water, stores, crew) when loaded to the summer load line. Key metric for cargo capacity and port tariff calculation.

attributes.name: teu_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of twenty-foot equivalent containers the vessel can carry. Primary capacity metric for container vessels used in terminal planning and vessel scheduling.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date for this version of the vessel master record. Supports Type 2 slowly changing dimension tracking for vessel name changes, ownership transfers, and flag changes.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Effective end date for this version of the vessel master record. Null indicates the current active record. Supports historical analysis and audit trail for vessel attribute changes.

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: Current registered name of the vessel as recorded in the ship registry. Subject to change through vessel name amendments tracked via effectivity dating.
attributes.references: International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships

attributes.name: year_built
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the vessel was constructed and delivered. Used for age-based risk assessment, insurance classification, and Port State Control (PSC) targeting.

products.name: vessel_type
products.description: Reference classification of vessel types recognised in maritime logistics — container ship, bulk carrier, tanker (crude/product/chemical), RoRo, LoLo, general cargo, passenger/cruise, tug, barge, FPSO, LNG/LPG carrier, car carrier, and livestock carrier. Captures IMO vessel type code, NAVIS vessel category code, typical DWT range, typical LOA range, beam range, applicable SOLAS chapter references, berth compatibility flags, and effectivity dates (valid_from/valid_to) for classification changes. Data steward: Marine Operations. SSOT for vessel type classification used to drive berth compatibility rules, tariff schedules, equipment assignment logic, and VTS categorisation.

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vessel_type

attributes.name: berth_compatibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vessel type has specific berth compatibility requirements that must be validated during berth allocation.

attributes.name: cargo_handling_method
attributes.description: Primary cargo handling method associated with this vessel type: Lift-on Lift-off (LoLo), Roll-on Roll-off (RoRo), bulk discharge, liquid pumping, or mixed methods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vessel type classification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether vessels of this type are certified and equipped to carry dangerous goods as defined by IMDG Code.

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business unit or individual responsible for maintaining the accuracy and currency of this vessel type classification record. Typically Marine Operations.

attributes.name: environmental_category
attributes.description: Environmental classification of vessel type based on typical emissions profile and environmental impact. Used for GHG reporting and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: IMO GHG Strategy and MARPOL Annex VI

attributes.name: imo_vessel_type_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Vessel Type Code
attributes.description: Two-digit IMO standard vessel type code as defined by the International Maritime Organization for global vessel classification.

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Security Level
attributes.description: Default ISPS security level applicable to vessels of this type: Level 1 (normal), Level 2 (heightened), Level 3 (exceptional), or not applicable.
attributes.references: ISPS Code (International Ship and Port Facility Security)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vessel type classification record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: marpol_annex_reference
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of applicable MARPOL annex references for this vessel type (e.g., Annex I - Oil, Annex II - Noxious Liquid Substances).

attributes.name: mobile_crane_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether vessels of this type are compatible with mobile harbour cranes (MHC) for cargo handling operations.

attributes.name: navis_vessel_category_code
attributes.description: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System vessel category code used for vessel planning, berth allocation, and operational scheduling.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Vessel Planning Module

attributes.name: priority_ranking
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for berth allocation and scheduling when multiple vessels compete for limited berth capacity. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: requires_pilotage
attributes.description: Indicates whether vessels of this type typically require marine pilotage services for port entry and berthing operations.

attributes.name: requires_towage
attributes.description: Indicates whether vessels of this type typically require towage (tug) services for berthing and unberthing operations.

attributes.name: solas_chapter_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Chapter Reference
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of applicable SOLAS chapter references for this vessel type (e.g., Chapter II-1, Chapter II-2, Chapter V).
attributes.references: SOLAS Convention (Safety of Life at Sea)

attributes.name: sts_crane_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether vessels of this type are compatible with ship-to-shore (STS) quay cranes for container handling operations.

attributes.name: tariff_category_code
attributes.description: Tariff category code used to determine applicable port charges, wharfage, and terminal handling charges (THC) for this vessel type.

attributes.name: typical_beam_max_m
attributes.description: Maximum typical beam (width) in meters for vessels of this type. Used for berth width compatibility assessment.

attributes.name: typical_beam_min_m
attributes.description: Minimum typical beam (width) in meters for vessels of this type. Used for berth width compatibility assessment.

attributes.name: typical_draft_max_m
attributes.description: Maximum typical draft (depth below waterline) in meters for vessels of this type. Critical for channel and berth depth compatibility.

attributes.name: typical_draft_min_m
attributes.description: Minimum typical draft (depth below waterline) in meters for vessels of this type. Critical for channel and berth depth compatibility.

attributes.name: typical_dwt_max
attributes.description: Maximum typical deadweight tonnage (DWT) in metric tons for vessels of this type. Used for berth compatibility and tariff calculation.

attributes.name: typical_dwt_min
attributes.description: Minimum typical deadweight tonnage (DWT) in metric tons for vessels of this type. Used for berth compatibility and tariff calculation.

attributes.name: typical_grt_max
attributes.description: Maximum typical gross registered tonnage (GRT) for vessels of this type. Used for regulatory reporting and tariff calculations.

attributes.name: typical_grt_min
attributes.description: Minimum typical gross registered tonnage (GRT) for vessels of this type. Used for regulatory reporting and tariff calculations.

attributes.name: typical_loa_max_m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Typical Length Overall (LOA) Maximum in Meters
attributes.description: Maximum typical length overall (LOA) in meters for vessels of this type. Critical for berth allocation and planning.

attributes.name: typical_loa_min_m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Typical Length Overall (LOA) Minimum in Meters
attributes.description: Minimum typical length overall (LOA) in meters for vessels of this type. Critical for berth allocation and planning.

attributes.name: typical_teu_capacity_max
attributes.business_glossary_term: Typical Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU) Capacity Maximum
attributes.description: Maximum typical container capacity in TEU for container vessel types. Null for non-container vessel types.

attributes.name: typical_teu_capacity_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Typical Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU) Capacity Minimum
attributes.description: Minimum typical container capacity in TEU for container vessel types. Null for non-container vessel types.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date from which this vessel type classification is valid and available for operational use. Supports temporal versioning of classification changes.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Effective end date after which this vessel type classification is no longer valid. Null indicates the classification is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: vessel_category
attributes.description: High-level categorical grouping of vessel types for operational and analytical purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: container|bulk|tanker|roro|lolo|general_cargo|passenger|tug|barge|specialized — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vessel_type_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the vessel type classification. Used as business key across operational systems.

attributes.name: vessel_type_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the vessel type classification, including operational characteristics, typical cargo types, and special handling requirements.

attributes.name: vessel_type_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the vessel type classification (e.g., Container Ship, Bulk Carrier, Tanker, RoRo, LoLo, General Cargo, Passenger/Cruise, Tug, Barge).

attributes.name: vessel_type_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vessel type classification record. Active types are available for operational use; deprecated types are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: vts_tracking_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) Tracking Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vessels of this type are required to be tracked by the Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) system during port operations.

products.name: container_type
products.description: Reference master for all ISO 6346 container types handled at the terminal — 20GP, 40GP, 40HC, 45HC, 20RF, 40RF, 20OT, 40OT, 20FR, 40FR, 20TK (tank), flat rack collapsible, platform, and special-purpose units. Captures ISO type code (4-character), size code (TEU/FEU), height category (standard/high-cube/super-high-cube), tare weight, maximum gross weight, internal cubic capacity (CBM), SWL, temperature range (for reefers), ventilation settings, special handling flags (IMDG, OOG, hazardous), and effectivity dates for ISO standard revisions. Data steward: Terminal Operations. SSOT for container type classification used by NAVIS N4 TOS, cargo manifests, yard planning, and tariff domains.

attributes.name: container_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for container_type

attributes.name: handling_equipment_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.equipment_type. Business justification: container_type.handling_equipment_type is a STRING field that denotes the primary equipment type used to handle this container type (e.g., STS crane for 20GP/40GP, RTG for yard moves). Normalizing thi

attributes.name: container_category
attributes.description: Primary functional category of the container: 'general-purpose' (dry cargo), 'reefer' (refrigerated), 'open-top', 'flat-rack', 'tank', 'platform', or 'special' (non-standard). Determines handling requirements and yard allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: general-purpose|reefer|open-top|flat-rack|tank|platform|special — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: container_type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the container type (e.g., '20ft General Purpose', '40ft High Cube Reefer', '20ft Open Top', '40ft Flat Rack Collapsible').

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this container type master record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Business unit or role responsible for maintaining the accuracy and currency of this container type master record. Typically 'Terminal Operations' or 'Master Data Management'.

attributes.name: door_configuration
attributes.description: Door access configuration: 'end-door' (standard rear doors), 'side-door' (side access), 'open-top' (top loading), or 'no-door' (platform/flat-rack). Determines loading/unloading procedures.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this container type definition became effective and available for operations. Used for temporal validity and historical tracking.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this container type definition is valid. Null for currently active types. Used for phasing out obsolete container types and maintaining historical accuracy.

attributes.name: height_category
attributes.description: Height classification of the container: 'standard' (8ft 6in), 'high-cube' (9ft 6in), or 'super-high-cube' (10ft or greater). Determines stacking and stowage constraints.

attributes.name: height_mm
attributes.description: External height of the container in millimeters. Standard containers are typically 2591mm, high-cube containers are 2896mm.

attributes.name: internal_capacity_cbm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Cubic Capacity in Cubic Meters (CBM)
attributes.description: Internal volume capacity of the container in cubic meters. Used for cargo volume planning and Less than Container Load (LCL) consolidation.

attributes.name: is_collapsible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the container can be collapsed or folded for empty repositioning to save space. Common for flat-rack collapsible types.

attributes.name: is_hazmat_approved
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this container type is approved for carrying hazardous materials under IMDG Code. True if IMDG-certified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_oog_capable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Out of Gauge (OOG) Capable Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this container type can accommodate out-of-gauge (oversized) cargo. True for open-top, flat-rack, and platform types; False for standard enclosed containers.

attributes.name: is_reefer
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a refrigerated (reefer) container requiring temperature control and power supply. True for reefer types, False otherwise.

attributes.name: iso_standard_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) Standard Version
attributes.description: Version or revision year of the ISO 6346 standard under which this container type is classified (e.g., 'ISO 6346:1995', 'ISO 6346:2022'). Tracks standard evolution and compliance.

attributes.name: iso_type_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 6346 Type Code
attributes.description: Four-character ISO 6346 container type code identifying the container category and characteristics (e.g., 22G1 for 20ft general purpose, 45R1 for 40ft high-cube reefer). This is the globally recognized standard identifier for container types.
attributes.references: ISO 6346 - Freight containers - Coding, identification and marking

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this container type master record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: length_mm
attributes.description: External length of the container in millimeters. 20ft containers are 6058mm, 40ft containers are 12192mm, 45ft containers are 13716mm.

attributes.name: max_gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum permissible gross weight (container + cargo) in kilograms as per ISO 6346 and SOLAS VGM requirements. Typically 30,480 kg for standard containers.
attributes.references: ISO 6346, SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) Convention - Verified Gross Mass (VGM)

attributes.name: max_payload_kg
attributes.description: Maximum cargo weight capacity in kilograms, calculated as max_gross_weight minus tare_weight. Used for cargo booking and load planning.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this container type in the terminal system: 'active' (in use), 'inactive' (not currently handled), 'deprecated' (phased out), or 'restricted' (limited use). Controls availability in booking and yard systems.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Container Type Master

attributes.name: reefer_temp_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum operating temperature in Celsius for refrigerated containers. Typically ranges from +25°C to +30°C for chilled cargo. Null for non-reefer types.

attributes.name: reefer_temp_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum operating temperature in Celsius for refrigerated containers. Typically ranges from -35°C to -25°C for frozen cargo. Null for non-reefer types.

attributes.name: size_code
attributes.description: Nominal length of the container in feet. Standard values are 20, 40, and 45 feet.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling, stowage, or operational instructions specific to this container type (e.g., 'Requires twist locks', 'Must be stowed on deck only', 'Power supply mandatory').

attributes.name: stacking_strength_tier
attributes.description: Structural stacking tier rating indicating how many containers can be safely stacked on top of this type. Typically 1-9 for standard containers, lower for specialized types. Used for yard planning and vessel stowage.
attributes.references: ISO 1496 - Series 1 freight containers - Specification and testing

attributes.name: swl_kg
attributes.description: Safe Working Load for lifting operations in kilograms. Maximum load that can be safely lifted by crane or handling equipment. Critical for terminal operations safety.
attributes.references: ISO 3874 - Series 1 freight containers - Handling and securing

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: Empty weight of the container in kilograms, excluding cargo. Used for gross weight calculations and vessel stability planning.

attributes.name: tariff_class_code
attributes.description: Tariff classification code used for billing and Terminal Handling Charge (THC) calculation. Links this container type to the port's tariff schedule for pricing.
attributes.references: Port Tariff Schedule, NAVIS N4 Billing Module

attributes.name: teu_equivalent
attributes.description: The TEU equivalent value for this container type. A 20ft container = 1.0 TEU, a 40ft container = 2.0 TEU, a 45ft container = 2.25 TEU. Used for capacity planning and vessel stowage calculations.

attributes.name: ventilation_setting
attributes.description: Ventilation capability of the container: 'none' (sealed), 'passive' (natural vents), 'active' (forced air), or 'controlled-atmosphere' (CA for perishables). Relevant for reefers and ventilated containers.

attributes.name: width_mm
attributes.description: External width of the container in millimeters. Standard ISO containers are 2438mm wide.

attributes.name: yard_block_preference
attributes.description: Preferred yard block or zone designation for storing this container type (e.g., 'REEFER-01' for reefers near power outlets, 'HAZMAT-A' for dangerous goods, 'GENERAL-B' for standard dry containers). Guides automated yard planning.

products.name: port_location
products.description: Enterprise reference for all port locations and sub-locations within the port's jurisdiction — berths (numbered), quay sections, anchorage areas (inner/outer), pilot boarding grounds, container yard blocks (CY), CFS sheds, gate lanes, rail sidings, bunkering points, and ICD linkage points. Captures UN/LOCODE (FK to un_locode), internal location code, location type hierarchy (zone > area > point), geographic coordinates (WGS84 lat/long), water depth (CD), maximum vessel LOA, maximum beam, maximum DWT, bollard spacing, shore crane coverage, fender type, and operational status (active/under-maintenance/decommissioned). Includes effectivity dates for location commissioning and decommissioning. Data steward: Infrastructure / Marine Operations. SSOT for physical location identity referenced across terminal, vessel, infrastructure, and intermodal domains.
products.reference: UN/LOCODE — United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the port location record. Primary key for the port_location entity.

attributes.name: un_locode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.un_locode. Business justification: Port locations reference UN/LOCODE global location codes for international trade and EDI messaging. Currently stores un_locode as STRING; normalizing to FK allows joining to un_locode for full locatio

attributes.name: bollard_spacing_meters
attributes.description: Distance in meters between mooring bollards along the berth or quay. Critical for vessel mooring planning and safe berthing operations. Applicable to berth and quay locations.
attributes.references: PIANC Mooring Equipment Guidelines; BS 6349 Maritime Structures

attributes.name: bollard_swl_tonnes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bollard Safe Working Load (SWL) in Tonnes
attributes.description: Safe Working Load (SWL) of mooring bollards at this location, measured in metric tonnes. Defines the maximum safe mooring line tension. Applicable to berth and quay locations.
attributes.references: PIANC Mooring Equipment Guidelines; ISO 3913 Shipbuilding Bollards

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the location was officially commissioned and became operational. Marks the start of the location's active lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: AVEVA Marine Engineering Project Lifecycle; Asset Management Standards

attributes.name: container_yard_capacity_teu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Container Yard Capacity in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU)
attributes.description: Total container storage capacity of the yard location measured in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU). Applicable to Container Yard (CY) and container stacking locations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 Container Classification; NAVIS N4 Yard Capacity Planning

attributes.name: crane_type
attributes.description: Type of cargo handling crane equipment serving this location. STS = Ship-to-Shore, QC = Quay Crane, MHC = Mobile Harbour Crane, RTG = Rubber Tyred Gantry, ASC = Automated Stacking Crane. 'none' if no crane coverage.
attributes.references: ISO 9374 Cargo Handling Equipment Classification; NAVIS N4 Equipment Master

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this location record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format; Data Governance Audit Standards

attributes.name: customs_zone_code
attributes.description: Customs authority zone code applicable to this location. Defines the customs jurisdiction and regulatory requirements for cargo handling. Used for customs clearance and trade compliance.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System; Port Community System (PCS) Customs Integration

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Business unit or role responsible for maintaining the accuracy and completeness of this location record. Typically Infrastructure Planning, Marine Operations, or Terminal Operations department.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework; Master Data Management (MDM) Standards

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the location was officially decommissioned and retired from operational service. Nullable for active locations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: AVEVA Marine Engineering Project Lifecycle; Asset Management Standards

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this location record is effective and valid for operational use. Supports temporal validity and historical tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Temporal Data Management Standards; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this location record is effective and valid for operational use. Nullable for currently effective records. Supports temporal validity and historical tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Temporal Data Management Standards; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: environmental_zone
attributes.description: Environmental monitoring zone classification for this location. Used for tracking air quality, water quality, noise levels, and emissions per Environmental Management System (EMS) requirements. Links to environmental monitoring stations.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; MARPOL Annex VI Emission Control; Environmental Monitoring System (EMS)

attributes.name: fender_energy_absorption_kj
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fender Energy Absorption Capacity in Kilojoules (kJ)
attributes.description: Maximum energy absorption capacity of the fender system in kilojoules (kJ). Defines the berthing impact energy the fender can safely absorb. Applicable to berth and quay locations with fender systems.
attributes.references: PIANC Fender Design Guidelines; ISO 17357 Floating Fenders

attributes.name: fender_type
attributes.description: Type of fender system installed at the berth or quay for vessel impact absorption. Applicable to berth and quay locations. 'none' if no fender system present. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pneumatic|foam_filled|cylindrical|cone|cell|arch|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PIANC Fender Design Guidelines; BS 6349 Maritime Structures

attributes.name: gate_lane_type
attributes.description: Operational direction and function of the gate lane. Defines whether the lane handles inbound traffic, outbound traffic, bidirectional flow, or inspection/customs processing. Applicable to gate lane locations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Gate Operations Module; ISPS Code Port Facility Security

attributes.name: icd_linkage_code
attributes.description: Reference code linking this port location to an associated Inland Container Depot (ICD) for intermodal container transfer. Applicable to ICD linkage point locations. Nullable for locations without ICD connectivity.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE ICD Classification; Intermodal Transport Standards

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Security Level
attributes.description: Current ISPS Code security level assigned to this location. Level 1 = normal security measures; Level 2 = heightened security measures; Level 3 = exceptional security measures. Defines access control and security protocols.
attributes.references: ISPS Code (International Ship and Port Facility Security Code); SOLAS Chapter XI-2

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this location record was last modified in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format; Data Governance Audit Standards

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the location in decimal degrees using WGS84 datum. Positive values represent North, negative values represent South. Used for vessel navigation, pilotage planning, and GIS integration.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geographic Coordinate System; International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) S-57 Standard

attributes.name: location_area
attributes.description: Mid-level area classification within a zone (e.g., 'Berth Complex A', 'Yard Section 3', 'Anchorage Inner'). Second level of the zone > area > point hierarchy.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the location within the port's operational systems. Used across Terminal Operating System (TOS), Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS), and Port Community System (PCS) for location referencing.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Location Master; ISO 6346 Container Identification

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the port location (e.g., 'Berth 12 North', 'Container Yard Block A3', 'Anchorage Zone Outer', 'Pilot Boarding Ground Alpha').

attributes.name: location_point
attributes.description: Specific point identifier within an area (e.g., 'Bollard 12A', 'Stack Row 5', 'Gate Lane 3'). Lowest level of the zone > area > point hierarchy.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the location type within the port infrastructure hierarchy. Defines the operational function and handling capabilities of the location. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: berth|quay|anchorage|pilot_boarding_ground|container_yard|cfs_shed|gate_lane|rail_siding|bunkering_point|icd_linkage|warehouse|maintenance_area — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PIANC Port Infrastructure Classification; NAVIS N4 Location Type Taxonomy

attributes.name: location_zone
attributes.description: High-level zone classification within the port (e.g., 'North Terminal', 'South Basin', 'Container Terminal 1'). Top level of the zone > area > point hierarchy.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the location in decimal degrees using WGS84 datum. Positive values represent East, negative values represent West. Used for vessel navigation, pilotage planning, and GIS integration.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geographic Coordinate System; International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) S-57 Standard

attributes.name: maximum_vessel_beam_meters
attributes.description: Maximum permissible vessel beam (width) in meters that can be accommodated at this location. Constraint based on berth width, fender spacing, and approach channel dimensions.
attributes.references: PIANC Berth Design Guidelines; IMO Ship Dimensions Standards

attributes.name: maximum_vessel_dwt_tonnes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Vessel Deadweight Tonnage (DWT) in Tonnes
attributes.description: Maximum permissible vessel Deadweight Tonnage (DWT) in metric tonnes that can be accommodated at this location. Constraint based on water depth, berth structural capacity, and mooring equipment Safe Working Load (SWL).
attributes.references: IMO Tonnage Measurement Standards; PIANC Berth Design Guidelines

attributes.name: maximum_vessel_loa_meters
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Vessel Length Overall (LOA) in Meters
attributes.description: Maximum permissible vessel Length Overall (LOA) in meters that can be accommodated at this location. Constraint based on berth length, maneuvering space, and infrastructure design.
attributes.references: PIANC Berth Design Guidelines; IMO Ship Dimensions Standards

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the port location. Active = fully operational and available for use; Under Maintenance = temporarily unavailable due to maintenance or repair; Decommissioned = permanently retired from service; Planned = future location not yet commissioned; Suspended = temporarily out of service for operational reasons.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Location Status Management; Port Management Information System (PMIS)

attributes.name: rail_siding_capacity_teu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rail Siding Capacity in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU)
attributes.description: Container handling capacity of the rail siding measured in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU). Defines the maximum number of containers that can be loaded/unloaded per rail operation. Applicable to rail siding locations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 Container Classification; NAVIS N4 Rail Operations Module

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, restrictions, special handling requirements, or other relevant information about the location. Used for operational guidance and exception documentation.
attributes.references: Port Management Information System (PMIS) Documentation Standards

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this location is equipped with Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology for automated container and vehicle tracking. True if RFID-enabled, False otherwise.
attributes.references: ISO 18185 RFID for Freight Containers; NAVIS N4 Gate Automation

attributes.name: shore_crane_coverage
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this location is covered by shore-based cargo handling cranes (Ship-to-Shore (STS), Quay Crane (QC), or Mobile Harbour Crane (MHC)). True if crane coverage exists, False otherwise.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Equipment Assignment; Terminal Operating System (TOS) Standards

attributes.name: water_depth_meters
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Depth at Chart Datum (CD) in Meters
attributes.description: Water depth at the location measured in meters below Chart Datum (CD). Critical for determining vessel draft limitations and safe navigation. Applicable to berths, anchorages, and waterside locations.
attributes.references: International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) Chart Datum Standards; SOLAS Chapter V

attributes.name: yard_block_bays
attributes.description: Number of container stacking bays in the yard block. Defines the longitudinal layout dimension of the container yard. Applicable to Container Yard (CY) locations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Yard Configuration; Terminal Operating System (TOS) Standards

attributes.name: yard_block_rows
attributes.description: Number of container stacking rows in the yard block. Defines the horizontal layout dimension of the container yard. Applicable to Container Yard (CY) locations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Yard Configuration; Terminal Operating System (TOS) Standards

attributes.name: yard_block_tiers
attributes.description: Maximum number of container stacking tiers (vertical height) in the yard block. Defines the vertical stacking capacity. Applicable to Container Yard (CY) locations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Yard Configuration; Terminal Operating System (TOS) Standards

products.name: un_locode
products.description: Global reference table of UN/LOCODE location codes covering ports, inland freight terminals, airports, and border crossings worldwide. Captures LOCODE (5-character), country reference (FK to country), location name, subdivision code, function codes (port, rail, road, airport, ICD), coordinates (WGS84), IAPH membership flag, and UNECE update cycle reference with effectivity dates. Data steward: Marine Operations / Trade Compliance. Used as the global location standard for BOL origin/destination, cargo routing, customs declarations, and EDI messaging across all domains.

attributes.name: un_locode_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the UN/LOCODE location record. Primary key for the global location reference table.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: UN/LOCODE location codes reference the country in which the location resides. Currently stores country_code as STRING (ISO alpha-2); normalizing to FK allows joining to country for full country data (

attributes.name: coordinate_precision
attributes.description: Indicator of the precision level of the latitude and longitude coordinates. Exact=surveyed or GPS-verified coordinates; Approximate=estimated from regional data; Unknown=coordinates not verified.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this record was first created in the enterprise data lakehouse. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: date_added
attributes.description: Date when the location code was first added to the UN/LOCODE directory. Used for data lineage and historical tracking.

attributes.name: date_last_modified
attributes.description: Date when the location code record was last updated in the UN/LOCODE directory. Reflects changes to location name, function codes, coordinates, or status.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this UN/LOCODE record is valid and should be used in operational systems, EDI messaging, and trade documentation. Supports temporal validity for location code changes.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this UN/LOCODE record is valid. Null indicates the record is currently active. Used for managing deprecated or superseded location codes.

attributes.name: function_code
attributes.description: Eight-character function classifier indicating the transport modes and facilities available at the location. Position 1: Port (1=yes); Position 2: Rail terminal (2=yes); Position 3: Road terminal (3=yes); Position 4: Airport (4=yes); Position 5: Postal exchange office (5=yes); Position 6: Inland Container Depot (ICD) or Container Freight Station (CFS) (6=yes); Position 7: Fixed transport functions (7=yes); Position 8: Border crossing (B=yes). Hyphen (-) indicates function not available.

attributes.name: iata_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport or city code if the location is an airport or has an associated IATA code. Used for air cargo routing and Air Waybill (AWB) documentation.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the location code is currently active and should be used in operational systems. Inactive codes are retained for historical reference and audit purposes.

attributes.name: is_airport
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the location functions as an airport with cargo handling facilities. Derived from function_code position 4. Used for Air Waybill (AWB) routing and multimodal logistics.

attributes.name: is_border_crossing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the location serves as an international border crossing point. Derived from function_code position 8. Used for customs declarations, trade compliance, and cross-border cargo tracking.

attributes.name: is_fixed_transport_function
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the location has fixed transport infrastructure functions (e.g., pipelines, cable transport). Derived from function_code position 7.

attributes.name: is_iaph_member
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Member Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the port is a member of the International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH). IAPH membership signals adherence to international port standards, best practices, and participation in global maritime policy development.

attributes.name: is_inland_container_depot
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the location operates as an Inland Container Depot (ICD) or Container Freight Station (CFS). Derived from function_code position 6. Critical for Full Container Load (FCL) and Less than Container Load (LCL) cargo routing and customs clearance.

attributes.name: is_port
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the location functions as a seaport or maritime terminal. Derived from function_code position 1. Used for vessel traffic management, berth allocation, and marine services routing.

attributes.name: is_postal_exchange
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the location serves as a postal exchange office. Derived from function_code position 5.

attributes.name: is_rail_terminal
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the location has rail freight terminal facilities. Derived from function_code position 2. Used for intermodal transport coordination and rail operations planning.

attributes.name: is_road_terminal
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the location has road freight terminal facilities. Derived from function_code position 3. Used for truck gate operations and yard management.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this record was last modified in the enterprise data lakehouse. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Positive values represent North, negative values represent South. Used for vessel tracking, route optimization, and geographic information systems.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Official name of the port, inland container depot, airport, or border crossing as registered with UNECE. This is the human-readable identifier used in shipping documentation, vessel schedules, and port community systems.

attributes.name: location_name_without_diacritics
attributes.description: ASCII-normalized version of the location name with diacritical marks removed for system compatibility and EDI messaging where special characters are not supported.

attributes.name: locode
attributes.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE identifier consisting of two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code followed by three-character location code. This is the globally recognized standard identifier for ports, inland freight terminals, airports, and border crossings used in Bill of Lading (BOL), cargo manifests, customs declarations, and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) messaging.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations (UNECE Recommendation 16)

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Positive values represent East, negative values represent West. Used for vessel tracking, route optimization, and geographic information systems.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to the location code. May include alternative names, historical context, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: status_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE status indicator. AA=Approved by competent national government agency; AC=Approved by Customs Authority; AF=Approved by national facilitation body; AI=Code adopted by international organization (IATA or ECLAC); AM=Approved by the UN/LOCODE Maintenance Agency; AQ=Entry approved, functions not verified; AS=Approved by national standardization body; RL=Recognized location (not officially approved); RN=Request from credible national sources; RQ=Request under consideration; RR=Request rejected; UR=Entry included on user request; XX=Entry that will be removed in the next issue. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AA|AC|AF|AI|AM|AQ|AS|RL|RN|RQ|RR|UR|XX — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: subdivision_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code identifying the state, province, or administrative region within the country. Used for regional trade statistics and domestic routing.

attributes.name: unece_update_cycle
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE) Update Cycle
attributes.description: Identifier of the UNECE publication cycle in which this location code was added or last modified, formatted as YYYY-N where YYYY is the year and N is the half-year cycle (1 or 2). Used for version control and data stewardship.

products.name: commodity_code
products.description: Reference master for Harmonized System (HS) commodity codes, port-specific cargo classification codes, and cargo category hierarchy (FCL, LCL, bulk dry, bulk liquid, breakbulk, RoRo, project cargo, OOG, reefer, IMDG, empty). Captures HS code (6-digit international, 8/10-digit national extension), commodity description, chapter, heading, subheading, cargo category code, handling method, applicable equipment types, storage area type, IMDG class reference (FK to imdg_class), MARPOL category, applicable WCO controls, import/export licensing requirements, prohibited goods flag, and effectivity dates (valid_from/valid_to) for HS code revision cycles. Data steward: Trade Compliance. SSOT for cargo classification used in customs clearance, trade compliance, tariff calculation, and IMDG dangerous goods management.

attributes.name: commodity_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commodity code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cargo_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cargo_category. Business justification: Commodity codes (HS codes) are classified into cargo categories (FCL, LCL, breakbulk, etc.) for handling and storage purposes. Currently stores cargo_category_code as STRING; normalizing to FK allows

attributes.name: imdg_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.imdg_class. Business justification: Commodity codes for dangerous goods reference IMDG hazard classifications. Currently stores imdg_class_code as STRING; normalizing to FK allows joining to imdg_class for full hazard data (division, ha

attributes.name: applicable_equipment_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of container or equipment type codes suitable for this commodity (e.g., 20GP, 40HC, 40RF, TANK, FLAT). References standard ISO container type codes and port-specific equipment classifications.

attributes.name: commodity_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the commodity code record: ACTIVE (in use), INACTIVE (not in use), DEPRECATED (superseded by newer code), PENDING_APPROVAL (awaiting data steward approval).

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the commodity or cargo type as defined by the HS code and port-specific classification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity code record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the data steward responsible for maintaining this commodity code record. Typically Trade Compliance team.

attributes.name: ems_number
attributes.description: IMDG Emergency Schedule number providing fire-fighting and spillage procedures for dangerous goods (format: F-X,S-Y). Null if not dangerous goods.

attributes.name: excepted_quantity
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity qualifies for excepted quantity exemptions under IMDG Code (True/False).

attributes.name: export_license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an export license or permit is required for this commodity when leaving the port jurisdiction (True/False).

attributes.name: flash_point_celsius
attributes.description: Flash point temperature in Celsius for flammable commodities. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: fumigation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity requires fumigation treatment before or after discharge (True/False).

attributes.name: handling_method
attributes.description: Standard handling method required for this commodity type: LOLO (Lift-on Lift-off), RORO (Roll-on Roll-off), BULK_PUMP (bulk liquid pumping), BULK_GRAB (bulk dry grab), CRANE (crane handling), FORKLIFT (forklift handling), MANUAL (manual handling), AUTOMATED (automated handling). attributes.name: hs_chapter
attributes.description: Two-digit chapter code representing the highest level of HS classification hierarchy (e.g., Chapter 01 = Live Animals).

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: International commodity classification code under the Harmonized System. 6-digit international standard, with optional 8 or 10-digit national extensions for detailed classification.

attributes.name: hs_heading
attributes.description: Four-digit heading code representing the second level of HS classification hierarchy within a chapter.

attributes.name: hs_revision_year
attributes.description: Year of the HS nomenclature revision that this code belongs to (e.g., 2017, 2022). WCO updates HS codes approximately every 5 years.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) HS Code Revision Cycle

attributes.name: hs_subheading
attributes.description: Six-digit subheading code representing the third level of HS classification hierarchy, providing detailed commodity classification.

attributes.name: import_license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an import license or permit is required for this commodity when entering the port jurisdiction (True/False).

attributes.name: limited_quantity
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity qualifies for limited quantity exemptions under IMDG Code (True/False).

attributes.name: marine_pollutant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is classified as a marine pollutant under MARPOL and IMDG Code (True/False).

attributes.name: marpol_category
attributes.description: MARPOL annex category applicable to this commodity if it is a pollutant or hazardous substance: ANNEX_I (oil), ANNEX_II (noxious liquid substances), ANNEX_III (harmful substances in packaged form), ANNEX_IV (sewage), ANNEX_V (garbage), ANNEX_VI (air pollution), NOT_APPLICABLE (not a MARPOL-regulated substance). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ANNEX_I|ANNEX_II|ANNEX_III|ANNEX_IV|ANNEX_V|ANNEX_VI|NOT_APPLICABLE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, handling instructions, or special considerations for this commodity code.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: IMDG packing group indicating degree of danger for dangerous goods: I (high danger), II (medium danger), III (low danger). Null if not dangerous goods.

attributes.name: prohibited_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity is prohibited from import or export through the port under current regulations (True/False).
attributes.references: National Customs Authority Prohibited Goods List

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name
attributes.description: Official proper shipping name for dangerous goods as defined by IMDG Code. Null if not dangerous goods.

attributes.name: quarantine_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity requires quarantine inspection or clearance by biosecurity or agricultural authorities (True/False).

attributes.name: segregation_group
attributes.description: IMDG segregation group code indicating stowage and segregation requirements for dangerous goods. Null if not dangerous goods.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this commodity code record originated (e.g., Port Community System, SAP ERP, NAVIS N4).

attributes.name: storage_area_type

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_celsius

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: valid_to_date

products.name: equipment_type
products.description: Reference classification of all port equipment types — STS (Ship-to-Shore) cranes, RTG (Rubber Tyred Gantry) cranes, ASC (Automated Stacking Cranes), MHC (Mobile Harbour Cranes), QC (Quay Cranes), AGV (Automated Guided Vehicles), reach stackers, forklifts, terminal tractors, straddle carriers, and harbour tugs. Captures equipment type code, category, manufacturer model reference, SWL rating, lift height, outreach, span, power type (electric/diesel/hybrid), automation level (manual/semi-auto/full-auto), applicable maintenance standards (OEM intervals), and effectivity dates for type reclassification. Data steward: Asset Management / Engineering. SSOT for equipment type classification used by asset registry, terminal dispatch, workforce rostering, and maintenance planning domains.

attributes.name: equipment_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the equipment type record. Primary key for the equipment type master data entity.

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation for the equipment type. Values: manual (operator-controlled with no automation), semi_automated (operator-assisted with automated functions such as auto-positioning or collision avoidance), fully_automated (autonomous operation with remote monitoring such as AutoRTG, AutoASC, AGV). Impacts workforce planning, training requirements, and operational efficiency metrics.
attributes.references: IAPH Smart Port Guidelines, NAVIS N4 Automation Configuration

attributes.name: certification_interval_months
attributes.description: Frequency of mandatory certification or statutory inspection for the equipment type expressed in months. Typical values: 12 months for lifting equipment SWL certificates, 24 months for pressure vessel inspections. Null if certification_required_flag is False.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter VI Regulation 5, ISO 9927 Cranes - Inspections, National Maritime Safety Authority Regulations

attributes.name: certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment type requires periodic certification or inspection by a competent authority or third-party surveyor. True for lifting equipment requiring SWL certificates, pressure vessels, cranes subject to statutory inspection. False for equipment without regulatory certification requirements.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter VI Regulation 5, ISO 9927 Cranes - Inspections, Port State Control (PSC) Guidelines

attributes.name: collision_avoidance_system_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment type is equipped with collision avoidance or anti-collision systems. True for equipment with radar, lidar, proximity sensors, or automated braking systems to prevent collisions with other equipment, containers, or personnel. False for equipment without collision avoidance capability.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety, IAPH Smart Port Safety Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment type record was first created in the master data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, DAMA-DMBOK Data Lineage

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business unit or role responsible for maintaining and governing this equipment type master data. Typically Asset Management, Engineering, or Terminal Operations. Used for data quality accountability and change request routing.
attributes.references: ISO 8000 Data Quality, DAMA-DMBOK Data Governance

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this equipment type classification becomes effective and valid for use in operational systems. Used for managing equipment type lifecycle and supporting historical reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this equipment type classification remains valid. Null for currently active equipment types. Populated when an equipment type is retired, superseded, or reclassified. Used for managing equipment type lifecycle and supporting historical reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: emission_standard
attributes.description: Applicable emissions standard or tier classification for the equipment type. Examples: EPA Tier 3, EPA Tier 4 Final, Euro Stage V, IMO Tier II, IMO Tier III. Relevant for diesel-powered equipment and harbour tugs. Null for electric or manual equipment.
attributes.references: MARPOL Annex VI Air Pollution, EPA Nonroad Diesel Emission Standards, EMS Emissions Tracking

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment type is subject to environmental compliance monitoring and reporting requirements. True for diesel-powered equipment subject to emissions tracking (MARPOL Annex VI), noise monitoring, or fuel consumption reporting. False for equipment with no environmental compliance obligations.
attributes.references: MARPOL Annex VI Air Pollution, ISO 14001 Environmental Management, EMS Emissions Tracking

attributes.name: equipment_category
attributes.description: High-level classification grouping equipment types by operational function. Categories include: crane (STS, RTG, ASC, MHC, QC), mobile_equipment (reach stackers, forklifts, terminal tractors, straddle carriers), yard_equipment (container handlers, empty handlers), vessel_service (harbour tugs, pilot boats, mooring boats), gate_equipment (truck scales, OCR systems, radiation scanners), rail_equipment (rail-mounted gantry cranes, rail tractors), support_equipment (generators, compressors, workshop tools).
