attributes.references: IAPH Port Equipment Classification, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: equipment_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed classification within the equipment category. Examples: STS (Ship-to-Shore crane), RTG (Rubber Tyred Gantry crane), ASC (Automated Stacking Crane), MHC (Mobile Harbour Crane), QC (Quay Crane), AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle), reach stacker, forklift, terminal tractor, straddle carrier, harbour tug.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Equipment Classification, NAVIS N4 Equipment Type Master

attributes.name: equipment_type_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the equipment type across all port systems. Used as the business key for equipment classification in Terminal Operating System (TOS), asset registry, and maintenance planning systems.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, NAVIS N4 Equipment Type Master

attributes.name: equipment_type_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the equipment type. Human-readable label used in operational displays, reports, and user interfaces.

attributes.name: equipment_type_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the equipment type master record. Values: active (currently in use and available for asset registration), inactive (temporarily suspended from use), obsolete (retired and no longer valid for new assets), pending_approval (awaiting data steward approval before activation).

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_litres_per_hour
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Consumption in Litres per Hour
attributes.description: Average fuel consumption rate for diesel-powered equipment types expressed in litres per hour under normal operating conditions. Used for operational cost estimation, fuel budgeting, and Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions calculations. Null for electric, battery, or manual equipment.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, EMS Emissions Tracking

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Positioning System (GPS) Tracking Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment type is equipped with GPS (Global Positioning System) tracking capability for real-time location monitoring. True for mobile equipment with GPS transponders used in yard management, dispatch optimization, and asset visibility. False for stationary equipment or equipment without GPS.
attributes.references: ISO 19116 Geographic Information Positioning Services, NAVIS N4 Equipment Tracking

attributes.name: iot_sensor_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internet of Things (IoT) Sensor Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment type is equipped with IoT (Internet of Things) sensors for condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. True for equipment with sensors monitoring temperature, vibration, oil quality, load stress, or other operational parameters. False for equipment without IoT sensor integration.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, Maximo Asset Management IoT Integration

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment type record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization across systems. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, DAMA-DMBOK Data Lineage

attributes.name: lift_height_metres
attributes.description: Maximum vertical lift height capability of the equipment type in metres. Relevant for cranes, reach stackers, and stacking equipment. Determines container stacking height and vessel reach capability. Null for equipment without lift capability.
attributes.references: ISO 9927 Cranes - Inspections, NAVIS N4 Yard Planning Parameters

attributes.name: maintenance_interval_hours
attributes.description: Standard preventive maintenance interval for the equipment type expressed in operating hours. Defines the frequency of scheduled maintenance activities based on OEM recommendations. Used by Maximo Asset Management for work order scheduling and maintenance planning.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, Maximo Asset Management Preventive Maintenance Schedule

attributes.name: maintenance_standard
attributes.description: Applicable maintenance standard or framework governing the equipment type. Examples: OEM-specific maintenance program, ISO 55000 Asset Management, SOLAS inspection requirements, Port State Control (PSC) standards, manufacturer service bulletins. References the authoritative source for maintenance procedures and intervals.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, SOLAS Chapter I Regulation 6, Maximo Asset Management Standards Library

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM). Used for warranty tracking, spare parts sourcing, and maintenance standard alignment.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, Maximo Asset Management OEM Reference

attributes.name: model_reference
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or designation for this equipment type. Links to OEM technical specifications, parts catalogs, and maintenance manuals.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, Maximo Asset Management Model Master

attributes.name: moves_per_hour
attributes.description: Standard productivity rate for the equipment type expressed as container moves per hour under normal operating conditions. Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for equipment performance benchmarking, berth planning, and Service Level Agreement (SLA) commitments. Relevant for cranes and container handling equipment. Null for non-handling equipment.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators, NAVIS N4 Productivity Standards

attributes.name: operational_speed_kmh
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operational Speed in Kilometres per Hour (km/h)
attributes.description: Maximum operational travel speed of mobile equipment in kilometres per hour. Used for cycle time calculations, yard planning, and safety zone definitions. Relevant for terminal tractors, straddle carriers, reach stackers, AGVs, and harbour tugs. Null for stationary equipment.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety, NAVIS N4 Dispatch Planning

attributes.name: operator_certification_required
attributes.description: Type of operator certification or licence required to operate this equipment type. Examples: Crane Operator Licence (STS/RTG/ASC), Forklift Operator Certificate, Heavy Vehicle Licence, Marine Pilot Licence, IMDG Dangerous Goods Handling Certificate. Null for equipment not requiring operator certification. Used by Oracle HCM Cloud for workforce competency management and training planning.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention, ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety, Oracle HCM Competency Management

attributes.name: outreach_metres
attributes.description: Maximum horizontal reach or outreach distance of the equipment type in metres. Critical specification for Ship-to-Shore (STS) cranes and Quay Cranes (QC) to determine vessel size compatibility and berth planning. Null for equipment without reach capability.
attributes.references: ISO 9927 Cranes - Inspections, NAVIS N4 Berth Planning Parameters

attributes.name: power_consumption_kw
attributes.description: Average electrical power consumption for electric-powered equipment types expressed in kilowatts (kW) under normal operating conditions. Used for energy cost estimation, electrical infrastructure planning, and carbon footprint calculations. Null for diesel or manual equipment.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, EMS Energy Monitoring

attributes.name: power_type
attributes.description: Primary power source or propulsion type for the equipment. Values: electric (grid-powered or e-RTG), diesel (internal combustion engine), hybrid (diesel-electric or dual-mode), battery (battery-electric or AGV), manual (non-powered equipment). Critical for environmental reporting (GHG emissions), energy management, and infrastructure planning (charging stations, fuel depots).
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, MARPOL Annex VI Air Pollution, EMS Emissions Tracking

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special handling instructions, or contextual information about the equipment type that does not fit structured fields. Examples: phase-out plans, replacement recommendations, operational constraints, vendor support notes.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment type is equipped with RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology for automated tracking and identification. True for equipment with onboard RFID readers or tags used in automated gate operations, yard management, or asset tracking. False for equipment without RFID capability.
attributes.references: ISO 18000 RFID Standards, NAVIS N4 RFID Integration

attributes.name: span_metres
attributes.description: Rail span or track gauge distance for rail-mounted equipment types (RTG, ASC, rail-mounted gantry cranes) in metres. Defines the width of the equipment footprint and yard lane compatibility. Null for non-rail-mounted equipment.
attributes.references: ISO 9927 Cranes - Inspections, NAVIS N4 Yard Configuration

attributes.name: swl_rating_tonnes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safe Working Load (SWL) Rating in Tonnes
attributes.description: Maximum safe working load capacity of the equipment type expressed in metric tonnes. Critical for operational planning, load distribution, and safety compliance. Applies primarily to lifting equipment (cranes, reach stackers, forklifts). Null for non-lifting equipment.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter VI Regulation 5, ISO 9927 Cranes - Inspections, Maximo Asset Management SWL Certificate

attributes.name: teu_capacity
attributes.description: Container handling capacity of the equipment type expressed in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units). Represents the number of TEU the equipment can handle or transport in a single operation. Relevant for container handling equipment, terminal tractors, and AGVs. Null for non-container-handling equipment.
attributes.references: ISO 668 Freight Containers Classification, NAVIS N4 Equipment Capacity

products.name: country
products.description: Global reference for all countries and territories recognised in port trade, compliance, and vessel registration operations. Captures ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, alpha-3 code, numeric code, country name, official name, region, sub-region, flag state indicator (boolean), IMO member status, Paris MOU/Tokyo MOU/Indian Ocean MOU membership, PSC targeting factor, grey/black/white list classification, flag state authority contact, maritime conventions ratified (SOLAS, MARPOL, MLC), WCO member flag, FATF status, sanctions list flag, and applicable trade agreement codes. Includes effectivity dating for sanctions status changes. Data steward: Compliance & Regulatory Affairs. SSOT for country identity used across customs clearance, cargo manifests, vessel registration (flag state), customer onboarding, and compliance domains.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the country or territory record. Primary key.

attributes.name: calling_code
attributes.description: International dialing prefix for the country (e.g., +1, +44, +86). Used for contact information validation and telecommunications routing.

attributes.name: country_name
attributes.description: Common short-form name of the country or territory in English. Used for display purposes in Terminal Operating System (TOS), Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS), and reporting interfaces.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this country record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the official currency of the country. Used for billing, tariff calculations, Currency Adjustment Factor (CAF) application, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Name of the business unit or role responsible for maintaining and validating country master data. Typically Compliance & Regulatory Affairs or Master Data Management team.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this country record is effective and valid for operational use. Supports temporal validity and historical tracking of country status changes.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this country record is effective. Null if currently active. Used for historical tracking of country status changes, mergers, or dissolutions.

attributes.name: fatf_status
attributes.description: Status of the country with respect to Financial Action Task Force (FATF) anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing standards. Values: compliant (meets FATF standards), monitored (under increased monitoring), high_risk (identified as high-risk jurisdiction), not_assessed (not yet assessed). Impacts customer due diligence and financial transaction screening.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Public Statements

attributes.name: flag_state_authority_contact
attributes.description: Primary contact information (email, phone, or address) for the flag state maritime authority. Used for regulatory inquiries, vessel certification verification, and compliance coordination.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Flag State Directory

attributes.name: flag_state_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the national maritime authority or flag state administration responsible for vessel registration, certification, and flag state oversight. Used for regulatory correspondence and compliance verification.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Flag State Directory

attributes.name: flag_state_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this country is recognized as a vessel flag state. True if the country registers vessels under its flag; false otherwise. Critical for vessel registration validation and Port State Control (PSC) inspections.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Flag State Guidelines, United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS)

attributes.name: flag_state_performance_list
attributes.description: Classification of the flag state based on Port State Control (PSC) performance metrics. Values: white (high-performing, low deficiency rate), grey (medium-performing, moderate deficiency rate), black (low-performing, high deficiency rate). Directly impacts vessel inspection frequency and detention risk.
attributes.references: Paris MOU White, Grey and Black List, Tokyo MOU Performance List

attributes.name: imo_member_status
attributes.description: Membership status of the country in the International Maritime Organization (IMO). Values: member (full member state), associate_member (associate member), non_member (not a member). Affects applicability of IMO conventions and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Member State Directory

attributes.name: indian_ocean_mou_member
attributes.business_glossary_term: Indian Ocean Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) Member
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country is a member of the Indian Ocean Memorandum of Understanding on Port State Control (Indian Ocean MOU). True if member; false otherwise. Determines PSC inspection regime applicability for vessels calling at ports in this country.
attributes.references: Indian Ocean MOU on Port State Control

attributes.name: iso_alpha_2_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 3166-1 Alpha-2 Code
attributes.description: Two-letter country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard. Used in customs declarations, cargo manifests, and vessel registration documentation.

attributes.name: iso_alpha_3_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 3166-1 Alpha-3 Code
attributes.description: Three-letter country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 standard. Commonly used in Bill of Lading (BOL), Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) messages, and Port Community System (PCS) integrations.

attributes.name: iso_numeric_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 3166-1 Numeric Code
attributes.description: Three-digit numeric country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 numeric standard. Used in international trade statistics and customs systems.

attributes.name: isps_code_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code Compliant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country has implemented the International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code. True if compliant; false otherwise. Critical for port security assessments and vessel clearance procedures.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this country record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: marpol_ratified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country has ratified the International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL). True if ratified; false otherwise. Determines applicability of environmental protection and emissions standards.

attributes.name: mlc_ratified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country has ratified the Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006. True if ratified; false otherwise. Determines applicability of seafarer labor rights and working conditions standards.
attributes.references: International Labour Organization (ILO) Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: official_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the country or territory as recognized by the United Nations and International Maritime Organization (IMO). Used in formal legal documentation, customs declarations, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: United Nations Terminology Database, IMO Member State Directory

attributes.name: paris_mou_member
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country is a member of the Paris Memorandum of Understanding on Port State Control (Paris MOU). True if member; false otherwise. Determines PSC inspection regime applicability for vessels calling at ports in this country.
attributes.references: Paris MOU on Port State Control

attributes.name: psc_targeting_factor
attributes.description: Numeric targeting factor used by Port State Control (PSC) authorities to prioritize vessel inspections based on flag state performance. Higher values indicate higher risk and increased inspection likelihood. Range typically 0.00 to 10.00.
attributes.references: Paris MOU, Tokyo MOU, Indian Ocean MOU Targeting Methodologies

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the country record. Values: active (currently in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), deprecated (no longer valid, retained for historical reference). Used to control operational visibility and data quality.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Broad geographic region classification (e.g., Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Oceania) as defined by the United Nations geoscheme. Used for regional trade analysis and cargo routing strategies.

attributes.name: sanctions_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when current sanctions status became effective. Null if no sanctions are in place. Used for historical compliance tracking and audit trails.
attributes.references: United Nations Security Council Sanctions, OFAC Sanctions Programs, EU Sanctions Map

attributes.name: sanctions_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when current sanctions are scheduled to expire or be reviewed. Null if sanctions are indefinite or no sanctions are in place. Used for forward-looking compliance planning.
attributes.references: United Nations Security Council Sanctions, OFAC Sanctions Programs, EU Sanctions Map

attributes.name: sanctions_list_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country is currently subject to international trade sanctions or embargoes (e.g., United Nations, United States OFAC, European Union). True if sanctioned; false otherwise. Critical for trade compliance screening and cargo booking restrictions.
attributes.references: United Nations Security Council Sanctions, OFAC Sanctions Programs, EU Sanctions Map

attributes.name: solas_ratified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Convention Ratified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country has ratified the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS). True if ratified; false otherwise. Determines applicability of SOLAS safety requirements for vessels flagged or calling at ports in this country.

attributes.name: sub_region
attributes.description: Sub-regional classification within the broader region (e.g., Eastern Asia, Western Europe, Southern Africa) as defined by the United Nations geoscheme. Supports granular trade flow analysis and vessel routing optimization.

attributes.name: tokyo_mou_member
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country is a member of the Tokyo Memorandum of Understanding on Port State Control (Tokyo MOU). True if member; false otherwise. Determines PSC inspection regime applicability for vessels calling at ports in this country.
attributes.references: Tokyo MOU on Port State Control

attributes.name: trade_agreement_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of trade agreement codes applicable to this country (e.g., USMCA, EU, ASEAN, CPTPP, RCEP). Used to determine preferential tariff rates, customs duty exemptions, and Terminal Handling Charge (THC) adjustments.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Regional Trade Agreements Database

attributes.name: un_locode_prefix
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations (UN/LOCODE) Prefix
attributes.description: Two-letter country prefix used in UN/LOCODE location codes. Matches ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Used to construct full UN/LOCODE identifiers for ports and inland terminals within this country.
attributes.references: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE) UN/LOCODE

attributes.name: wco_member
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country is a member of the World Customs Organization (WCO). True if member; false otherwise. Affects customs clearance procedures, Harmonized System (HS) Code usage, and trade facilitation standards.

products.name: edi_partner

attributes.name: edi_partner_id

attributes.name: acknowledgment_required

attributes.name: activation_date

attributes.name: authentication_method

attributes.name: business_contact_email

attributes.name: communication_protocol

attributes.name: connection_endpoint

attributes.name: connection_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the EDI connection with this partner. Determines whether messages can be exchanged.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EDI partner master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: The internal team or role responsible for maintaining this EDI partner master record. Typically IT or Port Community Systems team.

attributes.name: deactivation_date

attributes.name: edi_standard
attributes.description: The primary EDI messaging standard used by this partner for electronic data interchange.

attributes.name: encryption_enabled

attributes.name: last_inbound_message_timestamp

attributes.name: last_outbound_message_timestamp

attributes.name: last_successful_transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful EDI message transmission (inbound or outbound) with this partner. Used for connection health monitoring.

attributes.name: message_format_version
attributes.description: The specific version of the EDI standard or message format used by this partner (e.g., EDIFACT D95B, X12 4010).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EDI partner master record was last updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional configuration notes, special requirements, or operational considerations for this EDI partner.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: The date when this EDI partner was first onboarded and configured in the system.

attributes.name: partner_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code assigned to the EDI trading partner. Used in message routing and partner identification across Port Community System (PCS) and Terminal Operating System (TOS).

attributes.name: partner_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the EDI trading partner organization. Used for contract management and billing purposes.

attributes.name: partner_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or alias for the EDI partner used in operational displays and reports.

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the EDI partner based on their role in the maritime logistics supply chain.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary technical contact for EDI support and issue resolution.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary technical contact person at the partner organization responsible for EDI operations.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary technical contact for urgent EDI connectivity issues.

attributes.name: receiver_identification
attributes.description: The unique receiver identification code used in EDI message interchange headers for this partner.

attributes.name: receiver_qualifier
attributes.description: The qualifier code identifying the receiver ID type in EDI message headers.

attributes.name: sender_identification
attributes.description: The unique sender identification code used in EDI message interchange headers for this partner.

attributes.name: sender_qualifier
attributes.description: The qualifier code identifying the sender ID type in EDI message headers (e.g., DUNS, SCAC, GLN).

attributes.name: sla_availability_percentage
attributes.description: The contractual uptime availability percentage guaranteed for EDI connectivity with this partner (e.g., 99.50 for 99.5% uptime).

attributes.name: sla_response_time_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time in Minutes
attributes.description: The contractual maximum response time in minutes for EDI message acknowledgment or processing by this partner.

attributes.name: supported_message_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EDI message types supported by this partner (e.g., COPARN, BAPLIE, IFTMIN, COARRI, CUSCAR, CUSRES, CODECO, IFTMBC). Defines the scope of electronic transactions enabled.

attributes.name: test_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this partner connection is configured for test/sandbox mode rather than production message exchange.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The primary time zone of the partner organization (IANA time zone identifier) used for scheduling and timestamp interpretation.

products.name: imdg_class
products.description: Reference master for IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods) hazard classifications as defined by the IMO IMDG Code. Captures IMDG class number (1–9), division (e.g., 2.1 flammable gas, 3 flammable liquid, 6.1 toxic), UN number range, hazard label type, packing group (I/II/III), segregation group code, segregation table references (away from, separated from), EmS (Emergency Schedule) fire/spillage codes, special provisions, applicable SOLAS Ch.VII regulation, and IMDG Code amendment cycle reference with effectivity dates (valid_from/valid_to) for amendment transitions. Data steward: Safety & Compliance. SSOT for dangerous goods classification used in BAPLIE stowage planning, gate-in DG acceptance checks, yard block segregation rules, and CUSCAR customs compliance.
products.reference: IMO IMDG Code — International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code

attributes.name: imdg_class_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Class Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IMDG hazard classification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_imdg_class_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on imdg_class (parent_imdg_class_id)

attributes.name: class_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the IMDG hazard class (e.g., 'Explosives', 'Flammable Gases', 'Flammable Liquids', 'Toxic Substances', 'Corrosive Substances', 'Radioactive Material'). Human-readable label for the class.

attributes.name: class_number
attributes.description: Primary IMDG hazard class number (1 through 9), with optional decimal subdivision (e.g., 2.1, 2.2, 2.3 for gases; 6.1, 6.2 for toxic substances). Defines the principal hazard category per IMO IMDG Code.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IMDG classification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Name or role of the data steward responsible for maintaining and validating this IMDG classification master data. Typically the Safety & Compliance team or Dangerous Goods Compliance Officer.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: Subdivision or division within the IMDG class (e.g., 2.1 for flammable gases, 3 for flammable liquids, 6.1 for toxic substances). Provides finer hazard categorization within the primary class.

attributes.name: ems_fire_code
attributes.description: EmS fire schedule code (e.g., F-A, F-B, F-C) specifying emergency response procedures for fire incidents involving this IMDG class. Referenced from the Emergency Response Procedures for Ships Carrying Dangerous Goods (EmS Guide).
attributes.references: IMO EmS Guide - Emergency Response Procedures

attributes.name: ems_spillage_code
attributes.description: EmS spillage schedule code (e.g., S-A, S-B, S-C) specifying emergency response procedures for spillage or leakage incidents involving this IMDG class. Referenced from the Emergency Response Procedures for Ships Carrying Dangerous Goods (EmS Guide).
attributes.references: IMO EmS Guide - Emergency Response Procedures

attributes.name: excepted_quantity_code
attributes.description: Excepted quantity code (E0, E1, E2, E3, E4, E5) defining the maximum quantity per inner packaging and per package for excepted quantity shipments. Excepted quantities are subject to minimal regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 3 - Excepted Quantities

attributes.name: hazard_label_type
attributes.description: Type or code of the hazard label required for containers and packages carrying goods of this IMDG class (e.g., 'Explosive 1.1', 'Flammable Gas', 'Toxic'). Used for visual identification and compliance with labeling regulations.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 5 - Consignment Procedures

attributes.name: imdg_code_amendment_cycle
attributes.description: Amendment cycle or version of the IMDG Code under which this classification is defined (e.g., 'Amendment 40-20', 'Amendment 41-22'). The IMDG Code is updated biennially; this field tracks which amendment cycle applies to this record.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when this IMDG classification record was last verified against the current IMO IMDG Code amendment. Used to ensure data currency and compliance with the latest regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: limited_quantity_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum quantity per package or inner packaging that qualifies for limited quantity (LQ) exemptions under the IMDG Code. Expressed as a volume or mass (e.g., '1L', '5kg'). Limited quantities are subject to reduced regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 3 - Limited Quantities

attributes.name: marine_pollutant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether substances in this IMDG class are classified as marine pollutants under MARPOL Annex III. True if the class typically contains marine pollutants requiring special marking and documentation.

attributes.name: marpol_annex_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable MARPOL annex for pollution prevention related to this IMDG class (e.g., 'Annex I - Oil', 'Annex II - Noxious Liquid Substances', 'Annex III - Harmful Substances in Packaged Form'). Used for environmental compliance and spill response planning.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IMDG classification record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or additional guidance related to this IMDG class. May include port-specific handling instructions, local regulatory variations, or clarifications for operational staff.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: Packing group classification (I, II, or III) indicating the degree of danger: I = high danger, II = medium danger, III = low danger. Used to determine packaging specifications and handling requirements.

attributes.name: segregation_group_code
attributes.description: Segregation group code assigned to this IMDG class for stowage and segregation purposes (e.g., acids, alkalis, ammonium compounds). Used to determine compatibility and separation requirements in vessel stowage planning and yard block allocation.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 7 - Stowage and Segregation

attributes.name: segregation_table_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the segregation table in the IMDG Code specifying separation requirements (e.g., 'away from', 'separated from', 'separated by a complete compartment or hold from'). Defines minimum physical separation distances for safe stowage.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 7 - Segregation Table

attributes.name: solas_regulation_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Regulation Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable SOLAS Chapter VII regulation governing the carriage of this dangerous goods class by sea (e.g., 'SOLAS Ch.VII Part A', 'SOLAS Ch.VII Part B'). SOLAS Chapter VII addresses the carriage of dangerous goods in packaged form or in solid form in bulk.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system or authoritative source from which this IMDG classification record was sourced (e.g., 'NAVIS N4', 'Port Community System', 'Manual Entry from IMO IMDG Code'). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: special_provisions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of special provision codes applicable to this IMDG class (e.g., SP23, SP172, SP274). Special provisions modify or supplement the general requirements for specific substances or articles within the class.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 3 - Dangerous Goods List Special Provisions

attributes.name: stowage_category
attributes.description: Stowage category code (A, B, C, D, or E) defining where this IMDG class may be stowed on a vessel. Category A = on deck or under deck; B = on deck or under deck with specific conditions; C = on deck only; D = on deck only with specific conditions; E = prohibited from carriage. Used in BAPLIE stowage planning.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 7 - Stowage and Segregation

attributes.name: un_number_range_end
attributes.description: Ending UN number in the range typically associated with this IMDG class. Defines the upper bound of UN numbers commonly classified under this hazard class.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: un_number_range_start
attributes.description: Starting UN number in the range typically associated with this IMDG class. UN numbers are four-digit identifiers assigned to hazardous substances and articles by the United Nations Committee of Experts on the Transport of Dangerous Goods.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Effective start date for this IMDG classification record. Used to manage amendment transitions and ensure the correct classification rules are applied based on the cargo acceptance or vessel departure date.

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: Effective end date for this IMDG classification record. Nullable for current/active classifications. Used to manage historical records when IMDG Code amendments supersede or modify classifications.

products.name: flag_state
products.description: Reference master for all flag states (countries of vessel registration) recognised under international maritime law. Captures flag state code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), flag state name, IMO member status, Paris MOU/Tokyo MOU/Indian Ocean MOU membership, PSC (Port State Control) targeting factor, grey/black/white list classification, flag state authority contact, and applicable maritime conventions ratified (SOLAS, MARPOL, MLC). Used in vessel master, PSC inspection, and compliance domains.
products.reference: IMO Flag State Registry / Paris MOU White/Grey/Black List

attributes.name: flag_state_id
attributes.description: Primary key for flag_state

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Flag states are countries that register vessels under their maritime authority. Normalizing to FK allows joining to country for full country data (ISO codes, region, sub-region, trade agreements, curr

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the flag state in the port's master data system. Active indicates the flag state is recognized and vessels under this flag are accepted; inactive indicates the flag state is no longer recognized; suspended indicates temporary restrictions.

attributes.name: authority_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for contacting the flag state maritime authority for official correspondence and inquiries.

attributes.name: authority_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for contacting the flag state maritime authority.

attributes.name: authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the official maritime authority or administration responsible for vessel registration and flag state control in this country.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO), National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: authority_website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL of the flag state maritime authority for accessing regulations, forms, and public information.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this flag state record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this flag state record is effective and valid for use in operational systems.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this flag state record is effective. Null indicates the record is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: flag_of_convenience
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flag state is commonly recognized as a flag of convenience, where vessel registration requirements are less stringent and often used for tax or regulatory advantages.
attributes.references: International Transport Workers' Federation (ITF), International Maritime Organization (IMO)

attributes.name: flag_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code representing the flag state under which vessels are registered. This is the primary business identifier for the flag state.

attributes.name: flag_state_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the flag state country as recognized under international maritime law.

attributes.name: imo_member_since_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Member Since Date
attributes.description: Date when the flag state became a member of the International Maritime Organization (IMO). Null if not a member.

attributes.name: imo_member_status
attributes.description: Membership status of the flag state in the International Maritime Organization (IMO). Indicates whether the flag state is a full member, associate member, or non-member.

attributes.name: indian_ocean_mou_member
attributes.business_glossary_term: Indian Ocean Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) Member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flag state is a member of the Indian Ocean MOU on Port State Control.
attributes.references: Indian Ocean MOU on Port State Control

attributes.name: isps_code_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flag state is compliant with the International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code, which prescribes responsibilities for governments, shipping companies, and ship and port personnel to detect and deter security threats.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this flag state record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: marpol_ratification_date
attributes.description: Date when the flag state ratified the MARPOL Convention. Null if not ratified.

attributes.name: marpol_ratified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flag state has ratified the International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL).

attributes.name: mlc_ratification_date
attributes.description: Date when the flag state ratified the Maritime Labour Convention. Null if not ratified.
attributes.references: International Labour Organization (ILO), Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: mlc_ratified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flag state has ratified the Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006, which sets out seafarers' rights to decent working conditions.
attributes.references: International Labour Organization (ILO), Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional information, special considerations, or operational notes related to the flag state.

attributes.name: paris_mou_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flag state is a member of the Paris MOU on Port State Control, covering European and North Atlantic regions.
attributes.references: Paris MOU on Port State Control

attributes.name: psc_list_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the flag state on Port State Control (PSC) performance lists. White list indicates high performance, grey list medium performance, black list poor performance, and not classified indicates no formal classification.
attributes.references: Paris MOU, Tokyo MOU, Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: psc_targeting_factor
attributes.description: Numerical targeting factor used by Port State Control (PSC) authorities to determine inspection priority for vessels flying this flag. Higher values indicate higher inspection priority due to poor performance history.
attributes.references: Port State Control (PSC) Authorities, Paris MOU, Tokyo MOU

attributes.name: recognized_organization_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flag state authorizes Recognized Organizations (classification societies) to carry out statutory surveys and certification on its behalf.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO), International Association of Classification Societies (IACS)

attributes.name: registry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the flag state registry. National registries require vessel ownership by nationals; open registries (flags of convenience) allow foreign ownership; international registries are hybrid models.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO), International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH)

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Internal risk assessment rating assigned to the flag state based on PSC performance, compliance history, and safety record. Used for prioritizing inspections and resource allocation.
attributes.references: Port State Control (PSC) Authorities, Port Management Information System (PMIS)

attributes.name: solas_ratification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Ratification Date
attributes.description: Date when the flag state ratified the SOLAS Convention. Null if not ratified.

attributes.name: solas_ratified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Convention Ratified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flag state has ratified the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS).

attributes.name: stcw_ratification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW) Ratification Date
attributes.description: Date when the flag state ratified the STCW Convention. Null if not ratified.

attributes.name: stcw_ratified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW) Convention Ratified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flag state has ratified the International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers (STCW).

attributes.name: tokyo_mou_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the flag state is a member of the Tokyo MOU on Port State Control, covering Asia-Pacific region.
attributes.references: Tokyo MOU on Port State Control

attributes.name: total_registered_dwt
attributes.description: Total Deadweight Tonnage (DWT) of all vessels registered under this flag state. Represents the total cargo-carrying capacity of the fleet.

attributes.name: total_registered_grt
attributes.description: Total Gross Registered Tonnage (GRT) of all vessels registered under this flag state. Used for assessing the overall size and capacity of the flag state's fleet.

attributes.name: total_registered_vessels
attributes.description: Total number of vessels currently registered under this flag state. This is a snapshot metric used for fleet size analysis and port planning.

products.name: shipping_line
products.description: Master record for all shipping lines (ocean carriers) operating vessel calls at the port. Captures SCAC code (Standard Carrier Alpha Code), BIC operator code (per ISO 6346), carrier name, alliance membership (2M, THE Alliance, Ocean Alliance, or independent), registered country (FK to country), principal contact, EDI partner reference (FK to edi_partner), preferred berth window, commercial account reference, fleet size indicator, and operational status (active/suspended/ceased). Data steward: Commercial / Marine Operations. Distinct from the broader port_community_participant in the customer domain — this is the operational SSOT for carrier identity used in vessel scheduling, BAPLIE stowage plans, BOL processing, tariff application, and alliance slot-sharing agreements.
products.reference: SCAC — Standard Carrier Alpha Code / BIC Operator Code

attributes.name: shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for shipping_line

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: shipping_line has registered_country_code (STRING) which should reference country master. Adding country_id FK normalizes the country reference and removes the denormalized code. Country table contain

attributes.name: edi_partner_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the carrier in the port's EDI messaging system. Used for automated exchange of BAPLIE (stowage plans), COPARN (container pre-advice), IFTMIN (transport instructions), and other UN/EDIFACT messages.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT Standards; Port Community System (PCS) EDI Registry

attributes.name: alliance_membership
attributes.description: Strategic alliance or consortium membership of the carrier. Major alliances include 2M (Maersk/MSC), THE Alliance (Hapag-Lloyd/ONE/Yang Ming/HMM), Ocean Alliance (CMA CGM/COSCO/OOCL/Evergreen). Independent carriers operate outside alliances. Impacts slot-sharing agreements and vessel scheduling coordination.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Alliance Registry

attributes.name: api_integration_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: API (Application Programming Interface) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has active REST/SOAP API integration with the port's Terminal Operating System (TOS) for real-time data exchange beyond traditional EDI.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 API Integration Standard; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: average_teu_per_call
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit) Per Call
attributes.description: Rolling 12-month average container volume in TEU handled per vessel call for this carrier. Used for yard planning and equipment allocation.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Yard Management Analytics; TEU Standard (ISO 668)

attributes.name: average_vessel_calls_per_month
attributes.description: Rolling 12-month average number of vessel calls made by this carrier at the port per month. Used for berth capacity planning and commercial forecasting.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Vessel Planning Analytics; Port Management Information System (PMIS)

attributes.name: bic_operator_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bureau International des Containers (BIC) Operator Code
attributes.description: Three-letter carrier prefix followed by 'U' (for container owner) as defined in ISO 6346. Used to identify container ownership and operator in global container tracking systems.
attributes.references: ISO 6346 - Freight Containers Coding Identification and Marking

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered name of the shipping line or ocean carrier as it appears on commercial contracts and vessel registration documents.

attributes.name: carrier_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or trade name of the shipping line commonly used in operational communications, vessel schedules, and port documentation.

attributes.name: commercial_account_reference
attributes.description: Internal account identifier linking this shipping line to the commercial billing and tariff management system. Used for invoice generation, credit management, and revenue tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Customer Master; NAVIS N4 Billing Module

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: External credit rating assigned by recognized rating agencies (Moody's, S&P, Fitch) reflecting the carrier's financial stability and creditworthiness. Used for credit limit determination and payment term negotiation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D|Not Rated — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: customs_broker_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred customs broker or clearance agent used by the carrier for import/export documentation and customs clearance at this port.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier is approved and certified to handle IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods) cargo at this port. Requires specific documentation, training, and compliance with IMDG Code.

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Business unit responsible for maintaining and validating the accuracy of this shipping line master record. Commercial: handles tariff and contract data. Marine Operations: handles vessel scheduling and operational data. Both: shared responsibility.

attributes.name: edi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has active EDI integration with the port for automated message exchange. True: EDI active. False: manual/email-based communication.

attributes.name: fleet_size_category
attributes.description: Classification of the carrier based on global fleet capacity measured in TEU. Mega Carrier: >1M TEU. Major Carrier: 500K-1M TEU. Regional Carrier: 100K-500K TEU. Niche Carrier: 10K-100K TEU. Feeder Operator: <10K TEU. Used for berth allocation priority and commercial negotiation.
attributes.value_regex: Mega Carrier|Major Carrier|Regional Carrier|Niche Carrier|Feeder Operator

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the shipping line's global or regional headquarters is located.

attributes.name: iso_certification_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISO (International Organization for Standardization) Certification Status
attributes.description: Highest level of ISO certification held by the carrier. ISO 9001: Quality Management. ISO 14001: Environmental Management. ISO 28000: Supply Chain Security. Multiple: holds more than one certification. Used for vendor assessment and partnership evaluation.
attributes.references: ISO Standards; International Organization for Standardization

attributes.name: isps_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISPS (International Ship and Port Facility Security) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier maintains valid ISPS certification and compliance for all vessels calling at the port. Required for international vessel operations per SOLAS Chapter XI-2.
attributes.references: ISPS Code (SOLAS Chapter XI-2); International Maritime Organization (IMO)

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date when this shipping line master record was last reviewed and validated for accuracy by the data steward. Used for data quality monitoring and compliance.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the shipping line at this port. Active: currently operating vessel calls. Suspended: temporarily not calling at port. Ceased: permanently discontinued operations. Merged/Acquired: absorbed into another carrier entity.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days allowed for payment of port charges and terminal handling charges (THC) after invoice date. Typical values: 0 (prepaid), 7, 14, 30, 45, 60 days.
attributes.references: Commercial Contract Terms; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms

attributes.name: preferred_berth_window_hours
attributes.description: Preferred advance notice window in hours between ETB (Estimated Time of Berthing) and vessel arrival that the carrier requests for berth allocation planning. Used by berth planning system to optimize scheduling.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Vessel Planning Module; Port Operations Standard

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact for operational communications, vessel scheduling, and commercial matters.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Internal Contact Management Standard

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the principal commercial or operations contact person at the shipping line for port coordination and service matters.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct telephone number of the primary contact including country and area codes for urgent operational coordination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Internal Contact Management Standard

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipping line master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system process name that last modified this shipping line master record. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipping line master record was last modified. Updated on any field change.

attributes.name: reefer_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier operates reefer-capable vessels and handles refrigerated cargo at this port. Impacts berth allocation to reefer-equipped berths.
attributes.references: Port Operations Standard; NAVIS N4 Vessel Planning

attributes.name: scac_code
attributes.description: Four-letter unique identifier assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) to identify ocean carriers in EDI transactions and shipping documentation. Required for all US-bound cargo per CBP regulations.
attributes.references: NMFTA SCAC Standard; US Customs and Border Protection (CBP)

attributes.name: service_commencement_date
attributes.description: Date when the shipping line first commenced vessel operations at this port facility.

attributes.name: service_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the shipping line ceased or suspended vessel operations at this port. Null for active carriers.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Primary type of shipping service the carrier provides at this port. Mainline: direct long-haul international routes. Feeder: short-sea distribution services. Transshipment Hub: hub-and-spoke operations. Regional: intra-regional services. Specialized: project cargo, heavy lift, or niche services.

attributes.name: tariff_group_code
attributes.description: Internal code linking the carrier to a specific tariff schedule for port charges, THC (Terminal Handling Charges), wharfage, and other fees. Carriers in the same group receive identical pricing.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module; Port Tariff Management System

attributes.name: total_fleet_teu_capacity
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Fleet TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit) Capacity
attributes.description: Total container capacity of the carrier's global fleet measured in TEU. Used for commercial assessment and berth planning.

attributes.name: vessel_count
attributes.description: Total number of vessels (owned and chartered) in the carrier's operating fleet. Includes container ships, RoRo vessels, and specialized cargo vessels.

attributes.name: vgm_compliance_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for VGM verification per SOLAS Chapter VI Regulation 2. Method 1: weighing the packed container. Method 2: weighing all contents and adding tare weight. Both: carrier accepts either method. Required for all export containers since July 2016.
attributes.references: SOLAS Chapter VI Regulation 2; International Maritime Organization (IMO)

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official corporate website URL of the shipping line for reference and public information access.

products.name: service_code
products.description: Reference master for all port service codes used in tariff schedules, TOS billing triggers, and SAP FI revenue posting. Captures service code (alphanumeric), service name, service category (THC, wharfage, pilotage, towage, mooring, storage, reefer monitoring, gate lift, rail lift, IMDG surcharge, OOG surcharge, etc.), applicable UOM code, billing basis (per TEU, per move, per hour, per day, per GT, per vessel call), revenue GL account mapping, tax applicability flag, owning tariff schedule reference, and effectivity dates (valid_from/valid_to) for tariff revision cycles. Data steward: Commercial / Tariff Management. SSOT for service code standardisation ensuring consistent billing line item generation across NAVIS N4 billing module and SAP FI/CO.

attributes.name: service_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service code record. Primary key. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: parent_service_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to a parent service code if this service is a component of a bundled service. Null for standalone services.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for new or revised service codes. Only approved service codes are activated for billing.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved this service code for activation. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: perimeter_fencing_type
attributes.description: Type of physical barrier securing the perimeter of the security zone. Chain link for standard fencing, concrete wall for high-security areas, steel barrier for vehicle protection, water barrier for waterside zones, none for open zones.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, special instructions, or operational considerations for this security zone. May include seasonal variations, temporary restrictions, or coordination requirements with other zones.

attributes.name: restricted_cargo_types
attributes.description: Types of cargo that are restricted or prohibited within this security zone. Examples: IMDG Class 1 explosives, radioactive materials, high-value cargo. Pipe-separated list for multiple restrictions.

attributes.name: threat_level
attributes.description: Current assessed threat level for this specific security zone based on intelligence, historical incidents, and risk assessments. May differ from overall port MARSEC level for high-value or vulnerable zones.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the security zone for operational reference and access control system integration. Used in gate systems and patrol logs.

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the security zone. Active zones are enforced, inactive zones are not currently monitored, suspended zones are temporarily disabled, under review zones are being reassessed.

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the security zone based on access restrictions and security requirements. Restricted areas require highest clearance, controlled areas require authorization, public areas allow general access with monitoring.

products.name: access_credential
products.description: Master record for all port access credentials issued to personnel, vehicles, and contractors. Captures credential number, credential type (port ID card, vehicle pass, visitor pass, contractor badge, biometric token), holder identity reference, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, MARSEC level access permissions, zone access entitlements, biometric enrolment status, and revocation details. SSOT for all physical access authorisation within the port precinct.
products.reference: ISPS Code — Port Facility Access Control

attributes.name: access_attempt_count

attributes.name: background_check_status

attributes.name: biometric_modality

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credential record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: credential_number

attributes.name: credential_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credential. Controls whether the credential is valid for access control system authorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|suspended|revoked|expired|pending_activation|lost|stolen — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: credential_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credential based on its purpose and holder category. Determines access privileges and validation requirements.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Guidance on Port Facility Security

attributes.name: escort_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credential holder must be accompanied by an authorized escort when accessing restricted areas. Typically true for visitors and contractors with limited clearance.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Visitor Access Control

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential expires and is no longer valid for access authorization. Nullable for credentials with indefinite validity subject to periodic review.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Credential Validity Period

attributes.name: failed_access_count
attributes.description: Total number of failed or denied access attempts for this credential. High counts may indicate lost credentials, unauthorized use, or system issues.

attributes.name: holder_national_identifier
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number of the credential holder. Required for background checks and compliance with maritime security regulations.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention - Seafarer Identity Documents

attributes.name: holder_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number of the credential holder for emergency contact and verification purposes.

attributes.name: holder_type
attributes.description: Category of the individual or entity to whom this credential is issued. Used for access policy enforcement and reporting segmentation.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential was officially issued to the holder. Marks the start of the credential validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the port security department, office, or authorized personnel who issued the credential. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_access_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful use of this credential at any port access control point. Used for activity monitoring and dormant credential identification.

attributes.name: marsec_level_access
attributes.description: Maximum MARSEC security level at which this credential remains valid. MARSEC 1 is normal, MARSEC 2 is heightened, MARSEC 3 is exceptional threat. Credentials may be restricted at higher threat levels.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credential record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional remarks, special instructions, or contextual information about the credential or holder. Used by security personnel for operational notes.

attributes.name: photo_reference
attributes.description: File path, URL, or document management system reference to the credential holder photograph. Used for visual identity verification at access points.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Identity Verification

attributes.name: renewal_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an automated renewal reminder notification has been sent to the credential holder prior to expiry.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential was revoked or permanently invalidated. Nullable if the credential has never been revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or justification for why the credential was revoked. Examples include employment termination, security breach, policy violation, or credential compromise.

attributes.name: revoked_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the security officer or authorized personnel who revoked the credential. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_number

attributes.name: sponsor_contact

attributes.name: sponsor_name

attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Visitor Management

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential holder completed mandatory port security awareness training or ISPS Code familiarization. Required for certain credential types.

attributes.name: vehicle_registration_number
attributes.description: License plate or registration number of the vehicle associated with this credential. Applicable for vehicle pass credential types.

products.name: access_event
products.description: Transactional record of every physical access attempt and entry/exit event at port access control points including gates, turnstiles, restricted area doors, and vehicle barriers. Captures event timestamp, access point identifier, credential presented, holder identity, zone accessed, access decision (granted/denied/alarm), denial reason code, MARSEC level at time of event, and CCTV clip reference. Provides the complete audit trail for port access control compliance and forensic investigation.

attributes.name: access_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical access event record. Primary key for the access event log.

attributes.name: access_credential_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the access credential presented during the event (badge, card, biometric token).
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A - Port Facility Security

attributes.name: access_point_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical access control point where the event occurred (gate, turnstile, door, vehicle barrier).
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A - Port Facility Security

attributes.name: correlated_access_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on access_event (correlated_access_event_id)

attributes.name: security_incident_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the security incident record created as a result of this access event, if the event triggered an incident investigation. Null if no incident was created.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A - Incident Response

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restricted security zone that was accessed or attempted to be accessed.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Port Facility Security

attributes.name: access_control_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical access control system (hardware/software platform) that recorded this event.

attributes.name: access_decision
attributes.description: The access control system decision outcome for this event indicating whether access was granted, denied, or triggered an alarm.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A - Port Facility Security

attributes.name: access_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration in minutes that the person remained in the zone, calculated from entry to exit events. Null if exit event not yet recorded or for single-point events.

attributes.name: access_point_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical access control point type (vehicle gate, pedestrian gate, turnstile, door, barrier, bollard).
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Access Control Points

attributes.name: access_purpose
attributes.description: Stated business purpose or reason for the access (e.g., cargo operations, maintenance, delivery, inspection, meeting).
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Visitor Management

attributes.name: alarm_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this access event triggered a security alarm condition. True if alarm was triggered, False otherwise.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A - Security Alarm Systems

attributes.name: alarm_type
attributes.description: Classification of the security alarm that was triggered, if applicable. Null if no alarm was triggered.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Alarm Response Procedures

attributes.name: anti_passback_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event violated anti-passback rules (attempting to enter without a prior exit, or vice versa). True if violation detected, False otherwise.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Access Control Logic

attributes.name: audit_trail_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash of the event record to ensure data integrity and prevent tampering for compliance and forensic purposes.

attributes.name: biometric_match_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.00 to 100.00) of the biometric authentication match, if biometric credential was used. Null for non-biometric credentials.

attributes.name: cctv_clip_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the CCTV video clip capturing this access event for forensic review and audit purposes.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A - Surveillance Systems

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this access event record was first created in the database. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX

attributes.name: credential_number

attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A - Access Control

attributes.name: credential_type
attributes.description: Type of credential technology used for the access attempt (RFID card, biometric scan, PIN code, QR code, vehicle RFID tag, visitor pass).
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Identification Systems

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason why access was denied, if applicable. Null for granted access events. attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Security Procedures

attributes.name: device_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the physical access control device (card reader, biometric scanner, barrier controller) that captured the event.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction of movement through the access point: inbound (entering the zone) or outbound (exiting the zone).

attributes.name: escort_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the person was required to be escorted while in the accessed zone per security policy. True if escort required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Visitor Escort Requirements

attributes.name: event_source_ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the access control device or system that generated this event record.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the access event occurred at the access control point. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the access event indicating whether it was an entry, exit, attempted access, or alarm condition.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A - Access Control

attributes.name: marsec_level
attributes.description: The MARSEC security level in effect at the port facility at the time of the access event (1=normal, 2=heightened, 3=exceptional). MARSEC levels are defined by ISPS Code to indicate threat conditions.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A - Security Levels

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by security personnel regarding this access event, if applicable.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Security Documentation

attributes.name: organization_name
attributes.description: Name of the company or organization that the person represents (e.g., port operator, shipping line, customs, contractor).
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Visitor Management

attributes.name: override_authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the security supervisor who authorized a manual override of the access control decision. Null for standard automated decisions.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Override Procedures

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why a manual override was authorized, if applicable. Null for standard automated decisions.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Security Procedures

attributes.name: person_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual associated with the credential at the time of the access event.

attributes.name: temperature_reading_celsius

attributes.name: time_zone_restriction_violated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the access attempt violated time-based access restrictions for the credential or zone. True if violation, False otherwise.

attributes.name: vehicle_registration
attributes.description: License plate or registration number of the vehicle involved in the access event, if applicable. Null for pedestrian access.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Vehicle Access Control

attributes.name: visitor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the person was a visitor (temporary access) rather than a regular employee or contractor. True if visitor, False if regular personnel.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Visitor Control

attributes.name: zone_classification
attributes.description: Security classification level of the zone: public (open access), restricted (controlled access), high security (limited personnel), or critical infrastructure (essential operations).
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part B - Security Zones
